~~~text
    1 | import {
    2 |   POWERUPS,
    3 |   canDropLife,
    4 |   type Pickup,
    5 |   type PowerupKind,
    6 | } from "./Powerups";
    7 | import { formation, waveSpeed, attackInterval } from "./Waves";
    8 | export interface Enemy {
    9 |   x: number;
   10 |   y: number;
   11 |   hp: number;
   12 |   kind: number;
   13 |   alive: boolean;
   14 |   maxHp?: number;
   15 |   phase?: number;
   16 |   charge?: number;
   17 |   drop?: PowerupKind;
   18 |   hit?: number;
   19 | }
   20 | export interface Projectile {
   21 |   x: number;
   22 |   y: number;
   23 |   previousX: number;
   24 |   previousY: number;
   25 |   vx: number;
   26 |   vy: number;
   27 |   enemy: boolean;
   28 |   active: boolean;
   29 |   damage: number;
   30 |   pierce: number;
   31 |   laser: boolean;
   32 |   hits: Enemy[];
   33 | }
   34 | export interface Burst {
   35 |   x: number;
   36 |   y: number;
   37 |   age: number;
   38 |   kind: "hit" | "kill" | "pickup";
   39 | }
   40 | /** Return the swept segment/box entry time, including diagonal fast shots. */
   41 | function contact(p: Projectile, x: number, y: number, rx: number, ry: number) {
   42 |   let low = 0,
   43 |     high = 1;
   44 |   // Avoid allocating axis arrays for every shot/enemy pair at 120 Hz.
   45 |   for (let axis = 0; axis < 2; axis++) {
   46 |     const start = axis === 0 ? p.previousX : p.previousY,
   47 |       delta = (axis === 0 ? p.x : p.y) - start,
   48 |       center = axis === 0 ? x : y,
   49 |       radius = axis === 0 ? rx : ry;
   50 |     if (Math.abs(delta) < 1e-8) {
   51 |       if (Math.abs(start - center) > radius) return Infinity;
   52 |       continue;
   53 |     }
   54 |     const a = (center - radius - start) / delta,
   55 |       b = (center + radius - start) / delta;
   56 |     low = Math.max(low, Math.min(a, b));
   57 |     high = Math.min(high, Math.max(a, b));
   58 |     if (low > high) return Infinity;
   59 |   }
   60 |   return low;
   61 | }
   62 | export class ShooterWorld {
   63 |   player = { x: 210, y: 599 };
   64 |   enemies: Enemy[] = [];
   65 |   projectiles: Projectile[] = Array.from({ length: 80 }, () => ({
   66 |     x: 0,
   67 |     y: 0,
   68 |     previousX: 0,
   69 |     previousY: 0,
   70 |     vx: 0,
   71 |     vy: 0,
   72 |     enemy: false,
   73 |     active: false,
   74 |     damage: 1,
   75 |     pierce: 1,
   76 |     laser: false,
   77 |     hits: [],
   78 |   }));
   79 |   pickups: Pickup[] = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, id) => ({
   80 |     id,
   81 |     x: 0,
   82 |     y: 0,
   83 |     kind: "spread",
   84 |     active: false,
   85 |     age: 0,
   86 |   }));
   87 |   bursts: Burst[] = [];
   88 |   score = 0;
   89 |   lives = 3;
   90 |   wave = 1;
   91 |   dead = false;
   92 |   invulnerable = 0;
   93 |   weaponLevel = 0;
   94 |   rapid = 0;
   95 |   laser = 0;
   96 |   drone = 0;
   97 |   shield = false;
   98 |   pickupSerial = 0;
   99 |   shotSerial = 0;
  100 |   kills = 0;
  101 |   elapsed = 0;
  102 |   announcement = { text: "", remaining: 0, kind: "spread" as PowerupKind };
  103 |   private direction = 1;
  104 |   private shotClock = 0;
  105 |   private enemyClock = 1.1;
  106 |   private nextWave = 0;
  107 |   private lastLife = -Infinity;
  108 |   private dropSerial = 0;
  109 |   private shotCount = 0;
  110 |   constructor(private random = Math.random) {
  111 |     this.spawnWave();
  112 |   }
  113 |   spawnWave() {
  114 |     this.enemies = formation(this.wave);
  115 |     this.direction = this.wave % 2 ? 1 : -1;
  116 |     this.enemyClock = 1.1;
  117 |     this.projectiles.forEach((p) => {
  118 |       p.active = false;
  119 |       p.hits.length = 0;
  120 |     });
  121 |     this.invulnerable = Math.max(this.invulnerable, 1.2);
  122 |   }
  123 |   get speed() {
  124 |     let killed = 0;
  125 |     for (const e of this.enemies) if (!e.alive) killed++;
  126 |     return waveSpeed(this.wave, killed);
  127 |   }
  128 |   get weaponName() {
  129 |     return this.laser > 0
  130 |       ? "PIERCING LASER"
  131 |       : ["BLASTER", "TWIN CANNON", "TRIPLE CANNON", "FIVE CANNON"][
  132 |           this.weaponLevel
  133 |         ];
  134 |   }
  135 |   private fire(x: number, y: number, enemy: boolean, vx = 0, vy?: number) {
  136 |     // Separate reservations prevent rapid/spread fire from suppressing enemy attacks.
  137 |     const start = enemy ? 52 : 0,
  138 |       end = enemy ? 80 : 52;
  139 |     let p: Projectile | undefined;
  140 |     for (let i = start; i < end; i++)
  141 |       if (!this.projectiles[i].active) {
  142 |         p = this.projectiles[i];
  143 |         break;
  144 |       }
  145 |     if (!p) return;
  146 |     Object.assign(p, {
  147 |       x,
  148 |       y,
  149 |       previousX: x,
  150 |       previousY: y,
  151 |       vx,
  152 |       vy: vy ?? (enemy ? Math.min(340, 155 + this.wave * 13) : -490),
  153 |       enemy,
  154 |       active: true,
  155 |       damage: !enemy && this.laser > 0 ? 2 : 1,
  156 |       pierce: !enemy && this.laser > 0 ? 3 : 1,
  157 |       laser: !enemy && this.laser > 0,
  158 |     });
  159 |     p.hits.length = 0;
  160 |   }
  161 |   private shoot() {
  162 |     const x = this.player.x,
  163 |       y = this.player.y - 19;
  164 |     this.fire(this.weaponLevel === 1 ? x - 7 : x, y, false);
  165 |     if (this.weaponLevel === 1) this.fire(x + 7, y, false);
  166 |     if (this.weaponLevel >= 2) {
  167 |       this.fire(x - 8, y + 3, false, -80);
  168 |       this.fire(x + 8, y + 3, false, 80);
  169 |     }
  170 |     if (this.weaponLevel >= 3) {
  171 |       this.fire(x - 13, y + 6, false, -145);
  172 |       this.fire(x + 13, y + 6, false, 145);
  173 |     }
  174 |     if (this.drone > 0 && this.shotCount++ % 2 === 0) {
  175 |       this.fire(Math.max(37, x - 29), y + 10, false);
  176 |       this.fire(Math.min(383, x + 29), y + 10, false);
  177 |     }
  178 |     this.shotSerial++;
  179 |   }
  180 |   private attack(e: Enemy) {
  181 |     const speed = Math.min(340, 155 + this.wave * 13);
  182 |     if (e.kind === 3 || e.kind === 5) {
  183 |       const dx = this.player.x - e.x,
  184 |         dy = this.player.y - e.y;
  185 |       const vx = Math.max(
  186 |         -speed * 0.6,
  187 |         Math.min(speed * 0.6, (dx / Math.hypot(dx, dy)) * speed),
  188 |       );
  189 |       this.fire(e.x, e.y + 15, true, vx, Math.sqrt(speed * speed - vx * vx));
  190 |       if (e.kind === 5)
  191 |         for (const offset of [-65, 65])
  192 |           this.fire(e.x, e.y + 15, true, vx + offset, speed * 0.88);
  193 |     } else if (e.kind === 1 && this.wave >= 2)
  194 |       for (const vx of [-55, 55]) this.fire(e.x, e.y + 14, true, vx);
  195 |     else this.fire(e.x, e.y + 14, true);
  196 |   }
  197 |   private drop(e: Enemy) {
  198 |     let kind = e.drop;
  199 |     if (
  200 |       e.kind === 4 &&
  201 |       canDropLife(this.wave, this.elapsed, this.lastLife, this.lives)
  202 |     )
  203 |       kind = "life";
  204 |     if (!kind && this.kills % 8 === 0) {
  205 |       const choices: PowerupKind[] = [
  206 |         "spread",
  207 |         "rapid",
  208 |         "shield",
  209 |         "drone",
  210 |         "laser",
  211 |       ];
  212 |       kind = choices[Math.min(4, Math.floor(this.random() * 5))];
  213 |     }
  214 |     if (!kind) return;
  215 |     if (kind === "life") this.lastLife = this.elapsed;
  216 |     const p =
  217 |       this.pickups.find((p) => !p.active) ??
  218 |       this.pickups
  219 |         .filter((p) => p.kind !== "life")
  220 |         .sort((a, b) => b.age - a.age)[0];
  221 |     if (p)
  222 |       Object.assign(p, {
  223 |         id: this.dropSerial++,
  224 |         kind,
  225 |         x: e.x,
  226 |         y: e.y,
  227 |         age: 0,
  228 |         active: true,
  229 |       });
  230 |   }
  231 |   private collect(p: Pickup) {
  232 |     p.active = false;
  233 |     this.pickupSerial++;
  234 |     const kind = p.kind === "life" && this.lives >= 4 ? "shield" : p.kind;
  235 |     if (kind === "spread") this.weaponLevel = Math.min(3, this.weaponLevel + 1);
  236 |     else if (kind === "shield") this.shield = true;
  237 |     else if (kind === "life") this.lives++;
  238 |     else this[kind] = Math.min(24, this[kind] + POWERUPS[kind].duration);
  239 |     this.announcement = {
  240 |       text:
  241 |         kind === "spread"
  242 |           ? this.weaponName
  243 |           : kind === "life" && this.lives === 4
  244 |             ? "+1 LIFE"
  245 |             : POWERUPS[kind].name,
  246 |       kind,
  247 |       remaining: 1.5,
  248 |     };
  249 |     this.effect(p.x, p.y, "pickup");
  250 |   }
  251 |   private effect(x: number, y: number, kind: Burst["kind"]) {
  252 |     if (this.bursts.length >= 24) this.bursts.shift();
  253 |     this.bursts.push({ x, y, kind, age: 0 });
  254 |   }
  255 |   private hurt() {
  256 |     if (this.invulnerable > 0) return;
  257 |     if (this.shield) {
  258 |       this.shield = false;
  259 |       this.invulnerable = 0.8;
  260 |       this.effect(this.player.x, this.player.y, "pickup");
  261 |       return;
  262 |     }
  263 |     this.lives--;
  264 |     this.weaponLevel = Math.max(0, this.weaponLevel - 1);
  265 |     this.invulnerable = 1.5;
  266 |     this.effect(this.player.x, this.player.y, "hit");
  267 |     if (this.lives <= 0) {
  268 |       this.dead = true;
  269 |       this.projectiles.forEach((p) => (p.active = false));
  270 |     }
  271 |   }
  272 |   step(dt: number, targetX: number, firing: boolean) {
  273 |     if (this.dead) return;
  274 |     this.elapsed += dt;
  275 |     this.invulnerable = Math.max(0, this.invulnerable - dt);
  276 |     for (const name of ["rapid", "laser", "drone"] as const)
  277 |       this[name] = Math.max(0, this[name] - dt);
  278 |     this.announcement.remaining = Math.max(0, this.announcement.remaining - dt);
  279 |     for (const b of this.bursts) b.age += dt;
  280 |     this.bursts = this.bursts.filter((b) => b.age < 0.45);
  281 |     this.player.x = Math.max(
  282 |       44,
  283 |       Math.min(
  284 |         376,
  285 |         this.player.x +
  286 |           Math.max(-370 * dt, Math.min(370 * dt, targetX - this.player.x)),
  287 |       ),
  288 |     );
  289 |     for (const p of this.pickups)
  290 |       if (p.active) {
  291 |         p.age += dt;
  292 |         p.y += 86 * dt;
  293 |         if (p.y > 450 && Math.abs(p.x - this.player.x) < 85)
  294 |           p.x += Math.max(-110 * dt, Math.min(110 * dt, this.player.x - p.x));
  295 |         if (
  296 |           Math.abs(p.x - this.player.x) < 24 &&
  297 |           Math.abs(p.y - this.player.y) < 25
  298 |         )
  299 |           this.collect(p);
  300 |         else if (p.y > 640 || p.age > 9) p.active = false;
  301 |       }
  302 |     this.shotClock -= dt;
  303 |     if (firing && this.shotClock <= 0 && !this.transitioning) {
  304 |       this.shoot();
  305 |       this.shotClock = this.rapid > 0 ? 0.11 : 0.23;
  306 |     }
  307 |     if (this.nextWave > 0) {
  308 |       this.nextWave -= dt;
  309 |       if (this.nextWave <= 0) {
  310 |         this.wave++;
  311 |         this.spawnWave();
  312 |       }
  313 |       return;
  314 |     }
  315 |     const living = this.enemies.filter((e) => e.alive),
  316 |       speed = this.speed;
  317 |     if (
  318 |       living.some(
  319 |         (e) =>
  320 |           e.x + this.direction * speed * dt < 43 ||
  321 |           e.x + this.direction * speed * dt > 377,
  322 |       )
  323 |     ) {
  324 |       this.direction *= -1;
  325 |       for (const e of living) e.y += 10;
  326 |     }
  327 |     for (const e of living) {
  328 |       const sway =
  329 |         e.kind === 1
  330 |           ? Math.sin(this.elapsed * 2 + (e.phase ?? 0)) -
  331 |             Math.sin((this.elapsed - dt) * 2 + (e.phase ?? 0))
  332 |           : 0;
  333 |       e.x = Math.max(
  334 |         42,
  335 |         Math.min(378, e.x + this.direction * speed * dt + sway * 9),
  336 |       );
  337 |       e.y += Math.min(1.2, 0.25 + this.wave * 0.06) * dt;
  338 |       e.hit = Math.max(0, (e.hit ?? 0) - dt);
  339 |       if ((e.charge ?? 0) > 0) {
  340 |         e.charge = Math.max(0, e.charge! - dt);
  341 |         if (e.charge === 0) this.attack(e);
  342 |       }
  343 |     }
  344 |     this.enemyClock -= dt;
  345 |     if (this.enemyClock <= 0 && living.length) {
  346 |       const front = living.filter(
  347 |         (e) =>
  348 |           !living.some(
  349 |             (other) => other.y > e.y + 15 && Math.abs(other.x - e.x) < 22,
  350 |           ),
  351 |       );
  352 |       const e =
  353 |         front[
  354 |           Math.min(front.length - 1, Math.floor(this.random() * front.length))
  355 |         ];
  356 |       if (e && !e.charge) e.charge = e.kind === 5 ? 0.55 : 0.38;
  357 |       this.enemyClock = attackInterval(this.wave);
  358 |     }
  359 |     for (const p of this.projectiles) {
  360 |       if (!p.active) continue;
  361 |       p.previousX = p.x;
  362 |       p.previousY = p.y;
  363 |       p.x += p.vx * dt;
  364 |       p.y += p.vy * dt;
  365 |       if (p.enemy) {
  366 |         if (
  367 |           this.invulnerable <= 0 &&
  368 |           contact(p, this.player.x, this.player.y, 17, 14) !== Infinity
  369 |         ) {
  370 |           p.active = false;
  371 |           this.hurt();
  372 |         }
  373 |       } else {
  374 |         for (let hit = 0; hit < 3 && p.active; hit++) {
  375 |           let target: Enemy | undefined,
  376 |             nearest = Infinity;
  377 |           for (const e of living)
  378 |             if (e.alive && !p.hits.includes(e)) {
  379 |               const t = contact(
  380 |                 p,
  381 |                 e.x,
  382 |                 e.y,
  383 |                 e.kind === 5 ? 25 : 17,
  384 |                 e.kind === 5 ? 17 : 13,
  385 |               );
  386 |               if (t < nearest) {
  387 |                 nearest = t;
  388 |                 target = e;
  389 |               }
  390 |             }
  391 |           if (!target) break;
  392 |           p.hits.push(target);
  393 |           p.pierce--;
  394 |           if (p.pierce <= 0) p.active = false;
  395 |           target.hp -= p.damage;
  396 |           target.hit = 0.09;
  397 |           this.effect(target.x, target.y, "hit");
  398 |           if (target.hp <= 0) {
  399 |             target.alive = false;
  400 |             this.kills++;
  401 |             this.score += 10 + target.kind * 5;
  402 |             this.drop(target);
  403 |             this.effect(target.x, target.y, "kill");
  404 |           }
  405 |         }
  406 |       }
  407 |       if (p.x < 26 || p.x > 394 || p.y < 116 || p.y > 646) p.active = false;
  408 |       if (this.dead) return;
  409 |     }
  410 |     if (living.some((e) => e.alive && e.y > 563)) {
  411 |       this.hurt();
  412 |       if (!this.dead) {
  413 |         this.spawnWave();
  414 |         this.player.x = 210;
  415 |       }
  416 |     } else if (!this.enemies.some((e) => e.alive)) {
  417 |       this.score += this.wave * 50;
  418 |       this.nextWave = 1.15;
  419 |       this.projectiles.forEach((p) => (p.active = false));
  420 |     }
  421 |   }
  422 |   get transitioning() {
  423 |     return this.nextWave > 0;
  424 |   }
  425 | }
~~~

## src/arcade/space-shooter/Waves.ts
SHA-256: f3100bebb5c5917738caee998f26a9332339450c1150de9b10bec5be1445260c
~~~text
    1 | import type { Enemy } from "./ShooterWorld";
    2 | import { waveReward } from "./Powerups";
    3 | export const waveSpeed = (wave: number, killed = 0) =>
    4 |   Math.min(130, 28 + wave * 6 + killed * 0.8);
    5 | export const attackInterval = (wave: number) =>
    6 |   Math.max(0.42, 1.4 - wave * 0.065);
    7 | export function formation(wave: number): Enemy[] {
    8 |   const enemies: Enemy[] = [],
    9 |     rows = Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor(wave / 2)),
   10 |     columns = wave % 4 === 0 ? 5 : 6;
   11 |   for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++)
   12 |     for (let c = 0; c < columns; c++) {
   13 |       const kind =
   14 |         r === 0 && c === Math.floor(columns / 2)
   15 |           ? 4
   16 |           : wave >= 3 && (r + c) % 5 === 0
   17 |             ? 3
   18 |             : wave >= 2 && (r + c) % 4 === 0
   19 |               ? 2
   20 |               : (r + c) % 2;
   21 |       const hp =
   22 |         kind === 2
   23 |           ? Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor(wave / 5))
   24 |           : kind === 4
   25 |             ? Math.min(4, 1 + Math.floor(wave / 4))
   26 |             : 1;
   27 |       enemies.push({
   28 |         x: columns === 5 ? 106 + c * 52 : 76 + c * 52,
   29 |         y: (wave % 4 === 0 ? 237 : 183) + r * 40,
   30 |         hp,
   31 |         maxHp: hp,
   32 |         kind,
   33 |         alive: true,
   34 |         phase: c * 0.9 + r * 0.5,
   35 |         charge: 0,
   36 |         drop: kind === 4 ? waveReward(wave) : undefined,
   37 |       });
   38 |     }
   39 |   if (wave % 4 === 0)
   40 |     enemies.push({
   41 |       x: 210,
   42 |       y: 190,
   43 |       hp: Math.min(22, 6 + wave * 2),
   44 |       maxHp: Math.min(22, 6 + wave * 2),
   45 |       kind: 5,
   46 |       alive: true,
   47 |       charge: 0,
   48 |       drop: "laser",
   49 |     });
   50 |   return enemies;
   51 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type { StorageManager } from "./StorageManager";
    2 | export class ArcadeScoreManager {
    3 |   constructor(private storage: StorageManager) {}
    4 |   best(id: string) {
    5 |     const data = this.storage.readRecord("pocket-rivals.arcade.v1") as Record<
    6 |       string,
    7 |       number
    8 |     > | null;
    9 |     const n = data?.[id];
   10 |     return typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0
   11 |       ? Math.floor(n)
   12 |       : 0;
   13 |   }
   14 |   record(id: string, score: number) {
   15 |     const old = this.storage.readRecord("pocket-rivals.arcade.v1");
   16 |     const data =
   17 |       old && typeof old === "object" && !Array.isArray(old)
   18 |         ? ({ ...old } as Record<string, number>)
   19 |         : {};
   20 |     const best = Math.max(this.best(id), Math.max(0, Math.floor(score)));
   21 |     data[id] = best;
   22 |     this.storage.writeRecord("pocket-rivals.arcade.v1", data);
   23 |     return best;
   24 |   }
   25 | }
~~~

## src/core/AudioManager.ts

~~~text
    1 | import type { StorageManager } from "./StorageManager";
    2 | export type Sound =
    3 |   | "tap"
    4 |   | "hit"
    5 |   | "goal"
    6 |   | "win"
    7 |   | "draw"
    8 |   | "start"
    9 |   | "countdown"
   10 |   | "pause"
   11 |   | "resume"
   12 |   | "fail"
   13 |   | "soft"
   14 |   | "metal"
   15 |   | "wood"
   16 |   | "shoot"
   17 |   | "fall"
   18 |   | "slide"
   19 |   | "capture"
   20 |   | "perfect"
   21 |   | "slice"
   22 |   | "thud"
   23 |   | "clockTick"
   24 |   | "clockStop";
   25 | /** Original procedural one-shots: created on demand, no soundtrack or audio downloads. */
   26 | const effects: Record<
   27 |   Sound,
   28 |   { notes: number[]; wave?: OscillatorType; duration?: number; gain?: number }
   29 | > = {
   30 |   slice: {
   31 |     notes: [2400, 1100],
   32 |     wave: "sawtooth",
   33 |     duration: 0.045,
   34 |     gain: 0.035,
   35 |   },
   36 |   thud: { notes: [110, 65], wave: "triangle", duration: 0.075, gain: 0.13 },
   37 |   clockTick: { notes: [1550], wave: "triangle", duration: 0.018, gain: 0.045 },
   38 |   clockStop: {
   39 |     notes: [820, 520],
   40 |     wave: "triangle",
   41 |     duration: 0.04,
   42 |     gain: 0.09,
   43 |   },
   44 |   tap: { notes: [480], duration: 0.055 },
   45 |   hit: { notes: [260], duration: 0.055 },
   46 |   goal: { notes: [440, 660] },
   47 |   win: { notes: [392, 494, 587, 784] },
   48 |   draw: { notes: [392, 330] },
   49 |   start: { notes: [330, 660], duration: 0.09 },
   50 |   countdown: { notes: [620], duration: 0.05 },
   51 |   pause: { notes: [400, 300], duration: 0.045 },
   52 |   resume: { notes: [300, 400], duration: 0.045 },
   53 |   fail: { notes: [180, 110], wave: "triangle", duration: 0.12 },
   54 |   soft: { notes: [170], duration: 0.055, gain: 0.06 },
   55 |   metal: { notes: [890, 1270], wave: "triangle", duration: 0.07 },
   56 |   wood: { notes: [140, 90], wave: "triangle", duration: 0.045 },
   57 |   shoot: { notes: [720], wave: "triangle", duration: 0.06 },
   58 |   fall: { notes: [330], duration: 0.13 },
   59 |   slide: { notes: [140], duration: 0.08, gain: 0.035 },
   60 |   capture: { notes: [500, 750], duration: 0.065 },
   61 |   perfect: { notes: [660, 880, 1100], duration: 0.09 },
   62 | };
   63 | export class AudioManager {
   64 |   private ctx?: AudioContext;
   65 |   private master?: GainNode;
   66 |   private voices = new Set<OscillatorNode>();
   67 |   private last = new Map<Sound, number>();
   68 |   constructor(private storage: StorageManager) {}
   69 |   unlock() {
   70 |     try {
   71 |       if (!this.ctx) {
   72 |         this.ctx = new AudioContext();
   73 |         this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
   74 |         this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
   75 |       }
   76 |       this.syncSettings();
   77 |       if (this.ctx.state === "suspended")
   78 |         void this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
   79 |     } catch {
   80 |       /* Optional audio must never block input. */
   81 |     }
   82 |   }
   83 |   syncSettings() {
   84 |     if (this.master && this.ctx)
   85 |       this.master.gain.setValueAtTime(
   86 |         this.storage.data.sound ? this.storage.data.volume : 0,
   87 |         this.ctx.currentTime,
   88 |       );
   89 |   }
   90 |   play(kind: Sound, strength = 1) {
   91 |     if (!this.storage.data.sound || this.storage.data.volume <= 0) return;
   92 |     this.unlock();
   93 |     const ctx = this.ctx;
   94 |     if (!ctx || ctx.state !== "running" || !this.master) return;
   95 |     const t = ctx.currentTime;
   96 |     if (t - (this.last.get(kind) ?? -1) < (kind === "slide" ? 0.12 : 0.04))
   97 |       return;
   98 |     this.last.set(kind, t);
   99 |     const e = effects[kind];
  100 |     for (const [i, hz] of e.notes.entries()) {
  101 |       if (this.voices.size >= 10) break;
  102 |       const oscillator = ctx.createOscillator(),
  103 |         gain = ctx.createGain(),
  104 |         at = t + i * 0.065,
  105 |         duration = e.duration ?? 0.13;
  106 |       this.voices.add(oscillator);
  107 |       oscillator.type = e.wave ?? "sine";
  108 |       oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz, at);
  109 |       oscillator.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(
  110 |         hz * 0.72,
  111 |         at + duration,
  112 |       );
  113 |       gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, at);
  114 |       gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(
  115 |         (e.gain ?? 0.1) * Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, strength)),
  116 |         at + 0.004,
  117 |       );
  118 |       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, at + duration);
  119 |       oscillator.connect(gain);
  120 |       gain.connect(this.master);
  121 |       oscillator.onended = () => {
  122 |         oscillator.disconnect();
  123 |         gain.disconnect();
  124 |         this.voices.delete(oscillator);
  125 |       };
  126 |       oscillator.start(at);
  127 |       oscillator.stop(at + duration + 0.01);
  128 |     }
  129 |   }
  130 |   private stop() {
  131 |     this.voices.forEach((v) => {
  132 |       try {
  133 |         v.stop();
  134 |       } catch {}
  135 |     });
  136 |     this.voices.clear();
  137 |   }
  138 |   suspend() {
  139 |     this.stop();
  140 |     if (this.ctx?.state === "running") void this.ctx.suspend().catch(() => {});
  141 |   }
  142 |   dispose() {
  143 |     this.stop();
  144 |     void this.ctx?.close().catch(() => {});
  145 |   }
  146 |   get activeVoices() {
  147 |     return this.voices.size;
  148 |   }
  149 | }
~~~

## src/core/Diagnostics.ts
SHA-256: f4e56f184e956310b766345c33d794d862ebf887ba763fcf9dd5147d9024e231
~~~text
    1 | /** Development-only observer; no timers, extra animation loop, or production telemetry. */
    2 | export class Diagnostics {
    3 |   private panel?: HTMLElement;
    4 |   private frames = 0;
    5 |   private seconds = 0;
    6 |   private frameMs = 0;
    7 |   private fps = 0;
    8 |   private initializations: Record<string, number> = {};
    9 |   private modules = new Set<string>();
   10 |   private ai = 0;
   11 |   private aiMax = 0;
   12 |   constructor() {
   13 |     if (
   14 |       import.meta.env.DEV &&
   15 |       new URLSearchParams(location.search).has("diagnostics")
   16 |     ) {
   17 |       this.panel = document.createElement("pre");
   18 |       this.panel.className = "diagnostics";
   19 |       document.body.append(this.panel);
   20 |     }
   21 |   }
   22 |   loaded(id: string) {
   23 |     this.modules.add(id);
   24 |   }
   25 |   initialized(id: string, ms: number) {
   26 |     this.initializations[id] = ms;
   27 |   }
   28 |   computation(ms: number) {
   29 |     this.ai = ms;
   30 |     this.aiMax = Math.max(ms, this.aiMax);
   31 |   }
   32 |   frame(dt: number, scenes: number, assets: number) {
   33 |     if (!this.panel) return;
   34 |     this.frames++;
   35 |     this.seconds += dt;
   36 |     this.frameMs = this.frameMs * 0.9 + dt * 100;
   37 |     if (this.seconds < 0.5) return;
   38 |     this.fps = this.frames / this.seconds;
   39 |     const memory = (
   40 |       performance as Performance & { memory?: { usedJSHeapSize: number } }
   41 |     ).memory;
   42 |     this.panel.textContent = `${Math.round(this.frames / this.seconds)} FPS · ${this.frameMs.toFixed(1)} ms\nScenes ${scenes} · textures ${assets}\nHeap ${memory ? (memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " MB" : "unavailable"}\nAI ${this.ai.toFixed(1)} ms · max ${this.aiMax.toFixed(1)}\nLoaded: ${[...this.modules].join(", ")}\nInit: ${Object.entries(
   43 |       this.initializations,
   44 |     )
   45 |       .map(([id, t]) => id + " " + t.toFixed(0) + "ms")
   46 |       .join(", ")}`;
   47 |     this.frames = 0;
   48 |     this.seconds = 0;
   49 |   }
   50 |   snapshot() {
   51 |     return {
   52 |       fps: this.fps,
   53 |       frameMs: this.frameMs,
   54 |       modules: [...this.modules],
   55 |       initializations: { ...this.initializations },
   56 |       aiMs: this.ai,
   57 |       aiMaxMs: this.aiMax,
   58 |     };
   59 |   }
   60 |   dispose() {
   61 |     this.panel?.remove();
   62 |   }
   63 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type {

    3 |   MatchOptions,

    5 | } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    6 | import { modulePath } from "./GameRegistry";
    7 | const modules = import.meta.glob<GameExports>([
    8 |   "../games/*/index.ts",

   10 | ]);
   11 | async function exportsFor(id: string) {

   15 | }

   18 | }
   19 | export async function loadTutorial(
   20 |   id: string,
   21 |   variant: string,
   22 |   ui: TutorialUI,
   23 | ) {
   24 |   await (await exportsFor(id)).tutorial?.(variant, ui);
~~~

~~~text
  179 |     const rect = document.querySelector("#game-stage")!.getBoundingClientRect();

  275 |     this.state = "results";

  277 |     this.audio.play("win");
  278 |     this.modal.show(
  279 |       `<div class="eyebrow">ONE MORE GO?</div><h2 id="dialog-title">${getGame(this.active!.gameId).name}</h2><div class="arcade-result-score">${score}</div><p>${detail}<br>Personal best <b>${best}</b></p><button class="primary-button" data-action="rematch">Play again →</button><button class="text-button" data-action="menu">${getGame(this.active!.gameId).category === "arcade" ? "Back to Arcade" : "Back to all games"}</button>`,
  280 |       {
  281 |         rematch: () => void this.play(this.active!.gameId),
  282 |         menu: () => this.goMenu(),
  283 |       },
  284 |       "result-modal",
  285 |       () => this.goMenu(),
  286 |     );
  287 |   }
  288 |   pause(reason = "pause") {
  289 |     if (this.state !== "playing" && this.state !== "loading") return;
  290 |     this.host.pauseGame();
  291 |     this.state = "paused";
  292 |     this.audio.play("tap");
  293 |     this.modal.show(
  294 |       `<div class="pause-symbol">Ⅱ</div><div class="eyebrow">TAKE YOUR TIME</div><h2 id="dialog-title">${reason === "leave" ? "A little timeout?" : "Rivalry on hold."}</h2><p>${getGame(this.active!.gameId).instructions}</p><button class="primary-button" data-action="resume">Keep playing →</button><button class="secondary-button" data-action="restart">Start a fresh match</button><button class="text-button" data-action="menu">${this.token ? "Save & return to menu" : "Back to all games"}</button>`,
  295 |       {
  296 |         resume: () => this.resume(),
  297 |         restart: () => this.restart(),
  298 |         menu: () => this.goMenu(),
  299 |       },
  300 |       "",
  301 |       () => this.resume(),
  302 |     );
  303 |   }
  304 |   private restart() {
  305 |     if (this.token) {
  306 |       const round = this.tournament.restartRound();
  307 |       if (round)
  308 |         void this.play(
  309 |           round.spec.gameId,
  310 |           round.spec.options,
  311 |           undefined,
  312 |           round.token,
  313 |         );
  314 |     } else if (this.active)
  315 |       void this.play(this.active.gameId, this.active.options);
  316 |   }
  317 |   private resume() {
  318 |     this.modal.close();
  319 |     this.audio.unlock();
  320 |     this.state = "playing";
  321 |     this.host.resumeGame();
  322 |   }
  323 |   private background() {
  324 |     if (this.state === "playing" || this.state === "loading") this.pause();
  325 |     this.audio.suspend();
  326 |     this.host.controls?.clear();
  327 |   }
  328 |   back() {
  329 |     if (this.state === "playing" || this.state === "loading")
  330 |       this.pause("leave");
  331 |     else if (this.modal.isOpen) this.modal.back();
  332 |     else this.goMenu();
  333 |   }
  334 |   goMenu() {
  335 |     this.run++;
  336 |     this.transition.hidden = true;
  337 |     this.modal.close();
  338 |     this.game.scene.stop("GameHost");
  339 |     this.game.loop.sleep();
  340 |     this.active = null;
  341 |     this.token = null;
  342 |     this.state = "menu";
  343 |     document.querySelector("#app")!.classList.remove("in-game");
  344 |     this.menuRoot.hidden = false;
  345 |     this.menu.render();
  346 |   }
  347 |   refreshMenu() {
  348 |     this.menu.render();
  349 |   }
  350 |   openTournament() {
  351 |     if (this.tournament.state) this.showTournament();
  352 |     else this.tournamentView.setup();
  353 |   }
  354 |   newTournament() {
  355 |     this.tournamentView.setup();
  356 |   }
  357 |   showTournament() {
  358 |     this.goMenu();
  359 |     this.tournamentView.show();
  360 |   }
  361 |   startTournamentRound() {
  362 |     const round = this.tournament.startRound();
  363 |     if (!round) return;
  364 |     try {
  365 |       const meta = getGame(round.spec.gameId);
  366 |       if (meta.category === "arcade" || meta.tournament === false)
  367 |         throw Error("This game is unavailable in tournaments");
  368 |       void this.play(
  369 |         round.spec.gameId,
  370 |         round.spec.options,
  371 |         round.checkpoint,
  372 |         round.token,
  373 |       );
  374 |     } catch (error) {
  375 |       this.showError(error);
  376 |     }
  377 |   }
  378 |   toggleSound() {
  379 |     this.storage.data.sound = !this.storage.data.sound;
  380 |     this.audio.syncSettings();
  381 |     this.storage.save();
  382 |     this.audio.play("tap");
  383 |   }
  384 |   settings() {
  385 |     new Settings(this).show();
  386 |   }
  387 |   showError(error: unknown) {
  388 |     this.transition.hidden = true;
  389 |     console.error(error);
  390 |     this.host.pauseGame();
  391 |     this.modal.show(
  392 |       '<h2 id="dialog-title">That game took a break.</h2><p>Return to the collection and try again.</p><button class="primary-button" data-action="menu">Back to games</button>',
  393 |       { menu: () => this.goMenu() },
  394 |       "",
  395 |       () => this.goMenu(),
  396 |     );
  397 |   }
  398 |   snapshot() {
  399 |     return {
  400 |       state: this.state,
  401 |       diagnostics: this.diagnostics.snapshot(),
  402 |       saved: structuredClone(this.storage.data),
  403 |       tournament: structuredClone(this.tournament.state),
  404 |       scene: this.host.snapshot(),
  405 |     };
  406 |   }
  407 |   dispose() {

  409 |     this.audio.dispose();
  410 |     this.diagnostics.dispose();
~~~

## src/core/GameRegistry.ts
SHA-256: cab8cad0bf77ee75bb5fa386a0f9344ceba608b1584160e3c2b52b852f15498c
~~~text
    1 | import type { GameMetadata } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    2 | const configs = import.meta.glob<{ default: GameMetadata }>(
    3 |   ["../games/*/config.ts", "../arcade/*/config.ts"],
    4 |   { eager: true },
    5 | );
    6 | const entries = Object.entries(configs).map(([path, m]) => ({
    7 |   path: path.replace("/config.ts", "/index.ts"),
    8 |   metadata: m.default,
    9 | }));
   10 | export const games = entries
   11 |   .map((e) => e.metadata)
   12 |   .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
   13 | const ids = new Set<string>();
   14 | for (const game of games) {
   15 |   if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(game.id) || ids.has(game.id))
   16 |     throw Error(`Invalid/duplicate game ID: ${game.id}`);
   17 |   ids.add(game.id);
   18 | }
   19 | export function getGame(id: string) {
   20 |   const game = games.find((g) => g.id === id);
   21 |   if (!game) throw Error(`Unknown game: ${id}`);
   22 |   return game;
   23 | }
   24 | export function modulePath(id: string) {
   25 |   const entry = entries.find((e) => e.metadata.id === id);
   26 |   if (!entry) throw Error(`Unknown game: ${id}`);
   27 |   return entry.path;
   28 | }
   29 | 
   30 | export const tournamentGames = games.filter(
   31 |   (g) => g.category !== "arcade" && g.tournament !== false,
   32 | );
~~~

## src/core/InputManager.ts
SHA-256: 4bae021c280b1857a5c167968867d803e7e515985fd420bb6d7da71530af70c9
~~~text
    1 | import Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import { FIELD } from "./ThemeManager";
    3 | import type { Player } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    4 | export interface TouchPoint {
    5 |   x: number;
    6 |   y: number;
    7 |   down: boolean;
    8 |   id: number | null;
    9 | }
   10 | /** Scene-owned subscriptions. Each half owns at most one pointer, never a global activePointer. */
   11 | export class InputManager {
   12 |   readonly players: [TouchPoint, TouchPoint] = [
   13 |     { x: 210, y: 600, down: false, id: null },
   14 |     { x: 210, y: 160, down: false, id: null },
   15 |   ];
   16 |   private cleanups: (() => void)[] = [];
   17 |   private enabled = true;
   18 |   private clearHandlers: (() => void)[] = [];
   19 |   constructor(private scene: Phaser.Scene) {}
   20 |   dragHalves() {
   21 |     const down = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   22 |       const pos = this.scene.cameras.main.getWorldPoint(p.x, p.y);
   23 |       if (
   24 |         !this.enabled ||
   25 |         pos.y < FIELD.top ||
   26 |         pos.y > FIELD.bottom ||
   27 |         pos.x < FIELD.left ||
   28 |         pos.x > FIELD.right
   29 |       )
   30 |         return;
   31 |       const player = this.players[pos.y >= FIELD.middle ? 0 : 1];
   32 |       if (player.id !== null) return;
   33 |       player.id = p.id;
   34 |       player.down = true;
   35 |       player.x = pos.x;
   36 |       player.y = pos.y;
   37 |     };
   38 |     const move = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   39 |       if (!this.enabled) return;
   40 |       const pos = this.scene.cameras.main.getWorldPoint(p.x, p.y);
   41 |       const player = this.players.find((v) => v.id === p.id);
   42 |       if (player) {
   43 |         player.x = pos.x;
   44 |         player.y = pos.y;
   45 |       }
   46 |     };
   47 |     const up = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   48 |       const player = this.players.find((v) => v.id === p.id);
   49 |       if (player) {
   50 |         player.down = false;
   51 |         player.id = null;
   52 |       }
   53 |     };
   54 |     this.on("pointerdown", down);
   55 |     this.on("pointermove", move);
   56 |     this.on("pointerup", up);
   57 |     this.on("pointerupoutside", up);
   58 |     const cancel = () => this.clear();
   59 |     this.scene.game.canvas.addEventListener("touchcancel", cancel);
   60 |     this.scene.game.canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", cancel);
   61 |     this.cleanups.push(() => {
   62 |       this.scene.game.canvas.removeEventListener("touchcancel", cancel);
   63 |       this.scene.game.canvas.removeEventListener("pointercancel", cancel);
   64 |     });
   65 |   }
   66 |   tap(fn: (x: number, y: number, player: Player) => void) {
   67 |     this.on("pointerdown", (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   68 |       if (this.enabled) {
   69 |         const pos = this.scene.cameras.main.getWorldPoint(p.x, p.y);
   70 |         fn(pos.x, pos.y, pos.y >= FIELD.middle ? 1 : 2);
   71 |       }
   72 |     });
   73 |   }
   74 |   drag(
   75 |     start: (x: number, y: number) => boolean,
   76 |     move: (x: number, y: number) => void,
   77 |     end: (x: number, y: number) => void,
   78 |     cancel: () => void = () => {},
   79 |   ) {
   80 |     let id: number | null = null;
   81 |     const point = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) =>
   82 |       this.scene.cameras.main.getWorldPoint(p.x, p.y);
   83 |     this.on("pointerdown", (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   84 |       if (!this.enabled || id !== null) return;
   85 |       const v = point(p);
   86 |       if (start(v.x, v.y)) id = p.id;
   87 |     });
   88 |     this.on("pointermove", (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   89 |       if (this.enabled && p.id === id) {
   90 |         const v = point(p);
   91 |         move(v.x, v.y);
   92 |       }
   93 |     });
   94 |     const up = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   95 |       if (p.id !== id) return;
   96 |       id = null;
   97 |       if (this.enabled) {
   98 |         const v = point(p);
   99 |         end(v.x, v.y);
  100 |       }
  101 |     };
  102 |     this.on("pointerup", up);
  103 |     this.on("pointerupoutside", up);
  104 |     const clear = () => {
  105 |       id = null;
  106 |       cancel();
  107 |     };
  108 |     this.clearHandlers.push(clear);
  109 |     this.scene.game.canvas.addEventListener("touchcancel", clear);
  110 |     this.scene.game.canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", clear);
  111 |     this.cleanups.push(() => {
  112 |       this.scene.game.canvas.removeEventListener("touchcancel", clear);
  113 |       this.scene.game.canvas.removeEventListener("pointercancel", clear);
  114 |     });
  115 |   }
  116 |   press(codes: string[], callback: (code: string) => void) {
  117 |     const keyboard = this.scene.input.keyboard;
  118 |     if (!keyboard) return;
  119 |     const handler = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  120 |       if (this.enabled && !event.repeat && codes.includes(event.code)) {
  121 |         event.preventDefault();
  122 |         callback(event.code);
  123 |       }
  124 |     };
  125 |     keyboard.on("keydown", handler);
  126 |     this.cleanups.push(() => keyboard.off("keydown", handler));
  127 |   }
  128 |   keys(codes: string[]) {
  129 |     const held = new Set<string>(),
  130 |       keyboard = this.scene.input.keyboard;
  131 |     if (!keyboard) return held;
  132 |     const down = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
  133 |         if (this.enabled && codes.includes(e.code)) {
  134 |           e.preventDefault();
  135 |           held.add(e.code);
  136 |         }
  137 |       },
  138 |       up = (e: KeyboardEvent) => held.delete(e.code);
  139 |     keyboard.on("keydown", down);
  140 |     keyboard.on("keyup", up);
  141 |     this.cleanups.push(() => {
  142 |       keyboard.off("keydown", down);
  143 |       keyboard.off("keyup", up);
  144 |     });
  145 |     this.clearHandlers.push(() => held.clear());
  146 |     return held;
  147 |   }
  148 |   private on(event: string, handler: (...args: any[]) => void) {
  149 |     this.scene.input.on(event, handler);
  150 |     this.cleanups.push(() => this.scene.input.off(event, handler));
  151 |   }
  152 |   clear() {
  153 |     this.clearHandlers.forEach((fn) => fn());
  154 |     this.players.forEach((p) => {
  155 |       p.down = false;
  156 |       p.id = null;
  157 |     });
  158 |   }
  159 |   pause() {
  160 |     this.enabled = false;
  161 |     this.clear();
  162 |   }
  163 |   resume() {
  164 |     this.enabled = true;
  165 |     this.clear();
  166 |   }
  167 |   dispose() {
  168 |     this.pause();
  169 |     this.cleanups.splice(0).forEach((fn) => fn());
  170 |     this.clearHandlers = [];
  171 |   }
  172 |   get listenerCount() {
  173 |     return this.cleanups.length;
  174 |   }
  175 | }
~~~

## src/core/OfflineManager.ts

~~~text
    1 | /** Explicit web download; Capacitor already packages all registered modules. */
    2 | export async function downloadCollection() {
    3 |   const controller = navigator.serviceWorker?.controller;
    4 |   if (!controller) throw Error("Offline caching is not ready");
    5 |   return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    6 |     const channel = new MessageChannel(),
    7 |       timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    8 |         channel.port1.close();
    9 |         reject(Error("Download timed out"));
   10 |       }, 60000);
   11 |     channel.port1.onmessage = ({ data }) => {
   12 |       clearTimeout(timeout);
   13 |       channel.port1.close();
   14 |       if (data.ok) resolve();
   15 |       else reject(Error("Download failed"));
   16 |     };
   17 |     controller.postMessage({ type: "CACHE_ALL" }, [channel.port2]);
   18 |   });
   19 | }
~~~

## src/core/StorageManager.ts
SHA-256: bb0f468bb78d7e43ea8a5deafbbacbc9f808756036cf31c5055564fc2f3a4e9c
~~~text
    1 | export interface SavedData {
    2 |   version: 1;
    3 |   sound: boolean;
    4 |   music: boolean; // Legacy field retained for saved-data compatibility; no music is played.
    5 |   volume: number;
    6 |   wins: [number, number];
    7 |   draws: number;
    8 |   rounds: number;
    9 | }
   10 | const defaults = (): SavedData => ({
   11 |   version: 1,
   12 |   sound: true,
   13 |   music: false,
   14 |   volume: 0.75,
   15 |   wins: [0, 0],
   16 |   draws: 0,
   17 |   rounds: 0,
   18 | });
   19 | const count = (v: unknown) =>
   20 |   typeof v === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= 0 ? v : 0;
   21 | export class StorageManager {
   22 |   static key = "pocket-rivals.v1";
   23 |   data: SavedData = defaults();
   24 |   persistent = true;
   25 |   private records = new Map<string, string>();
   26 |   constructor(
   27 |     private storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem"> | undefined,
   28 |   ) {
   29 |     this.persistent = !!storage;
   30 |     try {
   31 |       const raw = storage?.getItem(StorageManager.key);
   32 |       if (raw) {
   33 |         const d = JSON.parse(raw);
   34 |         if (d?.version === 1)
   35 |           this.data = {
   36 |             version: 1,
   37 |             sound: typeof d.sound === "boolean" ? d.sound : true,
   38 |             music: false,
   39 |             volume:
   40 |               typeof d.volume === "number" && Number.isFinite(d.volume)
   41 |                 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, d.volume))
   42 |                 : 0.75,
   43 |             wins: [count(d.wins?.[0]), count(d.wins?.[1])],
   44 |             draws: count(d.draws),
   45 |             rounds: count(d.rounds),
   46 |           };
   47 |       }
   48 |     } catch {
   49 |       this.persistent = false;
   50 |     }
   51 |   }
   52 |   save() {
   53 |     try {
   54 |       if (!this.storage) throw Error("Storage unavailable");
   55 |       this.storage.setItem(StorageManager.key, JSON.stringify(this.data));
   56 |     } catch {
   57 |       this.persistent = false;
   58 |     }
   59 |   }
   60 |   readRecord(key: string): unknown {
   61 |     try {
   62 |       const raw = this.records.get(key) ?? this.storage?.getItem(key);
   63 |       return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
   64 |     } catch {
   65 |       return null;
   66 |     }
   67 |   }
   68 |   writeRecord(key: string, value: unknown) {
   69 |     this.records.set(key, JSON.stringify(value));
   70 |     try {
   71 |       if (!this.storage) throw Error("unavailable");
   72 |       this.storage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
   73 |     } catch {
   74 |       this.persistent = false;
   75 |     }
   76 |   }
   77 |   resetScores() {
   78 |     this.data.wins = [0, 0];
   79 |     this.data.draws = 0;
   80 |     this.data.rounds = 0;
   81 |     this.save();
   82 |   }
   83 | }
~~~

## src/core/TournamentManager.ts
SHA-256: c9c19f188e57b017a3943de2c120531badc7df8c4201716270c76e3f1af687da
~~~text
    1 | import type { GameResult, MatchSpec } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    2 | import type { StorageManager } from "./StorageManager";
    3 | export interface TournamentState {
    4 |   version: 1;
    5 |   id: string;
    6 |   phase: "between" | "playing" | "complete";
    7 |   plan: MatchSpec[];
    8 |   results: GameResult[];
    9 |   points: [number, number];
   10 |   attempt: number;
   11 |   token: string | null;
   12 |   checkpoint?: unknown;
   13 | }
   14 | const KEY = "pocket-rivals.tournament.v1";
   15 | export function shuffledSchedule(
   16 |   choices: MatchSpec[],
   17 |   rounds: number,
   18 |   random = Math.random,
   19 | ) {
   20 |   if (!choices.length || !Number.isInteger(rounds) || rounds < 1 || rounds > 25)
   21 |     throw Error("Choose games and 1–25 rounds.");
   22 |   const plan: MatchSpec[] = [];
   23 |   while (plan.length < rounds) {
   24 |     const bag = [...choices];
   25 |     for (let i = bag.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   26 |       const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
   27 |       [bag[i], bag[j]] = [bag[j], bag[i]];
   28 |     }
   29 |     plan.push(...bag.slice(0, rounds - plan.length));
   30 |   }
   31 |   return structuredClone(plan);
   32 | }
   33 | export class TournamentManager {
   34 |   state: TournamentState | null = null;
   35 |   constructor(private storage: StorageManager) {
   36 |     this.state = this.restore(storage.readRecord(KEY));
   37 |   }
   38 |   private restore(data: unknown): TournamentState | null {
   39 |     const d = data as TournamentState;
   40 |     if (
   41 |       !d ||
   42 |       d.version !== 1 ||
   43 |       typeof d.id !== "string" ||
   44 |       !Array.isArray(d.plan) ||
   45 |       d.plan.length < 1 ||
   46 |       d.plan.length > 25 ||
   47 |       !Array.isArray(d.results) ||
   48 |       d.results.length > d.plan.length ||
   49 |       !["between", "playing", "complete"].includes(d.phase) ||
   50 |       !Number.isSafeInteger(d.attempt) ||
   51 |       d.attempt < 0
   52 |     )
   53 |       return null;
   54 |     if (
   55 |       !d.plan.every(
   56 |         (m) =>
   57 |           typeof m?.gameId === "string" &&
   58 |           ["local", "ai"].includes(m.options?.mode) &&
   59 |           ["medium", "hard", "impossible"].includes(m.options?.difficulty),
   60 |       )
   61 |     )
   62 |       return null;
   63 |     if (
   64 |       !d.results.every(
   65 |         (r) =>
   66 |           [1, 2, "draw"].includes(r?.winner) &&
   67 |           Array.isArray(r.scores) &&
   68 |           r.scores.length === 2 &&
   69 |           r.scores.every((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0),
   70 |       )
   71 |     )
   72 |       return null;
   73 |     if ((d.phase === "complete") !== (d.results.length === d.plan.length))
   74 |       return null;
   75 |     if (
   76 |       d.phase === "playing" &&
   77 |       d.token !== `${d.id}:${d.results.length}:${d.attempt}`
   78 |     )
   79 |       return null;
   80 |     d.points = [0, 0];
   81 |     for (const r of d.results) this.addPoints(d, r);
   82 |     return d;
   83 |   }
   84 |   private persist() {
   85 |     this.storage.writeRecord(KEY, this.state);
   86 |   }
   87 |   create(plan: MatchSpec[]) {
   88 |     if (!plan.length || plan.length > 25)
   89 |       throw Error("Invalid tournament length");
   90 |     this.state = {
   91 |       version: 1,
   92 |       id: crypto.randomUUID(),
   93 |       phase: "between",
   94 |       plan: structuredClone(plan),
   95 |       results: [],
   96 |       points: [0, 0],
   97 |       attempt: 0,
   98 |       token: null,
   99 |     };
  100 |     this.persist();
  101 |   }
  102 |   current() {
  103 |     const s = this.state;
  104 |     if (!s || s.phase === "complete") return null;
  105 |     return s.plan[s.results.length];
  106 |   }
  107 |   startRound() {
  108 |     const s = this.state;
  109 |     if (!s || s.phase === "complete") return null;
  110 |     if (s.phase === "between") {
  111 |       s.phase = "playing";
  112 |       s.token = `${s.id}:${s.results.length}:${s.attempt}`;
  113 |       this.persist();
  114 |     }
  115 |     return { spec: this.current()!, token: s.token!, checkpoint: s.checkpoint };
  116 |   }
  117 |   restartRound() {
  118 |     const s = this.state;
  119 |     if (!s || s.phase !== "playing") return null;
  120 |     s.attempt++;
  121 |     s.phase = "between";
  122 |     s.token = null;
  123 |     delete s.checkpoint;
  124 |     return this.startRound();
  125 |   }
  126 |   checkpoint(token: string, data: unknown) {
  127 |     const s = this.state;
  128 |     if (s?.phase !== "playing" || s.token !== token) return false;
  129 |     s.checkpoint = data;
  130 |     this.persist();
  131 |     return true;
  132 |   }
  133 |   finish(token: string, result: GameResult) {
  134 |     const s = this.state;
  135 |     if (!s || s.phase !== "playing" || s.token !== token) return false;
  136 |     s.results.push(structuredClone(result));
  137 |     this.addPoints(s, result);
  138 |     s.phase = s.results.length === s.plan.length ? "complete" : "between";
  139 |     s.token = null;
  140 |     delete s.checkpoint;
  141 |     this.persist();
  142 |     return true;
  143 |   }
  144 |   private addPoints(s: TournamentState, r: GameResult) {
  145 |     if (r.winner === "draw") {
  146 |       s.points[0] += 0.5;
  147 |       s.points[1] += 0.5;
  148 |     } else s.points[r.winner - 1]++;
  149 |   }
  150 |   rematch() {
  151 |     if (this.state) this.create(this.state.plan);
  152 |   }
  153 |   clear() {
  154 |     this.state = null;
  155 |     this.persist();
  156 |   }
  157 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/README.md
SHA-256: 4ded60daed3a27e39f380be17fe37513bb997a42d61217643d44e30edd004d9b
~~~text
    1 | # Future games
    2 | 
    3 | Flappy Jump (`flappy-jump`), Car Duel (`car-duel`), Archery Duel (`archery-duel`) and Chicken Jump (`chicken-jump`) are paused projects, preserved intact with their assets, metadata, AI, rules and module instructions.
    4 | 
    5 | This directory is intentionally outside `GameRegistry` and `GameLoader` discovery. These games do not appear in Quick Play or tournament selection, and their implementations/assets are not bundled. Existing stored records and IDs are not deleted. An old tournament containing a deferred game can be replaced through New tournament; an unavailable saved round cannot launch.
    6 | 
    7 | To reactivate a game, move its entire folder back into `src/games/` and rebuild. Relative imports retain the same depth; no core edits are needed. Unit tests remain active under `tests/unit` and reference this directory. Restore its saved browser spec from `tests/future/` to `tests/browser/` when the game returns, then run tests, build and module/bundle checks.
~~~

## src/future-games/archery-duel/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: e51c3cc2900024b8c2eb500a6525e5adfe7a290759aec0ed2e7c94f10f85a714
~~~text
    1 | # Archery Duel
    2 | Three-tap state machine, 120ms lock debounce, 175-unit/second reflected crosshair. Impact after 380ms awards 1/2 points using exact visible circle radii; first to ten, 180-second cap. Per-attempt targets are shared seeded data, independently consumed by players. AI locks the same moving crosshair, never supplies a fabricated hit. All objects are scene-owned. No reference PDF supplied; written specification is authoritative.
~~~

## src/future-games/archery-duel/AI.ts
SHA-256: 3ae43ecab1dda2dee1f36e37b811b5a24f3dc538ea11d5345fa1460e34993616
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { ArcheryMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class ArcheryAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private attempt = -1;
    7 |   private x = 0;
    8 |   private y = 0;
    9 |   private readyDelay = 0;
   10 |   constructor(
   11 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   12 |     seed?: number,
   13 |   ) {
   14 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   15 |   }
   16 |   update(m: ArcheryMatch) {
   17 |     if (m.winner) return false;
   18 |     const p = m.players[1],
   19 |       r = this.personality;
   20 |     if (this.attempt !== p.attempt) {
   21 |       this.attempt = p.attempt;
   22 |       const target =
   23 |           p.targets[
   24 |             this.difficulty === "impossible" ||
   25 |             r.next() > (this.difficulty === "hard" ? 0.12 : 0.45)
   26 |               ? 1
   27 |               : 0
   28 |           ],
   29 |         spread =
   30 |           this.difficulty === "medium"
   31 |             ? 27
   32 |             : this.difficulty === "hard"
   33 |               ? 9
   34 |               : 1;
   35 |       this.x = target.x + r.sample(r.side * spread * 0.15, spread, -spread);
   36 |       this.y = target.y + r.sample(0, spread, -spread);
   37 |       this.readyDelay = r.sample(
   38 |         this.difficulty === "medium" ? 0.7 : 0.3,
   39 |         0.12,
   40 |         0.15,
   41 |       );
   42 |     }
   43 |     if (p.stage === "ready") return p.age >= this.readyDelay;
   44 |     return p.stage === "horizontal"
   45 |       ? Math.abs(p.x - this.x) < 1.8
   46 |       : p.stage === "vertical"
   47 |         ? Math.abs(p.y - this.y) < 1.8
   48 |         : false;
   49 |   }
   50 | }
~~~

SHA-256: 622ffd439e84cafc05adde5469a8d7ec19508106e30f4a0b9b1feb0fac6d5908
~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import type { GameContext, MiniGame } from "../../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    3 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    4 | import { rounded, label } from "../../shared/components/drawing";
    5 | import { FixedStep } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
    6 | import { freshSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    7 | import { ArcheryMatch } from "./Rules";
    8 | import { ArcheryAI } from "./AI";
    9 | export class ArcheryGame implements MiniGame {
   10 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   11 |   private m = new ArcheryMatch(freshSeed());
   12 |   private ai?: ArcheryAI;
   13 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   14 |   private texts: Phaser.GameObjects.Text[] = [];
   15 |   private fixed = new FixedStep();
   16 |   private paused = false;
   17 |   private done = false;
   18 |   private scores = "";
   19 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   20 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   21 |     this.g = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   22 |     this.texts = [
   23 |       label(ctx.scene, 210, 610, "", 12),
   24 |       label(ctx.scene, 210, 340, "", 12),
   25 |     ];
   26 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai") {
   27 |       this.ai = new ArcheryAI(ctx.options.difficulty);
   28 |       this.m = new ArcheryMatch(this.ai.personality.seed);
   29 |     }
   30 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
   31 |       if (x >= 24 && x <= 396 && y >= 112 && y <= 650)
   32 |         this.tap(y < 380 ? 1 : 0);
   33 |     });
   34 |     ctx.input.press(["Space", "KeyA"], () => this.tap(0));
   35 |     ctx.input.press(["Enter", "KeyL"], () => this.tap(1));
   36 |     ctx.setHint("");
   37 |     this.draw();
   38 |   }
   39 |   private tap(p: 0 | 1, ai = false) {
   40 |     if (this.paused || this.done || (p === 1 && this.ai && !ai)) return;
   41 |     if (this.m.tap(p))
   42 |       this.ctx.audio.play(
   43 |         this.m.players[p].stage === "flight" ? "shoot" : "tap",
   44 |       );
   45 |   }
   46 |   update(dt: number) {
   47 |     if (this.paused || this.done) return;
   48 |     this.fixed.advance(dt, (h) => {
   49 |       if (this.ai?.update(this.m)) this.tap(1, true);
   50 |       this.m.step(h);
   51 |     });
   52 |     const s = this.m.players.map((p) => p.score) as [number, number];
   53 |     if (s.join() !== this.scores) {
   54 |       if (this.scores) this.ctx.audio.play("hit");
   55 |       this.scores = s.join();
   56 |       this.ctx.setScore(...s);
   57 |     }
   58 |     this.draw();
   59 |     if (this.m.winner) {
   60 |       this.done = true;
   61 |       this.ctx.finish({ winner: this.m.winner, scores: s });
   62 |     }
   63 |   }
   64 |   private draw() {
   65 |     const g = this.g;
   66 |     g.clear();
   67 |     rounded(g, 24, 112, 372, 538, 20, 0xdbe8cf, 4);
   68 |     for (const i of [0, 1] as const) {
   69 |       const p = this.m.players[i],
   70 |         top = i === 0 ? 415 : 145,
   71 |         color = i === 0 ? theme.orange : theme.blue;
   72 |       rounded(g, 40, top, 340, 170, 12, theme.white, 2);
   73 |       for (const t of p.targets) {
   74 |         g.fillStyle(color).fillCircle(40 + t.x, top + t.y, t.r);
   75 |         g.lineStyle(3, theme.ink).strokeCircle(40 + t.x, top + t.y, t.r);
   76 |         g.lineStyle(2, theme.white).strokeCircle(
   77 |           40 + t.x,
   78 |           top + t.y,
   79 |           t.r * 0.65,
   80 |         );
   81 |         g.fillStyle(theme.ink).fillCircle(40 + t.x, top + t.y, 3);
   82 |       }
   83 |       if (p.stage !== "ready") {
   84 |         const x = 40 + p.x,
   85 |           y = top + p.y;
   86 |         g.lineStyle(1, theme.ink, 0.3).lineBetween(x, top, x, top + 170);
   87 |         g.lineStyle(1, theme.ink, 0.3).lineBetween(40, y, 380, y);
   88 |         g.lineStyle(3, theme.ink).strokeCircle(x, y, 7);
   89 |         if (p.stage === "flight") {
   90 |           const t = Math.min(1, p.age / 0.38),
   91 |             ax = 210 + (x - 210) * t,
   92 |             ay = top + 180 + (y - top - 180) * t;
   93 |           g.lineStyle(4, theme.ink).lineBetween(ax, ay, ax - 5, ay + 18);
   94 |         }
   95 |         if (p.stage === "impact") {
   96 |           g.lineStyle(3, color, 1 - p.age / 0.7).strokeCircle(
   97 |             x,
   98 |             y,
   99 |             12 + p.age * 30,
  100 |           );
  101 |         }
  102 |       }
  103 |       this.texts[i].setText(
  104 |         p.stage === "ready"
  105 |           ? "Tap to aim"
  106 |           : p.stage === "horizontal"
  107 |             ? "Lock horizontal"
  108 |             : p.stage === "vertical"
  109 |               ? "Lock vertical"
  110 |               : p.stage === "impact"
  111 |                 ? p.lastPoints
  112 |                   ? `+${p.lastPoints} · NICE SHOT!`
  113 |                   : "MISS · TRY AGAIN"
  114 |                 : "ARROW AWAY",
  115 |       );
  116 |     }
  117 |   }
  118 |   pause() {
  119 |     this.paused = true;
  120 |     this.fixed.reset();
  121 |   }
  122 |   resume() {
  123 |     this.paused = false;
  124 |   }
  125 |   dispose() {
  126 |     this.done = true;
  127 |     this.g.destroy();
  128 |     this.texts.forEach((t) => t.destroy());
  129 |   }
  130 |   snapshot() {
  131 |     return {
  132 |       players: this.m.players,
  133 |       winner: this.m.winner,
  134 |       time: this.m.time,
  135 |       ai: this.ai?.personality.snapshot(),
  136 |     };
  137 |   }
  138 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/archery-duel/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 262f1ba3536744bdabe7c02cd29ed61e04d878f613121a430970f95c09bbf7c4
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, mixSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | export interface Target {
    3 |   x: number;
    4 |   y: number;
    5 |   r: number;
    6 |   points: number;
    7 | }
    8 | export interface Archer {
    9 |   score: number;
   10 |   attempt: number;
   11 |   stage: "ready" | "horizontal" | "vertical" | "flight" | "impact";
   12 |   x: number;
   13 |   y: number;
   14 |   direction: number;
   15 |   age: number;
   16 |   targets: Target[];
   17 |   lastPoints: number;
   18 | }
   19 | export class ArcheryMatch {
   20 |   readonly players: [Archer, Archer];
   21 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   22 |   time = 0;
   23 |   constructor(readonly seed: number) {
   24 |     const make = (): Archer => ({
   25 |       score: 0,
   26 |       attempt: 0,
   27 |       stage: "ready",
   28 |       x: 0,
   29 |       y: 0,
   30 |       direction: 1,
   31 |       age: 1,
   32 |       targets: this.targets(0),
   33 |       lastPoints: 0,
   34 |     });
   35 |     this.players = [make(), make()];
   36 |   }
   37 |   private targets(n: number) {
   38 |     const r = new MatchRandom(mixSeed(this.seed, n));
   39 |     const left = 40 + r.next() * 85,
   40 |       right = 210 + r.next() * 85;
   41 |     return [
   42 |       { x: left, y: 40 + r.next() * 90, r: 28, points: 1 },
   43 |       { x: right, y: 30 + r.next() * 110, r: 14, points: 2 },
   44 |     ];
   45 |   }
   46 |   tap(i: 0 | 1) {
   47 |     const p = this.players[i];
   48 |     if (this.winner || p.age < 0.12) return false;
   49 |     if (p.stage === "ready") {
   50 |       p.stage = "horizontal";
   51 |       p.x = 0;
   52 |       p.y = 85;
   53 |       p.direction = 1;
   54 |     } else if (p.stage === "horizontal") {
   55 |       p.stage = "vertical";
   56 |       p.y = 0;
   57 |       p.direction = 1;
   58 |     } else if (p.stage === "vertical") p.stage = "flight";
   59 |     else return false;
   60 |     p.age = 0;
   61 |     return true;
   62 |   }
   63 |   step(dt: number) {
   64 |     if (this.winner) return;
   65 |     this.time += dt;
   66 |     for (const p of this.players) {
   67 |       p.age += dt;
   68 |       if (p.stage === "horizontal" || p.stage === "vertical") {
   69 |         const key = p.stage === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
   70 |           limit = key === "x" ? 340 : 170;
   71 |         p[key] += p.direction * 175 * dt;
   72 |         if (p[key] > limit) {
   73 |           p[key] = 2 * limit - p[key];
   74 |           p.direction = -1;
   75 |         }
   76 |         if (p[key] < 0) {
   77 |           p[key] = -p[key];
   78 |           p.direction = 1;
   79 |         }
   80 |       } else if (p.stage === "flight" && p.age >= 0.38) {
   81 |         p.lastPoints =
   82 |           p.targets.find((t) => Math.hypot(p.x - t.x, p.y - t.y) <= t.r)
   83 |             ?.points ?? 0;
   84 |         p.score += p.lastPoints;
   85 |         p.stage = "impact";
   86 |         p.age = 0;
   87 |       } else if (p.stage === "impact" && p.age >= 0.7) {
   88 |         p.attempt++;
   89 |         p.targets = this.targets(p.attempt);
   90 |         p.stage = "ready";
   91 |         p.age = 1;
   92 |       }
   93 |     }
   94 |     const a = this.players[0].score >= 10,
   95 |       b = this.players[1].score >= 10;
   96 |     if (a || b) this.winner = a && b ? "draw" : a ? 1 : 2;
   97 |     if (this.time >= 180 && !this.winner)
   98 |       this.winner =
   99 |         this.players[0].score === this.players[1].score
  100 |           ? "draw"
  101 |           : this.players[0].score > this.players[1].score
  102 |             ? 1
  103 |             : 2;
  104 |   }
  105 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/car-duel/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 54527888637917b69e3fdd0efb7ac5ec8409f2db9c101cffb7b8fd8b6179f739
~~~text
    1 | # Car Duel
    2 | Custom 120Hz rigid-body approximation: mass one, angular inertia 560, circular chassis/wheel contacts, terrain normals, separating impulses and exposed head hitboxes. No Phaser physics instance. Geometry and driver locations are shared by rendering and physics. Input owns per-pointer button subscriptions; dispose/pause must clear them as well as host keys. AI drives through the same throttle/torque limits. First five wins; simultaneous deaths replay, 40-second stalled round replay, four-minute match cap. The missing reference PDF means terrain and tuning are original choices, not a claim of exact reference physics.
~~~

## src/future-games/car-duel/AI.ts
SHA-256: 7623eb802dbca5c0bde959eedf22a126eb3087e3ea19ff1460d175f718748d86
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { CarMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class CarAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private wait = 0;
    7 |   private control = 0;
    8 |   private retreat = 0;
    9 |   constructor(
   10 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   11 |     seed?: number,
   12 |   ) {
   13 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   14 |   }
   15 |   update(dt: number, m: CarMatch) {
   16 |     if (m.winner || m.between) {
   17 |       this.control = 0;
   18 |       this.wait = 0;
   19 |       return 0;
   20 |     }
   21 |     this.wait -= dt;
   22 |     if (this.wait > 0) return this.control;
   23 |     const r = this.personality,
   24 |       c = m.cars[1],
   25 |       other = m.cars[0],
   26 |       distance = other.x - c.x;
   27 |     this.wait = r.sample(
   28 |       this.difficulty === "medium"
   29 |         ? 0.24
   30 |         : this.difficulty === "hard"
   31 |           ? 0.1
   32 |           : 0.045,
   33 |       0.025,
   34 |       0.025,
   35 |     );
   36 |     const predicted =
   37 |       c.angle + c.omega * (this.difficulty === "medium" ? 0.08 : 0.22);
   38 |     if (Math.abs(predicted) > 0.42) {
   39 |       this.control = Math.sign(predicted);
   40 |       return this.control;
   41 |     }
   42 |     const closing = (other.vx - c.vx) * Math.sign(distance),
   43 |       separation = Math.abs(distance),
   44 |       cautious = r.role === 1 || r.role === 3;
   45 |     if (cautious && separation < 95 && closing < -90 && this.retreat <= 0)
   46 |       this.retreat = 0.35 + r.tempo * 0.08;
   47 |     this.retreat -= this.wait;
   48 |     this.control =
   49 |       this.retreat > 0 ? -Math.sign(distance) : Math.sign(distance);
   50 |     if (
   51 |       separation < 70 &&
   52 |       Math.abs(c.omega) > 0.8 &&
   53 |       this.difficulty !== "medium"
   54 |     )
   55 |       this.control = Math.sign(predicted || c.omega);
   56 |     return this.control;
   57 |   }
   58 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/car-duel/CarInput.ts
SHA-256: a33050c5ca0fcfb669ec2b5c0f247f4b0dc4fb0075e82a0d97ecd5aaa1c6e5f4
~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | export const BUTTONS = [
    3 |   { x: 40, y: 550, w: 74, h: 70, p: 0, d: -1 },
    4 |   { x: 122, y: 550, w: 74, h: 70, p: 0, d: 1 },
    5 |   { x: 224, y: 550, w: 74, h: 70, p: 1, d: -1 },
    6 |   { x: 306, y: 550, w: 74, h: 70, p: 1, d: 1 },
    7 | ] as const;
    8 | export class CarInput {
    9 |   private held = new Map<number, { p: 0 | 1; d: number }>();
   10 |   private enabled = true;
   11 |   constructor(
   12 |     private scene: Phaser.Scene,
   13 |     private ai: boolean,
   14 |   ) {
   15 |     scene.input.on("pointerdown", this.down);
   16 |     scene.input.on("pointermove", this.move);
   17 |     scene.input.on("pointerup", this.up);
   18 |     scene.input.on("pointerupoutside", this.up);
   19 |     scene.game.canvas.addEventListener("touchcancel", this.clear);
   20 |     scene.game.canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", this.clear);
   21 |   }
   22 |   private button(p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) {
   23 |     const v = this.scene.cameras.main.getWorldPoint(p.x, p.y);
   24 |     return BUTTONS.find(
   25 |       (b) => v.x >= b.x && v.x <= b.x + b.w && v.y >= b.y && v.y <= b.y + b.h,
   26 |     );
   27 |   }
   28 |   private down = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   29 |     const b = this.button(p);
   30 |     if (this.enabled && b && !(b.p === 1 && this.ai))
   31 |       this.held.set(p.id, { p: b.p, d: b.d });
   32 |   };
   33 |   private move = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   34 |     const owner = this.held.get(p.id);
   35 |     if (!owner) return;
   36 |     const b = this.button(p);
   37 |     owner.d = b?.p === owner.p ? b.d : 0;
   38 |   };
   39 |   private up = (p: Phaser.Input.Pointer) => {
   40 |     this.held.delete(p.id);
   41 |   };
   42 |   clear = () => {
   43 |     this.held.clear();
   44 |   };
   45 |   value(p: 0 | 1) {
   46 |     return Math.max(
   47 |       -1,
   48 |       Math.min(
   49 |         1,
   50 |         [...this.held.values()]
   51 |           .filter((v) => v.p === p)
   52 |           .reduce((s, v) => s + v.d, 0),
   53 |       ),
   54 |     );
   55 |   }
   56 |   pause() {
   57 |     this.enabled = false;
   58 |     this.clear();
   59 |   }
   60 |   resume() {
   61 |     this.enabled = true;
   62 |     this.clear();
   63 |   }
   64 |   dispose() {
   65 |     this.pause();
   66 |     this.scene.input.off("pointerdown", this.down);
   67 |     this.scene.input.off("pointermove", this.move);
   68 |     this.scene.input.off("pointerup", this.up);
   69 |     this.scene.input.off("pointerupoutside", this.up);
   70 |     this.scene.game.canvas.removeEventListener("touchcancel", this.clear);
   71 |     this.scene.game.canvas.removeEventListener("pointercancel", this.clear);
   72 |   }
   73 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/car-duel/Physics.ts
SHA-256: 06553e19ba8ddd4c62158b55015782f589e1dec759daafa0295162dfe06b412f
~~~text
    1 | export interface Car {
    2 |   x: number;
    3 |   y: number;
    4 |   vx: number;
    5 |   vy: number;
    6 |   angle: number;
    7 |   omega: number;
    8 |   facing: 1 | -1;
    9 |   alive: boolean;
   10 |   grounded: boolean;
   11 | }
   12 | export const INERTIA = 560;
   13 | export function terrain(x: number) {
   14 |   const d = (x - 170) / 48;
   15 |   return 260 - (Math.abs(d) < 1 ? 25 * (1 - d * d) ** 2 : 0);
   16 | }
   17 | export function point(c: Car, x: number, y: number) {
   18 |   const cs = Math.cos(c.angle),
   19 |     sn = Math.sin(c.angle);
   20 |   return { x: c.x + x * cs - y * sn, y: c.y + x * sn + y * cs };
   21 | }
   22 | export function head(c: Car) {
   23 |   return point(c, -c.facing * 5, -22);
   24 | }
   25 | export function colliders(c: Car) {
   26 |   return [
   27 |     [-14, 0, 12],
   28 |     [14, 0, 12],
   29 |     [-21, 12, 10],
   30 |     [21, 12, 10],
   31 |   ].map(([x, y, r]) => ({ ...point(c, x, y), r }));
   32 | }
   33 | function impulse(
   34 |   c: Car,
   35 |   x: number,
   36 |   y: number,
   37 |   nx: number,
   38 |   ny: number,
   39 |   j: number,
   40 | ) {
   41 |   c.vx += nx * j;
   42 |   c.vy += ny * j;
   43 |   c.omega += (((x - c.x) * ny - (y - c.y) * nx) * j) / INERTIA;
   44 | }
   45 | export function integrate(c: Car, input: number, dt: number) {
   46 |   if (!c.alive) return;
   47 |   input = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, input));
   48 |   c.vx += input * (c.grounded ? 145 : 35) * dt;
   49 |   c.vy += 520 * dt;
   50 |   c.omega -= input * (c.grounded ? 1.1 : 3.2) * dt;
   51 |   c.vx *= Math.exp(-0.65 * dt);
   52 |   c.omega *= Math.exp(-0.65 * dt);
   53 |   c.vx = Math.max(-180, Math.min(180, c.vx));
   54 |   c.vy = Math.max(-260, Math.min(300, c.vy));
   55 |   c.omega = Math.max(-5, Math.min(5, c.omega));
   56 |   c.x += c.vx * dt;
   57 |   c.y += c.vy * dt;
   58 |   c.angle += c.omega * dt;
   59 |   c.angle = Math.atan2(Math.sin(c.angle), Math.cos(c.angle));
   60 |   c.grounded = false;
   61 |   for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++)
   62 |     for (const q of colliders(c)) {
   63 |       const floor = terrain(q.x),
   64 |         depth = q.y + q.r - floor;
   65 |       if (depth > 0) {
   66 |         c.grounded = true;
   67 |         const slope = (terrain(q.x + 0.1) - terrain(q.x - 0.1)) / 0.2,
   68 |           norm = Math.hypot(slope, 1),
   69 |           nx = slope / norm,
   70 |           ny = -1 / norm;
   71 |         c.x += nx * depth * 0.6;
   72 |         c.y += ny * depth * 0.6;
   73 |         const rx = q.x - c.x,
   74 |           ry = q.y - c.y,
   75 |           vn = (c.vx - c.omega * ry) * nx + (c.vy + c.omega * rx) * ny;
   76 |         if (vn < 0) {
   77 |           const lever = rx * ny - ry * nx;
   78 |           impulse(c, q.x, q.y, nx, ny, -vn / (1 + (lever * lever) / INERTIA));
   79 |         }
   80 |       }
   81 |       if (q.x - q.r < 0) {
   82 |         c.x += -(q.x - q.r);
   83 |         if (c.vx < 0) c.vx = -c.vx * 0.25;
   84 |       }
   85 |       if (q.x + q.r > 340) {
   86 |         c.x -= q.x + q.r - 340;
   87 |         if (c.vx > 0) c.vx = -c.vx * 0.25;
   88 |       }
   89 |     }
   90 |   const h = head(c);
   91 |   if (h.y + 7 >= terrain(h.x) || h.x - 7 < 0 || h.x + 7 > 340) c.alive = false;
   92 | }
   93 | export function collide(a: Car, b: Car) {
   94 |   const ah = head(a),
   95 |     bh = head(b),
   96 |     ac = colliders(a),
   97 |     bc = colliders(b);
   98 |   if (bc.some((q) => Math.hypot(q.x - ah.x, q.y - ah.y) < q.r + 7))
   99 |     a.alive = false;
  100 |   if (ac.some((q) => Math.hypot(q.x - bh.x, q.y - bh.y) < q.r + 7))
  101 |     b.alive = false;
  102 |   if (Math.hypot(ah.x - bh.x, ah.y - bh.y) < 14) {
  103 |     a.alive = false;
  104 |     b.alive = false;
  105 |   }
  106 |   for (const p of ac)
  107 |     for (const q of bc) {
  108 |       const dx = q.x - p.x,
  109 |         dy = q.y - p.y,
  110 |         d = Math.hypot(dx, dy),
  111 |         over = p.r + q.r - d;
  112 |       if (over <= 0) continue;
  113 |       const nx = d ? dx / d : 1,
  114 |         ny = d ? dy / d : 0;
  115 |       a.x -= nx * over * 0.26;
  116 |       a.y -= ny * over * 0.26;
  117 |       b.x += nx * over * 0.26;
  118 |       b.y += ny * over * 0.26;
  119 |       const arx = p.x - a.x,
  120 |         ary = p.y - a.y,
  121 |         brx = q.x - b.x,
  122 |         bry = q.y - b.y,
  123 |         relative =
  124 |           (b.vx - b.omega * bry - a.vx + a.omega * ary) * nx +
  125 |           (b.vy + b.omega * brx - a.vy - a.omega * arx) * ny;
  126 |       if (relative < 0) {
  127 |         const la = arx * ny - ary * nx,
  128 |           lb = brx * ny - bry * nx,
  129 |           j = (-1.25 * relative) / (2 + (la * la + lb * lb) / INERTIA);
  130 |         impulse(a, p.x, p.y, -nx, -ny, j);
  131 |         impulse(b, q.x, q.y, nx, ny, j);
  132 |       }
  133 |     }
  134 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/car-duel/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 010afff9bef31c53ad9bcc3d8ac90b5cb57cf0460685f9d6d79077667fbf1fd7
~~~text
    1 | import { integrate, collide, type Car } from "./Physics";
    2 | export class CarMatch {
    3 |   cars: [Car, Car] = this.spawn();
    4 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
    5 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
    6 |   between = 1;
    7 |   round = 1;
    8 |   time = 0;
    9 |   roundTime = 0;
   10 |   private first = true;
   11 |   private spawn(): [Car, Car] {
   12 |     return [0, 1].map((i) => ({
   13 |       x: i ? 265 : 75,
   14 |       y: 224,
   15 |       vx: 0,
   16 |       vy: 0,
   17 |       angle: 0,
   18 |       omega: 0,
   19 |       facing: i ? -1 : 1,
   20 |       alive: true,
   21 |       grounded: false,
   22 |     })) as [Car, Car];
   23 |   }
   24 |   step(dt: number, controls: [number, number]) {
   25 |     if (this.winner) return;
   26 |     this.time += dt;
   27 |     if (this.time >= 240) {
   28 |       this.winner =
   29 |         this.scores[0] === this.scores[1]
   30 |           ? "draw"
   31 |           : this.scores[0] > this.scores[1]
   32 |             ? 1
   33 |             : 2;
   34 |       return;
   35 |     }
   36 |     if (this.between) {
   37 |       this.between = Math.max(0, this.between - dt);
   38 |       if (!this.between) {
   39 |         this.cars = this.spawn();
   40 |         this.roundTime = 0;
   41 |         if (!this.first) this.round++;
   42 |         this.first = false;
   43 |       }
   44 |       return;
   45 |     }
   46 |     this.roundTime += dt;
   47 |     integrate(this.cars[0], controls[0], dt);
   48 |     integrate(this.cars[1], controls[1], dt);
   49 |     collide(...this.cars);
   50 |     if (this.cars.some((c) => !c.alive) || this.roundTime >= 40) {
   51 |       if (this.cars[0].alive !== this.cars[1].alive)
   52 |         this.scores[this.cars[0].alive ? 0 : 1]++;
   53 |       this.between = 1.2;
   54 |       if (this.scores.some((s) => s >= 5))
   55 |         this.winner = this.scores[0] >= 5 ? 1 : 2;
   56 |     }
   57 |   }
   58 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | # Chicken Jump
    2 | Rules owns two independent stack states and geometric descending landings. The controller advances at 120 Hz; input locks a sliding block and launches the chicken. A miss retries the same height. Ten stacks wins, same-step ties draw; 180-second safety cap uses height. These timing/balancing choices are original because the referenced PDF was not supplied. AI chooses a seeded alignment offset per height and uses the same stop action. Keep rules/AI/rendering isolated; no global listeners or timers.
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";

    3 | import type { ChickenMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class ChickenAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private newAttempt = true;
    7 |   private offset = 0;
    8 |   private delay = 0;
    9 |   constructor(
   10 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   11 |     seed?: number,
   12 |   ) {
   13 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   14 |   }
   15 |   update(dt: number, m: ChickenMatch) {
   16 |     const p = m.players[1];
   17 |     if (m.winner) return false;
   18 |     if (p.phase !== "sliding") {
   19 |       this.newAttempt = true;
   20 |       return false;
   21 |     }
   22 |     if (this.newAttempt) {
   23 |       this.newAttempt = false;
   24 |       const spread =
   25 |         this.difficulty === "medium" ? 38 : this.difficulty === "hard" ? 15 : 4;
   26 |       this.offset = this.personality.sample(
   27 |         this.personality.side * spread * 0.2,
   28 |         spread,
   29 |         -spread,
   30 |       );
   31 |       this.delay = this.personality.sample(
   32 |         this.difficulty === "medium" ? 0.3 : 0.12,
   33 |         0.06,
   34 |         0.06,
   35 |       );
   36 |     }
   37 |     this.delay -= dt;
   38 |     if (this.delay > 0) return false;
   39 |     const target = Math.max(25, Math.min(175, p.x + this.offset));
   40 |     return Math.abs(p.block - target) <= m.speed(p) * dt + 2;
   41 |   }
   42 | }
~~~
