## src/future-games/chicken-jump/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 6ce62a01aa4117aac14faf3d40a93c4f7a8f283cdd9eafbdba17879b63794559
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | export interface Chicken {
    3 |   score: number;
    4 |   x: number;
    5 |   block: number;
    6 |   direction: number;
    7 |   width: number;
    8 |   phase: "sliding" | "jumping" | "miss";
    9 |   y: number;
   10 |   vy: number;
   11 |   age: number;
   12 |   stack: { x: number; width: number }[];
   13 | }
   14 | export class ChickenMatch {
   15 |   readonly players: [Chicken, Chicken];
   16 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   17 |   time = 0;
   18 |   constructor(seed: number) {
   19 |     const r = new MatchRandom(seed);
   20 |     const start = 28 + r.next() * 144;
   21 |     const make = (): Chicken => ({
   22 |       score: 0,
   23 |       x: 100,
   24 |       block: start,
   25 |       direction: r.side,
   26 |       width: 65,
   27 |       phase: "sliding",
   28 |       y: 0,
   29 |       vy: 0,
   30 |       age: 0,
   31 |       stack: [],
   32 |     });
   33 |     this.players = [make(), make()];
   34 |   }
   35 |   speed(p: Chicken) {
   36 |     return 92 + Math.min(85, p.score * 8);
   37 |   }
   38 |   stop(i: 0 | 1) {
   39 |     const p = this.players[i];
   40 |     if (this.winner || p.phase !== "sliding") return false;
   41 |     p.phase = "jumping";
   42 |     p.vy = -310;
   43 |     p.y = 0;
   44 |     p.age = 0;
   45 |     return true;
   46 |   }
   47 |   step(dt: number) {
   48 |     if (this.winner) return;
   49 |     this.time += dt;
   50 |     for (const p of this.players) {
   51 |       p.age += dt;
   52 |       if (p.phase === "sliding") {
   53 |         p.block += p.direction * this.speed(p) * dt;
   54 |         const edge = p.width / 2 + 4;
   55 |         if (p.block < edge) {
   56 |           p.block = edge + (edge - p.block);
   57 |           p.direction = 1;
   58 |         }
   59 |         if (p.block > 200 - edge) {
   60 |           p.block = 200 - edge - (p.block - (200 - edge));
   61 |           p.direction = -1;
   62 |         }
   63 |       } else if (p.phase === "jumping") {
   64 |         const old = p.y;
   65 |         p.vy += 800 * dt;
   66 |         p.y += p.vy * dt;
   67 |         if (
   68 |           p.vy > 0 &&
   69 |           old <= -26 &&
   70 |           p.y >= -26 &&
   71 |           Math.abs(p.x - p.block) <= p.width / 2 + 6
   72 |         ) {
   73 |           p.score++;
   74 |           p.x = Math.max(
   75 |             p.block - p.width / 2 + 6,
   76 |             Math.min(p.block + p.width / 2 - 6, p.x),
   77 |           );
   78 |           p.stack.push({ x: p.block, width: p.width });
   79 |           if (p.stack.length > 6) p.stack.shift();
   80 |           p.width = Math.max(38, 65 - p.score * 2.5);
   81 |           p.phase = "sliding";
   82 |           p.y = 0;
   83 |           p.vy = 0;
   84 |           p.age = 0;
   85 |         } else if (p.y > 60) {
   86 |           p.phase = "miss";
   87 |           p.age = 0;
   88 |         }
   89 |       } else if (p.age > 0.65) {
   90 |         p.phase = "sliding";
   91 |         p.y = 0;
   92 |         p.vy = 0;
   93 |         p.age = 0;
   94 |       }
   95 |     }
   96 |     const a = this.players[0].score >= 10,
   97 |       b = this.players[1].score >= 10;
   98 |     if (a || b) this.winner = a && b ? "draw" : a ? 1 : 2;
   99 |     if (this.time >= 180 && !this.winner)
  100 |       this.winner =
  101 |         this.players[0].score === this.players[1].score
  102 |           ? "draw"
  103 |           : this.players[0].score > this.players[1].score
  104 |             ? 1
  105 |             : 2;
  106 |   }
  107 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/flappy-jump/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 138f91401b82cb9da643d50738b0e9d6e5d0e6ef49ad9207726664919e80eeb7
~~~text
    1 | # Flappy Jump
    2 | A running jumper releases one ball at the jump apex. Shared 750-unit gravity, circular rim contacts, backboard reflection and swept downward hoop-plane crossing; each ball can score once. Data-driven seeded hoop positions stay reachable. AI estimates the same ballistic arc and calls jump, never awards points. 120Hz stepping, bounded ball lifetime. First ten baskets; four-minute cap. No supplied PDF, so exact running speed and court dimensions are documented implementation choices.
~~~

## src/future-games/flappy-jump/AI.ts
SHA-256: a30ebcecfe9321143f6237540dd4278049629e7d08939712bfa3c8d1f136496b
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import { projectedLanding, type FlappyMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class FlappyAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private attempt = 0;
    7 |   private waiting = false;
    8 |   private offset = 0;
    9 |   private delay = 0;
   10 |   constructor(
   11 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   12 |     seed?: number,
   13 |   ) {
   14 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   15 |   }
   16 |   update(dt: number, m: FlappyMatch) {
   17 |     const p = m.players[1];
   18 |     if (m.winner) return false;
   19 |     if (p.ball || p.jumping) {
   20 |       this.waiting = false;
   21 |       return false;
   22 |     }
   23 |     if (!this.waiting) {
   24 |       this.waiting = true;
   25 |       this.attempt++;
   26 |       const r = this.personality,
   27 |         spread =
   28 |           this.difficulty === "medium"
   29 |             ? 28
   30 |             : this.difficulty === "hard"
   31 |               ? 10
   32 |               : 2;
   33 |       this.offset = r.sample(r.side * spread * 0.15, spread, -spread);
   34 |       this.delay = r.sample(
   35 |         this.difficulty === "medium" ? 0.35 : 0.15,
   36 |         0.06,
   37 |         0.08,
   38 |       );
   39 |     }
   40 |     this.delay -= dt;
   41 |     return (
   42 |       this.delay <= 0 &&
   43 |       Math.abs(projectedLanding(p) - p.hoop.x - this.offset) < 1.5
   44 |     );
   45 |   }
   46 | }
~~~

## src/future-games/flappy-jump/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 013148249c720ef8983e50e9cbccb71f532e7d5bf40ef6c30ac6eb8571cb1636
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, mixSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | export interface BasketBall {
    3 |   x: number;
    4 |   y: number;
    5 |   vx: number;
    6 |   vy: number;
    7 |   age: number;
    8 |   scored: boolean;
    9 | }
   10 | export interface Jumper {
   11 |   x: number;
   12 |   y: number;
   13 |   vy: number;
   14 |   direction: number;
   15 |   score: number;
   16 |   jumping: boolean;
   17 |   released: boolean;
   18 |   hoop: { x: number; y: number };
   19 |   ball?: BasketBall;
   20 | }
   21 | export function walk(x: number, direction: number, seconds: number) {
   22 |   let p = x + direction * 70 * seconds;
   23 |   while (p < 45 || p > 195) {
   24 |     if (p < 45) p = 90 - p;
   25 |     else p = 390 - p;
   26 |   }
   27 |   return p;
   28 | }
   29 | export function projectedLanding(p: Jumper) {
   30 |   const releaseX = walk(p.x, p.direction, 310 / 750),
   31 |     releaseY = 155 - (310 * 310) / (2 * 750) - 20;
   32 |   const t = (200 + Math.sqrt(40000 + 1500 * (p.hoop.y - releaseY))) / 750;
   33 |   return releaseX + 225 * t;
   34 | }
   35 | export class FlappyMatch {
   36 |   players: [Jumper, Jumper];
   37 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   38 |   time = 0;
   39 |   constructor(readonly seed: number) {
   40 |     const make = (): Jumper => ({
   41 |       x: 65,
   42 |       y: 155,
   43 |       vy: 0,
   44 |       direction: 1,
   45 |       score: 0,
   46 |       jumping: false,
   47 |       released: false,
   48 |       hoop: this.hoop(0),
   49 |     });
   50 |     this.players = [make(), make()];
   51 |   }
   52 |   private hoop(n: number) {
   53 |     const r = new MatchRandom(mixSeed(this.seed, n));
   54 |     return { x: 250 + r.next() * 38, y: 68 + r.next() * 15 };
   55 |   }
   56 |   jump(i: 0 | 1) {
   57 |     const p = this.players[i];
   58 |     if (this.winner || p.jumping || p.ball) return false;
   59 |     p.jumping = true;
   60 |     p.released = false;
   61 |     p.vy = -310;
   62 |     return true;
   63 |   }
   64 |   step(dt: number) {
   65 |     if (this.winner) return;
   66 |     this.time += dt;
   67 |     for (const p of this.players) {
   68 |       p.x += p.direction * 70 * dt;
   69 |       if (p.x > 195) {
   70 |         p.x = 390 - p.x;
   71 |         p.direction = -1;
   72 |       }
   73 |       if (p.x < 45) {
   74 |         p.x = 90 - p.x;
   75 |         p.direction = 1;
   76 |       }
   77 |       if (p.jumping) {
   78 |         const prev = p.vy;
   79 |         p.vy += 750 * dt;
   80 |         p.y += p.vy * dt;
   81 |         if (prev < 0 && p.vy >= 0 && !p.released && !p.ball) {
   82 |           p.released = true;
   83 |           p.ball = {
   84 |             x: p.x,
   85 |             y: p.y - 20,
   86 |             vx: 225,
   87 |             vy: -200,
   88 |             age: 0,
   89 |             scored: false,
   90 |           };
   91 |         }
   92 |         if (p.y >= 155) {
   93 |           p.y = 155;
   94 |           p.vy = 0;
   95 |           p.jumping = false;
   96 |         }
   97 |       }
   98 |       const b = p.ball;
   99 |       if (!b) continue;
  100 |       b.age += dt;
  101 |       const oldX = b.x,
  102 |         oldY = b.y;
  103 |       b.vy += 750 * dt;
  104 |       b.x += b.vx * dt;
  105 |       b.y += b.vy * dt;
  106 |       // Circular rim ends; separating impulses avoid repeated reversals.
  107 |       for (const rx of [p.hoop.x - 21, p.hoop.x + 21]) {
  108 |         const dx = b.x - rx,
  109 |           dy = b.y - p.hoop.y,
  110 |           d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  111 |         if (d < 10) {
  112 |           const nx = d ? dx / d : 0,
  113 |             ny = d ? dy / d : -1;
  114 |           b.x = rx + nx * 10;
  115 |           b.y = p.hoop.y + ny * 10;
  116 |           const vn = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny;
  117 |           if (vn < 0) {
  118 |             b.vx -= 1.65 * vn * nx;
  119 |             b.vy -= 1.65 * vn * ny;
  120 |           }
  121 |         }
  122 |       }
  123 |       const board = p.hoop.x + 27;
  124 |       if (
  125 |         b.y >= p.hoop.y - 36 &&
  126 |         b.y <= p.hoop.y + 7 &&
  127 |         b.x + 7 >= board &&
  128 |         oldX + 7 < board
  129 |       ) {
  130 |         b.x = board - 7;
  131 |         b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.65;
  132 |       }
  133 |       if (!b.scored && oldY < p.hoop.y && b.y >= p.hoop.y && b.vy > 0) {
  134 |         const t = (p.hoop.y - oldY) / (b.y - oldY),
  135 |           crossX = oldX + (b.x - oldX) * t;
  136 |         if (crossX > p.hoop.x - 14 && crossX < p.hoop.x + 14) {
  137 |           b.scored = true;
  138 |           p.score++;
  139 |         }
  140 |       }
  141 |       if (b.y > 190 || b.x > 355 || b.x < -15 || b.age > 3) {
  142 |         p.ball = undefined;
  143 |         if (b.scored) p.hoop = this.hoop(p.score);
  144 |       }
  145 |     }
  146 |     const a = this.players[0].score >= 10,
  147 |       b = this.players[1].score >= 10;
  148 |     if (a || b) this.winner = a && b ? "draw" : a ? 1 : 2;
  149 |     if (this.time >= 240 && !this.winner)
  150 |       this.winner =
  151 |         this.players[0].score === this.players[1].score
  152 |           ? "draw"
  153 |           : this.players[0].score > this.players[1].score
  154 |             ? 1
  155 |             : 2;
  156 |   }
  157 | }
~~~

## src/games/air-hockey/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 8287054e7dc011ba58b64197728d63ef4e37f95facc7c04dcf98195f606c6f84
~~~text
    1 | # Air Hockey module
    2 | 
    3 | AirHockeyPhysics.ts integrates at 120 Hz with three collision substeps. rink.ts owns rounded rails, goals and reachability. Resolve only approaching normals; project penetration consistently, preserve tangent motion, and interpolate mallets over all substeps. The watchdog repairs only unreachable/invalid states after 0.75 seconds, never a reachable stationary puck. PossessionClock.ts uses center ±3 hysteresis; contacts do not reset it. HockeyState.ts validates clock/physics checkpoints. AirHockeyAI.ts must use the legal motion controller.
    4 | 
    5 | Read only this folder, the shared contract and required shared helpers. Do not import other games or put rules in core. Own and dispose workers/graphics; use host-owned input. Relevant checks: `tests/unit/engine.test.ts, phase2.test.ts and phase3.test.ts` (browser paths are under tests).
    6 | 
    7 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
~~~

## src/games/air-hockey/AirHockeyAI.ts
SHA-256: e00f991397025d330dc2859e5cad4143658a0074a96cbc5881aa2c52a643206b
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type {
    3 |   AIController,
    4 |   Difficulty,
    5 | } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    6 | import type { HockeyWorld, Vec } from "./AirHockeyPhysics";
    7 | import { MotionController } from "../../shared/physics/MotionController";
    8 | import { clamp } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
    9 | import { FIELD } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
   10 | function reflect(x: number) {
   11 |   const width = 350,
   12 |     phase = (((x - 35) % (2 * width)) + 2 * width) % (2 * width);
   13 |   return 35 + (phase <= width ? phase : 2 * width - phase);
   14 | }
   15 | export class AirHockeyAI implements AIController<HockeyWorld, Vec> {
   16 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
   17 |   private approachSide = 1;
   18 |   private observedOpponent = 210;
   19 |   snapshot() {
   20 |     return {
   21 |       ...this.personality.snapshot(),
   22 |       target: { ...this.target },
   23 |       attacking: this.attacking,
   24 |     };
   25 |   }
   26 |   private motion = new MotionController(210, 183);
   27 |   private attacking = false;
   28 |   private error = 0;
   29 |   private reaction = 0;
   30 |   private target: Vec = { x: 210, y: 180 };
   31 |   constructor(
   32 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   33 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   34 |   ) {
   35 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   36 |     this.approachSide = this.personality.side;
   37 |   }
   38 |   reset() {
   39 |     this.reaction = 0;
   40 |     this.target = { x: 210, y: 183 };
   41 |     this.motion.reset(210, 183);
   42 |     this.attacking = false;
   43 |   }
   44 |   update(dt: number, w: HockeyWorld) {
   45 |     if (w.done) return { x: w.mallets[1].x, y: w.mallets[1].y };
   46 |     const cfg = {
   47 |       medium: { delay: 0.19, error: 24, speed: 530 },
   48 |       hard: { delay: 0.065, error: 7, speed: 1050 },
   49 |       impossible: { delay: 0.02, error: 0, speed: 1450 },
   50 |     }[this.difficulty];
   51 |     const p = w.puck,
   52 |       m = w.mallets[1];
   53 |     this.reaction -= dt;
   54 |     if (w.cooldown > 0) {
   55 |       this.target = { x: 210, y: 183 };
   56 |       this.attacking = false;
   57 |     }
   58 |     if (this.reaction <= 0 && w.cooldown <= 0) {
   59 |       this.reaction = this.personality.sample(
   60 |         cfg.delay * (0.9 + this.personality.tempo * 0.1),
   61 |         cfg.delay * 0.12,
   62 |         0.015,
   63 |       );
   64 |       const role = this.personality.role,
   65 |         home = [170, 151, 159, 181][role];
   66 |       this.observedOpponent += (w.mallets[0].x - this.observedOpponent) * 0.18;
   67 |       if (p.vy < -60 && p.y < 480) {
   68 |         const t = Math.max(0, (home - p.y) / p.vy);
   69 |         this.target = { x: reflect(p.x + p.vx * t), y: home };
   70 |       } else if (p.y < FIELD.middle + 10) {
   71 |         // Approach behind the puck, then drive downfield; route around it when caught in front.
   72 |         if (m.y < p.y - 43) this.attacking = true;
   73 |         else if (m.y > p.y + 30) {
   74 |           if (this.attacking)
   75 |             this.approachSide =
   76 |               Math.abs(m.x - p.x) > 20
   77 |                 ? m.x < p.x
   78 |                   ? -1
   79 |                   : 1
   80 |                 : this.personality.side;
   81 |           this.attacking = false;
   82 |         }
   83 |         if (!this.attacking) {
   84 |           const side = this.approachSide;
   85 |           this.target = {
   86 |             x: p.x + side * [62, 75, 68, 72][role],
   87 |             y: Math.max(143, p.y - 58),
   88 |           };
   89 |         } else
   90 |           this.target = {
   91 |             // Aim through the puck toward open goal space, using the real mallet.
   92 |             x:
   93 |               p.x +
   94 |               (210 - (this.observedOpponent - 210) * 0.35 - p.x) *
   95 |                 [0.15, 0.08, 0.12, 0.18][role],
   96 |             y: Math.min(352, p.y + 34),
   97 |           };
   98 |       } else
   99 |         this.target = {
  100 |           x:
  101 |             210 +
  102 |             (p.x - 210) * [0.4, 0.16, 0.28, 0.32][role] +
  103 |             this.personality.side * 6,
  104 |           y: home + 12,
  105 |         };
  106 |       this.error +=
  107 |         (this.personality.sample(0, cfg.error, -cfg.error) - this.error) * 0.15;
  108 |       this.target.x += this.error;
  109 |       this.target.x = clamp(this.target.x, 53, 367);
  110 |       this.target.y = clamp(this.target.y, 141, 352);
  111 |     }
  112 |     const next = this.motion.move(
  113 |       dt,
  114 |       m.x,
  115 |       m.y,
  116 |       this.target.x,
  117 |       this.target.y,
  118 |       cfg.speed * (0.94 + this.personality.tempo * 0.03),
  119 |     );
  120 |     return { x: clamp(next.x, 53, 367), y: clamp(next.y, 141, 352) };
  121 |   }
  122 | }
~~~

~~~text
   82 |   private goal(p: Player) {

   93 |   update(dt: number) {

  124 |       .setColor(this.possession.remaining <= 5 ? "#ae432c" : "#62858b")
  125 |       .setAlpha(this.possession.remaining <= 5 ? 1 : 0.7);

  141 |         .strokePath();

  145 |     g.fillStyle(0x5b6770).fillCircle(w.puck.x - 2, w.puck.y - 3, 4);

  156 |   }
  157 |   private save() {
  158 |     if (!this.world.done)
  159 |       this.ctx.saveState({
  160 |         ...saveHockey(this.world, this.matchClock, this.possession),
  161 |         ai: this.ai?.snapshot(),
  162 |       });
  163 |   }
  164 |   private malletTarget(player: 0 | 1, step: number): Vec {
  165 |     const pointer = this.ctx.input.players[player];
  166 |     if (pointer.down) return pointer;
  167 |     const arrows = player === 1 || !!this.ai;
  168 |     const up =
  169 |       (player === 0 && this.keys.has("KeyW")) ||
  170 |       (arrows && this.keys.has("ArrowUp"));
  171 |     const down =
  172 |       (player === 0 && this.keys.has("KeyS")) ||
  173 |       (arrows && this.keys.has("ArrowDown"));
  174 |     const left =
  175 |       (player === 0 && this.keys.has("KeyA")) ||
  176 |       (arrows && this.keys.has("ArrowLeft"));
  177 |     const right =
  178 |       (player === 0 && this.keys.has("KeyD")) ||
  179 |       (arrows && this.keys.has("ArrowRight"));
  180 |     let vx = Number(right) - Number(left);
  181 |     let vy = Number(down) - Number(up);
  182 |     const m = this.world.mallets[player];
  183 |     if (vx === 0 && vy === 0) return m;
  184 |     const len = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
  185 |     vx /= len;
  186 |     vy /= len;
  187 |     const puckSpeed = Math.hypot(this.world.puck.vx, this.world.puck.vy);
  188 |     const speed = Math.min(1350, Math.max(950, puckSpeed * 1.25));
  189 |     return {
  190 |       x: m.x + vx * speed * step,
  191 |       y: m.y + vy * speed * step,
  192 |     };
  193 |   }
  194 |   pause() {
  195 |     this.save();
  196 |     this.paused = true;
  197 |     this.clock.reset();
  198 |   }
  199 |   resume() {
  200 |     this.paused = false;
  201 |     this.clock.reset();
  202 |   }
  203 |   dispose() {
  204 |     this.bg.destroy();
  205 |     this.graphics.destroy();
  206 |     this.status.destroy();
  207 |     this.possessionLabel.destroy();
  208 |   }
  209 |   snapshot() {
  210 |     return {
  211 |       ai: this.ai?.snapshot(),
  212 |       possession: {
  213 |         side: this.possession.side,
  214 |         remaining: this.possession.remaining,
  215 |       },
  216 |       puck: { ...this.world.puck },
  217 |       mallets: this.world.mallets.map((m) => ({ ...m })),
  218 |       timer: {
  219 |         remaining: this.matchClock.remaining,
  220 |         overtime: this.matchClock.overtime,
  221 |       },
  222 |       scores: [...this.world.scores],
  223 |     };
  224 |   }
  225 | }
~~~

## src/games/air-hockey/AirHockeyPhysics.ts
SHA-256: 0d307519d23f6c048f0ee6fd1682780e6be42e8db6a0d713527853f98443695b
~~~text
    1 | import { FIELD } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    2 | import { clamp } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
    3 | import type { Player } from "../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    4 | import {
    5 |   constrainRink,
    6 |   validPuckPosition,
    7 |   reachablePuck,
    8 |   inMouth,
    9 |   GOAL_HALF,
   10 |   type Body,
   11 | } from "./rink";
   12 | export interface Vec {
   13 |   x: number;
   14 |   y: number;
   15 | }
   16 | export class HockeyWorld {
   17 |   puck: Body = { x: 210, y: 381, vx: 75, vy: 220, r: 11 };
   18 |   mallets: [Body, Body] = [
   19 |     { x: 210, y: 579, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 29 },
   20 |     { x: 210, y: 183, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 29 },
   21 |   ];
   22 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   23 |   cooldown = 1.35;
   24 |   done = false;
   25 |   readonly goalHalf = GOAL_HALF;
   26 |   recoveries = 0;
   27 |   private invalidFor = 0;
   28 |   constructor(
   29 |     private impact: (x: number, y: number) => void = () => {},
   30 |     private scored: (p: Player) => void = () => {},
   31 |   ) {}
   32 |   step(dt: number, targets: [Vec, Vec]) {
   33 |     if (this.done) return;
   34 |     if (
   35 |       !Number.isFinite(this.puck.x + this.puck.y + this.puck.vx + this.puck.vy)
   36 |     ) {
   37 |       this.checkUnplayable(dt);
   38 |       return;
   39 |     }
   40 |     this.limitSpeed();
   41 |     const sub = dt / 3;
   42 |     const starts = this.mallets.map((m) => ({ x: m.x, y: m.y }));
   43 |     const destinations = this.mallets.map((m, i) => {
   44 |       const tx = clamp(targets[i].x, FIELD.left + m.r, FIELD.right - m.r),
   45 |         ty = clamp(
   46 |           targets[i].y,
   47 |           i === 0 ? FIELD.middle + m.r : FIELD.top + m.r,
   48 |           i === 0 ? FIELD.bottom - m.r : FIELD.middle - m.r,
   49 |         );
   50 |       const dx = tx - m.x,
   51 |         dy = ty - m.y,
   52 |         d = Math.hypot(dx, dy),
   53 |         s = d ? Math.min(1, (1500 * dt) / d) : 0;
   54 |       const end = { ...m, x: m.x + dx * s, y: m.y + dy * s };
   55 |       constrainRink(end, false, 0);
   56 |       return end;
   57 |     });
   58 |     for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) {
   59 |       this.mallets.forEach((m, i) => {
   60 |         const oldX = m.x,
   61 |           oldY = m.y,
   62 |           from = starts[i],
   63 |           to = destinations[i];
   64 |         m.x = from.x + ((to.x - from.x) * (n + 1)) / 3;
   65 |         m.y = from.y + ((to.y - from.y) * (n + 1)) / 3;
   66 |         constrainRink(m, false, 0);
   67 |         m.vx = (m.x - oldX) / sub;
   68 |         m.vy = (m.y - oldY) / sub;
   69 |       });
   70 |       if (this.cooldown > 0) continue;
   71 |       const p = this.puck;
   72 |       const damping = Math.exp(-0.1 * sub);
   73 |       p.vx *= damping;
   74 |       p.vy *= damping;
   75 |       this.limitSpeed();
   76 |       p.x += p.vx * sub;
   77 |       p.y += p.vy * sub;
   78 |       // Resolve swept small steps and project contacts in a consistent order.
   79 |       for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 3; iteration++) {
   80 |         for (const m of this.mallets) this.malletContact(m, iteration === 0);
   81 |         if (constrainRink(p, true) && iteration === 0) this.impact(p.x, p.y);
   82 |         this.posts(iteration === 0);
   83 |       }
   84 |       this.solvePinch();
   85 |       this.limitSpeed();
   86 |       if (inMouth(p.x, p.r) && p.y < FIELD.top - p.r) {
   87 |         this.awardPoint(1);
   88 |         break;
   89 |       }
   90 |       if (inMouth(p.x, p.r) && p.y > FIELD.bottom + p.r) {
   91 |         this.awardPoint(2);
   92 |         break;
   93 |       }
   94 |     }
   95 |     if (this.cooldown > 0) this.cooldown = Math.max(0, this.cooldown - dt);
   96 |     else this.checkUnplayable(dt);
   97 |   }
   98 |   private malletContact(m: Body, impulse: boolean) {
   99 |     const p = this.puck,
  100 |       dx = p.x - m.x,
  101 |       dy = p.y - m.y,
  102 |       d = Math.hypot(dx, dy),
  103 |       r = p.r + m.r;
  104 |     if (d >= r) return;
  105 |     const nx = d > 0.0001 ? dx / d : 0,
  106 |       ny = d > 0.0001 ? dy / d : m.y > FIELD.middle ? -1 : 1;
  107 |     p.x = m.x + nx * (r + 0.02);
  108 |     p.y = m.y + ny * (r + 0.02);
  109 |     const approach = (p.vx - m.vx) * nx + (p.vy - m.vy) * ny;
  110 |     if (impulse && approach < 0) {
  111 |       p.vx -= 1.9 * approach * nx;
  112 |       p.vy -= 1.9 * approach * ny;
  113 |       this.impact(p.x, p.y);
  114 |     }
  115 |   }
  116 |   private posts(impulse: boolean) {
  117 |     const p = this.puck;
  118 |     for (const y of [FIELD.top, FIELD.bottom])
  119 |       for (const x of [210 - GOAL_HALF, 210 + GOAL_HALF]) {
  120 |         const dx = p.x - x,
  121 |           dy = p.y - y,
  122 |           d = Math.hypot(dx, dy),
  123 |           r = p.r + 5;
  124 |         if (d >= r) continue;
  125 |         const nx = d > 0.0001 ? dx / d : 0,
  126 |           ny = d > 0.0001 ? dy / d : y === FIELD.top ? 1 : -1;
  127 |         p.x = x + nx * (r + 0.02);
  128 |         p.y = y + ny * (r + 0.02);
  129 |         const approach = p.vx * nx + p.vy * ny;
  130 |         if (impulse && approach < 0) {
  131 |           p.vx -= 1.96 * approach * nx;
  132 |           p.vy -= 1.96 * approach * ny;
  133 |           this.impact(x, y);
  134 |         }
  135 |       }
  136 |   }
  137 |   private solvePinch() {
  138 |     const p = this.puck;
  139 |     for (const m of this.mallets) {
  140 |       const r = m.r + p.r + 0.05;
  141 |       if (Math.hypot(p.x - m.x, p.y - m.y) >= r - 0.08) continue;
  142 |       let best = Infinity,
  143 |         bx = p.x,
  144 |         by = p.y;
  145 |       for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
  146 |         const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 32,
  147 |           x = m.x + Math.cos(angle) * r,
  148 |           y = m.y + Math.sin(angle) * r;
  149 |         if (
  150 |           !validPuckPosition(x, y, p.r) ||
  151 |           this.mallets.some(
  152 |             (other) =>
  153 |               other !== m &&
  154 |               Math.hypot(x - other.x, y - other.y) < other.r + p.r,
  155 |           )
  156 |         )
  157 |           continue;
  158 |         const d = (x - p.x) ** 2 + (y - p.y) ** 2;
  159 |         if (d < best) {
  160 |           best = d;
  161 |           bx = x;
  162 |           by = y;
  163 |         }
  164 |       }
  165 |       if (best < Infinity) {
  166 |         p.x = bx;
  167 |         p.y = by;
  168 |         const nx = (p.x - m.x) / r,
  169 |           ny = (p.y - m.y) / r,
  170 |           dot = p.vx * nx + p.vy * ny;
  171 |         if (dot < 0) {
  172 |           p.vx -= dot * nx;
  173 |           p.vy -= dot * ny;
  174 |         }
  175 |       }
  176 |     }
  177 |   }
  178 |   private checkUnplayable(dt: number) {
  179 |     const p = this.puck;
  180 |     const invalid =
  181 |       !validPuckPosition(p.x, p.y, p.r) || !reachablePuck(p.x, p.y, p.r);
  182 |     // A stationary reachable puck is a legitimate position. Never reset it for being slow.
  183 |     this.invalidFor = invalid ? this.invalidFor + dt : 0;
  184 |     if (this.invalidFor < 0.75) return;
  185 |     this.invalidFor = 0;
  186 |     this.recoveries++;
  187 |     // Local nearest-point repair only; do not reset the rally or invent a goal.
  188 |     if (!Number.isFinite(p.x + p.y + p.vx + p.vy)) {
  189 |       p.x = 210;
  190 |       p.y = 381;
  191 |       p.vx = 0;
  192 |       p.vy = 0;
  193 |     }
  194 |     constrainRink(p, true, 0);
  195 |     this.solvePinch();
  196 |     if (!reachablePuck(p.x, p.y, p.r)) {
  197 |       p.x = clamp(p.x, FIELD.left + 45, FIELD.right - 45);
  198 |       p.y = clamp(p.y, FIELD.top + 45, FIELD.bottom - 45);
  199 |     }
  200 |   }
  201 |   private limitSpeed() {
  202 |     const p = this.puck,
  203 |       s = Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy);
  204 |     if (s > 1100) {
  205 |       p.vx *= 1100 / s;
  206 |       p.vy *= 1100 / s;
  207 |     }
  208 |   }
  209 |   awardPoint(player: Player) {
  210 |     if (this.done) return;
  211 |     this.scores[player - 1]++;
  212 |     this.done = this.scores[player - 1] >= 5;
  213 |     this.cooldown = 1.1;
  214 |     this.invalidFor = 0;
  215 |     Object.assign(this.puck, {
  216 |       x: 210,
  217 |       y: 381,
  218 |       vx: 60,
  219 |       vy: player === 1 ? -220 : 220,
  220 |     });
  221 |     this.mallets.forEach((m, i) =>
  222 |       Object.assign(m, { x: 210, y: i === 0 ? 579 : 183, vx: 0, vy: 0 }),
  223 |     );
  224 |     this.scored(player);
  225 |   }
  226 | }
~~~

## src/games/air-hockey/HockeyState.ts
SHA-256: a3134d50d878c1112c3231117ded62e67df89feff7e6f0509d61d96d29f0576c
~~~text
    1 | import type { HockeyWorld } from "./AirHockeyPhysics";
    2 | import type { MatchClock } from "../../shared/rules/MatchClock";
    3 | import type { PossessionClock } from "./PossessionClock";
    4 | import { validPuckPosition } from "./rink";
    5 | export function saveHockey(
    6 |   w: HockeyWorld,
    7 |   clock: MatchClock,
    8 |   poss: PossessionClock,
    9 | ) {
   10 |   return {
   11 |     version: 1,
   12 |     puck: { ...w.puck },
   13 |     mallets: w.mallets.map((m) => ({ ...m })),
   14 |     scores: [...w.scores],
   15 |     cooldown: w.cooldown,
   16 |     clock: { remaining: clock.remaining, overtime: clock.overtime },
   17 |     possession: { side: poss.side, elapsed: poss.elapsed },
   18 |   };
   19 | }
   20 | export function restoreHockey(
   21 |   w: HockeyWorld,
   22 |   clock: MatchClock,
   23 |   poss: PossessionClock,
   24 |   value: unknown,
   25 | ) {
   26 |   const d = value as ReturnType<typeof saveHockey>;
   27 |   if (
   28 |     !d ||
   29 |     d.version !== 1 ||
   30 |     !d.puck ||
   31 |     !d.clock ||
   32 |     !d.possession ||
   33 |     !Array.isArray(d.mallets) ||
   34 |     d.mallets.length !== 2 ||
   35 |     !Array.isArray(d.scores) ||
   36 |     d.scores.length !== 2
   37 |   )
   38 |     return false;
   39 |   if (
   40 |     !d.scores.every((n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n < 5) ||
   41 |     !Number.isFinite(d.cooldown) ||
   42 |     d.cooldown < 0 ||
   43 |     d.cooldown > 1.35
   44 |   )
   45 |     return false;
   46 |   if (
   47 |     typeof d.clock.overtime !== "boolean" ||
   48 |     !Number.isFinite(d.clock.remaining) ||
   49 |     d.clock.remaining <= 0 ||
   50 |     d.clock.remaining > (d.clock.overtime ? 60 : 120)
   51 |   )
   52 |     return false;
   53 |   if (
   54 |     ![null, 1, 2].includes(d.possession.side) ||
   55 |     !Number.isFinite(d.possession.elapsed) ||
   56 |     d.possession.elapsed < 0 ||
   57 |     d.possession.elapsed >= 15
   58 |   )
   59 |     return false;
   60 |   const p = d.puck;
   61 |   if (
   62 |     !Number.isFinite(p.x + p.y + p.vx + p.vy) ||
   63 |     !validPuckPosition(p.x, p.y, 11) ||
   64 |     Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy) > 1100.01
   65 |   )
   66 |     return false;
   67 |   if (
   68 |     !d.mallets.every(
   69 |       (m, i) =>
   70 |         m &&
   71 |         Number.isFinite(m.x + m.y) &&
   72 |         m.x >= 53 &&
   73 |         m.x <= 367 &&
   74 |         m.y >= (i === 0 ? 410 : 141) &&
   75 |         m.y <= (i === 0 ? 621 : 352),
   76 |     )
   77 |   )
   78 |     return false;
   79 |   Object.assign(w.puck, p, { r: 11 });
   80 |   w.mallets.forEach((m, i) =>
   81 |     Object.assign(m, { x: d.mallets[i].x, y: d.mallets[i].y, vx: 0, vy: 0 }),
   82 |   );
   83 |   w.scores = [...d.scores] as [number, number];
   84 |   w.cooldown = d.cooldown;
   85 |   Object.assign(clock, d.clock);
   86 |   Object.assign(poss, d.possession);
   87 |   return true;
   88 | }
~~~

## src/games/air-hockey/PossessionClock.ts
SHA-256: 7d6fed3c6d5419745c330c583850b29547c2142cb4b45fad6a9fb55cda97653e
~~~text
    1 | import type { Player } from "../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    2 | export class PossessionClock {
    3 |   side: Player | null = null;
    4 |   elapsed = 0;
    5 |   reset() {
    6 |     this.side = null;
    7 |     this.elapsed = 0;
    8 |   }
    9 |   advance(dt: number, y: number): Player | null {
   10 |     const next = y > 384 ? 1 : y < 378 ? 2 : this.side;
   11 |     if (next !== this.side) {
   12 |       this.side = next;
   13 |       this.elapsed = 0;
   14 |     }
   15 |     if (this.side === null) return null;
   16 |     this.elapsed += dt;
   17 |     if (this.elapsed < 15) return null;
   18 |     const opponent = this.side === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   19 |     this.reset();
   20 |     return opponent;
   21 |   }
   22 |   get remaining() {
   23 |     return Math.max(0, 15 - this.elapsed);
   24 |   }
   25 | }
~~~

## src/games/air-hockey/rink.ts
SHA-256: ec220caa279a5013ba987af1254b08e82f7d717b5a5cc94b4982e894f28235b3
~~~text
    1 | import { FIELD } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    2 | import { clamp } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
    3 | export interface Body {
    4 |   x: number;
    5 |   y: number;
    6 |   vx: number;
    7 |   vy: number;
    8 |   r: number;
    9 | }
   10 | export const CORNER = 44,
   11 |   GOAL_HALF = 63;
   12 | export const inMouth = (x: number, r: number) =>
   13 |   Math.abs(x - 210) < GOAL_HALF - r - 5;
   14 | /** Outward normals remove only approaching velocity; separating contacts never bounce twice. */
   15 | function contact(
   16 |   b: Body,
   17 |   x: number,
   18 |   y: number,
   19 |   nx: number,
   20 |   ny: number,
   21 |   restitution: number,
   22 | ) {
   23 |   b.x = x;
   24 |   b.y = y;
   25 |   const approach = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny;
   26 |   if (approach > 0) {
   27 |     b.vx -= (1 + restitution) * approach * nx;
   28 |     b.vy -= (1 + restitution) * approach * ny;
   29 |   }
   30 | }
   31 | export function constrainRink(b: Body, goals: boolean, restitution = 0.96) {
   32 |   let hit = false;
   33 |   const left = FIELD.left + b.r,
   34 |     right = FIELD.right - b.r,
   35 |     top = FIELD.top + b.r,
   36 |     bottom = FIELD.bottom - b.r;
   37 |   if (b.x < left) {
   38 |     contact(b, left, b.y, -1, 0, restitution);
   39 |     hit = true;
   40 |   } else if (b.x > right) {
   41 |     contact(b, right, b.y, 1, 0, restitution);
   42 |     hit = true;
   43 |   }
   44 |   if (!(goals && inMouth(b.x, b.r))) {
   45 |     if (b.y < top) {
   46 |       contact(b, b.x, top, 0, -1, restitution);
   47 |       hit = true;
   48 |     } else if (b.y > bottom) {
   49 |       contact(b, b.x, bottom, 0, 1, restitution);
   50 |       hit = true;
   51 |     }
   52 |   }
   53 |   // In the four corner quadrants, constrain to a circular arc, not two opposing rail projections.
   54 |   const cx = clamp(b.x, FIELD.left + CORNER, FIELD.right - CORNER),
   55 |     cy = clamp(b.y, FIELD.top + CORNER, FIELD.bottom - CORNER);
   56 |   if (b.x !== cx && b.y !== cy) {
   57 |     const dx = b.x - cx,
   58 |       dy = b.y - cy,
   59 |       d = Math.hypot(dx, dy),
   60 |       allowed = CORNER - b.r;
   61 |     if (d > allowed) {
   62 |       contact(
   63 |         b,
   64 |         cx + (dx / d) * allowed,
   65 |         cy + (dy / d) * allowed,
   66 |         dx / d,
   67 |         dy / d,
   68 |         restitution,
   69 |       );
   70 |       hit = true;
   71 |     }
   72 |   }
   73 |   return hit;
   74 | }
   75 | export function validPuckPosition(x: number, y: number, r: number) {
   76 |   if (
   77 |     !Number.isFinite(x + y) ||
   78 |     x < FIELD.left + r - 0.01 ||
   79 |     x > FIELD.right - r + 0.01
   80 |   )
   81 |     return false;
   82 |   if (inMouth(x, r)) return y >= FIELD.top - r && y <= FIELD.bottom + r;
   83 |   if (y < FIELD.top + r - 0.01 || y > FIELD.bottom - r + 0.01) return false;
   84 |   const cx = clamp(x, FIELD.left + CORNER, FIELD.right - CORNER),
   85 |     cy = clamp(y, FIELD.top + CORNER, FIELD.bottom - CORNER);
   86 |   return (
   87 |     x === cx || y === cy || Math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy) <= CORNER - r + 0.01
   88 |   );
   89 | }
   90 | export function reachablePuck(x: number, y: number, r: number) {
   91 |   // Rounded mallet-center limits are checked by projecting the closest center.
   92 |   return [0, 1].some((i) => {
   93 |     const m = {
   94 |       x: clamp(x, FIELD.left + 29, FIELD.right - 29),
   95 |       y: clamp(
   96 |         y,
   97 |         i === 0 ? FIELD.middle + 29 : FIELD.top + 29,
   98 |         i === 0 ? FIELD.bottom - 29 : FIELD.middle - 29,
   99 |       ),
  100 |       vx: 0,
  101 |       vy: 0,
  102 |       r: 29,
  103 |     };
  104 |     constrainRink(m, false, 0);
  105 |     return Math.hypot(x - m.x, y - m.y) <= 29 + r + 0.5;
  106 |   });
  107 | }
~~~

## src/games/connect-four/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 7df5a3b482328f47ba7a39fc5ff8be252c3516bb907f7af1c5031d2f6c8b0502
~~~text
    1 | # Connect Four module
    2 | 
    3 | ConnectFourRules.ts owns gravity, legal columns, 69 winning windows, undo and replay validation. ConnectFourAI.ts mutates/undoes only a worker-local board and must restore it even on timeout. Search uses iterative deepening, bounded alpha-beta and transposition entries. ConnectFourGame blocks input during the drop animation/AI turn and checkpoints complete moves. Keep 7×6 geometry and match-result reporting independent of tournaments.
    4 | 
    5 | Read only this folder, the shared contract and required shared helpers. Do not import other games or put rules in core. Own and dispose workers/graphics; use host-owned input. Relevant checks: `tests/unit/phase3.test.ts and browser/phase3.spec.ts` (browser paths are under tests).
    6 | 
    7 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
~~~

## src/games/connect-four/ConnectFourAI.ts
SHA-256: 158756c451c76913f74e989950cc4788ddaa4d2a834cb7f54547ef42dc1f886b
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import { ConnectFourBoard, FOUR_LINES } from "./ConnectFourRules";
    3 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    4 | import type { Player } from "../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    5 | export interface SearchResult {
    6 |   column: number;
    7 |   depth: number;
    8 |   nodes: number;
    9 |   milliseconds: number;
   10 | }
   11 | function evaluate(b: ConnectFourBoard, root: Player, style: MatchRandom) {
   12 |   let score = 0;
   13 |   const weights = [0, 2, 18, 120, 100000];
   14 |   for (const line of FOUR_LINES) {
   15 |     let us = 0,
   16 |       them = 0;
   17 |     for (const i of line) {
   18 |       if (b.cells[i] === root) us++;
   19 |       else if (b.cells[i] !== null) them++;
   20 |     }
   21 |     if (!them) score += weights[us] * [1.08, 1, 1.03, 1][style.role];
   22 |     if (!us) score -= weights[them] * [1.05, 1.2, 1.12, 1.1][style.role];
   23 |   }
   24 |   for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
   25 |     const p = b.cells[r * 7 + 3];
   26 |     if (p) score += (p === root ? 1 : -1) * (5 + style.tempo * 2);
   27 |   }
   28 |   // A small preferred-flank positional term breaks symmetric plans without masking threats.
   29 |   for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
   30 |     const p = b.cells[r * 7 + (style.side < 0 ? 2 : 4)];
   31 |     if (p) score += (p === root ? 1 : -1) * (style.role === 3 ? 3 : 1);
   32 |   }
   33 |   return score;
   34 | }
   35 | export function searchConnectFour(
   36 |   b: ConnectFourBoard,
   37 |   difficulty: Difficulty,
   38 |   random = Math.random,
   39 |   options: { seed?: number; replay?: boolean } = {},
   40 | ): SearchResult {
   41 |   const style = new MatchRandom(options.seed ?? random),
   42 |     start = performance.now(),
   43 |     cfg = {
   44 |       medium: { ms: 25, depth: 3, nodes: 10000 },
   45 |       hard: { ms: 100, depth: 7, nodes: 60000 },
   46 |       impossible: { ms: 300, depth: 14, nodes: 220000 },
   47 |     }[difficulty],
   48 |     end = options.replay ? Infinity : start + cfg.ms,
   49 |     root = b.turn;
   50 |   let nodes = 0,
   51 |     best = b.legal()[0] ?? -1,
   52 |     completed = 0;
   53 |   const table = new Map<
   54 |     string,
   55 |     { depth: number; score: number; flag: number; move: number }
   56 |   >();
   57 |   const abort = {};
   58 |   function search(depth: number, alpha: number, beta: number): number {
   59 |     if ((++nodes & 63) === 0 && (performance.now() > end || nodes > cfg.nodes))
   60 |       throw abort;
   61 |     if (b.winner)
   62 |       return b.winner === "draw"
   63 |         ? 0
   64 |         : b.winner === root
   65 |           ? 100000 + depth
   66 |           : -100000 - depth;
   67 |     if (depth === 0) return evaluate(b, root, style);
   68 |     const key = b.cells.map((c) => c ?? 0).join("") + b.turn,
   69 |       entry = table.get(key),
   70 |       originalAlpha = alpha,
   71 |       originalBeta = beta;
   72 |     if (entry && entry.depth >= depth) {
   73 |       if (entry.flag === 0) return entry.score;
   74 |       if (entry.flag === 1) alpha = Math.max(alpha, entry.score);
   75 |       else beta = Math.min(beta, entry.score);
   76 |       if (alpha >= beta) return entry.score;
   77 |     }
   78 |     const maximizing = b.turn === root,
   79 |       moves = b.legal();
   80 |     if (entry) {
   81 |       const at = moves.indexOf(entry.move);
   82 |       if (at > 0) moves.unshift(...moves.splice(at, 1));
   83 |     }
   84 |     let value = maximizing ? -Infinity : Infinity,
   85 |       move = moves[0];
   86 |     for (const c of moves) {
   87 |       b.drop(c);
   88 |       let score: number;
   89 |       try {
   90 |         score = search(depth - 1, alpha, beta);
   91 |       } finally {
   92 |         b.undo();
   93 |       }
   94 |       if (maximizing ? score > value : score < value) {
   95 |         value = score;
   96 |         move = c;
   97 |       }
   98 |       if (maximizing) alpha = Math.max(alpha, value);
   99 |       else beta = Math.min(beta, value);
  100 |       if (alpha >= beta) break;
  101 |     }
  102 |     if (table.size < 40000)
  103 |       table.set(key, {
  104 |         depth,
  105 |         score: value,
  106 |         move,
  107 |         flag: value <= originalAlpha ? 2 : value >= originalBeta ? 1 : 0,
  108 |       });
  109 |     return value;
  110 |   }
  111 |   const legal = b.legal().sort((a, z) => style.rank(a) - style.rank(z));
  112 |   if (!legal.length) return { column: -1, depth: 0, nodes: 0, milliseconds: 0 };
  113 |   // Never overlook a win in one, even at the casual setting.
  114 |   for (const c of legal) {
  115 |     b.drop(c);
  116 |     const won = b.winner === root;
  117 |     b.undo();
  118 |     if (won)
  119 |       return {
  120 |         column: c,
  121 |         depth: 1,
  122 |         nodes,
  123 |         milliseconds: performance.now() - start,
  124 |       };
  125 |   }
  126 |   for (let depth = 1; depth <= cfg.depth; depth++) {
  127 |     let candidate = best,
  128 |       value = -Infinity;
  129 |     try {
  130 |       const ordered = [best, ...legal.filter((c) => c !== best)];
  131 |       for (const c of ordered) {
  132 |         b.drop(c);
  133 |         let s: number;
  134 |         try {
  135 |           s = search(depth - 1, -Infinity, Infinity);
  136 |         } finally {
  137 |           b.undo();
  138 |         }
  139 |         if (
  140 |           s > value ||
  141 |           (s === value && style.rank(c) < style.rank(candidate))
  142 |         ) {
  143 |           value = s;
  144 |           candidate = c;
  145 |         }
  146 |       }
  147 |       best = candidate;
  148 |       completed = depth;
  149 |     } catch (e) {
  150 |       if (e !== abort) throw e;
  151 |       break;
  152 |     }
  153 |     if (Math.abs(value) >= 100000 || performance.now() >= end) break;
  154 |   }
  155 |   if (difficulty === "medium" && style.next() < 0.16)
  156 |     best = legal[Math.floor(style.next() * legal.length)];
  157 |   return {
  158 |     column: best,
  159 |     depth: completed,
  160 |     nodes,
  161 |     milliseconds: performance.now() - start,
  162 |   };
  163 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { turnBackground } from "../../shared/components/TurnView";

   51 |             type: "module",
   52 |           }),
   53 |         ctx.reportAI,
   54 |       );
   55 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
   56 |       if (
   57 |         this.paused ||
   58 |         this.age < 0.32 ||
   59 |         this.board.winner ||
   60 |         (this.ai && this.board.turn === 2) ||
   61 |         x < 35 ||
   62 |         x >= 385 ||
   63 |         y < 200 ||
   64 |         y > 560
   65 |       )
   66 |         return;
   67 |       this.place(Math.floor((x - 35) / 50));

   69 |   }
   70 |   private place(c: number) {

   72 |     if (at < 0) return;

   74 |     this.age = 0;
   75 |     this.thinking = 0;

   86 |       this.ai &&
   87 |       !this.board.winner &&
   88 |       this.board.turn === 2 &&
   89 |       !this.pending &&
   90 |       this.age > 0.32
   91 |     ) {

   93 |       if (this.thinking > 0.75) {

  116 |         : this.board.turn === 1

  121 |     );

  128 |         y = 237 + Math.floor(i / 7) * 50,

  145 |       }

  148 |     this.hint.setDepth(1);
  149 |     if (this.board.winner && this.age > 0.9 && !this.reported) {
  150 |       this.reported = true;
  151 |       const w = this.board.winner;
  152 |       this.ctx.finish({
  153 |         winner: w,
  154 |         scores: w === 1 ? [1, 0] : w === 2 ? [0, 1] : [0, 0],
  155 |       });
  156 |     }
  157 |   }
  158 |   pause() {
  159 |     this.paused = true;
  160 |     this.generation++;
  161 |     this.pending = false;
  162 |     this.ai?.cancel();
  163 |   }
  164 |   resume() {
  165 |     this.paused = false;
  166 |     this.thinking = 0;
  167 |   }
  168 |   dispose() {
  169 |     this.disposed = true;
  170 |     this.generation++;
  171 |     this.ai?.cancel();
  172 |     this.g.destroy();

  174 |     this.hint.destroy();

  180 |       turn: this.board.turn,
  181 |       winner: this.board.winner,
  182 |       moves: this.board.history.length,
  183 |       pending: this.pending,
  184 |     };
  185 |   }
  186 | }
~~~

## src/games/connect-four/ConnectFourRules.ts
SHA-256: 1dfb4ca44a898c7e74b28ce7e709b97d1d37fe342af2f685f9c54c8a30e2ed91
~~~text
    1 | import type { Player, Winner } from "../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    2 | export const FOUR_LINES: number[][] = [];
    3 | for (let y = 0; y < 6; y++)
    4 |   for (let x = 0; x < 7; x++)
    5 |     for (const [dx, dy] of [
    6 |       [1, 0],
    7 |       [0, 1],
    8 |       [1, 1],
    9 |       [-1, 1],
   10 |     ]) {
   11 |       const xx = x + 3 * dx,
   12 |         yy = y + 3 * dy;
   13 |       if (xx >= 0 && xx < 7 && yy < 6)
   14 |         FOUR_LINES.push(
   15 |           Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => (y + i * dy) * 7 + x + i * dx),
   16 |         );
   17 |     }
   18 | export class ConnectFourBoard {
   19 |   cells: (Player | null)[] = Array(42).fill(null);
   20 |   turn: Player = 1;
   21 |   winner: Winner | null = null;
   22 |   line: number[] | null = null;
   23 |   history: number[] = [];
   24 |   legal() {
   25 |     return this.winner
   26 |       ? []
   27 |       : [3, 2, 4, 1, 5, 0, 6].filter((c) => this.cells[c] === null);
   28 |   }
   29 |   drop(column: number) {
   30 |     if (
   31 |       this.winner ||
   32 |       !Number.isInteger(column) ||
   33 |       column < 0 ||
   34 |       column > 6 ||
   35 |       this.cells[column] !== null
   36 |     )
   37 |       return -1;
   38 |     let row = 5;
   39 |     while (this.cells[row * 7 + column] !== null) row--;
   40 |     const index = row * 7 + column;
   41 |     this.cells[index] = this.turn;
   42 |     this.history.push(column);
   43 |     this.line =
   44 |       FOUR_LINES.find((l) => l.every((i) => this.cells[i] === this.turn)) ??
   45 |       null;
   46 |     if (this.line) this.winner = this.turn;
   47 |     else if (this.history.length === 42) this.winner = "draw";
   48 |     this.turn = this.turn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   49 |     return index;
   50 |   }
   51 |   undo() {
   52 |     const c = this.history.pop();
   53 |     if (c === undefined) return;
   54 |     for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++)
   55 |       if (this.cells[r * 7 + c] !== null) {
   56 |         this.cells[r * 7 + c] = null;
   57 |         break;
   58 |       }
   59 |     this.turn = this.turn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   60 |     this.winner = null;
   61 |     this.line = null;
   62 |   }
   63 |   save() {
   64 |     return { version: 1, moves: [...this.history] };
   65 |   }
   66 |   static restore(data: unknown) {
   67 |     const fresh = new ConnectFourBoard();
   68 |     if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return fresh;
   69 |     const d = data as { version?: number; moves?: unknown };
   70 |     if (d.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(d.moves) || d.moves.length > 42)
   71 |       return fresh;
   72 |     const b = new ConnectFourBoard();
   73 |     for (const c of d.moves)
   74 |       if (typeof c !== "number" || b.drop(c) < 0) return fresh;
   75 |     return b;
   76 |   }
   77 | }
~~~

## src/games/dots-and-boxes/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 2c8138e257b82c72cefe4be3fa062c7e7d941ba4518b9b3d6ef600f8aeea9420
~~~text
    1 | # Dots and Boxes
    2 | 
    3 | Rules.ts owns 40 edges and 16 boxes. Horizontal edges 0–19, vertical 20–39. Only completed boxes score; capture retains turn, including double captures. Saves replay legal history. AI is cancellable worker alpha-beta with extra-turn awareness, capture/chain ordering and bounded endgame search; no perfect-play claim. Game owns only rendering/input/feedback and reports one result. Test rules and worker legality before changing edge numbering or scoring.
    4 | 
    5 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
~~~

## src/games/dots-and-boxes/AI.ts
SHA-256: 3b810e6682b0eefbc59901c7defa38668be00eb4f3ce647bb8f9b49d05dc9c04
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { DotsBoard } from "./Rules";
    3 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    4 | 
    5 | function sacrificeDamage(board: DotsBoard, edge: number): number {
    6 |   const claimed = board.edges.slice();
    7 |   claimed[edge] = 1;
    8 |   const queue: number[] = [];
    9 |   for (const b of board.adjacent[edge]) {
   10 |     if (!board.owners[b]) {
   11 |       let drawn = 0;
   12 |       for (const e of board.boxes[b]) if (claimed[e]) drawn++;
   13 |       if (drawn === 3) queue.push(b);
   14 |     }
   15 |   }
   16 |   let total = 0;
   17 |   while (queue.length > 0) {
   18 |     const b = queue.shift()!;
   19 |     total++;
   20 |     const remaining = board.boxes[b].find((e) => !claimed[e]);
   21 |     if (remaining !== undefined) {
   22 |       claimed[remaining] = 1;
   23 |       for (const adj of board.adjacent[remaining]) {
   24 |         if (adj !== b && !board.owners[adj]) {
   25 |           let drawn = 0;
   26 |           for (const e of board.boxes[adj]) if (claimed[e]) drawn++;
   27 |           if (drawn === 3 && !queue.includes(adj)) {
   28 |             queue.push(adj);
   29 |           }
   30 |         }
   31 |       }
   32 |     }
   33 |   }
   34 |   return total;
   35 | }
   36 | 
   37 | function priority(b: DotsBoard, e: number): number {
   38 |   let hasThree = 0;
   39 |   let hasTwo = 0;
   40 |   let safeQuality = 0;
   41 | 
   42 |   for (const box of b.adjacent[e]) {
   43 |     let drawn = 0;
   44 |     for (const edge of b.boxes[box]) {
   45 |       if (b.edges[edge]) drawn++;
   46 |     }
   47 |     if (drawn === 3) hasThree++;
   48 |     else if (drawn === 2) hasTwo++;
   49 |     else if (drawn === 1) safeQuality += 15;
   50 |     else safeQuality += 30;
   51 |   }
   52 | 
   53 |   if (hasThree === 2) {
   54 |     return 30000;
   55 |   }
   56 |   if (hasThree === 1) {
   57 |     return hasTwo === 1 ? 25000 : 20000;
   58 |   }
   59 |   if (hasTwo > 0) {
   60 |     const damage = sacrificeDamage(b, e);
   61 |     return -20000 - damage * 1000;
   62 |   }
   63 |   return 1000 + safeQuality;
   64 | }
   65 | 
   66 | function getBoardKey(b: DotsBoard): string {
   67 |   let m0 = 0,
   68 |     m1 = 0,
   69 |     m2 = 0;
   70 |   const len = b.totalEdges;
   71 |   for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(32, len); i++) {
   72 |     if (b.edges[i]) m0 |= 1 << i;
   73 |   }
   74 |   for (let i = 32; i < Math.min(64, len); i++) {
   75 |     if (b.edges[i]) m1 |= 1 << (i - 32);
   76 |   }
   77 |   for (let i = 64; i < len; i++) {
   78 |     if (b.edges[i]) m2 |= 1 << (i - 64);
   79 |   }
   80 |   return `${m0}_${m1}_${m2}_${b.turn}_${b.scores[0]}`;
   81 | }
   82 | 
   83 | export function chooseEdge(
   84 |   board: DotsBoard,
   85 |   difficulty: Difficulty,
   86 |   options: { seed?: number; replay?: boolean } = {},
   87 | ) {
   88 |   const style = new MatchRandom(options.seed);
   89 |   const preference = (e: number) => {
   90 |     const box = board.adjacent[e]?.[0] ?? 0,
   91 |       center = (board.size - 1) / 2,
   92 |       row = Math.floor(box / board.size),
   93 |       col = box % board.size;
   94 |     return (
   95 |       (style.role === 0
   96 |         ? Math.abs(row - center) + Math.abs(col - center)
   97 |         : style.role === 1
   98 |           ? -Math.abs(row - center) - Math.abs(col - center)
   99 |           : style.role === 2
  100 |             ? e < board.horizontalCount
  101 |               ? 1
  102 |               : -1
  103 |             : col * style.side) +
  104 |       style.rank(e) * (1 + style.tempo)
  105 |     );
  106 |   };
  107 |   const order = (b: DotsBoard, a: number, c: number) =>
  108 |     priority(b, c) - priority(b, a) || preference(c) - preference(a);
  109 |   const start = performance.now(),
  110 |     budget = { medium: 12, hard: 80, impossible: 350 }[difficulty],
  111 |     legal = board.legal();
  112 |   let nodes = 0,
  113 |     best = legal.sort((a, b) => order(board, a, b))[0] ?? -1,
  114 |     completedDepth = 0;
  115 |   const root = board.turn;
  116 |   if (difficulty === "medium") {
  117 |     return {
  118 |       edge: best,
  119 |       milliseconds: performance.now() - start,
  120 |       depth: 0,
  121 |       nodes,
  122 |     };
  123 |   }
  124 |   const cache = new Map<
  125 |     string,
  126 |     { depth: number; value: number; flag: number }
  127 |   >();
  128 |   const evaluate = (b: DotsBoard) => {
  129 |     if (b.winner) {
  130 |       if (b.winner === root)
  131 |         return 100000 + (b.scores[root - 1] - b.scores[2 - root]) * 1000;
  132 |       if (b.winner === "draw") return 0;
  133 |       return -100000 + (b.scores[root - 1] - b.scores[2 - root]) * 1000;
  134 |     }
  135 |     const scoreDiff = (b.scores[root - 1] - b.scores[2 - root]) * 1000;
  136 |     let pendingCaptures = 0;
  137 |     for (let i = 0; i < b.totalBoxes; i++) {
  138 |       if (!b.owners[i]) {
  139 |         let drawn = 0;
  140 |         for (const e of b.boxes[i]) if (b.edges[e]) drawn++;
  141 |         if (drawn === 3) pendingCaptures++;
  142 |       }
  143 |     }
  144 |     const turnMultiplier = b.turn === root ? 1 : -1;
  145 |     return scoreDiff + pendingCaptures * turnMultiplier * 900;
  146 |   };
  147 |   const timeout = Symbol("search budget");
  148 |   const search = (
  149 |     b: DotsBoard,
  150 |     depth: number,
  151 |     alpha: number,
  152 |     beta: number,
  153 |   ): number => {
  154 |     if (
  155 |       ++nodes > 50000 ||
  156 |       (!options.replay && performance.now() - start > budget)
  157 |     )
  158 |       throw timeout;
  159 |     if (b.winner || depth === 0) return evaluate(b);
  160 |     const key = getBoardKey(b);
  161 |     const originalAlpha = alpha,
  162 |       originalBeta = beta,
  163 |       memo = cache.get(key);
  164 |     if (memo && memo.depth >= depth) {
  165 |       if (memo.flag === 0) return memo.value;
  166 |       if (memo.flag === 1) alpha = Math.max(alpha, memo.value);
  167 |       else beta = Math.min(beta, memo.value);
  168 |       if (alpha >= beta) return memo.value;
  169 |     }
  170 |     const maximize = b.turn === root;
  171 |     let value = maximize ? -Infinity : Infinity;
  172 |     for (const e of b.legal().sort((a, c) => order(b, a, c))) {
  173 |       const child = b.clone();
  174 |       child.play(e);
  175 |       const v = search(child, depth - 1, alpha, beta);
  176 |       value = maximize ? Math.max(value, v) : Math.min(value, v);
  177 |       if (maximize) alpha = Math.max(alpha, value);
  178 |       else beta = Math.min(beta, value);
  179 |       if (beta <= alpha) {
  180 |         break;
  181 |       }
  182 |     }
  183 |     if (cache.size < 20000)
  184 |       cache.set(key, {
  185 |         depth,
  186 |         value,
  187 |         flag: value <= originalAlpha ? 2 : value >= originalBeta ? 1 : 0,
  188 |       });
  189 |     return value;
  190 |   };
  191 |   const maxSearchDepth =
  192 |     difficulty === "hard" ? 6 : Math.min(legal.length, 30);
  193 |   for (let depth = 1; depth <= maxSearchDepth; depth++) {
  194 |     let candidate = best,
  195 |       score = -Infinity;
  196 |     try {
  197 |       for (const e of [best, ...legal.filter((x) => x !== best)]) {
  198 |         const b = board.clone();
  199 |         b.play(e);
  200 |         const v = search(b, depth - 1, -Infinity, Infinity);
  201 |         if (
  202 |           v > score ||
  203 |           (v === score && preference(e) > preference(candidate))
  204 |         ) {
  205 |           score = v;
  206 |           candidate = e;
  207 |         }
  208 |       }
  209 |       best = candidate;
  210 |       completedDepth = depth;
  211 |     } catch (error) {
  212 |       if (error !== timeout) throw error;
  213 |       break;
  214 |     }
  215 |   }
  216 |   return {
  217 |     edge: best,
  218 |     milliseconds: performance.now() - start,
  219 |     depth: completedDepth,
  220 |     nodes,
  221 |   };
  222 | }
~~~

## src/games/dots-and-boxes/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 7c81614b1cc0a15e45fcb367eaac83cc570f6371b02106adabf8e963f0a5d2bb
~~~text
    1 | export function createBoxes(size: number): number[][] {
    2 |   const H = (size + 1) * size;
    3 |   return Array.from({ length: size * size }, (_, i) => {
    4 |     const r = Math.floor(i / size),
    5 |       c = i % size;
    6 |     return [
    7 |       r * size + c,
    8 |       (r + 1) * size + c,
    9 |       H + r * (size + 1) + c,
   10 |       H + r * (size + 1) + c + 1,
   11 |     ];
   12 |   });
   13 | }
   14 | 
   15 | export function createAdjacent(totalEdges: number, boxesList: number[][]): number[][] {
   16 |   return Array.from({ length: totalEdges }, (_, i) =>
   17 |     boxesList.flatMap((b, j) => (b.includes(i) ? [j] : [])),
   18 |   );
   19 | }
   20 | 
   21 | const BOXES_BY_SIZE: Record<number, number[][]> = {
   22 |   4: createBoxes(4),
   23 |   5: createBoxes(5),
   24 |   6: createBoxes(6),
   25 | };
   26 | 
   27 | const ADJACENT_BY_SIZE: Record<number, number[][]> = {
   28 |   4: createAdjacent(40, BOXES_BY_SIZE[4]),
   29 |   5: createAdjacent(60, BOXES_BY_SIZE[5]),
   30 |   6: createAdjacent(84, BOXES_BY_SIZE[6]),
   31 | };
   32 | 
   33 | export const boxes = BOXES_BY_SIZE[4];
   34 | export const adjacent = ADJACENT_BY_SIZE[4];
   35 | 
   36 | export class DotsBoard {
   37 |   readonly size: number;
   38 |   readonly horizontalCount: number;
   39 |   readonly totalEdges: number;
   40 |   readonly totalBoxes: number;
   41 |   readonly boxes: number[][];
   42 |   readonly adjacent: number[][];
   43 |   edges: number[];
   44 |   owners: number[];
   45 |   turn: 1 | 2 = 1;
   46 |   history: number[] = [];
   47 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   48 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   49 | 
   50 |   constructor(size: number = 4) {
   51 |     this.size = size === 5 || size === 6 ? size : 4;
   52 |     this.horizontalCount = (this.size + 1) * this.size;
   53 |     this.totalEdges = 2 * this.horizontalCount;
   54 |     this.totalBoxes = this.size * this.size;
   55 |     this.boxes = BOXES_BY_SIZE[this.size] ?? createBoxes(this.size);
   56 |     this.adjacent =
   57 |       ADJACENT_BY_SIZE[this.size] ??
   58 |       createAdjacent(this.totalEdges, this.boxes);
   59 |     this.edges = Array<number>(this.totalEdges).fill(0);
   60 |     this.owners = Array<number>(this.totalBoxes).fill(0);
   61 |   }
   62 | 
   63 |   legal() {
   64 |     return this.edges.flatMap((v, i) => (v === 0 ? [i] : []));
   65 |   }
   66 | 
   67 |   play(edge: number) {
   68 |     if (
   69 |       this.winner ||
   70 |       !Number.isInteger(edge) ||
   71 |       edge < 0 ||
   72 |       edge >= this.totalEdges ||
   73 |       this.edges[edge]
   74 |     )
   75 |       return -1;
   76 |     this.edges[edge] = this.turn;
   77 |     this.history.push(edge);
   78 |     let gained = 0;
   79 |     for (const box of this.adjacent[edge])
   80 |       if (!this.owners[box] && this.boxes[box].every((e) => this.edges[e])) {
   81 |         this.owners[box] = this.turn;
   82 |         this.scores[this.turn - 1]++;
   83 |         gained++;
   84 |       }
   85 |     if (this.scores[0] + this.scores[1] === this.totalBoxes)
   86 |       this.winner =
   87 |         this.scores[0] === this.scores[1]
   88 |           ? "draw"
   89 |           : this.scores[0] > this.scores[1]
   90 |             ? 1
   91 |             : 2;
   92 |     else if (!gained) this.turn = this.turn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   93 |     return gained;
   94 |   }
   95 | 
   96 |   clone() {
   97 |     const b = new DotsBoard(this.size);
   98 |     b.edges = [...this.edges];
   99 |     b.owners = [...this.owners];
  100 |     b.turn = this.turn;
  101 |     b.history = [...this.history];
  102 |     b.scores = [...this.scores];
  103 |     b.winner = this.winner;
  104 |     return b;
  105 |   }
  106 | 
  107 |   save() {
  108 |     return { history: [...this.history], size: this.size };
  109 |   }
  110 | 
  111 |   static restore(value: unknown, fallbackSize = 4) {
  112 |     const size =
  113 |       value &&
  114 |       typeof value === "object" &&
  115 |       typeof (value as any).size === "number"
  116 |         ? (value as any).size
  117 |         : fallbackSize;
  118 |     const b = new DotsBoard(size);
  119 |     if (
  120 |       !value ||
  121 |       typeof value !== "object" ||
  122 |       !Array.isArray((value as any).history)
  123 |     )
  124 |       return b;
  125 |     const h = (value as any).history;
  126 |     if (h.length > b.totalEdges) return b;
  127 |     for (const e of h) if (b.play(e) < 0) return new DotsBoard(size);
  128 |     return b;
  129 |   }
  130 | }
  131 | 
  132 | export function edgeEnds(edge: number, size = 4) {
  133 |   const H = (size + 1) * size,
  134 |     spacing = 300 / size;
  135 |   if (edge < H) {
  136 |     const x = 60 + (edge % size) * spacing,
  137 |       y = 240 + Math.floor(edge / size) * spacing;
  138 |     return { x, y, x2: x + spacing, y2: y };
  139 |   }
  140 |   const i = edge - H,
  141 |     stride = size + 1,
  142 |     x = 60 + (i % stride) * spacing,
  143 |     y = 240 + Math.floor(i / stride) * spacing;
  144 |   return { x, y, x2: x, y2: y + spacing };
  145 | }
  146 | 
  147 | export function pickEdge(x: number, y: number, size = 4) {
  148 |   const H = (size + 1) * size,
  149 |     totalEdges = 2 * H,
  150 |     spacing = 300 / size,
  151 |     spacingSq = spacing * spacing,
  152 |     threshold = 21 * (spacing / 75);
  153 |   let best = -1,
  154 |     distance = threshold;
  155 |   for (let e = 0; e < totalEdges; e++) {
  156 |     const p = edgeEnds(e, size),
  157 |       dx = p.x2 - p.x,
  158 |       dy = p.y2 - p.y,
  159 |       t = Math.max(
  160 |         0.14,
  161 |         Math.min(0.86, ((x - p.x) * dx + (y - p.y) * dy) / spacingSq),
  162 |       ),
  163 |       d = Math.hypot(x - p.x - t * dx, y - p.y - t * dy);
  164 |     if (d < distance) {
  165 |       best = e;
  166 |       distance = d;
  167 |     }
  168 |   }
  169 |   return best;
  170 | }
~~~

## src/games/fruit-duel/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 14f65b510110dc96e0cfbf709960aa533b37ac55bf4440dfc74751552059f062
~~~text
    1 | # Fruit Duel
    2 | 
    3 | Rules owns seven real-fruit IDs (0–6), three decoys (7 gift, 8 medal, 9 flower), reveal timing, cooldowns and first-to-ten. Real fruit is guaranteed within three reveals. Any real fruit scores; there is no target-memory task. Empty/decoy swings cause 1.35s recovery and never give points to the rival. Successful swings recover for .72s; FirstResponse arbitrates ties. Capture the object ID at input time, before another reveal. AI sees only presented objects, uses the same tap/cooldown API, and Impossible never intentionally attacks decoys.
    4 | 
    5 | FruitArt owns original fruit, decoys, curved swords and cut interiors. FruitGame uses retained graphics, bounded split halves/droplets, short swing motion and edge cooldown arcs. Slice visuals/sound wait .15s for blade impact. No live instructions or keyboard labels. Pause freezes all clocks and animation; host input and global audio handle lifecycle. No new textures, workers, RAF or cross-game imports. MatchRandom supplies seeded match replay.
    6 | 
    7 | Tests: fruit-duel.test.ts (300 seeded AI completions plus invalid inputs/cooldown/ties/object changes), fruit-timer-effects.spec.ts, existing complete-match expansion browser check.
    8 | 
    9 | SwordMotion defines mirrored windup, impact, follow-through and slow return paths. Each sword returns to its original backed-away resting position after every strike. Rules and rendering share the same recovery duration/start time; input unlocks exactly when the sword reaches rest. No separate shake/tween/arc timer.
~~~

## src/games/fruit-duel/AI.ts
SHA-256: 1c89613d73e09b60a170daeb85224bd8782b8df2a9b47cafd723149a47070de5
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import { isFruit, type FruitMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class FruitAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   snapshot() {
    7 |     return { ...this.personality.snapshot(), reaction: this.delay };
    8 |   }
    9 |   private version = -1;
   10 |   private tapped = false;
   11 |   private delay = 1;
   12 |   private mistake = false;
   13 |   constructor(
   14 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   15 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   16 |   ) {
   17 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   18 |   }
   19 |   update(m: FruitMatch) {
   20 |     if (m.version !== this.version) {
   21 |       this.version = m.version;
   22 |       this.tapped = false;
   23 |       const style = this.personality,
   24 |         cautious = style.role === 1;
   25 |       this.delay = style.sample(
   26 |         { medium: 0.46, hard: 0.275, impossible: 0.145 }[this.difficulty] *
   27 |           (0.94 + style.tempo * 0.06) +
   28 |           (cautious ? 0.015 : 0),
   29 |         { medium: 0.1, hard: 0.055, impossible: 0.018 }[this.difficulty],
   30 |         0.12,
   31 |       );
   32 |       // Recognition errors are sampled once per presented fruit, never per frame.
   33 |       this.mistake =
   34 |         style.next() <
   35 |         { medium: 0.1, hard: 0.02, impossible: 0 }[this.difficulty] *
   36 |           (cautious ? 0.6 : style.role === 0 ? 1.3 : 1);
   37 |     }
   38 |     if (
   39 |       !this.tapped &&
   40 |       m.phase === "active" &&
   41 |       m.time - m.visibleAt >= this.delay &&
   42 |       (isFruit(m.current) || this.mistake)
   43 |     ) {
   44 |       if (m.tap(1)) this.tapped = true;
   45 |     }
   46 |   }
   47 | }
~~~

~~~text
  150 | export function half(
  151 |   g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
  152 |   id: number,
  153 |   x: number,
  154 |   y: number,
  155 |   r: number,
  156 |   left: boolean,

  158 | ) {

  160 |   g.translateCanvas(x, y);

  164 |   g.beginPath();
  165 |   g.arc(0, 0, r, a, a + Math.PI);
  166 |   g.closePath();
  167 |   g.fillPath();
  168 |   g.lineStyle(3, ink).strokePath();

  171 |   g.arc(0, 0, r * 0.82, a, a + Math.PI);
  172 |   g.closePath();
  173 |   g.fillPath();
  174 |   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
  175 |     g.fillStyle(id === 2 ? ink : 0xb87350).fillEllipse(
  176 |       (left ? -1 : 1) * r * 0.32,
  177 |       (i - 1) * r * 0.35,
  178 |       3,
  179 |       6,
  180 |     );
  181 |   g.restore();
  182 | }
  183 | export function sword(
  184 |   g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
  185 |   x: number,
  186 |   y: number,
  187 |   rotation: number,
  188 |   color: number,
  189 |   stunned: boolean,
  190 | ) {
  191 |   g.save();
  192 |   g.translateCanvas(x, y);
  193 |   g.rotateCanvas(rotation);
  194 |   g.fillStyle(ink, 0.1).fillEllipse(-25, -62, 58, 150);
  195 |   const bezier = (
  196 |     a: { x: number; y: number },
  197 |     b: { x: number; y: number },
  198 |     c: { x: number; y: number },
  199 |   ) =>
  200 |     Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => {
  201 |       const t = i / 17,
  202 |         u = 1 - t;
  203 |       return {
  204 |         x: u * u * a.x + 2 * u * t * b.x + t * t * c.x,
  205 |         y: u * u * a.y + 2 * u * t * b.y + t * t * c.y,
  206 |       };
  207 |     });
  208 |   const blade = [
  209 |     ...bezier({ x: -8, y: -18 }, { x: -45, y: -119 }, { x: -139, y: -154 }),
  210 |     ...bezier({ x: -139, y: -154 }, { x: -103, y: -92 }, { x: -18, y: -9 }),
  211 |   ];
  212 |   g.fillStyle(stunned ? 0xb3b4bc : 0xedf5f4).fillPoints(blade, true);
  213 |   g.lineStyle(5, ink).strokePoints(blade, true);
  214 |   g.lineStyle(5, 0xc4d3d6)
  215 |     .lineBetween(-22, -28, -61, -97)
  216 |     .lineBetween(-61, -97, -120, -143);
  217 |   g.lineStyle(16, ink).lineBetween(-7, -7, 12, 20);
  218 |   g.lineStyle(9, color).lineBetween(-7, -7, 12, 20);
  219 |   g.lineStyle(7, ink)
  220 |     .beginPath()
  221 |     .arc(0, 0, 24, -0.4, Math.PI + 1)
  222 |     .strokePath();
  223 |   g.lineStyle(3, color)
  224 |     .beginPath()
  225 |     .arc(0, 0, 24, -0.4, Math.PI + 1)
  226 |     .strokePath();
  227 |   g.restore();
  228 | }
~~~

## src/games/fruit-duel/Rules.ts
SHA-256: a84d86f80a1ec34f524afd3dba1d1b155e2e30a4b4acdf2d80f9795fbfff165a
~~~text
    1 | import { HIT_RECOVERY, MISS_RECOVERY } from "./SwordMotion";
    2 | import { FirstResponse } from "../../shared/rules/FirstResponse";
    3 | export const fruits = [
    4 |   "Apple",
    5 |   "Orange",
    6 |   "Watermelon",
    7 |   "Banana",
    8 |   "Pomegranate",
    9 |   "Pineapple",
   10 |   "Strawberry",
   11 | ];
   12 | export const decoys = ["Gift", "Medal", "Flower"];
   13 | export const isFruit = (id: number) =>
   14 |   Number.isInteger(id) && id >= 0 && id < fruits.length;
   15 | export class FruitMatch {
   16 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   17 |   target = 0;
   18 |   current = -1;
   19 |   phase: "preview" | "show" | "active" | "between" | "done" = "preview";
   20 |   time = 0;
   21 |   visibleAt = 0;
   22 |   version = 0;
   23 |   round = 0;
   24 |   message = "";
   25 |   winner: 1 | 2 | null = null;
   26 |   blockedUntil = [0, 0];
   27 |   attemptSerial = [0, 0];
   28 |   missed = [false, false];
   29 |   swingStartedAt = [-100, -100];
   30 |   recoveryDuration = [HIT_RECOVERY, HIT_RECOVERY];
   31 |   capturedBy: 0 | 1 | null = null;
   32 |   capturedKind = -1;
   33 |   private until = 0.7;
   34 |   private gap = 0;
   35 |   private queue = new FirstResponse<{ kind: number }>();
   36 |   constructor(private random = Math.random) {}
   37 |   canTap(p: 0 | 1) {
   38 |     return this.phase !== "done" && this.time >= this.blockedUntil[p];
   39 |   }
   40 |   tap(p: 0 | 1) {
   41 |     if (!this.canTap(p) || this.phase === "show") return false;
   42 |     this.attemptSerial[p]++;
   43 |     this.swingStartedAt[p] = this.time;
   44 |     const valid = this.phase === "active" && isFruit(this.current);
   45 |     this.missed[p] = !valid;
   46 |     if (!valid) {
   47 |       this.recoveryDuration[p] = MISS_RECOVERY;
   48 |       this.blockedUntil[p] = this.time + MISS_RECOVERY;
   49 |       return true;
   50 |     }
   51 |     // Capture the judgment now, before the next object can be revealed.
   52 |     this.recoveryDuration[p] = HIT_RECOVERY;
   53 |     this.blockedUntil[p] = this.time + HIT_RECOVERY;
   54 |     this.queue.add(p, { kind: this.current }, this.time);
   55 |     return true;
   56 |   }
   57 |   present() {
   58 |     if (this.phase === "show") {
   59 |       this.phase = "active";
   60 |       this.visibleAt = this.time;
   61 |       this.until = this.time + 0.85 + this.random() * 0.4;
   62 |     }
   63 |   }
   64 |   private reveal() {
   65 |     this.current =
   66 |       ++this.gap >= 3 || this.random() < 0.58
   67 |         ? Math.floor(this.random() * 7)
   68 |         : 7 + Math.floor(this.random() * 3);
   69 |     if (isFruit(this.current)) {
   70 |       this.gap = 0;
   71 |       this.target = this.current;
   72 |     }
   73 |     this.phase = "show";
   74 |     this.version++;
   75 |   }
   76 |   update(dt: number) {
   77 |     this.time += Math.max(0, dt);
   78 |     if (this.phase === "done") return;
   79 |     const response = this.queue.resolve(this.time);
   80 |     if (response) {
   81 |       if (response.tie) {
   82 |         // A simultaneous slice keeps each sword on its own visible return path.
   83 |         this.capturedBy = null;
   84 |       } else {
   85 |         const p = response.first.player;
   86 |         this.capturedBy = p;
   87 |         this.capturedKind = response.first.value.kind;
   88 |         this.scores[p]++;
   89 |         if (this.scores[p] >= 10) {
   90 |           this.winner = p === 0 ? 1 : 2;
   91 |           this.phase = "done";
   92 |           this.round++;
   93 |           return;
   94 |         }
   95 |       }
   96 |       this.phase = "between";
   97 |       this.round++;
   98 |       this.until = this.time + 0.9;
   99 |       return;
  100 |     }
  101 |     if (this.phase === "between" && this.time >= this.until) {
  102 |       this.current = -1;
  103 |       this.capturedBy = null;
  104 |       this.phase = "preview";
  105 |       this.until = this.time + 0.55;
  106 |       this.queue.clear();
  107 |     } else if (
  108 |       (this.phase === "preview" || this.phase === "active") &&
  109 |       this.time >= this.until
  110 |     )
  111 |       this.reveal();
  112 |   }
  113 | }
~~~

## src/games/fruit-duel/SwordMotion.ts
SHA-256: c58b6b0f607c85f7c959b9b1c3473d028ed1a7754e309a3bdeb948cc48d3d768
~~~text
    1 | /** The same recovery durations drive both legal input and visible sword return. */
    2 | export const SWING_IMPACT = 0.15;
    3 | export const HIT_RECOVERY = 0.72;
    4 | export const MISS_RECOVERY = 1.35;
    5 | const smooth = (t: number) => {
    6 |   const u = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    7 |   return u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
    8 | };
    9 | type Pose = { x: number; y: number; angle: number };
   10 | const rest: Pose[] = [
   11 |   { x: 322, y: 615, angle: -0.25 },
   12 |   { x: 98, y: 615, angle: 1.6 },
   13 | ];
   14 | const wind: Pose[] = [
   15 |   { x: 338, y: 624, angle: -0.4 },
   16 |   { x: 82, y: 624, angle: 1.75 },
   17 | ];
   18 | const impact: Pose[] = [
   19 |   { x: 300, y: 575, angle: 0.4 },
   20 |   { x: 120, y: 575, angle: 1.15 },
   21 | ];
   22 | const follow: Pose[] = [
   23 |   { x: 180, y: 560, angle: 1.25 },
   24 |   { x: 240, y: 560, angle: 0.1 },
   25 | ];
   26 | function mix(a: Pose, b: Pose, t: number): Pose {
   27 |   if (t <= 0) return { ...a };
   28 |   if (t >= 1) return { ...b };
   29 |   const s = smooth(t);
   30 |   return {
   31 |     x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * s,
   32 |     y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * s,
   33 |     angle: a.angle + (b.angle - a.angle) * s,
   34 |   };
   35 | }
   36 | export function swordPose(
   37 |   player: 0 | 1,
   38 |   attempt: number,
   39 |   age: number,
   40 |   duration: number,
   41 | ): Pose {
   42 |   const from = 0,
   43 |     to = 0;
   44 |   let pose: Pose;
   45 |   if (attempt === 0) pose = rest[0];
   46 |   else if (age < 0.065) pose = mix(rest[from], wind[from], age / 0.065);
   47 |   else if (age < SWING_IMPACT)
   48 |     pose = mix(
   49 |       wind[from],
   50 |       impact[from],
   51 |       (age - 0.065) / (SWING_IMPACT - 0.065),
   52 |     );
   53 |   else if (age < 0.26)
   54 |     pose = mix(
   55 |       impact[from],
   56 |       follow[from],
   57 |       (age - SWING_IMPACT) / (0.26 - SWING_IMPACT),
   58 |     );
   59 |   else pose = mix(follow[from], rest[to], (age - 0.26) / (duration - 0.26));
   60 |   return player === 0
   61 |     ? { ...pose }
   62 |     : { x: 420 - pose.x, y: 762 - pose.y, angle: pose.angle + Math.PI };
   63 | }
~~~
