## src/games/gravity-runner/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: be0808db1f4fa9e6229100449b91546629cb790f5d2435491bd8932a371891fc
~~~text
    1 | # Gravity Runner
    2 | 
    3 | One shared portrait corridor; cross-track physics y=0..170, progress scrolls vertically. Both runners share distance, hazards and legal flips. Orange Space/A/lower touch half; Blue Up/Enter/L/upper half. First five survival points; simultaneous deaths replay. Runs have no time limit or forced reset: they end only on collision. An eight-second warm-up precedes smooth three-second speed ramps every twenty seconds, from 120 toward a validated 264 maximum.
    4 | 
    5 | CourseStream owns bounded seeded endless generation. It chooses weighted map-specific motifs while excluding the previous two choices; there is no repeating pattern cycle. Widths, sides, counts, spacing and phases vary. Later sections are denser, with at least 245 units of clearance between independent hazards. One early rail teaches the transfer. Rail gaps begin/end 180 units inside the support; pinches/islands use intact outer walls. Retire geometry behind the camera; keep history capped at 16.
    6 | 
    7 | Map trap families: ice icicles/frost blocks; green roots/brambles; blue sinusoidal water jets/octagonal buoys; purple crystals/timed phase gates. Maps.ts contains lightweight metadata/previews only. CourseStream and physics stay lazy. Do not add other games' logic here.
    8 | 
    9 | ObstacleGeometry is authoritative for rendering and collision: triangle/trapezoid/convex silhouettes use SAT against the 26×18 runner footprint; jets change depth with seeded time and phase gates actually open. Pass the same round age to gameplay, renderer and AI forecasts. Open phase gates warn before activation. Runnable platform faces use swept landing; front penetration and returning-wall rescue are rejected. 120 Hz integration, gravity 900, 160 ms legal flip lock. No runner-to-runner collision or AI exemptions.
   10 | 
   11 | AI forecasts use the same advanceRunner, age-dependent speed and moving trap phases. Difficulty controls reaction distribution, visible lookahead and one/two-flip search. Safe movement remains stable. Seeded replay uses MatchRandom.
   12 | 
   13 | GravityView interpolates presentation only. GravityArt/TrapArt retain one masked Graphics; no extra RAF/textures. Round numbers are removed from the rail. Dispose graphics and mask; host owns input cleanup.
   14 | 
   15 | Tests: gravity-runner.test.ts, gravity-variation.test.ts, expansion-framerate.test.ts, premium-motion.test.ts; gravity-landscapes.spec.ts, gravity-shared.spec.ts and expansion/tournament browser regressions. Preserve independent automatic registration and lazy loading.
~~~

## src/games/gravity-runner/AI.ts
SHA-256: 03c4b189075db3738dfa299a7e0940cb9e2f80fa2dc1b8e6ba498e071eac6030
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { GravityMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | import { advanceRunner } from "./RunnerPhysics";
    5 | /** Bounded lookahead over legal flips, including a possible second transfer. */
    6 | export class GravityAI {
    7 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    8 |   private wait = 0;
    9 |   constructor(
   10 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   11 |     seed?: number,
   12 |   ) {
   13 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   14 |   }
   15 |   update(m: GravityMatch, dt = 1 / 120) {
   16 |     if (m.between || m.winner || !m.players[1].alive) return false;
   17 |     this.wait -= dt;
   18 |     if (this.wait > 0) return false;
   19 |     this.wait = this.personality.sample(
   20 |       { medium: 0.23, hard: 0.085, impossible: 0.04 }[this.difficulty],
   21 |       { medium: 0.045, hard: 0.018, impossible: 0.008 }[this.difficulty],
   22 |       0.025,
   23 |     );
   24 |     if (m.players[1].cooldown > 0) return false;
   25 |     const horizon = Math.min(
   26 |       410 / m.speed(),
   27 |       { medium: 0.85, hard: 1.45, impossible: 1.75 }[this.difficulty] +
   28 |         this.personality.tempo * 0.025,
   29 |     );
   30 |     const h = 1 / 120,
   31 |       steps = Math.ceil(horizon / h);
   32 |     const positions = new Float64Array(steps + 1);
   33 |     positions[0] = m.distance;
   34 |     for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++)
   35 |       positions[i] = positions[i - 1] + m.speed(m.age + i * h) * h;
   36 |     const end = positions[steps] + 18;
   37 |     const gaps = m.gaps.filter(
   38 |       (g) => g.x + g.width >= m.distance - 15 && g.x <= end,
   39 |     );
   40 |     const obstacles = m.obstacles.filter(
   41 |       (o) => o.x + o.width >= m.distance - 15 && o.x <= end,
   42 |     );
   43 |     if (!gaps.length && !obstacles.length) return false;
   44 |     const survival = (flipNow: boolean, secondAt = Infinity) => {
   45 |       const p = { ...m.players[1] };
   46 |       if (flipNow) {
   47 |         p.gravity = p.gravity === 1 ? -1 : 1;
   48 |         p.cooldown = 0.16;
   49 |       }
   50 |       for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
   51 |         if (i === secondAt && p.cooldown <= 0) {
   52 |           p.gravity = p.gravity === 1 ? -1 : 1;
   53 |           p.cooldown = 0.16;
   54 |         }
   55 |         advanceRunner(p, positions[i], h, gaps, obstacles, m.age + i * h);
   56 |         if (!p.alive) return i * h;
   57 |       }
   58 |       return steps * h;
   59 |     };
   60 |     const stay = survival(false);
   61 |     // Stay stable on a safe surface. No per-frame random target switches.
   62 |     if (stay >= horizon) return false;
   63 |     let hold = stay,
   64 |       flip = survival(true);
   65 |     if (this.difficulty !== "medium") {
   66 |       const delays =
   67 |         this.difficulty === "impossible"
   68 |           ? [0.25, 0.4, 0.6, 0.85, 1.1]
   69 |           : [0.35, 0.65, 0.95];
   70 |       for (const delay of delays) {
   71 |         if (delay >= horizon) break;
   72 |         const at = Math.round(delay / h);
   73 |         hold = Math.max(hold, survival(false, at));
   74 |         flip = Math.max(flip, survival(true, at));
   75 |       }
   76 |     }
   77 |     return flip > hold + 0.035;
   78 |   }
   79 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Gap, Obstacle } from "./RunnerPhysics";
    3 | export type Pattern =
    4 |   | "single"
    5 |   | "switchback"
    6 |   | "cluster"
    7 |   | "gaps"
    8 |   | "slalom"
    9 |   | "rail"
   10 |   | "pinch"
   11 |   | "islands";
   12 | interface Palette {
   13 |   side: Obstacle["kind"][];
   14 |   center: Obstacle["kind"];
   15 |   patterns: Pattern[];
   16 | }
   17 | export const TRAPS: Record<string, Palette> = {
   18 |   ice: {
   19 |     side: ["icicle", "ice-block"],
   20 |     center: "ice-block",
   21 |     patterns: [
   22 |       "single",
   23 |       "switchback",
   24 |       "gaps",
   25 |       "gaps",
   26 |       "rail",
   27 |       "pinch",
   28 |       "islands",
   29 |     ],
   30 |   },
   31 |   green: {
   32 |     side: ["root", "bramble"],
   33 |     center: "bramble",
   34 |     patterns: [
   35 |       "cluster",
   36 |       "switchback",
   37 |       "cluster",
   38 |       "gaps",
   39 |       "rail",
   40 |       "pinch",
   41 |       "slalom",
   42 |     ],
   43 |   },
   44 |   blue: {
   45 |     side: ["jet"],
   46 |     center: "buoy",
   47 |     patterns: [
   48 |       "single",
   49 |       "switchback",
   50 |       "cluster",
   51 |       "slalom",
   52 |       "rail",
   53 |       "pinch",
   54 |       "islands",
   55 |     ],
   56 |   },
   57 |   purple: {
   58 |     side: ["crystal"],
   59 |     center: "phase",
   60 |     patterns: [
   61 |       "switchback",
   62 |       "cluster",
   63 |       "slalom",
   64 |       "slalom",
   65 |       "rail",
   66 |       "pinch",
   67 |       "gaps",
   68 |     ],
   69 |   },
   70 | };
   71 | /** A rolling weighted choice, not a repeating bag/linear five-pattern loop. */
   72 | export class CourseStream {
   73 |   next = 350;
   74 |   readonly history: Pattern[] = [];
   75 |   private random: MatchRandom;
   76 |   constructor(
   77 |     seed: number,
   78 |     readonly map: string,
   79 |   ) {
   80 |     this.random = new MatchRandom(seed);
   81 |   }
   82 |   append(gaps: Gap[], obstacles: Obstacle[]) {
   83 |     const r = this.random,
   84 |       palette = TRAPS[this.map] ?? TRAPS.green;
   85 |     const options = palette.patterns.filter(
   86 |       (p) => !this.history.slice(-2).includes(p),
   87 |     );
   88 |     let pattern = options[Math.floor(r.next() * options.length)];
   89 |     // Guarantee an early rail demonstration without fixing the later sequence.
   90 |     if (this.history.length === 2 && !this.history.includes("rail"))
   91 |       pattern = "rail";
   92 |     this.history.push(pattern);
   93 |     if (this.history.length > 16) this.history.shift();
   94 |     const x = this.next,
   95 |       side = r.next() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
   96 |     const intensity = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - 1200) / 11000));
   97 |     const clearance = 245 + (1 - intensity) * 80 + r.next() * 55;
   98 |     const hazard = (at: number, s: -1 | 0 | 1, center = false): Obstacle => ({
   99 |       x: at,
  100 |       width: 42 + r.next() * 25,
  101 |       side: s,
  102 |       depth: center ? 32 + r.next() * 10 : 30 + r.next() * 17,
  103 |       kind: center
  104 |         ? palette.center
  105 |         : palette.side[Math.floor(r.next() * palette.side.length)],
  106 |       phase: r.next() * Math.PI * 2,
  107 |       period: 3.2 + r.next() * 1.6,
  108 |     });
  109 |     if (pattern === "rail" || pattern === "pinch") {
  110 |       const width =
  111 |         pattern === "rail" ? 540 + r.next() * 370 : 460 + r.next() * 140;
  112 |       obstacles.push({
  113 |         x,
  114 |         width,
  115 |         side: 0,
  116 |         depth: 22 + r.next() * 4,
  117 |         kind: "platform",
  118 |       });
  119 |       if (pattern === "rail")
  120 |         gaps.push(
  121 |           { x: x + 180, width: width - 360, side: -1 },
  122 |           { x: x + 180, width: width - 360, side: 1 },
  123 |         );
  124 |       else for (const s of [-1, 1] as const) obstacles.push(hazard(x + 200, s));
  125 |       this.next = x + width + clearance;
  126 |     } else if (pattern === "islands") {
  127 |       obstacles.push({
  128 |         x,
  129 |         width: 140 + r.next() * 90,
  130 |         side: 0,
  131 |         depth: 24,
  132 |         kind: "platform",
  133 |       });
  134 |       const second = x + obstacles.at(-1)!.width + 190 + r.next() * 70;
  135 |       obstacles.push({
  136 |         x: second,
  137 |         width: 140 + r.next() * 90,
  138 |         side: 0,
  139 |         depth: 24,
  140 |         kind: "platform",
  141 |       });
  142 |       this.next = second + obstacles.at(-1)!.width + clearance;
  143 |     } else {
  144 |       const count =
  145 |         pattern === "single"
  146 |           ? 1
  147 |           : pattern === "cluster"
  148 |             ? 2 + Math.floor(r.next() * 2)
  149 |             : 2;
  150 |       let at = x;
  151 |       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  152 |         if (pattern === "gaps") {
  153 |           const width = 90 + r.next() * 45;
  154 |           gaps.push({
  155 |             x: at,
  156 |             width,
  157 |             side: i % 2 ? (side === 1 ? -1 : 1) : side,
  158 |           });
  159 |           at += width + clearance;
  160 |         } else {
  161 |           const s =
  162 |             pattern === "slalom" && i === 0
  163 |               ? 0
  164 |               : pattern === "switchback" && i % 2
  165 |                 ? side === 1
  166 |                   ? -1
  167 |                   : 1
  168 |                 : side;
  169 |           const o = hazard(at, s, s === 0);
  170 |           obstacles.push(o);
  171 |           at += o.width + clearance;
  172 |         }
  173 |       }
  174 |       this.next = at;
  175 |     }
  176 |   }
  177 | }
~~~

~~~text
  195 | export function runners(

  200 |     players: { y: number; vy: number; angle: number; landing: number }[];

  237 |     g.fillStyle(theme.ink).fillCircle(3, -12, 1.3);
  238 |     g.lineStyle(2, color).lineBetween(-7, -5, -14, -2 + stride * 0.4);
~~~

~~~text
    6 | import { GravityView } from "./GravityView";

    8 | import { GravityAI } from "./AI";
    9 | export class GravityGame implements MiniGame {
   10 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   11 |   private m = new GravityMatch(freshSeed());
   12 |   private ai?: GravityAI;
   13 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   14 |   private clip!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   15 |   private mask!: Phaser.Display.Masks.GeometryMask;
   16 |   private fixed = new FixedStep();
   17 |   private view = new GravityView();
   18 |   private renderState?: ReturnType<GravityView["sample"]>;
   19 |   private paused = false;
   20 |   private done = false;
   21 |   private score = "";
   22 |   private finishAge = 0;
   23 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   24 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   25 |     this.g = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   26 |     this.clip = ctx.scene.make.graphics({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   27 |     this.clip.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRoundedRect(22, 110, 376, 542, 22);
   28 |     this.mask = this.clip.createGeometryMask();
   29 |     this.g.setMask(this.mask);
   30 |     this.m = new GravityMatch(this.m.seed, ctx.options.variant);
   31 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai") {
   32 |       this.ai = new GravityAI(ctx.options.difficulty);
   33 |       this.m = new GravityMatch(this.ai.personality.seed, ctx.options.variant);
   34 |     }
   35 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
   36 |       if (x >= 24 && x <= 396 && y >= 112 && y <= 650)
   37 |         this.flip(y < 380 ? 1 : 0);
   38 |     });
   39 |     ctx.input.press(["Space", "KeyA"], () => this.flip(0));
   40 |     ctx.input.press(["ArrowUp", "Enter", "KeyL"], () => this.flip(1));
   41 |     ctx.setHint("");
   42 |     ctx.setScore(0, 0);
   43 |     this.view.reset(this.m);
   44 |     ctx.setClock("", false);
   45 |     ctx.audio.play("start");
   46 |     this.draw();
   47 |   }
   48 |   private flip(p: 0 | 1, ai = false) {
   49 |     if (this.paused || this.done || (p === 1 && this.ai && !ai)) return;
   50 |     if (this.m.flip(p)) {
   51 |       this.view.flip(p);
   52 |       this.ctx.audio.play("shoot", 0.45);
   53 |     }
   54 |   }
   55 |   update(dt: number) {
   56 |     if (this.paused || this.done) return;
   57 |     this.fixed.advance(dt, (h) => {
   58 |       this.view.capture(this.m);
   59 |       if (this.ai?.update(this.m)) this.flip(1, true);
   60 |       const before = this.m.players.map((p) => ({ alive: p.alive, vy: p.vy }));
   61 |       const round = this.m.round;
   62 |       this.m.step(h);
   63 |       if (round !== this.m.round) {
   64 |         this.view.reset(this.m);
   65 |         this.ctx.audio.play("start", 0.65);
   66 |       }
   67 |       for (const i of [0, 1] as const) {
   68 |         const p = this.m.players[i];
   69 |         if (before[i].alive && !p.alive) this.ctx.audio.play("fail", 0.7);
   70 |         else if (Math.abs(before[i].vy) > 80 && p.vy === 0 && p.alive) {
   71 |           this.view.land(i);
   72 |           this.ctx.audio.play("wood", 0.35);
   73 |         }
   74 |       }
   75 |     });
   76 |     if (this.m.scores.join() !== this.score) {
   77 |       if (this.score) this.ctx.audio.play("goal");
   78 |       this.score = this.m.scores.join();
   79 |       this.ctx.setScore(...this.m.scores);
   80 |     }
   81 |     this.renderState = this.view.sample(
   82 |       this.m,
   83 |       this.fixed.fraction,
   84 |       Math.min(dt, 0.1),
   85 |     );
   86 |     this.draw();
   87 |     if (this.m.winner) this.finishAge += dt;
   88 |     if (this.m.winner && this.finishAge > 0.65) {
   89 |       this.done = true;
   90 |       this.ctx.finish({ winner: this.m.winner, scores: this.m.scores });
   91 |     }
   92 |   }
   93 |   private draw() {
   94 |     const g = this.g;
   95 |     g.clear();
   96 |     course(g, this.m, this.renderState?.distance ?? this.m.distance);
   97 |     runners(g, this.m, this.renderState);
   98 |   }
   99 |   pause() {
  100 |     this.paused = true;
  101 |     this.fixed.reset();
  102 |   }
  103 |   resume() {
  104 |     this.paused = false;
  105 |   }
  106 |   dispose() {
  107 |     this.done = true;
  108 |     this.g.destroy();
  109 |     this.mask.destroy();
  110 |     this.clip.destroy();
  111 |   }
  112 |   snapshot() {
  113 |     return {
  114 |       players: this.m.players,
  115 |       gaps: this.m.gaps,
  116 |       obstacles: this.m.obstacles,
  117 |       sharedCourse: true,
  118 |       map: this.m.map.id,
  119 |       speed: this.m.speed(),
  120 |       age: this.m.age,
  121 |       patterns: [...this.m.patterns],
  122 |       renderState: this.renderState,
  123 |       distance: this.m.distance,
  124 |       scores: this.m.scores,
  125 |       round: this.m.round,
  126 |       between: this.m.between,
  127 |       winner: this.m.winner,
  128 |       ai: this.ai?.personality.snapshot(),
  129 |     };
  130 |   }
  131 | }
~~~

## src/games/gravity-runner/GravityView.ts
SHA-256: db5943ae6711e104f4fd5ca9adde942cd1b7f32d7bde95154779014718fd0ad9
~~~text
    1 | import type { GravityMatch } from "./Rules";
    2 | /** Interpolate simulation positions; presentation never writes back to physics. */
    3 | export class GravityView {
    4 |   private distance = 0;
    5 |   private age = 0;
    6 |   private y = [160, 160];
    7 |   private vy = [0, 0];
    8 |   readonly angles = [-Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2];
    9 |   private targets = [-Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2];
   10 |   readonly landing = [0, 0];
   11 |   capture(m: GravityMatch) {
   12 |     this.distance = m.distance;
   13 |     this.age = m.age;
   14 |     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   15 |       this.y[i] = m.players[i].y;
   16 |       this.vy[i] = m.players[i].vy;
   17 |     }
   18 |   }
   19 |   reset(m: GravityMatch) {
   20 |     this.capture(m);
   21 |     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   22 |       this.angles[i] = this.targets[i] =
   23 |         m.players[i].gravity === 1 ? -Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 2;
   24 |       this.landing[i] = 0;
   25 |     }
   26 |   }
   27 |   flip(p: number) {
   28 |     this.targets[p] += Math.PI;
   29 |   }
   30 |   land(p: number) {
   31 |     this.landing[p] = 1;
   32 |   }
   33 |   sample(m: GravityMatch, alpha: number, dt: number) {
   34 |     const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, alpha));
   35 |     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   36 |       this.angles[i] +=
   37 |         (this.targets[i] - this.angles[i]) * (1 - Math.exp(-22 * dt));
   38 |       this.landing[i] *= Math.exp(-16 * dt);
   39 |     }
   40 |     return {
   41 |       distance: this.distance + (m.distance - this.distance) * t,
   42 |       age: this.age + (m.age - this.age) * t,
   43 |       players: m.players.map((p, i) => ({
   44 |         ...p,
   45 |         y: this.y[i] + (p.y - this.y[i]) * t,
   46 |         vy: this.vy[i] + (p.vy - this.vy[i]) * t,
   47 |         angle: this.angles[i],
   48 |         landing: this.landing[i],
   49 |       })),
   50 |     };
   51 |   }
   52 | }
~~~

## src/games/gravity-runner/ObstacleGeometry.ts
SHA-256: fefc82f2016b957cc0b9c8fae241257b9afadc2df729c19a90962d6122bff5c0
~~~text
    1 | import type { Obstacle } from "./RunnerPhysics";
    2 | export interface Point {
    3 |   x: number;
    4 |   y: number;
    5 | }
    6 | /** Canonical world geometry for both rendering and human/AI collision. */
    7 | export function obstacleBounds(o: Obstacle, age: number) {
    8 |   let depth = o.depth;
    9 |   const wave =
   10 |     o.kind === "jet" || o.kind === "phase"
   11 |       ? (1 +
   12 |           Math.sin((age * Math.PI * 2) / (o.period ?? 3.6) + (o.phase ?? 0))) /
   13 |         2
   14 |       : 0;
   15 |   if (o.kind === "jet") depth *= 0.2 + wave * 0.8;
   16 |   const active = o.kind !== "phase" || wave > 0.25;
   17 |   const low = o.side === -1 ? 0 : o.side === 1 ? 170 - depth : 85 - depth / 2;
   18 |   const warning =
   19 |     o.kind === "phase" &&
   20 |     !active &&
   21 |     wave > 0.06 &&
   22 |     Math.cos((age * Math.PI * 2) / (o.period ?? 3.6) + (o.phase ?? 0)) > 0;
   23 |   return { low, high: low + depth, active, warning };
   24 | }
   25 | export function obstacleOutline(o: Obstacle, age: number): Point[] {
   26 |   const { low, high } = obstacleBounds(o, age),
   27 |     x = o.x,
   28 |     end = x + o.width,
   29 |     mid = x + o.width / 2;
   30 |   if (o.kind === "crystal") {
   31 |     const base = o.side === 1 ? high : low,
   32 |       tip = o.side === 1 ? low : high;
   33 |     return [
   34 |       { x, y: (low + high) / 2 },
   35 |       { x: mid, y: tip },
   36 |       { x: end, y: (low + high) / 2 },
   37 |       { x: mid, y: base },
   38 |     ];
   39 |   }
   40 |   if (o.kind === "icicle") {
   41 |     const base = o.side === 1 ? high : low,
   42 |       tip = o.side === 1 ? low : high;
   43 |     return [
   44 |       { x, y: base },
   45 |       { x: mid, y: tip },
   46 |       { x: end, y: base },
   47 |     ];
   48 |   }
   49 |   if (o.kind === "root") {
   50 |     const base = o.side === 1 ? high : low,
   51 |       tip = o.side === 1 ? low : high;
   52 |     return [
   53 |       { x, y: base },
   54 |       { x: x + o.width * 0.18, y: tip },
   55 |       { x: x + o.width * 0.82, y: tip },
   56 |       { x: end, y: base },
   57 |     ];
   58 |   }
   59 |   if (o.kind === "bramble" && o.side !== 0) {
   60 |     const base = o.side === 1 ? high : low,
   61 |       sign = o.side === 1 ? -1 : 1,
   62 |       depth = high - low;
   63 |     return [
   64 |       { x, y: base },
   65 |       { x: x + o.width * 0.12, y: base + sign * depth * 0.65 },
   66 |       { x: mid, y: base + sign * depth },
   67 |       { x: end - o.width * 0.12, y: base + sign * depth * 0.65 },
   68 |       { x: end, y: base },
   69 |     ];
   70 |   }
   71 |   if (o.kind === "buoy" || o.kind === "bramble") {
   72 |     return Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => ({
   73 |       x: mid + (Math.cos((i * Math.PI) / 4) * o.width) / 2,
   74 |       y: (low + high) / 2 + (Math.sin((i * Math.PI) / 4) * (high - low)) / 2,
   75 |     }));
   76 |   }
   77 |   return [
   78 |     { x, y: low },
   79 |     { x: end, y: low },
   80 |     { x: end, y: high },
   81 |     { x, y: high },
   82 |   ];
   83 | }
   84 | /** SAT between the runner's 26×18 footprint and convex trap geometry. */
   85 | export function touchesTrap(
   86 |   o: Obstacle,
   87 |   distance: number,
   88 |   y: number,
   89 |   age: number,
   90 | ) {
   91 |   const b = obstacleBounds(o, age);
   92 |   if (distance + 13 < o.x || distance - 13 > o.x + o.width) return false;
   93 |   if (!b.active || y + 9 <= b.low + 0.001 || y - 9 >= b.high - 0.001)
   94 |     return false;
   95 |   if (!["icicle", "crystal", "root", "buoy", "bramble"].includes(o.kind))
   96 |     return true;
   97 |   const polygon = obstacleOutline(o, age);
   98 |   for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
   99 |     const a = polygon[i],
  100 |       b = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length],
  101 |       nx = -(b.y - a.y),
  102 |       ny = b.x - a.x;
  103 |     let lo = Infinity,
  104 |       hi = -Infinity;
  105 |     for (const p of polygon) {
  106 |       const dot = p.x * nx + p.y * ny;
  107 |       lo = Math.min(lo, dot);
  108 |       hi = Math.max(hi, dot);
  109 |     }
  110 |     const center = distance * nx + y * ny,
  111 |       radius = 13 * Math.abs(nx) + 9 * Math.abs(ny);
  112 |     if (center + radius <= lo + 0.001 || center - radius >= hi - 0.001)
  113 |       return false;
  114 |   }
  115 |   return true;
  116 | }
~~~

## src/games/gravity-runner/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 87352faa57d8bf271c4cbc1a1f1baf90cc55ecccfe73bd2a2784851b939e3c8d
~~~text
    1 | import { mixSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import {
    3 |   advanceRunner,
    4 |   type Gap,
    5 |   type Obstacle,
    6 |   type Runner,
    7 | } from "./RunnerPhysics";
    8 | import { MAPS, type RunnerMap } from "./Maps";
    9 | import { CourseStream } from "./CourseStream";
   10 | export type { Gap, Obstacle, Runner } from "./RunnerPhysics";
   11 | export class GravityMatch {
   12 |   players: [Runner, Runner] = [this.runner(), this.runner()];
   13 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   14 |   gaps: Gap[] = [];
   15 |   obstacles: Obstacle[] = [];
   16 |   distance = 0;
   17 |   round = 1;
   18 |   age = 0;
   19 |   total = 0;
   20 |   between = 0;
   21 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   22 |   readonly map: RunnerMap;
   23 |   private stream!: CourseStream;
   24 |   private trimmed = -200;
   25 |   constructor(
   26 |     readonly seed: number,
   27 |     mapId?: string,
   28 |   ) {
   29 |     this.map =
   30 |       MAPS.find((m) => m.id === mapId) ?? MAPS[mixSeed(seed, 42) % MAPS.length];
   31 |     this.course();
   32 |   }
   33 |   private runner(): Runner {
   34 |     return { y: 160, vy: 0, gravity: 1, alive: true, cooldown: 0 };
   35 |   }
   36 |   private course() {
   37 |     this.stream = new CourseStream(mixSeed(this.seed, this.round), this.map.id);
   38 |     this.trimmed = -200;
   39 |     this.gaps = [];
   40 |     this.obstacles = [];
   41 |     this.extend();
   42 |   }
   43 |   private extend() {
   44 |     // Stream and retire geometry: endless runs keep a bounded working set.
   45 |     if (this.distance - this.trimmed >= 180) {
   46 |       this.trimmed = this.distance;
   47 |       this.gaps = this.gaps.filter((o) => o.x + o.width > this.distance - 400);
   48 |       this.obstacles = this.obstacles.filter(
   49 |         (o) => o.x + o.width > this.distance - 400,
   50 |       );
   51 |     }
   52 |     while (
   53 |       this.stream.next < this.distance + 2100 ||
   54 |       this.stream.history.length < 3
   55 |     )
   56 |       this.stream.append(this.gaps, this.obstacles);
   57 |   }
   58 |   get patterns() {
   59 |     return this.stream.history;
   60 |   }
   61 |   speed(age = this.age) {
   62 |     // Eight seconds to settle in, then a short smooth acceleration every 20s.
   63 |     let speed = 120;
   64 |     for (let stage = 0; stage < 6; stage++) {
   65 |       const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (age - 8 - stage * 20) / 3));
   66 |       speed += 24 * t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
   67 |     }
   68 |     return speed;
   69 |   }
   70 |   flip(i: 0 | 1) {
   71 |     const p = this.players[i];
   72 |     if (this.winner || this.between || !p.alive || p.cooldown > 0) return false;
   73 |     p.gravity = p.gravity === 1 ? -1 : 1;
   74 |     p.cooldown = 0.16;
   75 |     return true;
   76 |   }
   77 |   step(dt: number) {
   78 |     if (this.winner) return;
   79 |     this.total += dt;
   80 |     if (this.between) {
   81 |       this.between = Math.max(0, this.between - dt);
   82 |       if (!this.between) {
   83 |         this.players = [this.runner(), this.runner()];
   84 |         this.age = 0;
   85 |         this.distance = 0;
   86 |         this.round++;
   87 |         this.course();
   88 |       }
   89 |       return;
   90 |     }
   91 |     this.age += dt;
   92 |     this.distance += this.speed() * dt;
   93 |     this.extend();
   94 |     for (const p of this.players)
   95 |       advanceRunner(p, this.distance, dt, this.gaps, this.obstacles, this.age);
   96 |     if (this.players.some((p) => !p.alive)) {
   97 |       if (this.players[0].alive !== this.players[1].alive)
   98 |         this.scores[this.players[0].alive ? 0 : 1]++;
   99 |       this.between = 1.1;
  100 |       if (this.scores.some((s) => s >= 5))
  101 |         this.winner = this.scores[0] >= 5 ? 1 : 2;
  102 |     }
  103 |   }
  104 | }
~~~

~~~text
   33 |   alive: boolean;
   34 |   cooldown: number;
   35 | }
   36 | export const RUNNER_REACH = 13;
   37 | /** Shared by gameplay and the AI forecast; all units remain independent of display scale. */
   38 | export function advanceRunner(
   39 |   p: Runner,
   40 |   distance: number,
   41 |   dt: number,
   42 |   gaps: readonly Gap[],
   43 |   obstacles: readonly Obstacle[],
   44 |   age = 0,
   45 | ) {
   46 |   if (!p.alive) return;
   47 |   p.cooldown = Math.max(0, p.cooldown - dt);
   48 |   const previousY = p.y;
   49 |   p.vy += p.gravity * 900 * dt;
   50 |   p.y += p.vy * dt;
   51 |   const gap = (side: number) =>
   52 |     gaps.some(
   53 |       (g) =>
   54 |         g.side === side &&
   55 |         distance + RUNNER_REACH >= g.x &&
   56 |         distance - RUNNER_REACH <= g.x + g.width,
   57 |     );
   58 |   if (p.y >= 160 && !gap(1)) {
   59 |     if (previousY > 160.001) {
   60 |       p.alive = false;
   61 |       return;
   62 |     }
   63 |     p.y = 160;
   64 |     p.vy = Math.min(0, p.vy);
   65 |   }
   66 |   if (p.y <= 10 && !gap(-1)) {
   67 |     if (previousY < 9.999) {
   68 |       p.alive = false;
   69 |       return;
   70 |     }
   71 |     p.y = 10;
   72 |     p.vy = Math.max(0, p.vy);
   73 |   }
   74 |   for (const o of obstacles) {
   75 |     if (
   76 |       distance + RUNNER_REACH < o.x ||
   77 |       distance - RUNNER_REACH > o.x + o.width
   78 |     )
   79 |       continue;
   80 |     const { low, high, active } = obstacleBounds(o, age);
   81 |     if (!active) continue;
   82 |     if (o.kind === "platform") {
   83 |       // Swept face crossings stop gravity on either runnable side. Front/end
   84 |       // collisions remain lethal; a platform is never a teleport/recovery aid.
   85 |       if (previousY + 9 <= low + 0.001 && p.y + 9 >= low && p.vy >= 0) {
   86 |         p.y = low - 9;
   87 |         p.vy = 0;
   88 |         continue;
   89 |       }
   90 |       if (previousY - 9 >= high - 0.001 && p.y - 9 <= high && p.vy <= 0) {
   91 |         p.y = high + 9;
   92 |         p.vy = 0;
   93 |         continue;
   94 |       }
   95 |     }
   96 |     if (touchesTrap(o, distance, p.y, age)) {
   97 |       p.alive = false;
   98 |       break;
   99 |     }
  100 |   }
  101 |   if (p.y < -22 || p.y > 192) p.alive = false;
  102 | }
~~~

## src/games/gravity-runner/TrapArt.ts
SHA-256: d447509d1036699ae501bb7606643ee3f99ca62791e14ae814830fdeb7160839

~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    3 | import type { Obstacle } from "./RunnerPhysics";
    4 | import type { RunnerMap } from "./Maps";
    5 | import { obstacleBounds, obstacleOutline } from "./ObstacleGeometry";
    6 | /** Trap silhouettes are the same polygons used by collision, including jet motion. */
    7 | export function drawTrap(
    8 |   g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
    9 |   o: Obstacle,
   10 |   map: RunnerMap,
   11 |   distance: number,
   12 |   age: number,
   13 | ) {
   14 |   const sy = (x: number) => 548 - (x - distance) * 1.05,
   15 |     sx = (y: number) => 84 + (y * 252) / 170;
   16 |   const bounds = obstacleBounds(o, age),
   17 |     top = sy(o.x + o.width),
   18 |     bottom = sy(o.x);
   19 |   const x = sx(bounds.low),
   20 |     w = ((bounds.high - bounds.low) * 252) / 170,
   21 |     mid = (top + bottom) / 2;
   22 |   const polygon = obstacleOutline(o, age).map((p) => ({
   23 |     x: sx(p.y),
   24 |     y: sy(p.x),
   25 |   }));
   26 |   const color =
   27 |     map.id === "ice"
   28 |       ? 0xb6e3ef
   29 |       : map.id === "green"
   30 |         ? 0x7d9e66
   31 |         : map.id === "blue"
   32 |           ? 0x56b5d5
   33 |           : 0xb29ace;
   34 |   if (bounds.active)
   35 |     g.fillStyle(o.kind === "root" ? 0x9c7960 : color).fillPoints(polygon, true);
   36 |   g.lineStyle(
   37 |     3,
   38 |     bounds.warning ? 0xd4934f : theme.ink,
   39 |     bounds.active || bounds.warning ? 1 : 0.25,
   40 |   ).strokePoints(polygon, true);
   41 |   if (o.kind === "crystal") {
   42 |     g.lineStyle(2, map.detail, 0.9)
   43 |       .lineBetween(polygon[0].x, polygon[0].y, polygon[2].x, polygon[2].y)
   44 |       .lineBetween(polygon[1].x, polygon[1].y, polygon[3].x, polygon[3].y);
   45 |   } else if (o.kind === "icicle") {
   46 |     const base = sx(o.side === 1 ? bounds.high : bounds.low),
   47 |       tip = sx(o.side === 1 ? bounds.low : bounds.high);
   48 |     g.lineStyle(2, map.detail, 0.85)
   49 |       .lineBetween(base, top + 4, tip + (base - tip) * 0.25, mid)
   50 |       .lineBetween(base, mid, tip, mid)
   51 |       .lineBetween(base, bottom - 4, tip + (base - tip) * 0.25, mid);
   52 |   } else if (o.kind === "ice-block") {
   53 |     g.lineStyle(2, 0xf1fcff, 0.85)
   54 |       .strokeRect(x + 5, top + 5, w - 10, bottom - top - 10)
   55 |       .lineBetween(x + 5, top + 5, x + w - 5, bottom - 5);
   56 |   } else if (o.kind === "root" || o.kind === "bramble") {
   57 |     g.lineStyle(3, 0x4b6a49).lineBetween(
   58 |       x + w * 0.25,
   59 |       top + 6,
   60 |       x + w * 0.65,
   61 |       bottom - 6,
   62 |     );
   63 |     for (let y = top + 12; y < bottom - 5; y += 15) {
   64 |       g.lineStyle(2, 0x4b6a49).lineBetween(x + w * 0.45, y, x + w * 0.8, y + 6);
   65 |       g.fillStyle(0xc8dc8a).fillEllipse(x + w * 0.72, y + 3, 9, 5);
   66 |     }
   67 |   } else if (o.kind === "jet") {
   68 |     g.lineStyle(2, 0xddf9ff, 0.85);
   69 |     for (let y = top + 8; y < bottom - 4; y += 12)
   70 |       g.lineBetween(x + 3, y, x + w - 3, y + 3);
   71 |     const base = o.side === 1 ? sx(170) : sx(0);
   72 |     g.lineStyle(5, map.rail).lineBetween(base, top + 2, base, bottom - 2);
   73 |   } else if (o.kind === "buoy") {
   74 |     g.lineStyle(4, 0xfaf3d7).lineBetween(x + 5, mid, x + w - 5, mid);
   75 |     g.fillStyle(map.rail).fillCircle(x + w / 2, mid, 5);
   76 |   } else if (o.kind === "phase") {
   77 |     g.lineStyle(
   78 |       2,
   79 |       bounds.active ? 0xf4d8ff : 0x927ca9,
   80 |       bounds.active ? 0.85 : 0.35,
   81 |     );
   82 |     for (let y = top + 8; y < bottom - 4; y += 11)
   83 |       g.lineBetween(x + 5, y, x + w - 5, y + 4);
   84 |     if (bounds.active) g.fillStyle(0xf4d8ff, 0.9).fillCircle(x + w / 2, mid, 4);
   85 |   }
   86 | }
~~~

## src/games/hammer-hit/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 98d505b70075077c5b0fb9aa2d69d9bc770bec1ce83d9e334f1b7ded2ce64480
~~~text
    1 | # Hammer Hit
    2 | 
    3 | Rules.ts owns exactly three integer strike scores per player. Compare integer totals; divide by three only for display/result averages. Never use best strike or rounded averages to choose a winner. The controller runs alternating full-field turns; the rule engine retains separate sine gauges. Reset the active gauge after handoff and block input until the strike animation finishes. Local Blue turns rotate module-owned content through TurnView while host navigation stays fixed. AI watches the same legal needle after a 1.2–1.5 second preparation delay. Pause freezes handoff and gauge clocks. Defaults: score 0–100, reveal cooldown 1.1s. No frame-count timing.
    4 | 
    5 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
    6 | 
    7 | User-requested precision variation: Impossible samples a legal target once per strike: 70% 97–100, 25% 90–96, 5% 75–89 (97 belongs to the top band). Never assign scores directly. Gauge/AI run at 600Hz inside the bounded fixed-step update. The hammer rotates around a fixed grip; do not translate its pivot between animation phases.
    8 | 
    9 | StrikePhysics owns presentation-only ballistic puck flight and bell contact; ImpactRing is a damped spring. Both use the existing bounded fixed-step loop. A perfect score reaches the bell; non-perfect trajectories peak below it. Scores still come exclusively from Rules. Scale labels alternate lanes. Popup and ring motion pause with gameplay and have no independent timers.
~~~

## src/games/hammer-hit/AI.ts
SHA-256: 0a283440e25f9e429f66d17b1fb73140c16769b906d70f0a18908d21ec715e29
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { HammerMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class HammerAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private threshold = 0;
    7 |   private previous = 1;
    8 |   private attempt = -1;
    9 |   constructor(
   10 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   11 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   12 |   ) {
   13 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   14 |   }
   15 |   snapshot() {
   16 |     return { ...this.personality.snapshot(), threshold: this.threshold };
   17 |   }
   18 |   update(m: HammerMatch) {
   19 |     if (m.cooldowns[1] > 0 || m.scores[1].length === 3) {
   20 |       this.previous = 1;
   21 |       return false;
   22 |     }
   23 |     if (this.attempt !== m.scores[1].length) {
   24 |       this.attempt = m.scores[1].length;
   25 |       const p = this.personality;
   26 |       const roll = p.next();
   27 |       // Select a timing target once per strike, never alter the awarded score.
   28 |       const bands =
   29 |         this.difficulty === "impossible"
   30 |           ? roll < 0.7
   31 |             ? [97, 100]
   32 |             : roll < 0.95
   33 |               ? [90, 96]
   34 |               : [75, 89]
   35 |           : this.difficulty === "hard"
   36 |             ? roll < 0.6
   37 |               ? [90, 98]
   38 |               : roll < 0.9
   39 |                 ? [80, 89]
   40 |                 : [65, 79]
   41 |             : roll < 0.5
   42 |               ? [75, 89]
   43 |               : roll < 0.85
   44 |                 ? [60, 74]
   45 |                 : [50, 59];
   46 |       const target =
   47 |         bands[0] + Math.floor(p.next() * (bands[1] - bands[0] + 1));
   48 |       this.threshold = (100 - target + 0.49) / 100;
   49 |     }
   50 |     const distance = Math.abs(m.position(1));
   51 |     const hit =
   52 |       m.clocks[1] > 0.3 &&
   53 |       (distance <= this.threshold ||
   54 |         (distance > this.previous && this.previous < 0.07));
   55 |     this.previous = distance;
   56 |     return hit;
   57 |   }
   58 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { FixedStep } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
    2 | import { StrikePhysics, ImpactRing } from "./StrikePhysics";
    3 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    4 | import { TurnView, turnBackground } from "../../shared/components/TurnView";
    5 | import type { GameContext, MiniGame } from "../../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    6 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    7 | import { rounded, label, circle } from "../../shared/components/drawing";
    8 | import { HammerMatch } from "./Rules";
    9 | import { HammerAI } from "./AI";
   10 | 
   11 | interface Spark {
   12 |   x: number;
   13 |   y: number;
   14 |   vx: number;
   15 |   vy: number;
   16 |   life: number;
   17 |   maxLife: number;
   18 |   color: number;
   19 |   size: number;
   20 | }
   21 | 
   22 | interface StrikeAnimation {
   23 |   physics: StrikePhysics;
   24 |   player: 0 | 1;
   25 |   score: number;
   26 |   elapsed: number;
   27 |   peakY: number;
   28 |   puckY: number;
   29 |   hitTriggered: boolean;
   30 |   bellTriggered: boolean;
   31 | }
   32 | 
   33 | export class HammerGame implements MiniGame {
   34 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   35 |   private view!: TurnView;
   36 |   private fixed = new FixedStep();
   37 |   private animationFixed = new FixedStep();
   38 |   private ring = new ImpactRing();
   39 |   private turnWait = 0.7;
   40 |   private model = new HammerMatch();
   41 |   private ai?: HammerAI;
   42 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   43 |   private numberTexts: Phaser.GameObjects.Text[] = [];
   44 |   private turnBadgeText!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   45 |   private popupText!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   46 |   private paused = false;
   47 |   private finishAge = 0;
   48 |   private reported = false;
   49 | 
   50 |   // Turn management: turns are strictly one-by-one!
   51 |   private currentTurn: 0 | 1 = 0; // 0 = Orange (P1), 1 = Blue (P2 / AI)
   52 | 
   53 |   // Visual & animation state
   54 |   private strikeAnim?: StrikeAnimation;
   55 |   private hammerAngle = 0.32; // resting ~18.5 deg
   56 |   private hammerRestAngle = 0.32;
   57 |   private sparks: Spark[] = [];
   58 |   private bellFlashAge = 0;
   59 |   private cameraShake = 0;
   60 |   private totalElapsed = 0;
   61 | 
   62 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   63 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   64 |     this.g = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   65 | 
   66 |     // 10 band numbers: 0 to 90
   67 |     // Bands run from y = 216 down to y = 606 (390px height, 10 bands of 39px each)
   68 |     // Alternating lanes leave the white rail unobstructed.
   69 |     const bandNumbers = [
   70 |       "0",
   71 |       "10",
   72 |       "20",
   73 |       "30",
   74 |       "40",
   75 |       "50",
   76 |       "60",
   77 |       "70",
   78 |       "80",
   79 |       "90",
   80 |     ];
   81 |     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
   82 |       const y = 606 - (i + 0.5) * 36;
   83 |       const t = label(
   84 |         ctx.scene,
   85 |         i % 2 ? 184 : 236,
   86 |         y,
   87 |         bandNumbers[i],
   88 |         22,
   89 |         "#b86812",
   90 |       );
   91 |       t.setFontStyle("700").setDepth(1);
   92 |       this.numberTexts.push(t);
   93 |     }
   94 | 
   95 |     // Top center bell "100" text (centered at y = 212)
   96 |     const bellText = label(ctx.scene, 210, 212, "100", 22, "#1d2328");
   97 |     bellText.setFontStyle("800").setDepth(2);
   98 |     this.numberTexts.push(bellText);
   99 | 
  100 |     // Active turn badge text (inside field at y = 132, safely above dome arch)
  101 |     this.turnBadgeText = label(ctx.scene, 342, 136, "1 / 3", 12, "#596361");
  102 |     this.turnBadgeText.setFontStyle("700").setDepth(3);
  103 | 
  104 |     // Score popup text (floats in open field space to the left of column at x = 88)
  105 |     this.popupText = label(ctx.scene, 88, 380, "", 24, "#242b32");
  106 |     this.popupText
  107 |       .setFontStyle("900")
  108 |       .setStroke("#fffaf0", 3)
  109 |       .setDepth(4)
  110 |       .setAlpha(0);
  111 | 
  112 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai") {
  113 |       this.ai = new HammerAI(ctx.options.difficulty);
  114 |     }
  115 | 
  116 |     this.view = new TurnView(ctx.scene, [
  117 |       this.g,
  118 |       ...this.numberTexts,
  119 |       this.turnBadgeText,
  120 |       this.popupText,
  121 |     ]);
  122 |     // Input handlers: turns are one-by-one!
  123 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
  124 |       if (x > 20 && x < 400 && y > 100 && y < 700) {
  125 |         // In local mode, tap anywhere or player half hits for the current turn player
  126 |         this.hit(this.currentTurn);
  127 |       }
  128 |     });
  129 |     ctx.input.press(["Space", "Enter"], (code) => {
  130 |       const p = code === "Space" ? 0 : 1;
  131 |       if (p === this.currentTurn) this.hit(p);
  132 |     });
  133 | 
  134 |     // Score is tracked out of 300!
  135 |     ctx.setScore(0, 0);
  136 |     ctx.setHint("");
  137 |     ctx.audio.play("start");
  138 |   }
  139 | 
  140 |   private hit(p: 0 | 1, ai = false) {
  141 |     if (this.paused || this.reported) return;
  142 |     if (!this.view.ready || this.turnWait > 0) return;
  143 |     // Strictly enforce turn: only current turn player can strike!
  144 |     if (p !== this.currentTurn) return;
  145 |     // Prevent human from triggering AI turn
  146 |     if (this.ai && p === 1 && !ai) return;
  147 |     // If a strike is actively animating (smash/rise), ignore taps
  148 |     if (this.strikeAnim) return;
  149 | 
  150 |     const score = this.model.hit(p);
  151 |     if (score !== null) {
  152 |       // Trigger hammer swing & rising puck animation
  153 |       const targetPeakY = 602 - (score / 100) * (602 - 212);
  154 |       this.strikeAnim = {
  155 |         physics: new StrikePhysics(score),
  156 |         player: p,
  157 |         score,
  158 |         elapsed: 0,
  159 |         peakY: targetPeakY,
  160 |         puckY: 602,
  161 |         hitTriggered: false,
  162 |         bellTriggered: false,
  163 |       };
  164 | 
  165 |       // Score out of 300 (integer sum of up to 3 strikes)
  166 |       const t = this.model.totals;
  167 |       this.ctx.setScore(t[0], t[1]);
  168 |     }
  169 |   }
  170 | 
  171 |   update(dt: number) {
  172 |     if (this.paused || this.reported) return;
  173 |     this.totalElapsed += dt;
  174 |     this.view.update(dt);
  175 |     this.turnWait = Math.max(0, this.turnWait - dt);
  176 |     if (this.turnWait === 0 && !this.strikeAnim) {
  177 |       this.fixed.advance(dt, (step) => {
  178 |         // Refine visible needle timing within the same fixed simulation tick.
  179 |         for (let i = 0; i < 5 && !this.strikeAnim; i++) {
  180 |           this.model.update(step / 5);
  181 |           if (this.currentTurn === 1 && this.ai?.update(this.model))
  182 |             this.hit(1, true);
  183 |         }
  184 |       });
  185 |     } else this.fixed.reset();
  186 | 
  187 |     // Update camera shake
  188 |     if (this.cameraShake > 0) {
  189 |       this.cameraShake = Math.max(0, this.cameraShake - dt * 18);
  190 |     }
  191 | 
  192 |     // Update bell flash
  193 |     if (this.bellFlashAge > 0) {
  194 |       this.bellFlashAge = Math.max(0, this.bellFlashAge - dt);
  195 |     }
  196 | 
  197 |     // Stable spring and flight integration, independent of render rate.
  198 |     this.animationFixed.advance(dt, (step) => {
  199 |       this.ring.step(step);
  200 |       this.updateStrike(step);
  201 |     });
  202 | 
  203 |     // Update particles
  204 |     this.updateSparks(dt);
  205 | 
  206 |     // Render all elements
  207 |     this.render();
  208 | 
  209 |     // Update UI text & badges
  210 |     this.updateUI();
  211 | 
  212 |     // Match end check
  213 |     if (this.model.done) {
  214 |       this.finishAge += dt;
  215 |       if (this.finishAge > 1.4 && !this.reported) {
  216 |         this.reported = true;
  217 |         // Final score card is averaged as requested!
  218 |         this.ctx.finish({
  219 |           winner: this.model.winner!,
  220 |           scores: this.model.averages,
  221 |         });
  222 |       }
  223 |     }
  224 |   }
  225 | 
  226 |   private updateStrike(dt: number) {
  227 |     if (!this.strikeAnim) {
  228 |       // Idle hammer breathing
  229 |       this.hammerAngle = this.hammerRestAngle;
  230 |       return;
  231 |     }
  232 | 
  233 |     const anim = this.strikeAnim;
  234 |     anim.elapsed += dt;
  235 |     const t = anim.elapsed;
  236 | 
  237 |     if (t < 0.07) this.hammerAngle = this.hammerRestAngle - (t / 0.07) * 0.42;
  238 |     else if (t < 0.16)
  239 |       this.hammerAngle =
  240 |         this.hammerRestAngle - 0.42 + Math.pow((t - 0.07) / 0.09, 2) * 1.3;
  241 |     else {
  242 |       if (!anim.hitTriggered) {
  243 |         anim.hitTriggered = true;
  244 |         this.ctx.audio.play("wood", 0.8);
  245 |         this.cameraShake = 3;
  246 |       }
  247 |       this.hammerAngle =
  248 |         this.hammerRestAngle + 0.88 * Math.max(0, 1 - (t - 0.16) / 0.3);
  249 |       anim.physics.step(dt);
  250 |       anim.puckY = anim.physics.y;
  251 |       if (anim.physics.peaked && !anim.bellTriggered) {
  252 |         anim.bellTriggered = true;
  253 |         anim.peakY = anim.puckY;
  254 |         if (anim.physics.contacted) {
  255 |           this.ring.strike();
  256 |           this.ctx.audio.play("perfect");
  257 |           this.bellFlashAge = 0.6;
  258 |           this.spawnSparks(210, 244, 0xffea00, 8);
  259 |         } else this.ctx.audio.play("metal", 0.4);
  260 |         this.popupText
  261 |           .setText(String(anim.score))
  262 |           .setColor(anim.player === 0 ? "#b85e20" : "#22789e");
  263 |       }
  264 |       if (anim.bellTriggered) {
  265 |         const age = t - 0.16;
  266 |         this.popupText
  267 |           .setPosition(
  268 |             88 - 210,
  269 |             Math.max(220, anim.peakY) - 381 - Math.min(24, age * 24),
  270 |           )
  271 |           .setAlpha(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (1.25 - t) / 0.35)))
  272 |           .setScale(1 + 0.08 * Math.exp(-age * 6));
  273 |       }
  274 |     }
  275 |     if (t >= 1.25 && anim.physics.settled) {
  276 |       this.popupText.setAlpha(0);
  277 |       this.strikeAnim = undefined;
  278 | 
  279 |       // Advance turn one-by-one
  280 |       if (!this.model.done) {
  281 |         const s0 = this.model.scores[0].length;
  282 |         const s1 = this.model.scores[1].length;
  283 |         if (this.currentTurn === 0) {
  284 |           if (s1 < 3) this.currentTurn = 1;
  285 |         } else {
  286 |           if (s0 < 3) this.currentTurn = 0;
  287 |         }
  288 |         this.turnWait =
  289 |           this.ai && this.currentTurn === 1
  290 |             ? 1.2 + this.ai.personality.tempo * 0.15
  291 |             : 0.65;
  292 |         this.model.clocks[this.currentTurn] = 0;
  293 |         this.model.cooldowns[this.currentTurn] = 0;
  294 |         this.view.set(!this.ai && this.currentTurn === 1);
  295 |       }
  296 |     }
  297 |   }
  298 | 
  299 |   private spawnSparks(cx: number, cy: number, color: number, count = 8) {
  300 |     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  301 |       const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
  302 |       const speed = 120 + Math.random() * 180;
  303 |       this.sparks.push({
  304 |         x: cx,
  305 |         y: cy,
  306 |         vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
  307 |         vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 60,
  308 |         life: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.25,
  309 |         maxLife: 0.5,
  310 |         color: Math.random() > 0.4 ? color : 0xffffff,
  311 |         size: 3 + Math.random() * 3,
  312 |       });
  313 |     }
  314 |   }
  315 | 
  316 |   private updateSparks(dt: number) {
  317 |     for (let i = this.sparks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  318 |       const s = this.sparks[i];
  319 |       s.life -= dt;
  320 |       if (s.life <= 0) {
  321 |         this.sparks.splice(i, 1);
  322 |         continue;
  323 |       }
  324 |       s.x += s.vx * dt;
  325 |       s.y += s.vy * dt;
  326 |       s.vy += 380 * dt; // gravity
  327 |     }
  328 |   }

  330 |   private render() {

  484 |   private drawStar(
  485 |     g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
  486 |     cx: number,
  487 |     cy: number,
  488 |     r: number,
  489 |     color: number,
  490 |     line = 2,
  491 |   ) {
  492 |     const points: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  493 |     const innerR = r * 0.44;
  494 |     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  495 |       const rad = (i * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
  496 |       const radDist = i % 2 === 0 ? r : innerR;
  497 |       points.push({
  498 |         x: cx + Math.cos(rad) * radDist,
  499 |         y: cy + Math.sin(rad) * radDist,
  500 |       });
  501 |     }
  502 |     g.fillStyle(color);
  503 |     g.beginPath();
  504 |     g.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
  505 |     for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
  506 |       g.lineTo(points[i].x, points[i].y);
  507 |     }
  508 |     g.closePath();
  509 |     g.fillPath();
  510 |     if (line) {
  511 |       g.lineStyle(line, theme.ink);
  512 |       g.strokePath();
  513 |     }
  514 |   }
  515 | 
  516 |   private drawHammer(
  517 |     g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
  518 |     shakeX: number,
  519 |     shakeY: number,
  520 |   ) {
  521 |     // Hammer grip colored according to the current turn player!
  522 |     const activePlayer = this.strikeAnim
  523 |       ? this.strikeAnim.player
  524 |       : this.currentTurn;
  525 |     const gripColor = activePlayer === 0 ? theme.orange : theme.blue;
  526 | 
  527 |     // Keep the grip planted; rotate the head onto the anvil without a position snap.
  528 |     const pivotX = 300 + shakeX;
  529 |     const pivotY = 600 + shakeY;
  530 |     const angle = 0.32 - (this.hammerAngle - 0.32) * 2.32;
  531 |     const cos = Math.cos(angle);
  532 |     const sin = Math.sin(angle);
  533 | 
  534 |     const rot = (dx: number, dy: number) => ({
  535 |       x: pivotX + dx * cos - (dy - 86) * sin,
  536 |       y: pivotY + dx * sin + (dy - 86) * cos,
  537 |     });
  538 | 
  539 |     // 1. Hammer Handle
  540 |     // Length 84px, width 14px
  541 |     const p1 = rot(-6, 0);
  542 |     const p2 = rot(6, 0);
  543 |     const p3 = rot(6, 84);
  544 |     const p4 = rot(-6, 84);
  545 | 
  546 |     g.fillStyle(0x8c502b); // Wood brown
  547 |     g.beginPath();
  548 |     g.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
  549 |     g.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
  550 |     g.lineTo(p3.x, p3.y);
  551 |     g.lineTo(p4.x, p4.y);
  552 |     g.closePath();
  553 |     g.fillPath();
  554 |     g.lineStyle(3, theme.ink);
  555 |     g.strokePath();
  556 | 
  557 |     // Grip band
  558 |     const g1 = rot(-6, 38);
  559 |     const g2 = rot(6, 38);
  560 |     const g3 = rot(6, 70);
  561 |     const g4 = rot(-6, 70);
  562 |     g.fillStyle(gripColor);
  563 |     g.beginPath();
  564 |     g.moveTo(g1.x, g1.y);
  565 |     g.lineTo(g2.x, g2.y);
  566 |     g.lineTo(g3.x, g3.y);
  567 |     g.lineTo(g4.x, g4.y);
  568 |     g.closePath();
  569 |     g.fillPath();
  570 | 
  571 |     // Handle end pommel
  572 |     const pommel = rot(0, 86);
  573 |     circle(g, pommel.x, pommel.y, 6, 0x8c502b, 3);
  574 | 
  575 |     // 2. Hammer Head
  576 |     // Width 64, height 36
  577 |     const headCorners = [
  578 |       rot(-32, -18),
  579 |       rot(32, -18),
  580 |       rot(32, 18),
  581 |       rot(-32, 18),
  582 |     ];
  583 |     g.fillStyle(0x41474d); // Steel grey
  584 |     g.beginPath();
  585 |     g.moveTo(headCorners[0].x, headCorners[0].y);
  586 |     g.lineTo(headCorners[1].x, headCorners[1].y);
  587 |     g.lineTo(headCorners[2].x, headCorners[2].y);
  588 |     g.lineTo(headCorners[3].x, headCorners[3].y);
  589 |     g.closePath();
  590 |     g.fillPath();
  591 |     g.lineStyle(4, theme.ink);
  592 |     g.strokePath();
  593 | 
  594 |     // Head top fastener pin
  595 |     const pin1 = rot(-6, -24);
  596 |     const pin2 = rot(6, -24);
  597 |     const pin3 = rot(6, -18);
  598 |     const pin4 = rot(-6, -18);
  599 |     g.fillStyle(0x2b3036);
  600 |     g.beginPath();
  601 |     g.moveTo(pin1.x, pin1.y);
  602 |     g.lineTo(pin2.x, pin2.y);
  603 |     g.lineTo(pin3.x, pin3.y);
  604 |     g.lineTo(pin4.x, pin4.y);
  605 |     g.closePath();
  606 |     g.fillPath();
  607 |     g.lineStyle(2, theme.ink);
  608 |     g.strokePath();
  609 |   }
  610 | 
  611 |   private updateUI() {
  612 |     const s0 = this.model.scores[0];
  613 |     const s1 = this.model.scores[1];

  615 |     if (this.model.done) {

  617 |       return;
  618 |     }
  619 | 
  620 |     const count = this.currentTurn === 0 ? s0.length : s1.length;

  628 |     if (this.currentTurn === 0) {
~~~

## src/games/hammer-hit/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 11724c721dde8aff71a94326b19a905bb0fb98ebff557b6ce2cd720446d18541
~~~text
    1 | export const ATTEMPTS = 3;
    2 | export function needle(time: number, attempt: number) {
    3 |   return Math.sin(time * (2.6 + attempt * 0.35) - Math.PI / 2);
    4 | }
    5 | export function strikeScore(position: number) {
    6 |   return Math.round(100 * (1 - Math.min(1, Math.abs(position))));
    7 | }
    8 | export class HammerMatch {
    9 |   scores: [number[], number[]] = [[], []];
   10 |   clocks = [0, 0];
   11 |   cooldowns = [0.6, 0.6];
   12 |   locked = [-1, -1];
   13 |   update(dt: number) {
   14 |     for (let p = 0; p < 2; p++) {
   15 |       if (this.cooldowns[p] > 0) {
   16 |         this.cooldowns[p] = Math.max(0, this.cooldowns[p] - dt);
   17 |         continue;
   18 |       }
   19 |       if (this.scores[p].length < ATTEMPTS) this.clocks[p] += dt;
   20 |     }
   21 |   }
   22 |   position(p: number) {
   23 |     return needle(this.clocks[p], this.scores[p].length);
   24 |   }
   25 |   hit(p: 0 | 1) {
   26 |     if (this.cooldowns[p] > 0 || this.scores[p].length >= ATTEMPTS) return null;
   27 |     const position = this.position(p),
   28 |       score = strikeScore(position);
   29 |     this.locked[p] = position;
   30 |     this.scores[p].push(score);
   31 |     this.clocks[p] = 0;
   32 |     this.cooldowns[p] = 1.1;
   33 |     return score;
   34 |   }
   35 |   get totals() {
   36 |     return this.scores.map((s) => s.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)) as [
   37 |       number,
   38 |       number,
   39 |     ];
   40 |   }
   41 |   get done() {
   42 |     return this.scores.every((s) => s.length === ATTEMPTS);
   43 |   }
   44 |   get winner(): 1 | 2 | "draw" | null {
   45 |     if (!this.done) return null;
   46 |     const [a, b] = this.totals;
   47 |     return a === b ? "draw" : a > b ? 1 : 2;
   48 |   }
   49 |   get averages() {
   50 |     return this.totals.map((n) => n / ATTEMPTS) as [number, number];
   51 |   }
   52 | }
~~~

## src/games/hammer-hit/StrikePhysics.ts
SHA-256: d273da2efaec58dde10bcdfc0e384fc418d619bf5f444b652e489015649dfc23
~~~text
    1 | /** Presentation physics only: the legal timing score remains owned by Rules. */
    2 | export class StrikePhysics {
    3 |   y = 602;
    4 |   velocity: number;
    5 |   settled = false;
    6 |   contacted = false;
    7 |   peaked = false;
    8 |   constructor(score: number) {
    9 |     this.velocity = -Math.sqrt(
   10 |       2 * 2200 * (score === 100 ? 365 : (score / 100) * 348),
   11 |     );
   12 |   }
   13 |   step(dt: number) {
   14 |     if (this.settled) return;
   15 |     const previous = this.velocity;
   16 |     this.y += this.velocity * dt + 1100 * dt * dt;
   17 |     this.velocity += 2200 * dt;
   18 |     // Puck radius 10, bell bottom 244: actual separating contact at 254.
   19 |     if (this.y <= 254 && this.velocity < 0) {
   20 |       this.y = 254;
   21 |       this.velocity = -this.velocity * 0.28;
   22 |       this.contacted = true;
   23 |     }
   24 |     if (previous <= 0 && this.velocity >= 0) this.peaked = true;
   25 |     if (this.y >= 602 && this.velocity >= 0) {
   26 |       this.y = 602;
   27 |       this.velocity = 0;
   28 |       this.settled = true;
   29 |       this.peaked = true;
   30 |     }
   31 |   }
   32 | }
   33 | export class ImpactRing {
   34 |   angle = 0;
   35 |   velocity = 0;
   36 |   strike() {
   37 |     this.velocity += 2.8;
   38 |   }
   39 |   step(dt: number) {
   40 |     this.velocity += (-65 * this.angle - 9 * this.velocity) * dt;
   41 |     this.angle += this.velocity * dt;
   42 |   }
   43 | }
~~~

## src/games/happy-birds/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 430d5fa6fbe51939ea6d41fceae8e658ab81e38b6bd301c7945ada9b4737ee2b
~~~text
    1 | # Happy Birds
    2 | 
    3 | One shared 320×460 arena; auto-flying birds bounce on safe walls and flap through ordinary input. First to 15 collected stars wins, with a draw for equal same-step finishes. No survival points, score penalties, round resets or match deadline. One 1.1-second opening beat precedes the continuous race.
    4 | 
    5 | Rules owns seeded wall patterns and defers telegraphed changes until active birds clear the wall. Stars owns exactly one shared collectible and swept pickup distances. Spawn candidates cover x 58–262/y110–350, with at least 65 units from active birds and 80 from the previous star; bounded rejection sampling has a farthest-candidate fallback. No fixed player slots or alternating sides. The nearest eligible bird collects; exactly tied contacts share credit. Replacement stars have a brief birth animation. Never award points without actual contact or let recovering birds collect. Bursts are bounded and expire.
    6 | 
    7 | ArenaPhysics owns radius 15 bird collision with wall triangles; 120 Hz simulation, 140 ms flap lock. No bird-to-bird collision. Recovery owns the independent three-second knockout: gray at impact, eased curved return to middle positions 140/180×230, gradual recoloring and automatic upward relaunch. During recovery, collision, collection and human/AI flaps are disabled for that bird only. Pause freezes recovery. There is no numeric cooldown label or timer object.
    8 | 
    9 | AI routes toward visible stars and safe wall openings using legal flaps, difficulty-specific reactions and seeded personalities. It must collect the same physical stars as humans. BirdView interpolates position, turns and saturation; per-bird reset clears respawn trails without interrupting the opponent. BirdArt owns round vector birds, hinged wings, gold stars and collection bursts. One retained masked Graphics plus two compact target labels; dispose all module resources. No extra RAF, textures or unowned timers.
   10 | 
   11 | Orange Space/A or lower touch half; Blue arrows/Enter/L or upper half. In AI mode arrows control Orange. Host input subscriptions reject repeat, pause and clean up on exit. Keep keyboard instructions in setup, not the arena. Thumbnail should depict this shared star arena, never pipes.
   12 | 
   13 | Checks: happy-birds.test.ts, premium-motion.test.ts, expansion-framerate.test.ts; birds-stars.spec.ts, premium-motion.spec.ts, gravity-landscapes.spec.ts, expansion-phase2.spec.ts and tournament regression in clean-ui.spec.ts.
~~~

## src/games/happy-birds/AI.ts
SHA-256: 85e9917ad9f9a6f1e22f762a26fbe06aaf8447f70a2348337e088b49e8cc908a
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { BirdsMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class BirdsAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private think = 0;
    7 |   constructor(
    8 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
    9 |     seed?: number,
   10 |   ) {
   11 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   12 |   }
   13 |   private ageReady(m: BirdsMatch, born: number) {
   14 |     return m.age - born > 0.1;
   15 |   }
   16 |   update(dt: number, m: BirdsMatch, player: 0 | 1 = 1) {
   17 |     if (m.winner || m.between || !m.players[player].alive) return false;
   18 |     this.think -= dt;
   19 |     if (this.think > 0) return false;
   20 |     this.think = this.personality.sample(
   21 |       { medium: 0.14, hard: 0.06, impossible: 0.024 }[this.difficulty],
   22 |       0.012,
   23 |       0.018,
   24 |     );
   25 |     const p = m.players[player];
   26 |     if (p.cooldown > 0) return false;
   27 |     const side = p.direction === 1 ? 1 : 0,
   28 |       eta = (side === 0 ? p.x : 320 - p.x) / m.speed();
   29 |     const desired =
   30 |       m.safeCenter(side) +
   31 |       this.personality.side *
   32 |         { medium: 10, hard: 4, impossible: 1 }[this.difficulty];
   33 |     const mix = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (1.9 - eta) / 0.8));
   34 |     let target = 230 + (desired - 230) * mix;
   35 |     const ahead = m.stars
   36 |       .filter(
   37 |         (s) => this.ageReady(m, s.born) && (s.x - p.x) * p.direction > -20,
   38 |       )
   39 |       .sort((a, b) => (a.x - p.x) * p.direction - (b.x - p.x) * p.direction)[0];
   40 |     if (ahead && eta > 0.25) {
   41 |       // Route toward visible collectibles, then leave time to line up with the safe wall opening.
   42 |       target =
   43 |         ahead.y +
   44 |         14 +
   45 |         this.personality.side *
   46 |           { medium: 10, hard: 3, impossible: 0 }[this.difficulty];
   47 |     }
   48 |     const look = { medium: 0.05, hard: 0.11, impossible: 0.11 }[
   49 |       this.difficulty
   50 |     ];
   51 |     const future = p.y + p.vy * look + 325 * look * look;
   52 |     if (p.y < 48 && p.vy < 0) return false;
   53 |     const climb = p.y > target + 35 && p.vy > -145;
   54 |     return (
   55 |       climb ||
   56 |       (p.vy >= -20 &&
   57 |         future >
   58 |           target + { medium: 20, hard: 10, impossible: 10 }[this.difficulty])
   59 |     );
   60 |   }
   61 | }
~~~

## src/games/happy-birds/ArenaPhysics.ts
SHA-256: 91f02064aa3e8b5056459ed0c00460447633f1cf3835425e28344481879279cf
~~~text
    1 | export const WIDTH = 320,
    2 |   HEIGHT = 460,
    3 |   RADIUS = 15,
    4 |   GRAVITY = 650,
    5 |   FLAP = -195;
    6 | export interface Bird {
    7 |   x: number;
    8 |   y: number;
    9 |   vy: number;
   10 |   direction: -1 | 1;
   11 |   alive: boolean;
   12 |   cooldown: number;
   13 |   bounces: number;
   14 |   flapSerial: number;
   15 |   recovery: number;
   16 |   hitX: number;
   17 |   hitY: number;
   18 | }
   19 | export interface Wall {
   20 |   rows: number[];
   21 |   window: number;
   22 |   version: number;
   23 |   pending?: { rows: number[]; window: number; remaining: number };
   24 | }
   25 | export const rowY = (index: number) => 44 + index * 44;
   26 | function segmentDistance(
   27 |   x: number,
   28 |   y: number,
   29 |   ax: number,
   30 |   ay: number,
   31 |   bx: number,
   32 |   by: number,
   33 | ) {
   34 |   const dx = bx - ax,
   35 |     dy = by - ay,
   36 |     t = Math.max(
   37 |       0,
   38 |       Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)),
   39 |     );
   40 |   return (x - ax - t * dx) ** 2 + (y - ay - t * dy) ** 2;
   41 | }
   42 | export function spikeCollision(x: number, y: number, side: 0 | 1, row: number) {
   43 |   const cx = side === 0 ? x : WIDTH - x,
   44 |     cy = y - rowY(row);
   45 |   if (cx > 18 + RADIUS || Math.abs(cy) > 16 + RADIUS) return false;
   46 |   if (cx >= 0 && cx <= 18 && Math.abs(cy) <= 16 * (1 - cx / 18)) return true;
   47 |   return (
   48 |     Math.min(
   49 |       segmentDistance(cx, cy, 0, -16, 18, 0),
   50 |       segmentDistance(cx, cy, 18, 0, 0, 16),
   51 |       segmentDistance(cx, cy, 0, 16, 0, -16),
   52 |     ) <=
   53 |     RADIUS * RADIUS
   54 |   );
   55 | }
   56 | /** Shared arena physics: no rule exemptions for AI, no bird-to-bird collision. */
   57 | export function advanceBird(
   58 |   p: Bird,
   59 |   dt: number,
   60 |   speed: number,
   61 |   walls: readonly Wall[],
   62 | ): 0 | 1 | null {
   63 |   if (!p.alive) return null;
   64 |   p.cooldown = Math.max(0, p.cooldown - dt);
   65 |   p.x += p.direction * speed * dt;
   66 |   p.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
   67 |   p.y += p.vy * dt;
   68 |   if (p.y - RADIUS < 16 || p.y + RADIUS > HEIGHT - 16) {
   69 |     p.alive = false;
   70 |     return null;
   71 |   }
   72 |   for (const side of [0, 1] as const)
   73 |     if (walls[side].rows.some((row) => spikeCollision(p.x, p.y, side, row))) {
   74 |       p.alive = false;
   75 |       return null;
   76 |     }
   77 |   if (p.x <= RADIUS) {
   78 |     p.x = RADIUS;
   79 |     p.direction = 1;
   80 |     p.bounces++;
   81 |     return 0;
   82 |   }
   83 |   if (p.x >= WIDTH - RADIUS) {
   84 |     p.x = WIDTH - RADIUS;
   85 |     p.direction = -1;
   86 |     p.bounces++;
   87 |     return 1;
   88 |   }
   89 |   return null;
   90 | }
~~~

## src/games/happy-birds/BirdView.ts
SHA-256: ad47fe027d1d819c85d9e0ad108a46a03e189f2f9636f92742ad095c300dd8b9
~~~text
    1 | import { recoveryPose } from "./Recovery";
    2 | import type { BirdsMatch } from "./Rules";
    3 | export class BirdView {
    4 |   private previous = [
    5 |     { x: 100, y: 230, vy: 0 },
    6 |     { x: 220, y: 230, vy: 0 },
    7 |   ];
    8 |   private faces = [1, -1];
    9 |   private angles = [0, 0];
   10 |   readonly wings = [0, 0];
   11 |   readonly bumps = [0, 0];
   12 |   readonly trails = [
   13 |     Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => ({ x: 100, y: 230 })),
   14 |     Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => ({ x: 220, y: 230 })),
   15 |   ];
   16 |   private trailAge = 0;
   17 |   capture(m: BirdsMatch) {
   18 |     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   19 |       const p = m.players[i];
   20 |       Object.assign(this.previous[i], { x: p.x, y: p.y, vy: p.vy });
   21 |     }
   22 |   }
   23 |   reset(m: BirdsMatch) {
   24 |     this.capture(m);
   25 |     for (const i of [0, 1] as const) this.resetBird(m, i);
   26 |   }
   27 |   resetBird(m: BirdsMatch, i: 0 | 1) {
   28 |     const p = m.players[i];
   29 |     Object.assign(this.previous[i], { x: p.x, y: p.y, vy: p.vy });
   30 |     this.faces[i] = p.direction;
   31 |     this.angles[i] = 0;
   32 |     this.wings[i] = 0;
   33 |     this.bumps[i] = 0;
   34 |     for (const t of this.trails[i]) Object.assign(t, this.previous[i]);
   35 |   }
   36 |   sample(m: BirdsMatch, t: number, dt: number) {
   37 |     const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
   38 |     const result = m.players.map((p, i) => {
   39 |       const prev = this.previous[i];
   40 |       this.faces[i] += (p.direction - this.faces[i]) * (1 - Math.exp(-26 * dt));
   41 |       this.angles[i] +=
   42 |         (Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.75, p.vy / 400)) - this.angles[i]) *
   43 |         (1 - Math.exp(-14 * dt));
   44 |       this.wings[i] = Math.max(0, this.wings[i] - dt * 5);
   45 |       this.bumps[i] *= Math.exp(-18 * dt);
   46 |       return {
   47 |         ...p,
   48 |         saturation: p.alive ? 1 : recoveryPose(p.recovery).tint,
   49 |         x: prev.x + (p.x - prev.x) * alpha,
   50 |         y: prev.y + (p.y - prev.y) * alpha,
   51 |         face: this.faces[i],
   52 |         angle: this.angles[i],
   53 |         wing: this.wings[i],
   54 |         bump: this.bumps[i],
   55 |       };
   56 |     });
   57 |     this.trailAge += dt;
   58 |     if (this.trailAge >= 0.045) {
   59 |       this.trailAge %= 0.045;
   60 |       for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   61 |         for (let j = 5; j > 0; j--)
   62 |           Object.assign(this.trails[i][j], this.trails[i][j - 1]);
   63 |         Object.assign(this.trails[i][0], result[i]);
   64 |       }
   65 |     }
   66 |     return result;
   67 |   }
   68 | }
~~~

~~~text
    8 | import { label } from "../../shared/components/drawing";
    9 | import { arena } from "./BirdArt";
   10 | export class BirdsGame implements MiniGame {
   11 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   12 |   private m = new BirdsMatch(freshSeed());
   13 |   private ai?: BirdsAI;
   14 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   15 |   private clip!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   16 |   private mask!: Phaser.Display.Masks.GeometryMask;
   17 |   private goalLabels: Phaser.GameObjects.Text[] = [];
   18 |   private fixed = new FixedStep();
   19 |   private view = new BirdView();
   20 |   private renderState?: ReturnType<BirdView["sample"]>;
   21 |   private paused = false;
   22 |   private done = false;
   23 |   private scores = "";
   24 |   private finishAge = 0;
   25 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   26 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   27 |     this.g = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   28 |     this.clip = ctx.scene.make.graphics({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   29 |     this.clip.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRoundedRect(22, 110, 376, 542, 22);
   30 |     this.mask = this.clip.createGeometryMask();
   31 |     this.g.setMask(this.mask);
   32 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai") {
   33 |       this.ai = new BirdsAI(ctx.options.difficulty);
   34 |       this.m = new BirdsMatch(this.ai.personality.seed);
   35 |     }
   36 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
   37 |       if (x >= 24 && x <= 396 && y >= 112 && y <= 650)
   38 |         this.flap(y < 380 ? 1 : 0);
   39 |     });
   40 |     ctx.input.press(["Space", "KeyA"], () => this.flap(0));
   41 |     ctx.input.press(["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight"], () =>
   42 |       this.flap(this.ai ? 0 : 1),
   43 |     );
   44 |     ctx.input.press(["Enter", "KeyL"], () => this.flap(1));
   45 |     ctx.setHint("");
   46 |     ctx.setScore(0, 0);
   47 |     ctx.setClock("", false);
   48 |     this.goalLabels = [
   49 |       label(ctx.scene, 73, 86, "★ / 15", 12, "#a17e2d"),
   50 |       label(ctx.scene, 73, 690, "★ / 15", 12, "#a17e2d"),
   51 |     ];
   52 |     if (!this.ai) this.goalLabels[0].setRotation(Math.PI);
   53 |     this.view.reset(this.m);
   54 |     this.renderState = this.view.sample(this.m, 1, 0);
   55 |     this.draw();
   56 |     ctx.audio.play("start");
   57 |   }
   58 |   private flap(p: 0 | 1, ai = false) {
   59 |     if (this.paused || this.done || (p === 1 && this.ai && !ai)) return;
   60 |     if (this.m.flap(p)) {
   61 |       this.view.wings[p] = 1;
   62 |       this.ctx.audio.play("shoot", 0.3);
   63 |     }
   64 |   }
   65 |   update(dt: number) {
   66 |     if (this.paused || this.done) return;
   67 |     this.fixed.advance(dt, (h) => {
   68 |       this.view.capture(this.m);
   69 |       if (this.ai?.update(h, this.m)) this.flap(1, true);
   70 |       const oldRound = this.m.round,
   71 |         oldBetween = this.m.between;
   72 |       const old = this.m.players.map((p) => ({
   73 |         alive: p.alive,
   74 |         bounces: p.bounces,
   75 |         recovery: p.recovery,
   76 |       }));
   77 |       this.m.step(h);
   78 |       if (
   79 |         this.m.round !== oldRound ||
   80 |         (oldBetween > 0 && this.m.between === 0)
   81 |       ) {
   82 |         this.view.reset(this.m);
   83 |         this.ctx.audio.play("start", 0.5);
   84 |       }
   85 |       for (const i of [0, 1] as const) {
   86 |         const p = this.m.players[i];
   87 |         if (old[i].recovery > 0 && p.recovery === 0) {
   88 |           this.view.resetBird(this.m, i);
   89 |           this.view.wings[i] = 1;
   90 |           this.ctx.audio.play("start", 0.4);
   91 |         }
   92 |         if (old[i].alive && !p.alive) this.ctx.audio.play("thud", 0.6);
   93 |         else if (p.bounces > old[i].bounces) {
   94 |           this.view.bumps[i] = 1;
   95 |           this.ctx.audio.play("hit", 0.35);
   96 |         }
   97 |       }
   98 |     });
   99 |     this.renderState = this.view.sample(
  100 |       this.m,
  101 |       this.fixed.fraction,
  102 |       Math.min(0.1, dt),
  103 |     );
  104 |     if (this.m.scores.join() !== this.scores) {
  105 |       if (this.scores) this.ctx.audio.play("capture", 0.55);
  106 |       this.scores = this.m.scores.join();
  107 |       this.ctx.setScore(...this.m.scores);
  108 |     }
  109 |     this.draw();
  110 |     if (this.m.winner) {
  111 |       this.finishAge += dt;
  112 |       if (this.finishAge > 0.75) {
  113 |         this.done = true;
  114 |         this.ctx.finish({ winner: this.m.winner, scores: this.m.scores });
  115 |       }
  116 |     }
  117 |   }
  118 |   private draw() {
  119 |     this.g.clear();
  120 |     arena(this.g, this.m, this.renderState!, this.view.trails);
  121 |   }
  122 |   pause() {
  123 |     this.paused = true;
  124 |     this.fixed.reset();
  125 |   }
  126 |   resume() {
  127 |     this.paused = false;
  128 |   }
  129 |   dispose() {
  130 |     this.done = true;
  131 |     this.g.destroy();
  132 |     this.mask.destroy();
  133 |     this.clip.destroy();
  134 |     this.goalLabels.forEach((t) => t.destroy());
  135 |     this.goalLabels = [];
  136 |   }
  137 |   snapshot() {
  138 |     return {
  139 |       players: this.m.players,
  140 |       walls: this.m.walls,
  141 |       sharedArena: true,
  142 |       scores: this.m.scores,
  143 |       round: this.m.round,
  144 |       between: this.m.between,
  145 |       winner: this.m.winner,
  146 |       stars: this.m.stars,
  147 |       bursts: this.m.bursts,
  148 |       goal: 15,
  149 |       renderState: this.renderState,
  150 |       ai: this.ai?.personality.snapshot(),
  151 |     };
  152 |   }
  153 | }
~~~
