## src/games/happy-birds/Recovery.ts
SHA-256: db4536d01b3d34fbff4bd999006f6368381be4e312dc0d41ec747d054a398810
~~~text
    1 | import type { Bird } from "./ArenaPhysics";
    2 | export const RECOVERY_SECONDS = 3;
    3 | export const home = (player: 0 | 1) => ({
    4 |   x: player === 0 ? 140 : 180,
    5 |   y: 230,
    6 | });
    7 | export function beginRecovery(p: Bird) {
    8 |   p.alive = false;
    9 |   p.recovery = RECOVERY_SECONDS;
   10 |   p.hitX = p.x;
   11 |   p.hitY = p.y;
   12 |   p.vy = 0;
   13 |   p.cooldown = 0;
   14 | }
   15 | const clamp = (n: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
   16 | export function recoveryPose(remaining: number) {
   17 |   const progress = clamp(1 - remaining / RECOVERY_SECONDS);
   18 |   const t = clamp((progress - 0.12) / 0.68);
   19 |   const travel = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
   20 |   const tint = clamp((progress - 0.45) / 0.55);
   21 |   return { progress, travel, tint: tint * tint * (3 - 2 * tint) };
   22 | }
   23 | export function advanceRecovery(p: Bird, player: 0 | 1, dt: number) {
   24 |   p.recovery = Math.max(0, p.recovery - dt);
   25 |   const { travel } = recoveryPose(p.recovery),
   26 |     target = home(player);
   27 |   p.x = p.hitX + (target.x - p.hitX) * travel;
   28 |   p.y = p.hitY + (target.y - p.hitY) * travel - Math.sin(travel * Math.PI) * 22;
   29 |   if (p.recovery < 1e-8) {
   30 |     p.recovery = 0;
   31 |     p.alive = true;
   32 |     p.x = target.x;
   33 |     p.y = target.y;
   34 |     p.direction = player === 0 ? 1 : -1;
   35 |     p.vy = -125;
   36 |   }
   37 | }
   38 | /** All colored parts fade together; no numeric cooldown UI is needed. */
   39 | export function recoveryColor(color: number, t: number) {
   40 |   const gray = 0xa8afb1;
   41 |   const channel = (shift: number) =>
   42 |     Math.round(
   43 |       ((gray >> shift) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((color >> shift) & 255) * t,
   44 |     );
   45 |   return (channel(16) << 16) | (channel(8) << 8) | channel(0);
   46 | }
~~~

## src/games/happy-birds/Rules.ts
SHA-256: f50502982e3327757f8fec4b1fa432e27ac1286ce67699de1b7975a66f9e4e7a
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, mixSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import {
    3 |   advanceBird,
    4 |   FLAP,
    5 |   RADIUS,
    6 |   rowY,
    7 |   type Bird,
    8 |   type Wall,
    9 | } from "./ArenaPhysics";
   10 | import { beginRecovery, advanceRecovery } from "./Recovery";
   11 | import {
   12 |   STAR_GOAL,
   13 |   STAR_RADIUS,
   14 |   spawnStar,
   15 |   pickupDistance,
   16 |   type Star,
   17 |   type StarBurst,
   18 | } from "./Stars";
   19 | export type { Bird, Wall } from "./ArenaPhysics";
   20 | export class BirdsMatch {
   21 |   players: [Bird, Bird] = [this.bird(0), this.bird(1)];
   22 |   walls: [Wall, Wall];
   23 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   24 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   25 |   age = 0;
   26 |   total = 0;
   27 |   round = 1;
   28 |   between = 1.1;
   29 |   stars: Star[] = [];
   30 |   bursts: StarBurst[] = [];
   31 |   private random: MatchRandom;
   32 |   private nextStar = 0;
   33 |   constructor(readonly seed: number) {
   34 |     this.walls = [this.wall(0, 3, 0), this.wall(1, 3, 0)];
   35 |     this.random = new MatchRandom(mixSeed(seed, 809));
   36 |     this.stars = [
   37 |       spawnStar(this.random, this.nextStar++, this.age, this.players),
   38 |     ];
   39 |   }
   40 |   private bird(p: number): Bird {
   41 |     return {
   42 |       x: p === 0 ? 100 : 220,
   43 |       y: 230,
   44 |       vy: 0,
   45 |       direction: p === 0 ? 1 : -1,
   46 |       alive: true,
   47 |       cooldown: 0,
   48 |       bounces: 0,
   49 |       flapSerial: 0,
   50 |       recovery: 0,
   51 |       hitX: 0,
   52 |       hitY: 0,
   53 |     };
   54 |   }
   55 |   private wall(side: number, window: number, version: number): Wall {
   56 |     const r = new MatchRandom(
   57 |       mixSeed(this.seed, this.round * 97 + side * 31 + version * 13),
   58 |     );
   59 |     const rows = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => i)
   60 |       .filter((i) => i < window || i > window + 2)
   61 |       .sort((a, b) => r.rank(a) - r.rank(b))
   62 |       .slice(0, 4)
   63 |       .sort((a, b) => a - b);
   64 |     return { rows, window, version };
   65 |   }
   66 |   speed() {
   67 |     return Math.min(165, 115 + this.age * 0.25);
   68 |   }
   69 |   flap(i: 0 | 1) {
   70 |     const p = this.players[i];
   71 |     if (this.winner || this.between || !p.alive || p.cooldown > 0) return false;
   72 |     p.vy = FLAP;
   73 |     p.cooldown = 0.14;
   74 |     p.flapSerial++;
   75 |     return true;
   76 |   }
   77 |   safeCenter(side: 0 | 1) {
   78 |     return rowY(this.walls[side].window + 1);
   79 |   }
   80 |   private clear(side: 0 | 1) {
   81 |     return this.players.every(
   82 |       (p) => !p.alive || (side === 0 ? p.x : 320 - p.x) > 100,
   83 |     );
   84 |   }
   85 |   private schedule(side: 0 | 1) {
   86 |     const wall = this.walls[side];
   87 |     if (wall.pending) return;
   88 |     const r = new MatchRandom(
   89 |       mixSeed(this.seed, this.round * 113 + wall.version * 41 + side),
   90 |     );
   91 |     const window = Math.max(
   92 |       1,
   93 |       Math.min(5, wall.window + (r.next() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1)),
   94 |     );
   95 |     const next = this.wall(side, window, wall.version + 1);
   96 |     wall.pending = { rows: next.rows, window, remaining: 0.4 };
   97 |   }
   98 |   step(dt: number) {
   99 |     if (this.winner) return;
  100 |     this.total += dt;
  101 |     if (this.between) {
  102 |       this.between = Math.max(0, this.between - dt);
  103 |       return;
  104 |     }
  105 |     this.age += dt;
  106 |     for (const side of [0, 1] as const) {
  107 |       const w = this.walls[side];
  108 |       if (w.pending) {
  109 |         w.pending.remaining -= dt;
  110 |         if (w.pending.remaining <= 0 && this.clear(side)) {
  111 |           w.rows = w.pending.rows;
  112 |           w.window = w.pending.window;
  113 |           w.version++;
  114 |           w.pending = undefined;
  115 |         }
  116 |       }
  117 |     }
  118 |     for (const burst of this.bursts) burst.age += dt;
  119 |     this.bursts = this.bursts.filter((b) => b.age < 0.5);
  120 |     const before = this.players.map((p) => ({
  121 |       x: p.x,
  122 |       y: p.y,
  123 |       active: p.alive && p.recovery === 0,
  124 |     }));
  125 |     for (const i of [0, 1] as const) {
  126 |       const p = this.players[i];
  127 |       if (p.recovery > 0) {
  128 |         advanceRecovery(p, i, dt);
  129 |         continue;
  130 |       }
  131 |       const bounce = advanceBird(p, dt, this.speed(), this.walls);
  132 |       if (!p.alive) {
  133 |         beginRecovery(p);
  134 |         continue;
  135 |       }
  136 |       if (bounce !== null) this.schedule(bounce === 0 ? 1 : 0);
  137 |     }
  138 |     const collected: Star[] = [];
  139 |     for (const star of this.stars) {
  140 |       if (this.age - star.born < 0.18) continue;
  141 |       const distances = this.players.map((p, i) =>
  142 |         p.alive && p.recovery === 0 && before[i].active
  143 |           ? pickupDistance(star, before[i], p)
  144 |           : Infinity,
  145 |       );
  146 |       const nearest = Math.min(...distances);
  147 |       if (nearest > RADIUS + STAR_RADIUS) continue;
  148 |       for (const i of [0, 1] as const)
  149 |         if (Math.abs(distances[i] - nearest) < 1e-6) {
  150 |           this.scores[i] = Math.min(STAR_GOAL, this.scores[i] + 1);
  151 |           this.bursts.push({ x: star.x, y: star.y, player: i, age: 0 });
  152 |         }
  153 |       collected.push(star);
  154 |     }
  155 |     if (collected.length)
  156 |       this.stars = this.stars.filter((s) => !collected.includes(s));
  157 |     if (this.scores.some((s) => s >= STAR_GOAL)) {
  158 |       this.winner =
  159 |         this.scores[0] >= STAR_GOAL && this.scores[1] >= STAR_GOAL
  160 |           ? "draw"
  161 |           : this.scores[0] >= STAR_GOAL
  162 |             ? 1
  163 |             : 2;
  164 |       return;
  165 |     }
  166 |     if (collected.length)
  167 |       this.stars = [
  168 |         spawnStar(
  169 |           this.random,
  170 |           this.nextStar++,
  171 |           this.age,
  172 |           this.players,
  173 |           collected[0],
  174 |         ),
  175 |       ];
  176 |   }
  177 | }
~~~

## src/games/happy-birds/Stars.ts
SHA-256: b6571079f07f5215ca3308b08a4fa43c065ebf74f7ec5819d49d8e0f7813fabf
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Bird } from "./ArenaPhysics";
    3 | export const STAR_GOAL = 15;
    4 | export const STAR_RADIUS = 10;
    5 | export interface Star {
    6 |   id: number;
    7 |   x: number;
    8 |   y: number;
    9 |   born: number;
   10 | }
   11 | export interface StarBurst {
   12 |   x: number;
   13 |   y: number;
   14 |   player: 0 | 1;
   15 |   age: number;
   16 | }
   17 | /** Uniform candidates across the open arena; reject instant pickups and nearby repeats. */
   18 | export function spawnStar(
   19 |   random: MatchRandom,
   20 |   id: number,
   21 |   age: number,
   22 |   players: readonly Bird[],
   23 |   previous?: { x: number; y: number },
   24 | ): Star {
   25 |   let best = { x: 160, y: 230 },
   26 |     bestClearance = -Infinity;
   27 |   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 64; attempt++) {
   28 |     const point = { x: 58 + random.next() * 204, y: 110 + random.next() * 240 };
   29 |     const clearance = Math.min(
   30 |       ...players
   31 |         .filter((p) => p.alive)
   32 |         .map((p) => Math.hypot(p.x - point.x, p.y - point.y) / 65),
   33 |       previous
   34 |         ? Math.hypot(previous.x - point.x, previous.y - point.y) / 80
   35 |         : Infinity,
   36 |     );
   37 |     if (clearance > bestClearance) {
   38 |       best = point;
   39 |       bestClearance = clearance;
   40 |     }
   41 |     if (clearance >= 1) break;
   42 |   }
   43 |   return { id, ...best, born: age };
   44 | }
   45 | export function pickupDistance(
   46 |   s: Star,
   47 |   from: { x: number; y: number },
   48 |   to: { x: number; y: number },
   49 | ) {
   50 |   const dx = to.x - from.x,
   51 |     dy = to.y - from.y,
   52 |     length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
   53 |   const t = length
   54 |     ? Math.max(
   55 |         0,
   56 |         Math.min(1, ((s.x - from.x) * dx + (s.y - from.y) * dy) / length),
   57 |       )
   58 |     : 0;
   59 |   return Math.hypot(from.x + t * dx - s.x, from.y + t * dy - s.y);
   60 | }
~~~

## src/games/light-fingers/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 29c6e40fb2dc2f3f3c469c54471c032d95c34ce675d86223a654a36f8b4db238
~~~text
    1 | # Light Fingers
    2 | 
    3 | Rules owns waiting/signal/active/between/done and first-to-five. Signal becomes claimable only after the render update presents it. FirstResponse arbitrates the first tap per player; same-frame ties leave the gem available and lock both players briefly. Early/missed grabs impose a 1.25s cooldown with no score changes; a successful steal gives only its owner a point. Only an attempted failed grab triggers cooldown; an idle rival is not penalized. AI starts its calibrated delay only after the shared visible signal (minimum 120ms); no hidden activation access or premature response. Pause freezes model time.
    4 | 
    5 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
    6 | 
    7 | LightArt draws original outlined gloves, an orange forearm and a gem plinth; Blue has no visible hand. The gem travels toward the successful player. Reach animations follow taps/results without delaying signal presentation or changing arbitration. Round results tint the field by winner; keyboard instructions stay in setup.
~~~

## src/games/light-fingers/AI.ts
SHA-256: 08525946456e7fe1860f0b194ef503dbc3d3645238d9dd178f9ace0ef4e900c9

~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { LightMatch } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class LightAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   snapshot() {
    7 |     return { ...this.personality.snapshot(), reaction: this.delay };
    8 |   }
    9 |   private serial = -1;
   10 |   private delay = 1;
   11 |   private tapped = false;
   12 |   private retryAt = 0;
   13 |   constructor(
   14 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   15 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   16 |   ) {
   17 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   18 |   }
   19 |   update(m: LightMatch) {
   20 |     if (this.serial !== m.serial) {
   21 |       this.serial = m.serial;
   22 |       this.tapped = false;
   23 |       const style = this.personality;
   24 |       const pressure =
   25 |         m.scores[0] > m.scores[1] && style.role === 2 ? -0.025 : 0;
   26 |       const mean = { medium: 0.53, hard: 0.29, impossible: 0.145 }[
   27 |         this.difficulty
   28 |       ];
   29 |       this.delay = style.sample(
   30 |         mean * (0.92 + style.tempo * 0.08) + pressure,
   31 |         this.difficulty === "medium"
   32 |           ? 0.12
   33 |           : this.difficulty === "hard"
   34 |             ? 0.06
   35 |             : 0.018,
   36 |         0.12,
   37 |       );
   38 |     }
   39 |     if (
   40 |       this.tapped &&
   41 |       m.phase === "active" &&
   42 |       m.time >= this.retryAt &&
   43 |       m.canTap(1)
   44 |     )
   45 |       this.tapped = false;
   46 |     if (
   47 |       !this.tapped &&
   48 |       m.phase === "active" &&
   49 |       m.time - m.signalAt >= this.delay
   50 |     ) {
   51 |       if (m.tap(1)) {
   52 |         this.tapped = true;
   53 |         this.retryAt = m.time + 1.3;
   54 |       }
   55 |     }
   56 |   }
   57 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, mixSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    3 | import type { GameContext, MiniGame } from "../../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    4 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    5 | import { rounded, label, circle } from "../../shared/components/drawing";
    6 | import { LightMatch } from "./Rules";
    7 | import { hand, pedestal, gem } from "./LightArt";
    8 | import { turnBackground } from "../../shared/components/TurnView";
    9 | import { LightAI } from "./AI";
   10 | export class LightGame implements MiniGame {
   11 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   12 |   private m = new LightMatch();
   13 |   private ai?: LightAI;
   14 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   15 |   private text!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   16 |   private prompts: Phaser.GameObjects.Text[] = [];
   17 |   private paused = false;
   18 |   private serial = 0;
   19 |   private reported = false;
   20 |   private finishAge = 0;
   21 |   private celebration: 1 | 2 | null = null;
   22 |   private previousScores = [0, 0];
   23 |   private reach = [0, 0];
   24 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   25 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   26 |     this.g = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   27 |     this.text = label(ctx.scene, 210, 625, "", 11);
   28 |     this.prompts = [
   29 |       label(ctx.scene, 210, 137, "", 11).setRotation(
   30 |         ctx.options.mode === "local" ? Math.PI : 0,
   31 |       ),
   32 |     ];
   33 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai")
   34 |       this.ai = new LightAI(ctx.options.difficulty);
   35 |     if (this.ai)
   36 |       this.m = new LightMatch(
   37 |         new MatchRandom(mixSeed(this.ai.personality.seed, 42)).next,
   38 |       );
   39 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
   40 |       if (x > 24 && x < 396 && y > 112 && y < 650) this.tap(y < 380 ? 1 : 0);
   41 |     });
   42 |     ctx.input.press(["Space", "Enter"], (code) =>
   43 |       this.tap(code === "Space" ? 0 : 1),
   44 |     );
   45 |     ctx.setScore(0, 0);
   46 |     ctx.setHint("");
   47 |     ctx.audio.play("start");
   48 |   }
   49 |   private tap(p: 0 | 1) {
   50 |     if (!this.paused && !(p === 1 && this.ai)) {
   51 |       const accepted = this.m.tap(p);
   52 |       if (accepted) this.reach[p] = 1;
   53 |     }
   54 |   }
   55 |   update(dt: number) {
   56 |     if (this.paused) return;
   57 |     this.m.update(dt);
   58 |     this.ai?.update(this.m);
   59 |     if (this.serial !== this.m.serial) {
   60 |       this.serial = this.m.serial;
   61 |       this.celebration =
   62 |         this.m.scores[0] > this.previousScores[0]
   63 |           ? 1
   64 |           : this.m.scores[1] > this.previousScores[1]
   65 |             ? 2
   66 |             : null;
   67 |       this.previousScores = [...this.m.scores];
   68 |       if (this.celebration) this.reach[this.celebration - 1] = 1;
   69 |       this.ctx.setScore(...this.m.scores);
   70 |       this.ctx.audio.play(this.m.message.includes("SOON") ? "fail" : "capture");
   71 |     }
   72 |     const g = this.g;
   73 |     g.clear();
   74 |     const celebrating = this.m.phase === "between" || this.m.phase === "done";
   75 |     rounded(
   76 |       g,
   77 |       24,
   78 |       112,
   79 |       372,
   80 |       538,
   81 |       20,
   82 |       celebrating && this.celebration
   83 |         ? turnBackground(this.celebration)
   84 |         : 0xbca698,
   85 |       4,
   86 |     );
   87 |     const active = this.m.phase === "signal" || this.m.phase === "active";
   88 |     pedestal(g, active, this.m.time);
   89 |     this.reach = this.reach.map((age) => Math.max(0, age - dt));
   90 |     for (const p of [0] as const) {
   91 |       const travel =
   92 |         Math.sin(Math.min(1, (1 - this.reach[p]) / 0.7) * Math.PI) * 140;
   93 |       hand(
   94 |         g,
   95 |         p === 0 ? 260 - (travel / 140) * 50 : 160,
   96 |         p === 0 ? 550 : 210,
   97 |         p === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI,
   98 |         p === 0 ? theme.orange : theme.blue,
   99 |         travel,
  100 |       );
  101 |     }
  102 |     if (celebrating && this.celebration) {
  103 |       const age = 1 - this.reach[this.celebration - 1];
  104 |       const travel = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (age - 0.32) / 0.5));
  105 |       const ease = travel * travel * (3 - 2 * travel);
  106 |       gem(
  107 |         g,
  108 |         210 + (this.celebration === 1 ? 45 : -45) * ease,
  109 |         364 + (this.celebration === 1 ? 200 : -200) * ease,
  110 |         1 - 0.65 * ease,
  111 |         this.m.time,
  112 |       );
  113 |     }
  114 |     const cooldown = Math.max(0, this.m.blockedUntil[0] - this.m.time);
  115 |     this.text.setText(cooldown > 0 ? `${cooldown.toFixed(1)}s` : "");
  116 |     const blueCooldown = Math.max(0, this.m.blockedUntil[1] - this.m.time);
  117 |     this.prompts[0].setText(
  118 |       blueCooldown > 0 ? `${blueCooldown.toFixed(1)}s` : "",
  119 |     );
  120 |     if (this.m.phase === "signal") {
  121 |       this.ctx.audio.play("countdown");
  122 |       this.m.presentSignal();
  123 |     }
  124 |     if (this.m.winner) {
  125 |       this.finishAge += dt;
  126 |       if (this.finishAge > 0.75 && !this.reported) {
  127 |         this.reported = true;
  128 |         this.ctx.finish({ winner: this.m.winner, scores: this.m.scores });
  129 |       }
  130 |     }
  131 |   }
  132 |   pause() {
  133 |     this.paused = true;
  134 |   }
  135 |   resume() {
  136 |     this.paused = false;
  137 |   }
  138 |   dispose() {
  139 |     this.g.destroy();
  140 |     this.text.destroy();
  141 |     this.prompts.forEach((p) => p.destroy());
  142 |   }
  143 |   snapshot() {
  144 |     return {
  145 |       ai: this.ai?.snapshot(),
  146 |       phase: this.m.phase,
  147 |       scores: [...this.m.scores],
  148 |       time: this.m.time,
  149 |       signalAt: this.m.signalAt,
  150 |       round: this.m.serial,
  151 |       winner: this.m.winner,
  152 |       hands: [...this.reach],
  153 |       cooldowns: this.m.blockedUntil.map((t) => Math.max(0, t - this.m.time)),
  154 |       capturedBy: this.m.capturedBy,
  155 |     };
  156 |   }
  157 | }
~~~

## src/games/light-fingers/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 21f1379025698deb7e96b8285f021e55caebdbda5d8301d631ae05277bd029c7
~~~text
    1 | import { FirstResponse } from "../../shared/rules/FirstResponse";
    2 | export class LightMatch {
    3 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
    4 |   phase: "waiting" | "signal" | "active" | "between" | "done" = "waiting";
    5 |   time = 0;
    6 |   signalAt = 0;
    7 |   blockedUntil = [0, 0];
    8 |   capturedBy: 0 | 1 | null = null;
    9 |   serial = 0;
   10 |   message = "WAIT FOR THE GEM";
   11 |   winner: 1 | 2 | null = null;
   12 |   private until: number;
   13 |   private attempted = [false, false];
   14 |   private input = new FirstResponse<boolean>();
   15 |   constructor(private random = Math.random) {
   16 |     this.until = 1.5 + random() * 3;
   17 |   }
   18 |   canTap(player: 0 | 1) {
   19 |     return this.time >= this.blockedUntil[player];
   20 |   }
   21 |   tap(player: 0 | 1) {
   22 |     if (
   23 |       this.phase === "done" ||
   24 |       this.phase === "signal" ||
   25 |       !this.canTap(player)
   26 |     )
   27 |       return false;
   28 |     if (this.phase !== "active") {
   29 |       this.blockedUntil[player] = this.time + 1.25;
   30 |       return false;
   31 |     }
   32 |     this.attempted[player] = true;
   33 |     this.input.add(player, true, this.time);
   34 |     return true;
   35 |   }
   36 |   presentSignal() {
   37 |     if (this.phase === "signal") {
   38 |       this.phase = "active";
   39 |       this.signalAt = this.time;
   40 |     }
   41 |   }
   42 |   update(dt: number) {
   43 |     this.time += dt;
   44 |     if (this.phase === "done") return;
   45 |     const response = this.input.resolve(this.time);
   46 |     if (response) {
   47 |       const { first, tie } = response;
   48 |       const attempted = this.attempted;
   49 |       this.attempted = [false, false];
   50 |       if (tie) {
   51 |         this.blockedUntil = [this.time + 1.25, this.time + 1.25];
   52 |         this.message = "";
   53 |         return;
   54 |       }
   55 |       const p = first.player;
   56 |       this.capturedBy = p;
   57 |       if (attempted[1 - p]) this.blockedUntil[1 - p] = this.time + 1.25;
   58 |       this.scores[p]++;
   59 |       this.message = "";
   60 |       if (this.scores[p] === 5) {
   61 |         this.winner = p === 0 ? 1 : 2;
   62 |         this.phase = "done";
   63 |         this.serial++;
   64 |         return;
   65 |       }
   66 |       this.phase = "between";
   67 |       this.until = this.time + 1.1;
   68 |       this.serial++;
   69 |       return;
   70 |     }
   71 |     if (this.phase === "waiting" && this.time >= this.until) {
   72 |       this.phase = "signal";
   73 |       this.message = "GRAB IT!";
   74 |     } else if (this.phase === "between" && this.time >= this.until) {
   75 |       this.phase = "waiting";
   76 |       this.capturedBy = null;
   77 |       this.until = this.time + 1.5 + this.random() * 3;
   78 |       this.message = "WAIT FOR THE GEM";
   79 |       this.input.clear();
   80 |     }
   81 |   }
   82 | }
~~~

## src/games/lumberjack/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 08b5082e556faa8d45cbdcddbac635dca2e6c2e8801c1362760beb0aa4e0a3f0
~~~text
    1 | # Lumberjack
    2 | 
    3 | Rules owns identical seeded segment streams, each player's chop index, side, idle budget and three-round totals. Adjacent segments never carry branches on opposite sides, ensuring a legal choice exists. Check both current/next branches before a chop. Defaults: 20-second round cap, 85ms input cooldown, idle allowance falls from 1.5s to 0.32s; ties add rounds until cumulative scores differ. These are documented balancing choices, not reference-PDF claims. AI reads visible segments and uses the same chop API. Game draws two independent trees and flips Blue for opposite-side local play.
    4 | 
    5 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
    6 | 
    7 | LumberArt owns the original leafy trees/characters. Each half reserves a sky panel and a central round strip. Seven 28-unit segments remain visible to match AI lookahead. Chop offsets are capped at 28 units and decay exponentially; character sides change immediately so they never interpolate through the trunk. Axes swing and edge meters remain outside branch lanes. No core/rule changes for presentation.
~~~

## src/games/lumberjack/AI.ts
SHA-256: 70d549a604da2062e6028a044c6aa894a4877daea46579054ab9d7da142b3e3a
~~~text
    1 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    2 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    3 | import type { LumberMatch, Side } from "./Rules";
    4 | export class LumberAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private wait: number;
    7 |   constructor(
    8 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
    9 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   10 |   ) {
   11 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   12 |     this.wait = this.personality.sample(0.45, 0.12, 0.25);
   13 |   }
   14 |   snapshot() {
   15 |     return { ...this.personality.snapshot(), wait: this.wait };
   16 |   }
   17 |   update(dt: number, m: LumberMatch): Side | null {
   18 |     if (m.phase !== "playing" || !m.players[1].alive) {
   19 |       this.wait = 0.35;
   20 |       return null;
   21 |     }
   22 |     this.wait -= dt;
   23 |     if (this.wait > 0) return null;
   24 |     const p = this.personality,
   25 |       v = m.players[1],
   26 |       base = { medium: 0.42, hard: 0.245, impossible: 0.135 }[this.difficulty];
   27 |     this.wait = p.sample(base * (0.88 + p.tempo * 0.12), base * 0.12, 0.095);
   28 |     if (this.difficulty !== "medium")
   29 |       this.wait = Math.min(this.wait, m.limit(1) * 0.8);
   30 |     const legal = ([-1, 1] as Side[]).filter((side) => m.safe(1, side));
   31 |     let side = legal[0];
   32 |     if (legal.length === 2) {
   33 |       // Only inspect the seven visible segments. Plan which side stays safe longest.
   34 |       const room = (s: Side) => {
   35 |         for (let i = 2; i < 7; i++) if (m.pattern[v.score + i] === s) return i;
   36 |         return 7;
   37 |       };
   38 |       side =
   39 |         p.role === 0
   40 |           ? p.side
   41 |           : p.role === 1
   42 |             ? v.side
   43 |             : p.role === 3 && m.pattern[v.score + 2] !== v.side
   44 |               ? v.side
   45 |               : room(-1) === room(1)
   46 |                 ? p.side
   47 |                 : room(-1) > room(1)
   48 |                   ? -1
   49 |                   : 1;
   50 |     }
   51 |     // Casual recognition errors; Impossible never deliberately chooses a branch.
   52 |     if (p.next() < { medium: 0.1, hard: 0.012, impossible: 0 }[this.difficulty])
   53 |       side = side === 1 ? -1 : 1;
   54 |     return side ?? null;
   55 |   }
   56 | }
~~~

## src/games/lumberjack/LumberArt.ts
SHA-256: 7adb2a4b4f17931347445ed384df162caebd4603dac4ec68fb10078becf4c6c2
~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    3 | import { rounded, circle } from "../../shared/components/drawing";
    4 | import type { LumberMatch } from "./Rules";
    5 | /** Local coordinates: feet at zero, tree grows upward; blue local view rotates as a whole. */
    6 | export function forest(
    7 |   g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
    8 |   m: LumberMatch,
    9 |   p: 0 | 1,
   10 |   flip: boolean,
   11 |   scroll: number,
   12 |   swing: number,
   13 |   side: number,
   14 | ) {
   15 |   const v = m.players[p],
   16 |     color = p === 0 ? theme.orange : theme.blue;
   17 |   g.save();
   18 |   g.translateCanvas(210, p === 0 ? 625 : flip ? 137 : 359);
   19 |   if (flip) g.rotateCanvas(Math.PI);
   20 |   // Ground and restrained background foliage stay outside control/score areas.
   21 |   rounded(g, -166, -2, 332, 16, 7, 0xa6c982, 0);
   22 |   rounded(g, -24, -226, 48, 228, 7, 0xb77b50, 3);
   23 |   g.fillStyle(0xd79e6a).fillRect(-18, -222, 12, 218);
   24 |   for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
   25 |     const y = -j * 28 - scroll,
   26 |       branch = m.pattern[v.score + j];
   27 |     g.lineStyle(2, 0x895c40, 0.6).lineBetween(-18, y - 4, 18, y - 4);
   28 |     if (!branch) continue;
   29 |     const x = branch * 24,
   30 |       tip = branch * 86;
   31 |     g.lineStyle(10, theme.ink).lineBetween(x, y - 16, tip, y - 22);
   32 |     g.lineStyle(6, 0xb77b50).lineBetween(x, y - 16, tip, y - 22);
   33 |     circle(g, tip, y - 20, 10, 0x79aa62, 3);
   34 |     circle(g, tip + branch * 12, y - 18, 9, 0x91bc68, 2);
   35 |     circle(g, tip - branch * 9, y - 18, 8, 0xa9cf7c, 2);
   36 |   }
   37 |   // Compact original lumberjack, kept beside the trunk and inside its half.
   38 |   g.save();
   39 |   g.translateCanvas(side * 66, 3);
   40 |   if (side > 0) g.scaleCanvas(-1, 1);
   41 |   const alive = v.alive ? color : 0x9ba39a;
   42 |   g.lineStyle(5, theme.ink)
   43 |     .lineBetween(-9, -14, -11, 0)
   44 |     .lineBetween(8, -14, 10, 0);
   45 |   rounded(g, -16, -40, 32, 27, 7, alive, 3);
   46 |   circle(g, 0, -53, 13, 0xf2c395, 3);
   47 |   rounded(g, -16, -67, 33, 12, 4, alive, 3);
   48 |   g.fillStyle(theme.ink).fillCircle(6, -54, 2);
   49 |   // Beard and hands distinguish the character from a rectangle control.
   50 |   g.fillStyle(0x704a36).fillTriangle(-9, -48, 11, -48, 3, -37);
   51 |   g.save();
   52 |   g.translateCanvas(12, -29);
   53 |   g.rotateCanvas(-0.7 + Math.sin(swing * Math.PI) * 1.1);
   54 |   g.lineStyle(7, theme.ink).lineBetween(0, 0, 27, -23);
   55 |   g.lineStyle(4, 0xe0b77e).lineBetween(0, 0, 27, -23);
   56 |   rounded(g, 19, -34, 20, 15, 3, 0xd5e3df, 3);
   57 |   g.restore();
   58 |   circle(g, 13, -29, 5, 0xf2c395, 2);
   59 |   g.restore();
   60 |   // Small reserved edge meter, no giant labels over branches.
   61 |   const fraction = v.alive ? Math.max(0, 1 - v.idle / m.limit(p)) : 0;
   62 |   rounded(g, -160, -195, 8, 156, 4, theme.paper, 2);
   63 |   if (fraction > 0)
   64 |     rounded(
   65 |       g,
   66 |       -159,
   67 |       -40 - 154 * fraction,
   68 |       6,
   69 |       154 * fraction,
   70 |       3,
   71 |       fraction < 0.25 ? theme.orange : 0x79aa62,
   72 |       0,
   73 |     );
   74 |   g.restore();
   75 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";

    8 | export class LumberGame implements MiniGame {
    9 |   private ctx!: GameContext;

   11 |   private ai?: LumberAI;
   12 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;

   33 |         p,
   34 |         ((x < 210 ? -1 : 1) *
   35 |           (p === 1 && ctx.options.mode === "local" ? -1 : 1)) as Side,
   36 |       );
   37 |     });
   38 |     ctx.input.press(["KeyA", "KeyD", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight"], (key) =>
   39 |       this.chop(

   45 |     ctx.audio.play("start");
   46 |   }
   47 |   private chop(p: 0 | 1, side: Side, ai = false) {

   49 |     const result = this.m.chop(p, side);
   50 |     if (result !== null) {
   51 |       this.ctx.audio.play(result ? "wood" : "fail");

   55 |   }

   70 |       this.swing = [0, 0];

  100 |             : `${this.m.round} / 3`,

  108 |     }
~~~

## src/games/lumberjack/Rules.ts
SHA-256: 3684347bfa6003280566e540b6c5d26779cf0e8355c0a01d5fcd111fe3a76c62
~~~text
    1 | export type Side=-1|1;
    2 | export const ROUND_SECONDS=20;
    3 | export function branches(seed:number,count=600){let s=seed>>>0,last=0;return Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;const value=i<2||last!==0?0:s%3-1;last=value;return value;});}
    4 | export class LumberMatch {
    5 |  pattern:number[];players=[{score:0,side:-1 as Side,alive:true,idle:0,cooldown:0},{score:0,side:1 as Side,alive:true,idle:0,cooldown:0}];totals:[number,number]=[0,0];round=1;phase:'playing'|'between'|'done'='playing';time=0;between=0;winner:1|2|null=null;
    6 |  constructor(readonly seed=12345){this.pattern=branches(seed);}
    7 |  limit(p:number){return Math.max(.32,1.5-this.players[p].score*.035);}
    8 |  safe(p:number,side:Side){const index=this.players[p].score;return this.pattern[index]!==side&&this.pattern[index+1]!==side;}
    9 |  chop(p:0|1,side:Side){const v=this.players[p];if(this.phase!=='playing'||!v.alive||v.cooldown>0)return null;v.side=side;v.cooldown=.085;if(!this.safe(p,side)){v.alive=false;return false;}v.score++;v.idle=0;return true;}
   10 |  update(dt:number){if(this.phase==='done')return;if(this.phase==='between'){this.between-=dt;if(this.between<=0){this.round++;this.time=0;this.pattern=branches(this.seed+this.round*7919);this.players.forEach(p=>{p.score=0;p.alive=true;p.idle=0;p.cooldown=0;});this.phase='playing';}return;}this.time+=dt;for(const p of this.players){p.cooldown=Math.max(0,p.cooldown-dt);if(p.alive){p.idle+=dt;if(p.idle>Math.max(.32,1.5-p.score*.035))p.alive=false;}}if(this.time>=ROUND_SECONDS)this.players.forEach(p=>p.alive=false);if(this.players.every(p=>!p.alive)){this.players.forEach((p,i)=>this.totals[i]+=p.score);if(this.round>=3&&this.totals[0]!==this.totals[1]){this.winner=this.totals[0]>this.totals[1]?1:2;this.phase='done';}else{this.phase='between';this.between=1.4;}}}
   11 | }
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 65268a83acb47b42d3c0561d76036cee656e7c609dc9ba3f795d2ba1d38e009d
~~~text
    1 | # Math Quiz
    2 | 
    3 | Banked university questions: `questions/university.json` (100 verified static questions) supplemented by procedural question families in `questions/ProceduralUniversity.ts` across 8 topics (Limits, Derivatives, Integrals, Trigonometry, Algebra, Matrices, Complex numbers, Probability) providing >430+ distinct valid instances.
    4 | Basic arithmetic is procedurally generated in `questions/Basic.ts` across 7 categories (Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, Fractions, Percentages, Operator Precedence) with exact rational and integer calculations and misconception-based distractors.
    5 | Repetition and uniqueness are tracked via bounded FIFO ring buffer (150 recent question IDs) in `questions/History.ts` under localStorage (`pocket-rivals.math-history.v1`), with safe fallback to memory and graceful topic exhaustion reset policy preventing infinite loops.
    6 | Every question guarantees exactly three pairwise distinct options, exactly one correct answer, two plausible misconception-based distractors, and strictly validated KaTeX LaTeX.
    7 | MathUI is a DOM overlay positioned over the logical 420x760 canvas. It includes dedicated player-local topic indicators, balanced vertical rhythm, display-mode margin resets inside buttons, and dual-axis auto-fit scaling executed upon `document.fonts.ready` and viewport resizes. Blue section rotates 180 degrees for local two-player mode and is cleanly disposed on shutdown.
    8 | Rules coordinates scoring via FirstResponse, rewarding 1 point for the first correct answer and awarding 1 point to the opponent on errors. First to 10 points wins.
    9 | Math Quiz AI is game-local (`AI.ts`) with difficulty-calibrated latency and accuracy, never responding before question visibility.
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/AI.ts
SHA-256: e7e83f942be7171e6fab1a076fb2f60b997a077ec8c0d3328c0495f065cec931
~~~text
    1 | import type {Difficulty} from '../../shared/contracts/AIController';import type {QuizMatch} from './Rules';
    2 | /** Bank-answer selection with calibrated timing, explicitly not symbolic reasoning. */
    3 | export class QuizAI {private id='';private tapped=false;private delay=1;private answer=0;constructor(private difficulty:Difficulty,private random=Math.random){}update(m:QuizMatch){if(m.question.id!==this.id){this.id=m.question.id;this.tapped=false;const q=m.question;this.delay=Math.max(.6,q.estimatedSeconds*{medium:.8,hard:.48,impossible:.25}[this.difficulty])*(.9+this.random()*.2);const accuracy={medium:.72,hard:.93,impossible:1}[this.difficulty];this.answer=this.random()<accuracy?q.correctIndex:(q.correctIndex+1+Math.floor(this.random()*2))%3;}if(!this.tapped&&m.phase==='active'&&m.time-m.visibleAt>=this.delay){m.answer(1,this.answer);this.tapped=true;}}}
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/MathGame.ts
SHA-256: 15e04da886c51962f81fef33291d9d90b00d523da9964baa285c9a42d1189aec

~~~text
    1 | import type {GameContext,MiniGame} from '../../shared/contracts/GameModule';import {QuizMatch} from './Rules';import {QuizAI} from './AI';import {MathUI} from './MathUI';import {basicQuestion} from './questions/Basic';import {universityDeck} from './questions/Bank';import {globalQuestionHistory} from './questions/History';
    2 | export class MathGame implements MiniGame {
    3 |  private ctx!:GameContext;private m!:QuizMatch;private ai?:QuizAI;private ui!:MathUI;private paused=false;private round=0;private finished=0;private reported=false;
    4 |  initialize(ctx:GameContext){this.ctx=ctx;let serial=0,deck=universityDeck(),last='';const next=()=>{let q;if(ctx.options.variant!=='university')q=basicQuestion(serial++);else{if(!deck.length){deck=universityDeck();if(deck[0].id===last)deck.push(deck.shift()!);}q=deck.shift()!;}last=q.id;globalQuestionHistory.record(q.id);return q;};this.m=new QuizMatch(next);if(ctx.options.mode==='ai')this.ai=new QuizAI(ctx.options.difficulty);this.ui=new MathUI(!this.ai,(p,i)=>{if(!this.paused&&!(p===1&&this.ai))this.m.answer(p,i);});ctx.input.press(['Digit1','Digit2','Digit3','Digit7','Digit8','Digit9'],code=>{const n=Number(code.at(-1));if(!this.paused&&!(n>=7&&this.ai))this.m.answer(n>=7?1:0,n>=7?n-7:n-1);});ctx.setScore(0,0);ctx.setHint('SAME QUESTION. THREE ANSWERS. ONE QUICK MIND.');ctx.audio.play('start');this.ui.render(this.m,!!this.ai);this.m.present();}
    5 |  update(dt:number){if(this.paused)return;this.m.update(dt);this.ai?.update(this.m);if(this.round!==this.m.round){this.round=this.m.round;this.ctx.setScore(...this.m.scores);this.ctx.audio.play(this.m.message==='CORRECT!'?'capture':'fail');}this.ui.render(this.m,!!this.ai);this.m.present();if(this.m.winner){this.finished+=dt;if(this.finished>1.4&&!this.reported){this.reported=true;this.ctx.finish({winner:this.m.winner,scores:this.m.scores});}}}
    6 |  resize(){this.ui?.resize();}pause(){this.paused=true;this.ui.pause(true);}resume(){this.paused=false;this.ui.pause(false);this.resize();}dispose(){this.ui.dispose();}snapshot(){return {phase:this.m.phase,question:this.m.question,scores:[...this.m.scores],round:this.m.round,time:this.m.time,winner:this.m.winner};}
    7 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import katex from 'katex';

    5 | 
    6 | export const renderMath = (value: string, node: HTMLElement) =>
    7 |   katex.render(value, node, {
    8 |     throwOnError: false,
    9 |     trust: false,
   10 |     strict: 'ignore',
   11 |     displayMode: true,
   12 |   });
   13 | 
   14 | export class MathUI {
   15 |   readonly root = document.createElement('div');
   16 |   private id = '';
   17 |   private phase = '';
   18 | 
   19 |   constructor(local: boolean, answer: (p: 0 | 1, index: number) => void) {
   20 |     this.root.className = 'quiz-overlay';
   21 |     this.root.innerHTML = `<div class="quiz-panel">${this.side(1, local)}<div class="quiz-middle"><span></span><div class="quiz-explanation"></div></div>${this.side(0, local)}</div>`;
   22 |     this.root.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
   23 |       const b = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>('button');
   24 |       if (b && !b.disabled) {
   25 |         e.preventDefault();
   26 |         answer(Number(b.dataset.player) as 0 | 1, Number(b.dataset.answer));
   27 |       }
   28 |     });
   29 |     document.querySelector('#game-stage')!.append(this.root);
   30 |     this.resize();
   31 |   }
   32 | 
   33 |   private side(p: number, local: boolean) {
   34 |     return `<section class="quiz-side ${p === 1 ? 'blue' : 'orange'} ${local ? 'local' : ''}" aria-label="${p === 1 ? 'Blue' : 'Orange'} answers">
   35 |       <div class="quiz-topic"></div>
   36 |       <div class="quiz-formula"></div>
   37 |       <div class="quiz-options">${[0, 1, 2].map((i) => `<button data-player="${p}" data-answer="${i}" aria-label="${p === 1 ? 'Blue' : 'Orange'} answer ${i + 1}"></button>`).join('')}</div>
   38 |     </section>`;
   39 |   }
   40 | 
   41 |   render(m: QuizMatch, ai: boolean) {
   42 |     const changed = this.id !== m.question.id;
   43 |     if (changed) {
   44 |       this.id = m.question.id;
   45 |       this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.quiz-topic').forEach((t) => {
   46 |         t.textContent = m.question.topic;
   47 |       });
   48 |       this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.quiz-formula').forEach((n) => {
   49 |         renderMath(m.question.questionLatex, n);
   50 |       });
   51 |       this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button').forEach((b) => {
   52 |         renderMath(m.question.optionsLatex[Number(b.dataset.answer)], b);
   53 |       });
   54 |       this.fit();
   55 |       void document.fonts?.ready?.then(() => this.fit());
   56 |     }
   57 | 
   58 |     if (this.phase !== m.phase || changed) {
   59 |       this.phase = m.phase;
   60 |       const statusText = m.phase === 'between' || m.phase === 'done' ? m.message : `${m.question.topic} · FIRST TO 10`;
   61 |       this.root.querySelector('.quiz-middle span')!.textContent = statusText;
   62 |       const explain = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.quiz-explanation')!;
   63 |       if (m.phase === 'between' || m.phase === 'done') {
   64 |         renderMath(m.question.explanationLatex, explain);
   65 |       } else {
   66 |         explain.replaceChildren();
   67 |       }
   68 |       this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button').forEach((b) => {
   69 |         b.disabled = (m.phase !== 'active' && m.phase !== 'show') || (ai && b.dataset.player === '1');
   70 |         b.classList.toggle('correct', (m.phase === 'between' || m.phase === 'done') && Number(b.dataset.answer) === m.question.correctIndex);
   71 |       });
   72 |       this.fit();
   73 |     }
   74 |   }
   75 | 
   76 |   private fit() {
   77 |     // Fit formulas
   78 |     for (const n of this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.quiz-formula')) {
   79 |       n.style.fontSize = '18px';
   80 |       const math = n.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.katex');
   81 |       if (!math) continue;
   82 |       const maxW = 338;
   83 |       const maxH = 68;
   84 |       const scaleW = math.offsetWidth > maxW ? maxW / math.offsetWidth : 1;
   85 |       const scaleH = math.offsetHeight > maxH ? maxH / math.offsetHeight : 1;
   86 |       const scale = Math.min(scaleW, scaleH);
   87 |       if (scale < 1) {
   88 |         n.style.fontSize = `${Math.max(11, Math.floor(18 * scale))}px`;
   89 |       }
   90 |     }
   91 | 
   92 |     // Fit buttons
   93 |     for (const b of this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('.quiz-options button')) {
   94 |       b.style.fontSize = '18px';
   95 |       const math = b.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.katex');
   96 |       if (!math) continue;
   97 |       const maxW = b.offsetWidth > 0 ? b.offsetWidth - 12 : 98;
   98 |       const maxH = 44;
   99 |       const scaleW = math.offsetWidth > maxW ? maxW / math.offsetWidth : 1;
  100 |       const scaleH = math.offsetHeight > maxH ? maxH / math.offsetHeight : 1;
  101 |       const scale = Math.min(scaleW, scaleH);
  102 |       if (scale < 1) {
  103 |         b.style.fontSize = `${Math.max(11, Math.floor(18 * scale))}px`;
  104 |       }
  105 |     }
  106 | 
  107 |     // Fit explanation
  108 |     const explain = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.quiz-explanation');
  109 |     if (explain) {
  110 |       explain.style.fontSize = '12px';
  111 |       const math = explain.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.katex');
  112 |       if (math && math.offsetWidth > 338) {
  113 |         explain.style.fontSize = `${Math.max(10, Math.floor(12 * 338 / math.offsetWidth))}px`;
  114 |       }
  115 |     }
  116 |   }
  117 | 
  118 |   resize() {
  119 |     const stage = document.querySelector('#game-stage');
  120 |     const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
  121 |     if (!stage || !canvas) return;
  122 |     const stageRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  123 |     const canvasRect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  124 |     this.root.style.left = `${canvasRect.x - stageRect.x}px`;
  125 |     this.root.style.top = `${canvasRect.y - stageRect.y}px`;
  126 |     this.root.style.transform = `scale(${canvasRect.width / 420})`;
  127 |     this.fit();
  128 |   }
  129 | 
  130 |   pause(p: boolean) {
  131 |     this.root.hidden = p;
  132 |   }
  133 | 
  134 |   dispose() {
  135 |     this.root.remove();
  136 |   }
  137 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import {FirstResponse} from '../../shared/rules/FirstResponse';import type {MathQuestion} from './questions/Question';
    2 | export class QuizMatch {scores:[number,number]=[0,0];question!:MathQuestion;phase:'show'|'active'|'between'|'done'='show';time=0;visibleAt=0;round=0;winner:1|2|null=null;message='CHOOSE ONE';private until=0;private queue=new FirstResponse<boolean>();
    3 |  constructor(private next:()=>MathQuestion){this.question=next();}
    4 |  present(){if(this.phase==='show'){this.phase='active';this.visibleAt=this.time;}}
    5 |  answer(p:0|1,index:number){if(this.phase==='active'&&Number.isInteger(index)&&index>=0&&index<3)this.queue.add(p,index===this.question.correctIndex,this.time);}
    6 |  update(dt:number){this.time+=dt;if(this.phase==='done')return;const result=this.queue.resolve(this.time);if(result){if(result.tie)this.message='SAME INSTANT · NEXT QUESTION';else{const p=result.first.value?result.first.player:(1-result.first.player) as 0|1;this.scores[p]++;this.message=result.first.value?'CORRECT!':'RIVAL GETS THE POINT';if(this.scores[p]===10){this.winner=p===0?1:2;this.phase='done';this.round++;return;}}this.phase='between';this.round++;this.until=this.time+1.4;return;}if(this.phase==='between'&&this.time>=this.until){this.question=this.next();this.phase='show';this.message='CHOOSE ONE';}}
    7 | }
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/questions/Bank.ts
SHA-256: fb73ae6aadc788e0979d80d6a3e6065ee6ad036462337a7eb4b72fb26561d62c
~~~text
    1 | import type { MathQuestion } from './Question';
    2 | import { shuffleAnswers, shuffled } from './Question';
    3 | import { getAllProceduralQuestions } from './ProceduralUniversity';
    4 | import { globalQuestionHistory } from './History';
    5 | import data from './university.json';
    6 | 
    7 | export const university = data as MathQuestion[];
    8 | 
    9 | // Combine verified static bank with all procedural questions
   10 | const rawCombined: MathQuestion[] = [...university, ...getAllProceduralQuestions()];
   11 | 
   12 | // Deduplicate by canonical ID
   13 | const uniqueMap = new Map<string, MathQuestion>();
   14 | for (const q of rawCombined) {
   15 |   uniqueMap.set(q.id, q);
   16 | }
   17 | 
   18 | export const allUniversityQuestions: MathQuestion[] = Array.from(uniqueMap.values());
   19 | 
   20 | /**
   21 |  * Creates an interleaved topic deck of university challenge questions.
   22 |  * Prioritizes questions not recently seen in persistent history.
   23 |  * Never freezes or loops: falls back to full pool when all variations are exhausted.
   24 |  */
   25 | export function universityDeck(random = Math.random): MathQuestion[] {
   26 |   const topics = shuffled([...new Set(allUniversityQuestions.map(q => q.topic))], random);
   27 | 
   28 |   // Group questions by topic, separating unplayed from recently played
   29 |   const groups: MathQuestion[][] = topics.map(t => {
   30 |     const topicPool = allUniversityQuestions.filter(q => q.topic === t);
   31 |     const unplayed = topicPool.filter(q => !globalQuestionHistory.has(q.id));
   32 |     // Fallback: if all questions in this topic were recently played, use the full topic pool
   33 |     const candidates = unplayed.length > 0 ? unplayed : topicPool;
   34 |     return shuffled(candidates, random);
   35 |   });
   36 | 
   37 |   const deck: MathQuestion[] = [];
   38 |   while (groups.some(g => g.length > 0)) {
   39 |     for (const g of groups) {
   40 |       const q = g.pop();
   41 |       if (q) {
   42 |         deck.push(shuffleAnswers(q, random));
   43 |       }
   44 |     }
   45 |   }
   46 | 
   47 |   return deck;
   48 | }
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/questions/Basic.ts

~~~text
    1 | import { shuffleAnswers, fracLatex, simplifyFrac, type MathQuestion } from './Question';
    2 | 
    3 | export function basicQuestion(serial: number, random = Math.random): MathQuestion {
    4 |   // Category selection across all 7 required basic math categories:
    5 |   // 0: Addition, 1: Subtraction, 2: Multiplication, 3: Division,
    6 |   // 4: Fractions, 5: Percentages, 6: Operator Precedence
    7 |   const cat = Math.floor(random() * 7);
    8 | 
    9 |   if (cat === 0) {
   10 |     // Addition: 2-digit sums
   11 |     const a = 11 + Math.floor(random() * 78);
   12 |     const b = 11 + Math.floor(random() * 78);
   13 |     const correct = a + b;
   14 |     // Misconceptions: off-by-one, digit carry mistake (off by 10)
   15 |     const d1 = correct + (random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
   16 |     const d2 = correct + (random() < 0.5 ? 10 : -10);
   17 |     const options: [string, string, string] = [
   18 |       String(correct),
   19 |       String(d1),
   20 |       String(d2 === correct || d2 === d1 ? correct + 2 : d2),
   21 |     ];
   22 |     const q: MathQuestion = {
   23 |       id: `basic-add-${a}-${b}`,
   24 |       topic: 'Arithmetic',
   25 |       difficulty: 'easy',
   26 |       questionLatex: `${a} + ${b} = ?`,
   27 |       optionsLatex: options,
   28 |       correctIndex: 0,
   29 |       explanationLatex: `${a} + ${b} = ${correct}`,
   30 |       estimatedSeconds: 6,
   31 |     };
   32 |     return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
   33 |   }
   34 | 
   35 |   if (cat === 1) {
   36 |     // Subtraction
   37 |     const a = 25 + Math.floor(random() * 74);
   38 |     const b = 12 + Math.floor(random() * (a - 5));
   39 |     const correct = a - b;
   40 |     const d1 = correct + (random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
   41 |     const d2 = correct + (random() < 0.5 ? 10 : -10);
   42 |     const options: [string, string, string] = [
   43 |       String(correct),
   44 |       String(d1),
   45 |       String(d2 === correct || d2 === d1 ? (correct > 2 ? correct - 2 : correct + 3) : d2),
   46 |     ];
   47 |     const q: MathQuestion = {
   48 |       id: `basic-sub-${a}-${b}`,
   49 |       topic: 'Arithmetic',
   50 |       difficulty: 'easy',
   51 |       questionLatex: `${a} - ${b} = ?`,
   52 |       optionsLatex: options,
   53 |       correctIndex: 0,
   54 |       explanationLatex: `${a} - ${b} = ${correct}`,
   55 |       estimatedSeconds: 7,
   56 |     };
   57 |     return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
   58 |   }
   59 | 
   60 |   if (cat === 2) {
   61 |     // Multiplication
   62 |     const a = 4 + Math.floor(random() * 12);
   63 |     const b = 4 + Math.floor(random() * 12);
   64 |     const correct = a * b;
   65 |     // Misconceptions: addition instead of multiplication, off-by-a, off-by-one
   66 |     const d1 = correct + a;
   67 |     const d2 = correct - b;
   68 |     const options: [string, string, string] = [
   69 |       String(correct),
   70 |       String(d1),
   71 |       String(d2 > 0 && d2 !== correct && d2 !== d1 ? d2 : correct + 1),
   72 |     ];
   73 |     const q: MathQuestion = {
   74 |       id: `basic-mul-${a}-${b}`,
   75 |       topic: 'Arithmetic',
   76 |       difficulty: 'easy',
   77 |       questionLatex: String.raw`${a} \times ${b} = ?`,
   78 |       optionsLatex: options,
   79 |       correctIndex: 0,
   80 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`${a} \times ${b} = ${correct}`,
   81 |       estimatedSeconds: 7,
   82 |     };
   83 |     return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
   84 |   }
   85 | 
   86 |   if (cat === 3) {
   87 |     // Division: exact integer
   88 |     const b = 3 + Math.floor(random() * 9);
   89 |     const correct = 4 + Math.floor(random() * 12);
   90 |     const dividend = b * correct;
   91 |     const d1 = correct + 1;
   92 |     const d2 = correct - 1 > 0 ? correct - 1 : correct + 2;
   93 |     const options: [string, string, string] = [
   94 |       String(correct),
   95 |       String(d1),
   96 |       String(d2),
   97 |     ];
   98 |     const q: MathQuestion = {
   99 |       id: `basic-div-${dividend}-${b}`,
  100 |       topic: 'Arithmetic',
  101 |       difficulty: 'easy',
  102 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\frac{${dividend}}{${b}} = ?`,
  103 |       optionsLatex: options,
  104 |       correctIndex: 0,
  105 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`\frac{${dividend}}{${b}} = ${correct}`,
  106 |       estimatedSeconds: 8,
  107 |     };
  108 |     return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
  109 |   }
  110 | 
  111 |   if (cat === 4) {
  112 |     // Fractions: Addition with common denominator
  113 |     const den = 3 + Math.floor(random() * 7); // 3..9
  114 |     const a = 1 + Math.floor(random() * (den - 2));
  115 |     const b = 1 + Math.floor(random() * (den - a));
  116 |     const correctNum = a + b;
  117 |     const correctStr = fracLatex(correctNum, den);
  118 |     // Misconceptions: added denominators (a+b)/(2*den), or forgot to add numerators
  119 |     const d1 = fracLatex(correctNum, den * 2);
  120 |     const d2 = fracLatex(correctNum + 1, den);
  121 |     const optSet = new Set([correctStr]);
  122 |     const validD1 = !optSet.has(d1) ? d1 : fracLatex(Math.max(1, correctNum - 1), den);
  123 |     optSet.add(validD1);
  124 |     const validD2 = !optSet.has(d2) ? d2 : fracLatex(correctNum + 2, den);
  125 |     const options: [string, string, string] = [correctStr, validD1, validD2];
  126 | 
  127 |     const q: MathQuestion = {
  128 |       id: `basic-frac-${a}-${b}-${den}`,
  129 |       topic: 'Fractions',
  130 |       difficulty: 'easy',
  131 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\frac{${a}}{${den}} + \frac{${b}}{${den}} = ?`,
  132 |       optionsLatex: options,
  133 |       correctIndex: 0,
  134 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`\frac{${a}+${b}}{${den}} = ${correctStr}`,
  135 |       estimatedSeconds: 10,
  136 |     };
  137 |     return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
  138 |   }
  139 | 
  140 |   if (cat === 5) {
  141 |     // Percentages: 10%, 20%, 25%, 50%, 75%
  142 |     const pOptions = [10, 20, 25, 50, 75];
  143 |     const pct = pOptions[Math.floor(random() * pOptions.length)];
  144 |     // Pick base that gives clean integer
  145 |     const mult = pct === 10 ? 10 : pct === 20 ? 5 : pct === 50 ? 2 : 4;
  146 |     const k = 2 + Math.floor(random() * 8);
  147 |     const base = k * mult;
  148 |     const correct = (pct * base) / 100;
  149 |     // Misconceptions: off-by-base/10, forgot percentage multiplier
  150 |     const d1 = correct + mult;
  151 |     const d2 = correct > mult ? correct - mult : correct + mult * 2;
  152 |     const options: [string, string, string] = [
  153 |       String(correct),
  154 |       String(d1),
  155 |       String(d2 === correct || d2 === d1 ? correct + 5 : d2),
  156 |     ];
  157 |     const q: MathQuestion = {
  158 |       id: `basic-pct-${pct}-${base}`,
  159 |       topic: 'Percentages',
  160 |       difficulty: 'easy',
  161 |       questionLatex: `${pct}\\% \\text{ of } ${base} = ?`,
  162 |       optionsLatex: options,
  163 |       correctIndex: 0,
  164 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`\frac{${pct}}{100} \times ${base} = ${correct}`,
  165 |       estimatedSeconds: 9,
  166 |     };
  167 |     return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
  168 |   }
  169 | 
  170 |   // cat === 6: Operator Precedence: a + b * c
  171 |   const a = 2 + Math.floor(random() * 8);
  172 |   const b = 2 + Math.floor(random() * 6);
  173 |   const c = 2 + Math.floor(random() * 6);
  174 |   const correct = a + b * c;
  175 |   // Misconception: (a + b) * c (evaluated left to right without precedence!)
  176 |   const dPrecedence = (a + b) * c;
  177 |   const dOff = correct + 1;
  178 |   const options: [string, string, string] = [
  179 |     String(correct),
  180 |     String(dPrecedence !== correct ? dPrecedence : correct + b),
  181 |     String(dOff !== correct && dOff !== dPrecedence ? dOff : correct - 1),
  182 |   ];
  183 |   const q: MathQuestion = {
  184 |     id: `basic-prec-${a}-${b}-${c}`,
  185 |     topic: 'Precedence',
  186 |     difficulty: 'easy',
  187 |     questionLatex: String.raw`${a} + ${b} \times ${c} = ?`,
  188 |     optionsLatex: options,
  189 |     correctIndex: 0,
  190 |     explanationLatex: String.raw`${a} + (${b}\times${c}) = ${a}+${b * c} = ${correct}`,
  191 |     estimatedSeconds: 8,
  192 |   };
  193 |   return shuffleAnswers(q, random);
  194 | }
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/questions/History.ts
SHA-256: d7a4713b73254cbf4a91546f6822ece80c8512a6787ae5c688716446dfde7e6f
~~~text
    1 | const STORAGE_KEY = 'pocket-rivals.math-history.v1';
    2 | const MAX_HISTORY = 150;
    3 | 
    4 | export class QuestionHistory {
    5 |   private memory = new Set<string>();
    6 | 
    7 |   constructor() {
    8 |     this.load();
    9 |   }
   10 | 
   11 |   private get storage(): Storage | null {
   12 |     try {
   13 |       if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) return window.localStorage;
   14 |     } catch {
   15 |       // ignore
   16 |     }
   17 |     return null;
   18 |   }
   19 | 
   20 |   private load(): void {
   21 |     try {
   22 |       const store = this.storage;
   23 |       if (!store) return;
   24 |       const raw = store.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
   25 |       if (!raw) return;
   26 |       const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
   27 |       if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
   28 |         this.memory = new Set(arr.slice(-MAX_HISTORY));
   29 |       }
   30 |     } catch {
   31 |       // Ignore storage access errors in restricted environments
   32 |     }
   33 |   }
   34 | 
   35 |   private save(): void {
   36 |     try {
   37 |       const store = this.storage;
   38 |       if (!store) return;
   39 |       const arr = Array.from(this.memory).slice(-MAX_HISTORY);
   40 |       store.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr));
   41 |     } catch {
   42 |       // Storage quota or privacy restriction
   43 |     }
   44 |   }
   45 | 
   46 |   has(id: string): boolean {
   47 |     return this.memory.has(id);
   48 |   }
   49 | 
   50 |   record(id: string): void {
   51 |     if (this.memory.size >= MAX_HISTORY) {
   52 |       // Remove oldest entries to maintain ring buffer bound
   53 |       const first = this.memory.values().next().value;
   54 |       if (first !== undefined) this.memory.delete(first);
   55 |     }
   56 |     this.memory.add(id);
   57 |     this.save();
   58 |   }
   59 | 
   60 |   clear(): void {
   61 |     this.memory.clear();
   62 |     try {
   63 |       if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
   64 |         localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
   65 |       }
   66 |     } catch {
   67 |       // ignore
   68 |     }
   69 |   }
   70 | 
   71 |   size(): number {
   72 |     return this.memory.size;
   73 |   }
   74 | }
   75 | 
   76 | export const globalQuestionHistory = new QuestionHistory();
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { fracLatex, simplifyFrac, shuffleAnswers, type MathQuestion } from './Question';
    2 | 
    3 | function buildUniqueOptions(correct: string, distractors: string[], fallbackOffset = 1): [string, string, string] {
    4 |   const chosen: string[] = [correct];
    5 |   for (const d of distractors) {
    6 |     if (!chosen.includes(d)) {
    7 |       chosen.push(d);
    8 |       if (chosen.length === 3) break;
    9 |     }
   10 |   }
   11 |   let step = fallbackOffset;
   12 |   while (chosen.length < 3) {
   13 |     const num = Number(correct);
   14 |     const candidate = !isNaN(num) ? String(num + step) : `${correct}+${step}`;
   15 |     if (!chosen.includes(candidate)) {
   16 |       chosen.push(candidate);
   17 |     }
   18 |     step += step > 0 ? -2 * step : -2 * step + 1;
   19 |   }
   20 |   return [chosen[0], chosen[1], chosen[2]];
   21 | }
   22 | 
   23 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
   24 | // 1. LIMITS TEMPLATES
   25 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
   26 | function generateLimitsTemplates(): MathQuestion[] {
   27 |   const list: MathQuestion[] = [];
   28 | 
   29 |   // L1: lim_{x->0} sin(ax)/(bx) = a/b
   30 |   for (let a = 2; a <= 7; a++) {
   31 |     for (let b = 2; b <= 7; b++) {
   32 |       if (a === b) continue;
   33 |       const [an, bn] = simplifyFrac(a, b);
   34 |       const correct = fracLatex(an, bn);
   35 |       const d1 = fracLatex(bn, an);
   36 |       const d2 = '1';
   37 |       const d3 = '0';
   38 |       const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, d3]);
   39 |       list.push({
   40 |         id: `limits-sin-${a}-${b}`,
   41 |         topic: 'Limits',
   42 |         difficulty: 'medium',
   43 |         questionLatex: String.raw`\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin(${a}x)}{${b}x}`,
   44 |         optionsLatex: options,
   45 |         correctIndex: 0,
   46 |         explanationLatex: String.raw`\sin(kx)\sim kx \implies \frac{${a}x}{${b}x} = ${correct}`,
   47 |         estimatedSeconds: 12,
   48 |       });
   49 |     }
   50 |   }
   51 | 
   52 |   // L2: lim_{x->0} (1 - cos(ax))/x^2 = a^2 / 2
   53 |   for (let a = 2; a <= 6; a++) {
   54 |     const a2 = a * a;
   55 |     const correct = fracLatex(a2, 2);
   56 |     const d1 = String(a2);
   57 |     const d2 = fracLatex(a, 2);
   58 |     const d3 = String(a);
   59 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, d3]);
   60 |     list.push({
   61 |       id: `limits-cos-${a}`,
   62 |       topic: 'Limits',
   63 |       difficulty: 'hard',
   64 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\lim_{x\to0}\frac{1-\cos(${a}x)}{x^2}`,
   65 |       optionsLatex: options,
   66 |       correctIndex: 0,
   67 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`1-\cos u \sim \frac{u^2}{2} \implies \frac{${a2}x^2}{2x^2} = ${correct}`,
   68 |       estimatedSeconds: 16,
   69 |     });
   70 |   }
   71 | 
   72 |   // L3: lim_{x->0} tan(ax)/sin(bx) = a/b
   73 |   for (let a = 2; a <= 5; a++) {
   74 |     for (let b = 2; b <= 5; b++) {
   75 |       if (a === b) continue;
   76 |       const [an, bn] = simplifyFrac(a, b);
   77 |       const correct = fracLatex(an, bn);
   78 |       const d1 = fracLatex(bn, an);
   79 |       const d2 = '1';
   80 |       const d3 = '0';
   81 |       const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, d3]);
   82 |       list.push({
   83 |         id: `limits-tan-sin-${a}-${b}`,
   84 |         topic: 'Limits',
   85 |         difficulty: 'medium',
   86 |         questionLatex: String.raw`\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\tan(${a}x)}{\sin(${b}x)}`,
   87 |         optionsLatex: options,
   88 |         correctIndex: 0,
   89 |         explanationLatex: String.raw`\frac{\tan(${a}x)}{\sin(${b}x)} \sim \frac{${a}x}{${b}x} = ${correct}`,
   90 |         estimatedSeconds: 12,
   91 |       });
   92 |     }

  568 |   const cases = [
  569 |     { a: 3, b: 1, c: 4, d: 2, exp: 2 },
  570 |     { a: 5, b: 2, c: 2, d: 1, exp: 1 },
  571 |     { a: 4, b: 3, c: 1, d: 2, exp: 5 },
  572 |     { a: 6, b: 2, c: 3, d: 2, exp: 6 },
  573 |   ];
  574 |   for (const item of cases) {
  575 |     const correct = String(item.exp);
  576 |     const d1 = String(item.a * item.d + item.b * item.c);
  577 |     const d2 = String(item.exp + 2);
  578 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, String(item.exp - 2)]);
  579 |     list.push({
  580 |       id: `mat-det2x2-${item.a}-${item.b}-${item.c}-${item.d}`,
  581 |       topic: 'Matrices',
  582 |       difficulty: 'medium',
  583 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\det\begin{pmatrix}${item.a}&${item.b}\\${item.c}&${item.d}\end{pmatrix}`,
  584 |       optionsLatex: options,
  585 |       correctIndex: 0,
  586 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`${item.a}\cdot${item.d} - ${item.b}\cdot${item.c} = ${correct}`,
  587 |       estimatedSeconds: 12,
  588 |     });
  589 |   }
  590 | 
  591 |   return list;
  592 | }
  593 | 
  594 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
  595 | // 7. COMPLEX NUMBERS
  596 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
  597 | function generateComplexTemplates(): MathQuestion[] {
  598 |   const list: MathQuestion[] = [];
  599 | 
  600 |   // C1: i^{4k + r}
  601 |   const rCases = [
  602 |     { r: 0, ans: '1', d1: '-1', d2: 'i' },
  603 |     { r: 1, ans: 'i', d1: '-i', d2: '1' },
  604 |     { r: 2, ans: '-1', d1: '1', d2: '-i' },
  605 |     { r: 3, ans: '-i', d1: 'i', d2: '-1' },
  606 |   ];
  607 |   for (let k = 2; k <= 5; k++) {
  608 |     for (const rc of rCases) {
  609 |       const pow = 4 * k + rc.r;
  610 |       list.push({
  611 |         id: `cpx-pow-${pow}`,
  612 |         topic: 'Complex numbers',
  613 |         difficulty: 'easy',
  614 |         questionLatex: String.raw`i^2=-1.\quad i^{${pow}}=?`,
  615 |         optionsLatex: [rc.ans, rc.d1, rc.d2],
  616 |         correctIndex: 0,
  617 |         explanationLatex: String.raw`i^{4\cdot${k}+${rc.r}} = (i^4)^{${k}}\cdot i^{${rc.r}} = ${rc.ans}`,
  618 |         estimatedSeconds: 8,
  619 |       });
  620 |     }
  621 |   }
  622 | 
  623 |   // C2: |a + ai|^2 = 2 a^2
  624 |   for (let a = 2; a <= 6; a++) {
  625 |     const correct = String(2 * a * a);
  626 |     const d1 = String(a * a);
  627 |     const d2 = String(4 * a * a);
  628 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, String(2 * a)]);
  629 |     list.push({
  630 |       id: `cpx-mod-sq-${a}`,
  631 |       topic: 'Complex numbers',
  632 |       difficulty: 'medium',
  633 |       questionLatex: String.raw`i^2=-1.\quad |${a}+${a}i|^2=?`,
  634 |       optionsLatex: options,
  635 |       correctIndex: 0,
  636 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`${a}^2 + ${a}^2 = ${correct}`,
  637 |       estimatedSeconds: 10,
  638 |     });
  639 |   }
  640 | 
  641 |   // C3: (1+i)^2 = 2i
  642 |   list.push({
  643 |     id: 'cpx-one-plus-i-sq',
  644 |     topic: 'Complex numbers',
  645 |     difficulty: 'easy',
  646 |     questionLatex: String.raw`i^2=-1.\quad (1+i)^2=?`,
  647 |     optionsLatex: ['2i', '2', '0'],
  648 |     correctIndex: 0,
  649 |     explanationLatex: String.raw`1 + 2i + i^2 = 1 + 2i - 1 = 2i`,
  650 |     estimatedSeconds: 8,
  651 |   });
  652 | 
  653 |   // C4: e^{i pi} = -1
  654 |   list.push({
  655 |     id: 'cpx-euler-pi',
  656 |     topic: 'Complex numbers',
  657 |     difficulty: 'easy',
  658 |     questionLatex: String.raw`e^{i\pi}=?`,
  659 |     optionsLatex: ['-1', '1', 'i'],
  660 |     correctIndex: 0,
  661 |     explanationLatex: String.raw`\cos\pi + i\sin\pi = -1 + 0 = -1`,
  662 |     estimatedSeconds: 7,
  663 |   });
  664 | 
  665 |   return list;
  666 | }
  667 | 
  668 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
  669 | // 8. PROBABILITY & COMBINATIONS
  670 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
  671 | function generateProbabilityTemplates(): MathQuestion[] {
  672 |   const list: MathQuestion[] = [];
  673 | 
  674 |   // P1: binom(n, 2) = n(n-1)/2
  675 |   for (let n = 4; n <= 10; n++) {
  676 |     const correct = String((n * (n - 1)) / 2);
  677 |     const d1 = String(2 * n);
  678 |     const d2 = String(n * (n - 1));
  679 |     const d3 = String(n * n);
  680 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, d3]);
  681 |     list.push({
  682 |       id: `prob-choose-2-${n}`,
  683 |       topic: 'Probability',
  684 |       difficulty: 'easy',
  685 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\binom{${n}}{2}`,
  686 |       optionsLatex: options,
  687 |       correctIndex: 0,
  688 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`\frac{${n}\cdot${n - 1}}{2} = ${correct}`,
  689 |       estimatedSeconds: 10,
  690 |     });
  691 |   }
  692 | 
  693 |   // P2: P(n, 2) = n(n-1)
  694 |   for (let n = 4; n <= 8; n++) {
  695 |     const correct = String(n * (n - 1));
  696 |     const d1 = String((n * (n - 1)) / 2);
  697 |     const d2 = 2 * n === (n * (n - 1)) / 2 ? String(n * n) : String(2 * n);
  698 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, String(n * n)]);
  699 |     list.push({
  700 |       id: `prob-perm-2-${n}`,
  701 |       topic: 'Probability',
  702 |       difficulty: 'medium',
  703 |       questionLatex: String.raw`P(${n}, 2) = \frac{${n}!}{( ${n}-2 )!}`,
  704 |       optionsLatex: options,
  705 |       correctIndex: 0,
  706 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`${n}\cdot${n - 1} = ${correct}`,
  707 |       estimatedSeconds: 10,
  708 |     });
  709 |   }
  710 | 
  711 |   // P3: P(exactly 1 head in n flips) = n / 2^n
  712 |   for (let n = 3; n <= 6; n++) {
  713 |     const den = Math.pow(2, n);
  714 |     const correct = fracLatex(n, den);
  715 |     const d1 = fracLatex(1, den);
  716 |     const d2 = fracLatex(n - 1, den);
  717 |     const d3 = fracLatex(1, 2);
  718 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, d3]);
  719 |     list.push({
  720 |       id: `prob-coin-1head-${n}`,
  721 |       topic: 'Probability',
  722 |       difficulty: 'medium',
  723 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\text{${n} fair coins.\ } P(\text{exactly 1 head})=?`,
  724 |       optionsLatex: options,
  725 |       correctIndex: 0,
  726 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`\binom{${n}}{1}\left(\frac12\right)^{${n}} = ${correct}`,
  727 |       estimatedSeconds: 14,
  728 |     });
  729 |   }
  730 | 
  731 |   // P4: P(at least 1 head in n flips) = (2^n - 1) / 2^n
  732 |   for (let n = 3; n <= 5; n++) {
  733 |     const den = Math.pow(2, n);
  734 |     const correct = fracLatex(den - 1, den);
  735 |     const d1 = fracLatex(1, den);
  736 |     const d2 = fracLatex(n, den);
  737 |     const options = buildUniqueOptions(correct, [d1, d2, fracLatex(1, 2)]);
  738 |     list.push({
  739 |       id: `prob-at-least-1head-${n}`,
  740 |       topic: 'Probability',
  741 |       difficulty: 'medium',
  742 |       questionLatex: String.raw`\text{${n} fair coins.\ } P(\ge 1 \text{ head})=?`,
  743 |       optionsLatex: options,
  744 |       correctIndex: 0,
  745 |       explanationLatex: String.raw`1 - P(\text{all tails}) = 1 - \frac{1}{${den}} = ${correct}`,
  746 |       estimatedSeconds: 12,
  747 |     });
  748 |   }
  749 | 
  750 |   // P5: Two standard dice sum
  751 |   list.push({
  752 |     id: 'prob-dice-sum-7',
  753 |     topic: 'Probability',
  754 |     difficulty: 'easy',
  755 |     questionLatex: String.raw`\text{Two fair dice.\ } P(\text{sum} = 7)=?`,
  756 |     optionsLatex: [String.raw`\frac16`, String.raw`\frac17`, String.raw`\frac1{12}`],
  757 |     correctIndex: 0,
  758 |     explanationLatex: String.raw`6 \text{ pairs out of } 36 \implies \frac{6}{36} = \frac16`,
  759 |     estimatedSeconds: 10,
  760 |   });
  761 | 
  762 |   list.push({
  763 |     id: 'prob-dice-sum-2',
  764 |     topic: 'Probability',
  765 |     difficulty: 'easy',
  766 |     questionLatex: String.raw`\text{Two fair dice.\ } P(\text{sum} = 2)=?`,
  767 |     optionsLatex: [String.raw`\frac{1}{36}`, String.raw`\frac{1}{18}`, String.raw`\frac{1}{12}`],
  768 |     correctIndex: 0,
  769 |     explanationLatex: String.raw`\text{Only }(1,1) \implies \frac{1}{36}`,
  770 |     estimatedSeconds: 8,
  771 |   });
  772 | 
  773 |   return list;
  774 | }
  775 | 
  776 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
  777 | // COMPILED PROCEDURAL REGISTRY
  778 | // -------------------------------------------------------------
  779 | export function getAllProceduralQuestions(): MathQuestion[] {
  780 |   return [
  781 |     ...generateLimitsTemplates(),
  782 |     ...generateDerivativesTemplates(),
  783 |     ...generateIntegralsTemplates(),
  784 |     ...generateTrigTemplates(),
  785 |     ...generateAlgebraTemplates(),
  786 |     ...generateMatrixTemplates(),
  787 |     ...generateComplexTemplates(),
  788 |     ...generateProbabilityTemplates(),
  789 |   ];
  790 | }
~~~

## src/games/math-quiz/questions/Question.ts
SHA-256: f3d0a2281cb96c7739ab0082769caef47931269f3c047aab52aa58d98833abeb
~~~text
    1 | export interface MathQuestion {
    2 |   id: string;
    3 |   topic: string;
    4 |   difficulty: 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard';
    5 |   questionLatex: string;
    6 |   optionsLatex: [string, string, string];
    7 |   correctIndex: 0 | 1 | 2;
    8 |   explanationLatex: string;
    9 |   estimatedSeconds: number;
   10 | }
   11 | 
   12 | export function gcd(a: number, b: number): number {
   13 |   let x = Math.abs(a), y = Math.abs(b);
   14 |   while (y) {
   15 |     const t = y;
   16 |     y = x % y;
   17 |     x = t;
   18 |   }
   19 |   return x || 1;
   20 | }
   21 | 
   22 | export function simplifyFrac(num: number, den: number): [number, number] {
   23 |   if (den === 0) return [num, 1];
   24 |   const sign = (num < 0 ? -1 : 1) * (den < 0 ? -1 : 1);
   25 |   const d = gcd(num, den);
   26 |   return [(Math.abs(num) / d) * sign, Math.abs(den) / d];
   27 | }
   28 | 
   29 | export function fracLatex(num: number, den: number): string {
   30 |   const [n, d] = simplifyFrac(num, den);
   31 |   if (d === 1) return String(n);
   32 |   if (n < 0) return String.raw`-\frac{${Math.abs(n)}}{${d}}`;
   33 |   return String.raw`\frac{${n}}{${d}}`;
   34 | }
   35 | 
   36 | export function shuffled<T>(items: readonly T[], random = Math.random): T[] {
   37 |   const a = [...items];
   38 |   for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   39 |     const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
   40 |     [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
   41 |   }
   42 |   return a;
   43 | }
   44 | 
   45 | export function shuffleAnswers(q: MathQuestion, random = Math.random): MathQuestion {
   46 |   const order = shuffled([0, 1, 2], random);
   47 |   return {
   48 |     ...q,
   49 |     optionsLatex: order.map(i => q.optionsLatex[i]) as MathQuestion['optionsLatex'],
   50 |     correctIndex: order.indexOf(q.correctIndex) as 0 | 1 | 2,
   51 |   };
   52 | }
~~~
