## src/games/mini-golf/GolfAI.ts
SHA-256: 545a562bbe55094916c692f99c89d0ed2eb3479120f92650d6481228b809b126
~~~text
    1 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    2 | import type { Course } from "./courses";
    3 | import { FRICTION, MAX_POWER, simulate, type GolfBall } from "./GolfPhysics";
    4 | interface Point {
    5 |   x: number;
    6 |   y: number;
    7 | }
    8 | export interface GolfShot {
    9 |   angle: number;
   10 |   power: number;
   11 |   milliseconds: number;
   12 |   candidates: number;
   13 | }
   14 | function clear(a: Point, b: Point, c: Course) {
   15 |   const steps = Math.ceil(Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) / 5);
   16 |   for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
   17 |     const x = a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * i) / (steps || 1),
   18 |       y = a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * i) / (steps || 1);
   19 |     if (
   20 |       c.obstacles.some(
   21 |         (o) =>
   22 |           x > o.x - 9 && x < o.x + o.w + 9 && y > o.y - 9 && y < o.y + o.h + 9,
   23 |       )
   24 |     )
   25 |       return false;
   26 |   }
   27 |   return true;
   28 | }
   29 | function route(c: Course) {
   30 |   const points: Point[] = [c.hole];
   31 |   for (const o of c.obstacles)
   32 |     for (const x of [o.x - 12, o.x + o.w + 12])
   33 |       for (const y of [o.y - 12, o.y + o.h + 12])
   34 |         if (x > 8 && x < 332 && y > 8 && y < 392) points.push({ x, y });
   35 |   const distances = points.map((_, i) => (i ? Infinity : 0)),
   36 |     visited = new Set<number>();
   37 |   for (let k = 0; k < points.length; k++) {
   38 |     let at = -1;
   39 |     for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++)
   40 |       if (!visited.has(i) && (at === -1 || distances[i] < distances[at]))
   41 |         at = i;
   42 |     if (at < 0) break;
   43 |     visited.add(at);
   44 |     points.forEach((p, i) => {
   45 |       if (clear(points[at], p, c))
   46 |         distances[i] = Math.min(
   47 |           distances[i],
   48 |           distances[at] + Math.hypot(p.x - points[at].x, p.y - points[at].y),
   49 |         );
   50 |     });
   51 |   }
   52 |   return {
   53 |     points,
   54 |     cost: (p: Point) =>
   55 |       Math.min(
   56 |         ...points.map((q, i) =>
   57 |           clear(p, q, c)
   58 |             ? Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y) + distances[i]
   59 |             : Infinity,
   60 |         ),
   61 |       ),
   62 |   };
   63 | }
   64 | export function planGolfShot(
   65 |   c: Course,
   66 |   ball: GolfBall,
   67 |   difficulty: Difficulty,
   68 |   random = Math.random,
   69 | ): GolfShot {
   70 |   const start = performance.now(),
   71 |     cfg = {
   72 |       medium: { ms: 45, angles: 16, powers: 5, error: 0.1 },
   73 |       hard: { ms: 140, angles: 36, powers: 8, error: 0.025 },
   74 |       impossible: { ms: 300, angles: 64, powers: 10, error: 0 },
   75 |     }[difficulty],
   76 |     routing = route(c),
   77 |     candidates: { angle: number; power: number }[] = [];
   78 |   for (const p of routing.points) {
   79 |     const angle = Math.atan2(p.y - ball.y, p.x - ball.x),
   80 |       power = Math.sqrt(2 * FRICTION * Math.hypot(p.x - ball.x, p.y - ball.y));
   81 |     for (const factor of [0.96, 1, 1.04, 1.18])
   82 |       candidates.push({ angle, power: Math.min(MAX_POWER, power * factor) });
   83 |   }
   84 |   for (let i = 0; i < cfg.angles; i++)
   85 |     for (let j = 1; j <= cfg.powers; j++)
   86 |       candidates.push({
   87 |         angle: (i * Math.PI * 2) / cfg.angles,
   88 |         power: 70 + (j * (MAX_POWER - 70)) / cfg.powers,
   89 |       });
   90 |   let best = candidates[0],
   91 |     value = Infinity,
   92 |     n = 0;
   93 |   const finalists: { shot: typeof best; ball: GolfBall; cost: number }[] = [];
   94 |   for (const shot of candidates) {
   95 |     if (n > 8 && performance.now() - start > cfg.ms * 0.75) break;
   96 |     n++;
   97 |     const next = simulate(c, ball, shot.angle, shot.power),
   98 |       cost = next.holed
   99 |         ? -100000 + shot.power * 0.001
  100 |         : routing.cost(next) + shot.power * 0.002;
  101 |     if (cost < value) {
  102 |       value = cost;
  103 |       best = shot;
  104 |     }
  105 |     if (difficulty === "impossible" && !next.holed && Number.isFinite(cost))
  106 |       finalists.push({ shot, ball: next, cost });
  107 |     if (next.holed) break;
  108 |   }
  109 |   // Evaluate a direct second putt from promising landing positions, within the same budget.
  110 |   if (difficulty === "impossible" && value > 0)
  111 |     for (const f of finalists.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost).slice(0, 6)) {
  112 |       if (performance.now() - start > cfg.ms) break;
  113 |       const angle = Math.atan2(c.hole.y - f.ball.y, c.hole.x - f.ball.x),
  114 |         power = Math.sqrt(
  115 |           2 * FRICTION * Math.hypot(c.hole.x - f.ball.x, c.hole.y - f.ball.y),
  116 |         ),
  117 |         end = simulate(c, f.ball, angle, power);
  118 |       if (end.holed && f.cost < value + 60) {
  119 |         best = f.shot;
  120 |         break;
  121 |       }
  122 |     }
  123 |   return {
  124 |     angle: best.angle + (random() - 0.5) * cfg.error,
  125 |     power: Math.max(
  126 |       20,
  127 |       Math.min(MAX_POWER, best.power * (1 + (random() - 0.5) * cfg.error)),
  128 |     ),
  129 |     milliseconds: performance.now() - start,
  130 |     candidates: n,
  131 |   };
  132 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type { Player, Winner } from "../../shared/contracts/GameResult";

    4 | export class GolfMatch {
    5 |   hole = 0;
    6 |   turn: Player = 1;
    7 |   balls: [GolfBall, GolfBall];
    8 |   strokes: [number, number] = [0, 0];
    9 |   totals: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   10 |   history: [number, number][] = [];
   11 |   winner: Winner | null = null;
   12 |   shotActive = false;
   13 |   constructor(readonly count = 5) {
   14 |     this.balls = [newBall(this.course), newBall(this.course)];
   15 |   }
   16 |   get course() {
   17 |     return courses[this.hole];
   18 |   }
   19 |   get ball() {
   20 |     return this.balls[this.turn - 1];
   21 |   }
   22 |   takeShot(angle: number, power: number) {
   23 |     if (this.winner || this.shotActive || !shoot(this.ball, angle, power))
   24 |       return false;
   25 |     this.strokes[this.turn - 1]++;
   26 |     this.shotActive = true;
   27 |     return true;
   28 |   }
   29 |   finishShot() {
   30 |     if (!this.shotActive) return;
   31 |     this.shotActive = false;
   32 |     const i = this.turn - 1;
   33 |     if (!this.ball.holed && this.strokes[i] >= 12) {
   34 |       this.strokes[i] = 13;
   35 |       this.ball.holed = true;
   36 |     }
   37 |     if (this.balls.every((b) => b.holed)) {
   38 |       this.history.push([...this.strokes]);
   39 |       this.totals[0] += this.strokes[0];
   40 |       this.totals[1] += this.strokes[1];
   41 |       if (this.hole + 1 >= this.count) {
   42 |         this.winner =
   43 |           this.totals[0] === this.totals[1]
   44 |             ? "draw"
   45 |             : this.totals[0] < this.totals[1]
   46 |               ? 1
   47 |               : 2;
   48 |         return;
   49 |       }
   50 |       this.hole++;
   51 |       this.balls = [newBall(this.course), newBall(this.course)];
   52 |       this.strokes = [0, 0];
   53 |       this.turn = this.hole % 2 ? 2 : 1;
   54 |     } else {
   55 |       const next = this.turn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   56 |       if (!this.balls[next - 1].holed) this.turn = next;
   57 |     }
   58 |   }
   59 |   save() {
   60 |     return {
   61 |       version: 1,
   62 |       count: this.count,
   63 |       hole: this.hole,

   66 |       strokes: this.strokes,
   67 |       totals: this.totals,
   68 |       history: this.history,
   69 |     };
   70 |   }
   71 |   static restore(data: unknown, count: number) {

   77 |       d.count !== count ||

   79 |       d.hole < 0 ||
   80 |       d.hole >= count ||

   91 |           Array.isArray(a) &&
   92 |           a.length === 2 &&

   94 |       )
   95 |     )
   96 |       return fresh;

  101 |           Number.isFinite(b.x + b.y) &&

  103 |           b.x <= 333 &&
  104 |           b.y >= 7 &&

  108 |           b.vy === 0,
  109 |       )
  110 |     )

  117 |           a.every((n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 13),

  123 |       d.balls.every((b) => b.holed) ||
  124 |       d.balls[d.turn - 1].holed ||
  125 |       d.strokes.some((n) => n > 13)

  128 |     const course = courses[d.hole];
  129 |     if (
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/GolfPhysics.ts
SHA-256: e421c252a515e095ffcd6c22bf0e7ae7fafc129af7eba21b84a779e880711cc9
~~~text
    1 | import { COURSE_WIDTH as W, COURSE_HEIGHT as H, type Course } from "./courses";
    2 | export interface GolfBall {
    3 |   x: number;
    4 |   y: number;
    5 |   vx: number;
    6 |   vy: number;
    7 |   holed: boolean;
    8 | }
    9 | export const BALL_RADIUS = 7,
   10 |   FRICTION = 65,
   11 |   MAX_POWER = 600;
   12 | export function newBall(course: Course): GolfBall {
   13 |   return { ...course.start, vx: 0, vy: 0, holed: false };
   14 | }
   15 | export function moving(ball: GolfBall) {
   16 |   return Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) > 0;
   17 | }
   18 | export function shoot(ball: GolfBall, angle: number, power: number) {
   19 |   if (
   20 |     ball.holed ||
   21 |     moving(ball) ||
   22 |     !Number.isFinite(angle + power) ||
   23 |     power < 20
   24 |   )
   25 |     return false;
   26 |   const v = Math.min(MAX_POWER, power);
   27 |   ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * v;
   28 |   ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * v;
   29 |   return true;
   30 | }
   31 | export function golfStep(
   32 |   b: GolfBall,
   33 |   c: Course,
   34 |   dt: number,
   35 |   impact: () => void = () => {},
   36 | ) {
   37 |   if (b.holed || !moving(b)) return;
   38 |   // Limit the travelled distance to half a ball radius, even in trajectory simulations.
   39 |   const count = Math.max(
   40 |       1,
   41 |       Math.ceil((Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy) * dt) / (BALL_RADIUS * 0.5)),
   42 |     ),
   43 |     sub = dt / count;
   44 |   for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
   45 |     b.x += b.vx * sub;
   46 |     b.y += b.vy * sub;
   47 |     const bounce = (nx: number, ny: number) => {
   48 |       const dot = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny;
   49 |       if (dot < 0) {
   50 |         b.vx -= 1.82 * dot * nx;
   51 |         b.vy -= 1.82 * dot * ny;
   52 |         impact();
   53 |       }
   54 |     };
   55 |     for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 2; iteration++) {
   56 |       if (b.x < BALL_RADIUS) {
   57 |         b.x = BALL_RADIUS;
   58 |         bounce(1, 0);
   59 |       }
   60 |       if (b.x > W - BALL_RADIUS) {
   61 |         b.x = W - BALL_RADIUS;
   62 |         bounce(-1, 0);
   63 |       }
   64 |       if (b.y < BALL_RADIUS) {
   65 |         b.y = BALL_RADIUS;
   66 |         bounce(0, 1);
   67 |       }
   68 |       if (b.y > H - BALL_RADIUS) {
   69 |         b.y = H - BALL_RADIUS;
   70 |         bounce(0, -1);
   71 |       }
   72 |       for (const o of c.obstacles) {
   73 |         const px = Math.max(o.x, Math.min(o.x + o.w, b.x)),
   74 |           py = Math.max(o.y, Math.min(o.y + o.h, b.y)),
   75 |           dx = b.x - px,
   76 |           dy = b.y - py,
   77 |           d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   78 |         if (d >= BALL_RADIUS) continue;
   79 |         if (d > 0.00001) {
   80 |           const nx = dx / d,
   81 |             ny = dy / d;
   82 |           b.x = px + nx * (BALL_RADIUS + 0.01);
   83 |           b.y = py + ny * (BALL_RADIUS + 0.01);
   84 |           bounce(nx, ny);
   85 |         } else {
   86 |           const sides = [
   87 |             {
   88 |               d: b.x - o.x,
   89 |               x: o.x - BALL_RADIUS - 0.01,
   90 |               y: b.y,
   91 |               nx: -1,
   92 |               ny: 0,
   93 |             },
   94 |             {
   95 |               d: o.x + o.w - b.x,
   96 |               x: o.x + o.w + BALL_RADIUS + 0.01,
   97 |               y: b.y,
   98 |               nx: 1,
   99 |               ny: 0,
  100 |             },
  101 |             {
  102 |               d: b.y - o.y,
  103 |               x: b.x,
  104 |               y: o.y - BALL_RADIUS - 0.01,
  105 |               nx: 0,
  106 |               ny: -1,
  107 |             },
  108 |             {
  109 |               d: o.y + o.h - b.y,
  110 |               x: b.x,
  111 |               y: o.y + o.h + BALL_RADIUS + 0.01,
  112 |               nx: 0,
  113 |               ny: 1,
  114 |             },
  115 |           ].sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
  116 |           const p = sides[0];
  117 |           b.x = p.x;
  118 |           b.y = p.y;
  119 |           bounce(p.nx, p.ny);
  120 |         }
  121 |       }
  122 |     }
  123 |     let speed = Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy);
  124 |     if (Math.hypot(b.x - c.hole.x, b.y - c.hole.y) < 11 && speed < 150) {
  125 |       b.x = c.hole.x;
  126 |       b.y = c.hole.y;
  127 |       b.vx = b.vy = 0;
  128 |       b.holed = true;
  129 |       return;
  130 |     }
  131 |     const next = Math.max(0, speed - FRICTION * sub);
  132 |     if (next < 8) {
  133 |       b.vx = b.vy = 0;
  134 |     } else {
  135 |       b.vx *= next / speed;
  136 |       b.vy *= next / speed;
  137 |     }
  138 |   }
  139 | }
  140 | export function simulate(
  141 |   course: Course,
  142 |   ball: GolfBall,
  143 |   angle: number,
  144 |   power: number,
  145 | ) {
  146 |   const b = { ...ball, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
  147 |   shoot(b, angle, power);
  148 |   for (let i = 0; i < 1500 && moving(b); i++) golfStep(b, course, 1 / 120);
  149 |   return b;
  150 | }
~~~

~~~text
   18 |   private note!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   19 |   private clock = new FixedStep();
   20 |   private aim: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
   21 |   private paused = false;
   22 |   private age = 0;
   23 |   private pending = false;
   24 |   private generation = 0;
   25 |   private disposed = false;
   26 |   private reported = false;
   27 |   private ai?: WorkerTask<
   28 |     {
   29 |       course: Course;
   30 |       ball: GolfBall;
   31 |       difficulty: GameContext["options"]["difficulty"];
   32 |     },
   33 |     GolfShot
   34 |   >;
   35 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   36 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   37 |     const count =
   38 |       ctx.options.variant === "one"
   39 |         ? 1
   40 |         : ctx.options.variant === "three"
   41 |           ? 3
   42 |           : 5;
   43 |     this.match = GolfMatch.restore(ctx.restoredState, count);
   44 |     this.g = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   45 |     this.heading = label(ctx.scene, 210, 144, "", 21);
   46 |     this.caption = label(ctx.scene, 210, 173, "", 12);
   47 |     this.note = label(ctx.scene, 210, 627, "", 12);
   48 |     ctx.setHint("DRAG BACK FROM YOUR BALL · RELEASE TO PUTT");
   49 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai")
   50 |       this.ai = new WorkerTask(
   51 |         () =>
   52 |           new Worker(new URL("./ai.worker.ts", import.meta.url), {
   53 |             type: "module",
   54 |           }),
   55 |         ctx.reportAI,
   56 |       );
   57 |     ctx.input.drag(
   58 |       (x, y) => {
   59 |         if (
   60 |           this.paused ||
   61 |           this.age < 0.4 ||
   62 |           this.match.shotActive ||
   63 |           this.match.winner ||
   64 |           (this.ai && this.match.turn === 2)
   65 |         )
   66 |           return false;
   67 |         const b = this.match.ball;
   68 |         if (Math.hypot(x - 40 - b.x, y - 200 - b.y) > 42) return false;
   69 |         this.aim = { x: x - 40, y: y - 200 };
   70 |         return true;
   71 |       },
   72 |       (x, y) => {
   73 |         this.aim = { x: x - 40, y: y - 200 };
   74 |       },
   75 |       (x, y) => {
   76 |         const b = this.match.ball,
   77 |           dx = b.x - (x - 40),
   78 |           dy = b.y - (y - 200);
   79 |         this.aim = null;
   80 |         this.takeShot(
   81 |           Math.atan2(dy, dx),
   82 |           Math.min(MAX_POWER, Math.hypot(dx, dy) * 4),
   83 |         );
   84 |       },
   85 |       () => {
   86 |         this.aim = null;
   87 |       },
   88 |     );
   89 |     this.save();
   90 |   }
   91 |   private takeShot(angle: number, power: number) {
   92 |     if (this.match.takeShot(angle, power)) {
   93 |       this.ctx.audio.play("hit");
   94 |       this.age = 0;
   95 |     }
   96 |   }
   97 |   private save() {
   98 |     this.ctx.saveState(this.match.save());
   99 |   }
  100 |   update(dt: number) {
  101 |     if (this.paused) return;
  102 |     this.age += dt;
  103 |     const m = this.match;
  104 |     this.clock.advance(dt, (step) => {
  105 |       if (m.shotActive) {
  106 |         golfStep(m.ball, m.course, step, () => this.ctx.audio.play("hit"));
  107 |         if (!moving(m.ball)) {
  108 |           if (m.ball.holed) this.ctx.audio.play("goal");
  109 |           m.finishShot();
  110 |           this.age = 0;
  111 |           if (!m.winner) this.save();
  112 |         }
  113 |       }
  114 |     });
  115 |     if (
  116 |       this.ai &&
  117 |       m.turn === 2 &&
  118 |       !m.shotActive &&
  119 |       !m.winner &&
  120 |       !this.pending &&
  121 |       this.age > 0.7
  122 |     ) {
  123 |       this.pending = true;
  124 |       const generation = this.generation;
  125 |       void this.ai
  126 |         .run({
  127 |           course: m.course,
  128 |           ball: { ...m.ball },
  129 |           difficulty: this.ctx.options.difficulty,
  130 |         })
  131 |         .then((shot) => {
  132 |           if (this.disposed || generation !== this.generation) return;
  133 |           this.pending = false;
  134 |           if (!this.paused) {
  135 |             const s = shot ?? {
  136 |               angle: Math.atan2(
  137 |                 m.course.hole.y - m.ball.y,
  138 |                 m.course.hole.x - m.ball.x,
  139 |               ),
  140 |               power: 220,
  141 |             };
  142 |             this.takeShot(s.angle, s.power);
  143 |           }
  144 |         });
  145 |     }
  146 |     const g = this.g,
  147 |       c = m.course;
  148 |     g.clear();
  149 |     rounded(g, 24, 112, 372, 538, 20, theme.green, 4);
  150 |     rounded(g, 40, 200, 340, 400, 12, 0x93c57f, 4);
  151 |     g.lineStyle(1, 0xffffff, 0.1);
  152 |     for (let y = 220; y < 600; y += 24) g.lineBetween(44, y, 376, y);
  153 |     c.obstacles.forEach((o) => {
  154 |       rounded(g, 40 + o.x, 200 + o.y + 4, o.w, o.h, 3, 0x68976a, 0);
  155 |       rounded(g, 40 + o.x, 200 + o.y, o.w, o.h, 3, 0xe8d9b9, 3);
  156 |     });
  157 |     circle(g, 40 + c.hole.x, 200 + c.hole.y, 11, theme.ink, 0);
  158 |     g.lineStyle(2, theme.ink).lineBetween(
  159 |       40 + c.hole.x,
  160 |       200 + c.hole.y,
  161 |       40 + c.hole.x,
  162 |       173 + c.hole.y,
  163 |     );
  164 |     g.fillStyle(theme.white).fillTriangle(
  165 |       40 + c.hole.x,
  166 |       173 + c.hole.y,
  167 |       57 + c.hole.x,
  168 |       179 + c.hole.y,
  169 |       40 + c.hole.x,
  170 |       185 + c.hole.y,
  171 |     );
  172 |     const b = m.ball,
  173 |       color = m.turn === 1 ? theme.orange : theme.blue;
  174 |     if (!b.holed) {
  175 |       if (!m.shotActive) {
  176 |         g.lineStyle(2, color, 0.7).strokeCircle(40 + b.x, 200 + b.y, 15);
  177 |       }
  178 |       circle(g, 40 + b.x, 202 + b.y, 8, 0x679565, 0);
  179 |       circle(g, 40 + b.x, 200 + b.y, 7, color, 2);
  180 |       g.fillStyle(theme.white, 0.8).fillCircle(38 + b.x, 198 + b.y, 2);
  181 |     }
  182 |     if (this.aim) {
  183 |       const dx = b.x - this.aim.x,
  184 |         dy = b.y - this.aim.y,
  185 |         d = Math.hypot(dx, dy),
  186 |         power = Math.min(1, (d * 4) / MAX_POWER),
  187 |         length = 20 + 80 * power;
  188 |       if (d > 0) {
  189 |         g.lineStyle(3, theme.white, 0.9).lineBetween(
  190 |           40 + b.x,
  191 |           200 + b.y,
  192 |           40 + b.x + (dx / d) * length,
  193 |           200 + b.y + (dy / d) * length,
  194 |         );
  195 |         for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
  196 |           g.fillStyle(
  197 |             i <= power * 5 ? theme.orange : theme.white,
  198 |             0.9,
  199 |           ).fillRoundedRect(159 + i * 16, 614, 12, 8, 3);
  200 |       }
  201 |     }
  202 |     this.heading
  203 |       .setText(`HOLE ${m.hole + 1} / ${m.count} · PAR ${c.par}`)
  204 |       .setDepth(1);
  205 |     this.caption.setText(c.name.toUpperCase()).setDepth(1);
  206 |     this.note
  207 |       .setText(
  208 |         this.aim
  209 |           ? ""
  210 |           : m.shotActive
  211 |             ? "NICE AND EASY…"
  212 |             : this.pending
  213 |               ? "BLUE IS PLANNING…"
  214 |               : `${m.turn === 1 ? "ORANGE" : "BLUE"} · STROKE ${m.strokes[m.turn - 1] + 1}`,
  215 |       )
  216 |       .setDepth(1);
  217 |     this.ctx.setScore(
  218 |       m.totals[0] + (m.winner ? 0 : m.strokes[0]),
  219 |       m.totals[1] + (m.winner ? 0 : m.strokes[1]),
  220 |     );
  221 |     if (m.winner && this.age > 0.7 && !this.reported) {
  222 |       this.reported = true;
  223 |       this.ctx.finish({ winner: m.winner, scores: [...m.totals] });
  224 |     }
  225 |   }
  226 |   pause() {
  227 |     this.paused = true;
  228 |     this.aim = null;
  229 |     this.clock.reset();
  230 |     this.generation++;
  231 |     this.pending = false;
  232 |     this.ai?.cancel();
  233 |   }
  234 |   resume() {
  235 |     this.paused = false;
  236 |     this.age = 0;
  237 |     this.clock.reset();
  238 |   }
  239 |   dispose() {
  240 |     this.disposed = true;
  241 |     this.generation++;
  242 |     this.ai?.cancel();
  243 |     this.g.destroy();
  244 |     this.heading.destroy();
  245 |     this.caption.destroy();
  246 |     this.note.destroy();
  247 |   }
  248 |   snapshot() {
  249 |     return {
  250 |       ...this.match.save(),
  251 |       winner: this.match.winner,
  252 |       shotActive: this.match.shotActive,
  253 |       pending: this.pending,
  254 |       aim: this.aim,
  255 |     };
  256 |   }
  257 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 89bfc4790402ca0d83f0ec1074411b6637fc1e50daf9a6270e49a75b8877c509
~~~text
    1 | # Ultimate Golf
    2 | 
    3 | - `courses/` contains the four original layouts in unscaled 1920×1080 source coordinates. Do not replace courses with invented layouts. The reference repository is read-only.
    4 | - `GolfRules` owns original difficulty, stroke limits and score formula. `GolfPhysics` owns the 240 Hz ball simulation, capture and terminal states. `GolfCollision` owns separating normals and velocity limits. `GolfDynamics` owns timed obstacles, tides, portals, UFO, bridges and doors.
    5 | - `GolfInput/GolfView` use one uniform responsive transform: clockwise in portrait, unrotated in landscape; inverse transforms must stay exact during focus/resize. Drag ownership/cancellation comes from host InputManager. One gesture may shoot once only while stopped.
    6 | - `GolfRenderer` owns one retained masked Graphics and original vector artwork. Never change collision rules to fit the display. The ball halo is visual only. `UltimateGolfGame` owns selection/help/results and lifecycle; `GolfProgress` validates per-course local records.
    7 | - Pause cancels aiming and clears the fixed accumulator. Dispose UI objects, masks and graphics. No additional RAF loops. Cancel the shot-planning worker on pause/disposal. Retain source units regardless of screen resolution.
    8 | - Tests: `tests/unit/ultimate-golf.test.ts`, `golf-routes.test.ts` (four legal tee-to-cup fixtures), `tests/browser/ultimate-golf.spec.ts`. Full routes are deterministic Easy-mode evidence, not claims that all strategies or devices were tested.
    9 | - See `docs/ULTIMATE_GOLF.md` for source provenance, mechanics and intentional differences. `modes/` isolates casual, hot-seat and real AI race progression; `ai/` owns bounded worker shot planning. Competitive storage never changes casual records. Global tournament participation remains disabled.
   10 | 
   11 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
   12 | 
   13 | Temple AI waypoints must remain outside bumpers, quicksand and the moving-boulder sweep. Record reached route points before forecasting reaction delay; a mover must not erase completed progress. Keep original course geometry and human/AI physics identical. `golf-temple-ai.test.ts` verifies full planned completions at every AI difficulty; the browser regression runs the real planning worker.
   14 | 
   15 | CourseArt generates static portrait overviews from actual course data for the picker. It must not create physics/AI instances. Keep course cards readable within the app container (two columns in portrait, not a viewport-wide four-column assumption).
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/GolfCollision.ts
SHA-256: 7d174556903bf45370afc16e041b5e519e633cc656b9b7bfd1603e22d6e87c00
~~~text
    1 | import type { Point, Rect } from "./courses";
    2 | export interface Ball extends Point {
    3 |   vx: number;
    4 |   vy: number;
    5 | }
    6 | export const RADIUS = 7,
    7 |   MAX_SPEED = 650;
    8 | export const clamp = (v: number, a: number, b: number) =>
    9 |   Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
   10 | export const inside = (p: Point, r: Rect) =>
   11 |   p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h;
   12 | export const distance = (a: Point, b: Point) =>
   13 |   Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
   14 | export function cap(b: Ball) {
   15 |   const s = Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy);
   16 |   if (s > MAX_SPEED) {
   17 |     b.vx *= MAX_SPEED / s;
   18 |     b.vy *= MAX_SPEED / s;
   19 |   }
   20 | }
   21 | export function overlaps(b: Point, r: Rect, radius = RADIUS) {
   22 |   return (
   23 |     Math.hypot(
   24 |       b.x - clamp(b.x, r.x, r.x + r.w),
   25 |       b.y - clamp(b.y, r.y, r.y + r.h),
   26 |     ) < radius
   27 |   );
   28 | }
   29 | function reflect(b: Ball, nx: number, ny: number, vx = 0, vy = 0, e = 1) {
   30 |   const rx = b.vx - vx,
   31 |     ry = b.vy - vy,
   32 |     dot = rx * nx + ry * ny;
   33 |   if (dot >= 0) return false;
   34 |   b.vx = (rx - 2 * dot * nx) * e + vx;
   35 |   b.vy = (ry - 2 * dot * ny) * e + vy;
   36 |   cap(b);
   37 |   return true;
   38 | }
   39 | export function hitRect(b: Ball, r: Rect, vx = 0, vy = 0) {
   40 |   let cx = clamp(b.x, r.x, r.x + r.w),
   41 |     cy = clamp(b.y, r.y, r.y + r.h),
   42 |     nx = b.x - cx,
   43 |     ny = b.y - cy,
   44 |     d = Math.hypot(nx, ny);
   45 |   if (d >= RADIUS) return false;
   46 |   if (d < 1e-9) {
   47 |     const sides = [b.x - r.x, r.x + r.w - b.x, b.y - r.y, r.y + r.h - b.y],
   48 |       side = sides.indexOf(Math.min(...sides));
   49 |     nx = side === 0 ? -1 : side === 1 ? 1 : 0;
   50 |     ny = side === 2 ? -1 : side === 3 ? 1 : 0;
   51 |     cx = side === 0 ? r.x : side === 1 ? r.x + r.w : b.x;
   52 |     cy = side === 2 ? r.y : side === 3 ? r.y + r.h : b.y;
   53 |   } else {
   54 |     nx /= d;
   55 |     ny /= d;
   56 |   }
   57 |   b.x = cx + nx * (RADIUS + 0.001);
   58 |   b.y = cy + ny * (RADIUS + 0.001);
   59 |   const hit = reflect(b, nx, ny, vx, vy);
   60 |   if (hit && vx && Math.abs(ny) < 1e-6) {
   61 |     b.vy += ((b.y < r.y + r.h / 2 ? -1 : 1) * Math.abs(vx)) / 2;
   62 |     cap(b);
   63 |   }
   64 |   return hit;
   65 | }
   66 | export function hitCircle(b: Ball, c: Point, r: number, e = 1, vx = 0, vy = 0) {
   67 |   const d = distance(b, c);
   68 |   if (d >= r + RADIUS) return false;
   69 |   const nx = d > 1e-8 ? (b.x - c.x) / d : 0,
   70 |     ny = d > 1e-8 ? (b.y - c.y) / d : -1;
   71 |   b.x = c.x + nx * (r + RADIUS + 0.001);
   72 |   b.y = c.y + ny * (r + RADIUS + 0.001);
   73 |   return reflect(b, nx, ny, vx, vy, e);
   74 | }
   75 | export function hitRotated(
   76 |   b: Ball,
   77 |   c: Point,
   78 |   w: number,
   79 |   h: number,
   80 |   angle: number,
   81 |   spin = 0,
   82 | ) {
   83 |   const co = Math.cos(angle),
   84 |     si = Math.sin(angle),
   85 |     dx = b.x - c.x,
   86 |     dy = b.y - c.y;
   87 |   const local: Ball = {
   88 |     x: dx * co + dy * si,
   89 |     y: -dx * si + dy * co,
   90 |     vx: 0,
   91 |     vy: 0,
   92 |   };
   93 |   const before = { x: local.x, y: local.y };
   94 |   hitRect(local, { x: -w / 2, y: -h / 2, w, h });
   95 |   if (local.x === before.x && local.y === before.y) return false;
   96 |   const nx = local.x - before.x,
   97 |     ny = local.y - before.y,
   98 |     d = Math.hypot(nx, ny),
   99 |     wx = (nx * co - ny * si) / d,
  100 |     wy = (nx * si + ny * co) / d;
  101 |   b.x = c.x + local.x * co - local.y * si;
  102 |   b.y = c.y + local.x * si + local.y * co;
  103 |   const ax = b.x - c.x - wx * RADIUS,
  104 |     ay = b.y - c.y - wy * RADIUS;
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type { Point, Rect } from "./courses";

   19 |   get portrait() {
   20 |     return this.bounds.h >= this.bounds.w;
   21 |   }

   23 |     return this.portrait
   24 |       ? Math.min(this.bounds.w / 1010, this.bounds.h / 1920)
   25 |       : Math.min(this.bounds.w / 1920, this.bounds.h / 1010);
   26 |   }

   47 |       : {
   48 |           x: o.x + (p.x - this.center.x) * s,
   49 |           y: o.y + (p.y - this.center.y) * s,
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/GolfProgress.ts
SHA-256: db2755b6aa8d332d3fbed43c135485bf6f588a3ddf299c46129d7c1288a13a94
~~~text
    1 | const KEY = "pocket-rivals.ultimate-golf.v1";
    2 | export class GolfProgress {
    3 |   best = [0, 0, 0, 0];
    4 |   constructor() {
    5 |     try {
    6 |       const data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? "null");
    7 |       if (
    8 |         data?.version === 1 &&
    9 |         Array.isArray(data.best) &&
   10 |         data.best.length === 4
   11 |       )
   12 |         this.best = data.best.map((n: unknown) =>
   13 |           typeof n === "number" &&
   14 |           Number.isSafeInteger(n) &&
   15 |           n >= 0 &&
   16 |           n <= 2500
   17 |             ? n
   18 |             : 0,
   19 |         );
   20 |     } catch {
   21 |       /* Optional storage: play remains available. */
   22 |     }
   23 |   }
   24 |   record(course: number, score: number) {
   25 |     this.best[course] = Math.max(this.best[course], score);
   26 |     try {
   27 |       localStorage.setItem(
   28 |         KEY,
   29 |         JSON.stringify({ version: 1, best: this.best }),
   30 |       );
   31 |     } catch {
   32 |       /* Keep the session record. */
   33 |     }
   34 |   }
   35 |   get total() {
   36 |     return this.best.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
   37 |   }
   38 | }
~~~

~~~text
  227 |     g.lineStyle(4, theme.ink).lineBetween(
  228 |       c.hole.x,
  229 |       c.hole.y,
  230 |       c.hole.x + 42,
  231 |       c.hole.y,
  232 |     );
  233 |     g.fillStyle(theme.orange).fillTriangle(
  234 |       c.hole.x + 42,
  235 |       c.hole.y,
  236 |       c.hole.x + 42,
  237 |       c.hole.y - 30,
  238 |       c.hole.x + 20,
  239 |       c.hole.y,
  240 |     );
  241 |     if (aim && world.shootable) {
  242 |       const b = world.ball,
  243 |         speed = Math.hypot(aim.x, aim.y),
  244 |         preview = difficulties[world.difficulty].preview;
  245 |       g.lineStyle(3, theme.ink, 0.6).lineBetween(
  246 |         b.x,
  247 |         b.y,
  248 |         b.x - aim.x / 3.125,
  249 |         b.y - aim.y / 3.125,
  250 |       );
  251 |       if (c.id === "horizon" && preview && speed) {
  252 |         if (this.lastAim !== aim) {
  253 |           this.previewPoints = world.preview(aim);
  254 |           this.lastAim = aim;
  255 |         }
  256 |         this.previewPoints.forEach((p, i) =>
  257 |           g
  258 |             .fillStyle(theme.white, 1 - i / (this.previewPoints.length + 4))
  259 |             .fillCircle(p.x, p.y, 4),
  260 |         );
  261 |       } else if (preview && speed) {
  262 |         const len = speed * preview - 55 * preview * preview;
  263 |         for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++)
  264 |           g.fillStyle(theme.white, 1 - i / 15).fillCircle(
  265 |             b.x + ((aim.x / speed) * len * i) / 12,
  266 |             b.y + ((aim.y / speed) * len * i) / 12,
  267 |             4,
  268 |           );
  269 |       }
  270 |     }
  271 |     if (rival) {

  273 |       circle(rival, 7, theme.blue, 2);
  274 |     }
  275 |     // The halo enlarges visibility, not the physical collision radius.
  276 |     g.lineStyle(3, playerColor, 0.8).strokeCircle(
  277 |       world.ball.x,
  278 |       world.ball.y,
  279 |       18,
  280 |     );
  281 |     circle(world.ball, 7, theme.white, 2);
  282 |   }

  285 |     this.mask.destroy();
  286 |     this.maskShape.destroy();
  287 |     this.g.destroy();
  288 |     this.frame.destroy();
  289 |   }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/GolfRules.ts
SHA-256: 75ba49bfbb493a144b737fa214b832e4245e1838e92713f03dcc79844d2d91cf
~~~text
    1 | import type { Course } from "./courses";
    2 | export type GolfDifficulty = 0 | 1 | 2;
    3 | export const difficulties = [
    4 |   { name: "Easy", factor: 1.5, speed: 0.7, preview: 0.6, rate: 10, bonus: 100 },
    5 |   { name: "Normal", factor: 1.1, speed: 1, preview: 0.3, rate: 25, bonus: 250 },
    6 |   { name: "Hard", factor: 0.75, speed: 1.3, preview: 0, rate: 50, bonus: 500 },
    7 | ] as const;
    8 | export const strokeLimit = (course: Course, d: GolfDifficulty) =>
    9 |   Math.round(course.baseLimit * difficulties[d].factor);
   10 | export const scoreFor = (course: Course, strokes: number, d: GolfDifficulty) =>
   11 |   Math.max(0, strokeLimit(course, d) - strokes) * difficulties[d].rate +
   12 |   difficulties[d].bonus;
~~~

~~~text
  417 |         const totalAI = r.totals[1];
  418 |         this.ui.rival(
  419 |           `AI finished · ${totalAI.strokes} strokes (${timeText(totalAI.time)})`,
  420 |         );
  421 |       } else {
  422 |         this.ui.rival(
  423 |           `AI · ${r.worlds[1].strokes} strokes${this.plan.length > 1 ? ` · ${r.holes[1] + 1}/${this.plan.length}` : ""}`,
  424 |         );
  425 |       }
  426 |     }
  427 |     if (this.mode === "casual") {
  428 |       if (w.status !== "playing") this.casualResult();
  429 |     } else this.afterCompetition();
  430 |   }
  431 |   resize() {
  432 |     if (!this.ui) return;
  433 |     this.cancel();
  434 |     this.view.configure(this.ui.bounds());
  435 |     if (this.world) this.view.follow(this.world.ball, 1);
  436 |   }
  437 |   pause() {
  438 |     this.paused = true;
  439 |     this.cancel();
  440 |     this.race?.pause();
  441 |     this.world?.resetAccumulator();
  442 |     this.ui.pause(true);
  443 |   }
  444 |   resume() {
  445 |     this.paused = false;
  446 |     this.world?.resetAccumulator();
  447 |     this.ui.pause(false);
  448 |     this.resize();
  449 |   }
  450 |   dispose() {
  451 |     this.release();
  452 |     this.ui.dispose();
  453 |   }
  454 |   snapshot() {
  455 |     return {
  456 |       phase: this.phase,
  457 |       mode: this.mode,
  458 |       view: {
  459 |         zoom: this.view.zoom,
  460 |         targetZoom: this.view.targetZoom,
  461 |         scale: this.view.scale,
  462 |         center: { ...this.view.center },
  463 |         bounds: this.view.bounds,
  464 |       },
  465 |       aiming: !!this.anchor,
  466 |       progress: [...this.casual.progress.best],
  467 |       competition: this.local
  468 |         ? {
  469 |             player: this.local.player,
  470 |             phase: this.local.phase,
  471 |             elapsed: this.local.elapsed,
  472 |             attempts: this.local.attempts,
  473 |           }
  474 |         : this.race
  475 |           ? {
  476 |               phase: this.race.phase,
  477 |               elapsed: this.race.elapsed,
  478 |               opponent: this.race.worlds[1].snapshot(),
  479 |               ai: this.race.ai.snapshot(),
  480 |             }
  481 |           : null,
  482 |       ...this.world?.snapshot(),
  483 |     };
  484 |   }
  485 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/ai/GolfAI.ts
SHA-256: abde5fc06b0b7979c83ddca80b809834b50cc1461117c40e4c9d1dd6f081b8b2
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, replayMode } from "../../../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import { WorkerTask } from "../../../../shared/utilities/WorkerTask";
    3 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    4 | import type { GolfPhysics } from "../GolfPhysics";
    5 | import type { PlanInput, ShotPlan } from "./ShotPlanner";
    6 | export class GolfAI {
    7 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    8 |   private task: WorkerTask<PlanInput, ShotPlan>;
    9 |   private busy = false;
   10 |   private generation = 0;
   11 |   private plan: ShotPlan | null = null;
   12 |   private deadline = 0;
   13 |   private time = 0;
   14 |   private waypoint = 0;
   15 |   private origin = { x: 0, y: 0 };
   16 |   accelerated = false;
   17 |   constructor(
   18 |     readonly difficulty: Difficulty,
   19 |     report: (ms: number) => void,
   20 |     seed?: number,
   21 |   ) {
   22 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   23 |     this.task = new WorkerTask(
   24 |       () =>
   25 |         new Worker(new URL("./planner.worker.ts", import.meta.url), {
   26 |           type: "module",
   27 |         }),
   28 |       report,
   29 |     );
   30 |   }
   31 |   update(dt: number, world: GolfPhysics) {
   32 |     this.time += dt;
   33 |     if (!world.shootable) {
   34 |       this.plan = null;
   35 |       return;
   36 |     }
   37 |     if (this.plan && this.time >= this.deadline) {
   38 |       const p = this.plan;
   39 |       this.plan = null;
   40 |       if (
   41 |         Math.hypot(world.ball.x - p.origin.x, world.ball.y - p.origin.y) < 12
   42 |       ) {
   43 |         this.waypoint = p.waypoint;
   44 |         world.shoot(p.vx, p.vy);
   45 |       }
   46 |       return;
   47 |     }
   48 |     if (this.busy || this.plan || this.time < this.deadline) return;
   49 |     const baseDelay =
   50 |       { medium: 2.2, hard: 1.6, impossible: 1.2 }[this.difficulty] *
   51 |       (0.9 + this.personality.tempo * 0.1);
   52 |     const delay = this.accelerated
   53 |       ? 0.25
   54 |       : this.personality.sample(baseDelay, 0.15, 0.9);
   55 |     const token = this.generation;
   56 |     this.busy = true;
   57 |     this.origin = { ...world.ball };
   58 |     this.deadline = this.time + delay;
   59 |     void this.task
   60 |       .run({
   61 |         state: world.exportState(),
   62 |         difficulty: this.difficulty,
   63 |         waypoint: this.waypoint,
   64 |         delay,
   65 |         seed: this.personality.seed,
   66 |         replay: replayMode(),
   67 |       })
   68 |       .then((plan) => {
   69 |         if (token !== this.generation) return;
   70 |         this.busy = false;
   71 |         if (plan) {
   72 |           this.plan = plan;
   73 |           this.deadline += plan.wait;
   74 |         } else this.deadline = this.time + 0.5;
   75 |       });
   76 |   }
   77 |   cancel() {
   78 |     this.generation++;
   79 |     this.task.cancel();
   80 |     this.busy = false;
   81 |     this.plan = null;
   82 |     this.deadline = this.time + 0.2;
   83 |   }
   84 |   reset() {
   85 |     this.cancel();
   86 |     this.waypoint = 0;
   87 |   }
   88 |   dispose() {
   89 |     this.cancel();
   90 |   }
   91 |   snapshot() {
   92 |     return {
   93 |       ...this.personality.snapshot(),
   94 |       thinking: this.busy,
   95 |       waypoint: this.waypoint,
   96 |       pending: !!this.plan,
   97 |     };
   98 |   }
   99 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/ai/ShotPlanner.ts
SHA-256: 82649711213fa7fc2b059140e52e0deaa955d011cf29e36aa0bd2da531860ba3
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import { GolfPhysics } from "../GolfPhysics";
    3 | import { courses } from "../courses";
    4 | import { getRoute, routes } from "./routes";
    5 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    6 | export interface PlanInput {
    7 |   state: ReturnType<GolfPhysics["exportState"]>;
    8 |   difficulty: Difficulty;
    9 |   waypoint: number;
   10 |   delay: number;
   11 |   seed?: number;
   12 |   replay?: boolean;
   13 | }
   14 | export interface ShotPlan {
   15 |   vx: number;
   16 |   vy: number;
   17 |   wait: number;
   18 |   waypoint: number;
   19 |   origin: { x: number; y: number };
   20 |   milliseconds: number;
   21 |   candidates: number;
   22 | }
   23 | /** Bounded, deterministic candidate ordering. Simulations use the actual 240 Hz engine. */
   24 | export function planShot(input: PlanInput): ShotPlan {
   25 |   const style = new MatchRandom(input.seed ?? input.state.seed);
   26 |   const candidateLimit = { medium: 180, hard: 420, impossible: 800 }[
   27 |     input.difficulty
   28 |   ];
   29 |   const start = performance.now(),
   30 |     ci = courses.findIndex((c) => c.id === input.state.course),
   31 |     route = getRoute(ci, input.difficulty, style.seed, style.role);
   32 |   const budget = { medium: 65, hard: 140, impossible: 240 }[input.difficulty];
   33 |   const base = new GolfPhysics(
   34 |     courses[ci],
   35 |     input.state.difficulty,
   36 |     input.state.seed ?? 1,
   37 |   );
   38 |   base.restoreSimulation(input.state);
   39 |   let waypoint = Math.min(input.waypoint, route.length - 1);
   40 |   const advanceReached = () => {
   41 |     while (waypoint < route.length - 1) {
   42 |       const t = route[waypoint];
   43 |       if (
   44 |         Math.hypot(base.ball.x - (t[2] ?? t[0]), base.ball.y - (t[3] ?? t[1])) >
   45 |         25
   46 |       )
   47 |         break;
   48 |       waypoint++;
   49 |     }
   50 |   };
   51 |   // A completed waypoint stays completed if a mover pushes the resting ball
   52 |   // during the reaction delay. Forecasting first caused endless return shots.
   53 |   advanceReached();
   54 |   for (let i = 0; i < input.delay * 240; i++) base.tick(1 / 240);
   55 |   advanceReached();
   56 |   const [tx, ty, gx = tx, gy = ty] = route[waypoint],
   57 |     angle = Math.atan2(ty - base.ball.y, tx - base.ball.x),
   58 |     distance = Math.hypot(tx - base.ball.x, ty - base.ball.y);
   59 |   const origin = { x: base.ball.x, y: base.ball.y },
   60 |     snapshot = base.exportState();
   61 |   let best = Infinity,
   62 |     candidates = 0,
   63 |     shot = { vx: Math.cos(angle) * 200, vy: Math.sin(angle) * 200, wait: 0 };
   64 |   const trial = new GolfPhysics(
   65 |     courses[ci],
   66 |     input.state.difficulty,
   67 |     input.state.seed ?? 1,
   68 |   );
   69 |   const tolerance = { medium: 8, hard: 3, impossible: 1.5 }[input.difficulty];
   70 |   let alternatives: {
   71 |     vx: number;
   72 |     vy: number;
   73 |     wait: number;
   74 |     cost: number;
   75 |     rank: number;
   76 |   }[] = [];
   77 |   const evaluate = (a: number, p: number, wait: number) => {
   78 |     trial.restoreSimulation(snapshot);
   79 |     trial.recoveries = 0;
   80 |     trial.impacts = 0;
   81 |     for (let i = 0; i < wait * 240; i++) trial.tick(1 / 240);
   82 |     const vx = Math.cos(a) * p,
   83 |       vy = Math.sin(a) * p;
   84 |     if (!trial.shoot(vx, vy)) return;
   85 |     for (let i = 0; i < 240 * 10; i++) {
   86 |       trial.tick(1 / 240);
   87 |       if (trial.stopped || trial.status !== "playing") break;
   88 |     }
   89 |     candidates++;
   90 |     let cost =
   91 |       trial.status === "won"
   92 |         ? -1e6
   93 |         : Math.hypot(trial.ball.x - gx, trial.ball.y - gy) +
   94 |           (trial.recoveries ? 10000 : 0) +
   95 |           (!trial.stopped ? 2000 : 0) +
   96 |           wait * [3.5, 1.5, 2.5, 2][style.role] +
   97 |           Math.min(12, trial.impacts) * [0.03, 0.22, 0.1, 0.06][style.role];
   98 |     // Preserve the two latched temple switches before advancing toward its final gate.
   99 |     if (ci === 3) {
  100 |       if (Math.hypot(tx - 1810, ty - 200) < 60 && !trial.dynamics.plates[1])
  101 |         cost += 200;
  102 |       if (Math.hypot(tx - 1810, ty - 950) < 60 && !trial.dynamics.plates[2])
  103 |         cost += 200;
  104 |     }
  105 |     if (cost < best) {
  106 |       best = cost;
  107 |       shot = { vx, vy, wait };
  108 |     }
  109 |     if (cost <= best + tolerance) {
  110 |       const rank = style.rank(
  111 |         Math.round(a * 100000) +
  112 |           Math.round(p * 100) * 17 +
  113 |           Math.round(wait * 100) +
  114 |           input.state.strokes * 101,
  115 |       );
  116 |       alternatives = alternatives.filter(
  117 |         (v) =>
  118 |           v.cost <= best + tolerance &&
  119 |           !(
  120 |             Math.abs(v.vx - vx) < 0.001 &&
  121 |             Math.abs(v.vy - vy) < 0.001 &&
  122 |             v.wait === wait
  123 |           ),
  124 |       );
  125 |       alternatives.push({ vx, vy, wait, cost, rank });
  126 |       alternatives.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost || a.rank - b.rank);
  127 |       alternatives.length = Math.min(16, alternatives.length);
  128 |     }
  129 |   };
  130 |   const estimate = Math.max(45, Math.min(650, Math.sqrt(distance * 220)));
  131 |   const powers = [
  132 |     Math.max(45, Math.min(650, estimate + (style.tempo - 1) * 4)),
  133 |     estimate,
  134 |     ...Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => 50 + i * 25),
  135 |   ];
  136 |   outer: for (const wait of [0, 0.6, 1.2, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
  137 |     for (const da of [
  138 |       0,
  139 |       -0.035 * style.side,
  140 |       0.035 * style.side,
  141 |       -0.09 * style.side,
  142 |       0.09 * style.side,
  143 |       -0.18 * style.side,
  144 |       0.18 * style.side,
  145 |     ])
  146 |       for (const p of powers) {
  147 |         evaluate(angle + da, p, wait);
  148 |         if (
  149 |           best < 1 ||
  150 |           (input.replay
  151 |             ? candidates >= candidateLimit * 0.7
  152 |             : performance.now() - start > budget * 0.7)
  153 |         )
  154 |           break outer;
  155 |       }
  156 |   // Refine the strongest physically simulated shot (no authored velocities).
  157 |   const center = { ...shot },
  158 |     pa = Math.atan2(center.vy, center.vx),
  159 |     pp = Math.hypot(center.vx, center.vy);
  160 |   refine: for (const da of [0, -0.018, 0.018, -0.009, 0.009])
  161 |     for (const dp of [0, -12, 12, -6, 6, -3, 3]) {
  162 |       evaluate(pa + da, Math.max(44, Math.min(650, pp + dp)), center.wait);
  163 |       if (
  164 |         input.replay
  165 |           ? candidates >= candidateLimit * 0.9
  166 |           : performance.now() - start > budget * 0.9
  167 |       )
  168 |         break refine;
  169 |     }
  170 |   // Fine refinement around the updated winner (not the original coarse sample)
  171 |   // exposes truly comparable landings and improves precision near narrow routes.
  172 |   const fine = { ...shot },
  173 |     fineAngle = Math.atan2(fine.vy, fine.vx),
  174 |     finePower = Math.hypot(fine.vx, fine.vy);
  175 |   polish: for (const da of [0, -0.002, 0.002])
  176 |     for (const dp of [-1, 1, -0.5, 0.5]) {
  177 |       if (
  178 |         input.replay
  179 |           ? candidates >= candidateLimit
  180 |           : performance.now() - start >= budget
  181 |       )
  182 |         break polish;
  183 |       evaluate(
  184 |         fineAngle + da,
  185 |         Math.max(44, Math.min(650, finePower + dp)),
  186 |         fine.wait,
  187 |       );
  188 |     }
  189 |   // Only choose among simulated, comparably good landings. Never substitute an
  190 |   // untested angular error. A winning shot excludes every non-winning candidate.
  191 |   const comparable = alternatives
  192 |     .filter((v) => v.cost <= best + tolerance)
  193 |     .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
  194 |   if (comparable.length) {
  195 |     const v = comparable[0];
  196 |     shot = { vx: v.vx, vy: v.vy, wait: v.wait };
  197 |   }
  198 |   return {
  199 |     ...shot,
  200 |     origin,
  201 |     waypoint,
  202 |     milliseconds: performance.now() - start,
  203 |     candidates,
  204 |   };
  205 | }
~~~

~~~text
  198 |       [1420, 220],
  199 |       [1810, 200],
  200 |       [1810, 950],
  201 |       [1770, 660],
  202 |       [1770, 570],
  203 |       [1560, 575],
  204 |     ],
  205 |   ],
  206 | ];
  207 | 
  208 | /** Default routes for backward compatibility. */
  209 | export const routes: number[][][] = courseRoutes.map((variants) => variants[0]);
  210 | 
  211 | /**
  212 |  * Returns a deterministic route for the course given the difficulty, seed, and player style.
  213 |  * Provides distinct paths across matches and difficulty levels.
  214 |  */
  215 | export function getRoute(
  216 |   courseIndex: number,
  217 |   difficulty: Difficulty,
  218 |   seed = 0,
  219 |   role = 0,
  220 | ): number[][] {
  221 |   const variants = courseRoutes[courseIndex];
  222 |   if (!variants || variants.length === 0) return routes[courseIndex] ?? [];
  223 |   // Mix high and low bits before selection: correlated seed/role sequences
  224 |   // otherwise cancel in the low bits used by the four-entry Medium table.
  225 |   const hash = mixSeed(seed, role + courseIndex * 7);
  226 |   let variantIndex = 0;
  227 |   if (difficulty === "medium") {
  228 |     // Medium varies between safe lines (0 and 2) and alternate line (1)
  229 |     const options = [0, 2, 0, 1];
  230 |     variantIndex = options[hash % options.length];
  231 |   } else if (difficulty === "hard") {
  232 |     // Hard evenly uses all three variations
  233 |     variantIndex = hash % variants.length;
  234 |   } else {
  235 |     // Impossible chooses among all variants, prioritizing direct lines
  236 |     const options = [1, 0, 2];
  237 |     variantIndex = options[hash % options.length];
  238 |   }
  239 |   return variants[variantIndex % variants.length];
  240 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/components/CourseArt.ts

~~~text
    1 | import type { Course, Rect } from "../courses";
    2 | /** Static course overview: no world, AI, assets or physics initialization. */
    3 | export function courseArt(c: Course) {
    4 |   const hex = (n: number) => `#${n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0")}`;
    5 |   const rect = (r: Rect, fill: string, stroke = "", rx = 0) =>
    6 |     `<rect x="${r.x}" y="${r.y}" width="${r.w}" height="${r.h}" rx="${rx}" fill="${fill}"${stroke ? ` stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="8"` : ""}/>`;
    7 |   const ground = c.ground
    8 |     ? c.ground.map((r) => rect(r, hex(c.color))).join("")
    9 |     : rect({ x: 0, y: 70, w: 1920, h: 1010 }, hex(c.color));
   10 |   const surfaces = c.surfaces
   11 |     .map((s) =>
   12 |       rect(
   13 |         s,
   14 |         (
   15 |           {
   16 |             slick: "#a6dce8",
   17 |             mud: "#ae8468",
   18 |             quicksand: "#d9b47e",
   19 |             sand: "#e9cf96",
   20 |             belt: "#a3ada4",
   21 |             wind: "#c3d4ed",
   22 |             ford: "#a8d2bc",
   23 |           } as const
   24 |         )[s.kind],
   25 |       ),
   26 |     )
   27 |     .join("");
   28 |   const bridges = [...(c.bridges ?? []), ...(c.planks ?? []).flat()]
   29 |     .map((r) => rect(r, "#e1be85", "#80694d"))
   30 |     .join("");
   31 |   const fields = c.fields
   32 |     .map(
   33 |       (f) =>
   34 |         `<circle cx="${f.x}" cy="${f.y}" r="${f.r}" fill="#9d8bc0" opacity=".25" stroke="#74658d" stroke-width="6"/>`,
   35 |     )
   36 |     .join("");
   37 |   const circles = c.circles
   38 |     .map(
   39 |       (v) =>
   40 |         `<circle cx="${v.x}" cy="${v.y}" r="${v.r}" fill="#edbd75" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="7"/>`,
   41 |     )
   42 |     .join("");
   43 |   const movers = c.movers
   44 |     .map((m) =>
   45 |       m.r
   46 |         ? `<circle cx="${(m.from.x + m.to.x) / 2}" cy="${(m.from.y + m.to.y) / 2}" r="${m.r}" fill="#a1a99e" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="7"/>`
   47 |         : rect(
   48 |             {
   49 |               x: (m.from.x + m.to.x) / 2,
   50 |               y: (m.from.y + m.to.y) / 2,
   51 |               w: m.w ?? 10,
   52 |               h: m.h ?? 10,
   53 |             },
   54 |             "#899a97",
   55 |             "#242b32",
   56 |           ),
   57 |     )
   58 |     .join("");
   59 |   const walls = c.walls.map((r) => rect(r, "#82977b", "#242b32")).join("");
   60 |   const fans = c.fans
   61 |     .map(
   62 |       (f) =>
   63 |         `<g transform="translate(${f.x} ${f.y}) rotate(35)"><path d="M${-f.length / 2} 0h${f.length}M0 ${-f.length / 2}v${f.length}" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="22"/><circle r="${f.hub}" fill="#f49b58"/></g>`,
   64 |     )
   65 |     .join("");
   66 |   const portals = (c.portals ?? [])
   67 |     .map(
   68 |       (p) =>
   69 |         `<circle cx="${p.from.x}" cy="${p.from.y}" r="25" fill="#9b7fc4" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="8"/><circle cx="${p.to.x}" cy="${p.to.y}" r="25" fill="#58addb" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="8"/>`,
   70 |     )
   71 |     .join("");
   72 |   const plates = (c.plates ?? [])
   73 |     .map(
   74 |       (p) =>
   75 |         `<circle cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="23" fill="#f4b558" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="6"/>`,
   76 |     )
   77 |     .join("");
   78 |   return `<svg class="golf-course-preview" viewBox="0 0 1010 1920" aria-hidden="true"><g transform="translate(1080 0) rotate(90)">${rect({ x: 0, y: 70, w: 1920, h: 1010 }, c.ground ? "#465164" : hex(c.color))}${ground}${c.river ? rect(c.river, "#69afd0") : ""}${surfaces}${bridges}${fields}${portals}${walls}${circles}${movers}${fans}${c.lasers.map((r) => rect(r, "#df8b7e")).join("")}${(c.doors ?? []).map((r) => rect(r, "#d3b571", "#242b32")).join("")}${plates}<circle cx="${c.hole.x}" cy="${c.hole.y}" r="25" fill="#242b32"/><path d="M${c.hole.x} ${c.hole.y}v-75l50 18-50 18" fill="#f49b58" stroke="#242b32" stroke-width="8"/><circle cx="${c.start.x}" cy="${c.start.y}" r="20" fill="#fffdf5" stroke="#ed9a55" stroke-width="12"/></g></svg>`;
   79 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/components/GolfUI.ts
SHA-256: 6e356bb697ec956040a6aead50bf753a6f3e4b057768a035694bc5213f19e8e9
~~~text
    1 | import "./golf.css";
    2 | import type { Rect } from "../courses";
    3 | export class GolfUI {
    4 |   readonly root = document.createElement("div");
    5 |   readonly field: HTMLDivElement;
    6 |   private heading: HTMLElement;
    7 |   private stat: HTMLElement;
    8 |   private footer: HTMLElement;
    9 |   private toast: HTMLElement;
   10 |   private power: HTMLElement;
   11 |   private opponent: HTMLElement;
   12 |   constructor(action: (name: string) => void) {
   13 |     this.root.className = "golf-ui";
   14 |     this.root.innerHTML = `<header class="golf-header"><button class="golf-icon-button" data-action="back" aria-label="Golf back">‹</button><div class="golf-heading"><strong>Ultimate Golf</strong><small></small></div><button class="golf-icon-button" data-action="help" aria-label="Golf help">?</button><button class="golf-icon-button" data-action="pause" aria-label="Pause golf">Ⅱ</button></header><div class="golf-field"></div><footer class="golf-footer"></footer>`;
   15 |     this.field = this.root.querySelector(".golf-field")!;
   16 |     this.heading = this.root.querySelector("strong")!;
   17 |     this.stat = this.root.querySelector("small")!;
   18 |     this.footer = this.root.querySelector("footer")!;
   19 |     this.toast = document.createElement("div");
   20 |     this.toast.className = "golf-toast";
   21 |     this.power = document.createElement("div");
   22 |     this.power.className = "golf-power";
   23 |     this.power.innerHTML = "<i></i>";
   24 |     this.opponent = document.createElement("div");
   25 |     this.opponent.className = "golf-opponent";
   26 |     this.root.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
   27 |       const button = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>(
   28 |         "[data-action]",
   29 |       );
   30 |       if (button && !button.disabled) action(button.dataset.action!);
   31 |     });
   32 |     document.querySelector("#game-stage")!.append(this.root);
   33 |   }
   34 |   title(title: string, stat = "") {
   35 |     if (this.heading.textContent !== title) this.heading.textContent = title;
   36 |     if (this.stat.textContent !== stat) this.stat.textContent = stat;
   37 |     this.stat.hidden = !stat;
   38 |   }
   39 |   screen(html: string) {
   40 |     this.field.innerHTML = `<section class="golf-panel">${html}</section>`;
   41 |     this.footer.innerHTML = "";
   42 |   }
   43 |   playing(competitive = false) {
   44 |     this.field.replaceChildren(this.toast, this.power, this.opponent);
   45 |     this.toast.hidden = this.power.hidden = this.opponent.hidden = true;
   46 |     this.footer.innerHTML = `<button data-action="courses">Courses</button><button data-action="focus">Focus</button><button data-action="retry">${competitive ? "Forfeit" : "Retry"}</button>`;
   47 |   }
   48 |   focus(active: boolean) {
   49 |     const b = this.footer.querySelector("[data-action=focus]");
   50 |     if (b) {
   51 |       b.textContent = active ? "Full course" : "Focus";
   52 |       b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
   53 |     }
   54 |   }
   55 |   message(text: string) {
   56 |     if (this.toast.textContent !== text) this.toast.textContent = text;
   57 |     this.toast.hidden = !text;
   58 |   }
   59 |   meter(power: number | null) {
   60 |     this.power.hidden = power === null;
   61 |     if (power !== null)
   62 |       (this.power.firstElementChild as HTMLElement).style.width =
   63 |         `${power * 100}%`;
   64 |   }
   65 |   rival(text: string) {
   66 |     if (this.opponent.textContent !== text) this.opponent.textContent = text;
   67 |     this.opponent.hidden = !text;
   68 |   }
   69 |   help(text: string, closeLabel = "Back to play") {
   70 |     const panel = document.createElement("section");
   71 |     panel.className = "golf-panel help";
   72 |     panel.innerHTML = `<h2>How to play</h2><p>${text}</p><p>Pull back anywhere on the course, then release. Use Focus for a closer view.</p><button data-action="close-help">${closeLabel}</button>`;
   73 |     this.field.append(panel);
   74 |   }
   75 |   closeHelp() {
   76 |     this.field.querySelector(".help")?.remove();
   77 |   }
   78 |   bounds(): Rect {
   79 |     const r = this.field.getBoundingClientRect(),
   80 |       parent = this.root.parentElement!.getBoundingClientRect();
   81 |     return {
   82 |       x: r.x - parent.x + 2,
   83 |       y: r.y - parent.y + 2,
   84 |       w: Math.max(1, r.width - 4),
   85 |       h: Math.max(1, r.height - 4),
   86 |     };
   87 |   }
   88 |   pause(paused: boolean) {
   89 |     this.root.setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(paused));
   90 |     this.root.inert = paused;
   91 |   }
   92 |   dispose() {
   93 |     this.root.remove();
   94 |   }
   95 | }
~~~

~~~text
  304 | .golf-course { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  305 | .golf-course strong { font-weight: 600; text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; max-width: 100%; }
  306 | .golf-course small { margin-top: 0; text-align: center; }
  307 | .golf-course-preview { display: block; width: 100%; height: 155px; border-radius: 9px; }
  308 |
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/modes/AIChallengeMode.ts
SHA-256: c92fec6300a48592c38ac2445cfa4313c1352edc34b817d1d10a21a0790bcff1
~~~text
    1 | import { GolfPhysics } from "../GolfPhysics";
    2 | import { courses } from "../courses";
    3 | import { GolfAI } from "../ai/GolfAI";
    4 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    5 | import {
    6 |   COURSE_TIMEOUT,
    7 |   seedFor,
    8 |   total,
    9 |   winner,
   10 |   type Attempt,
   11 | } from "./CompetitionRules";
   12 | /** Two independent course instances, one foreground clock and one reproducible seed. */
   13 | export class AIChallengeMode {
   14 |   readonly attempts: [Attempt[], Attempt[]] = [[], []];
   15 |   readonly holes = [0, 0];
   16 |   readonly elapsed = [0, 0];
   17 |   readonly worlds: [GolfPhysics, GolfPhysics];
   18 |   readonly ai: GolfAI;
   19 |   phase: "ready" | "playing" | "complete" = "ready";
   20 |   private failed: [boolean, boolean] = [false, false];
   21 |   constructor(
   22 |     readonly plan: number[],
   23 |     readonly seed: number,
   24 |     difficulty: Difficulty,
   25 |     report: (ms: number) => void,
   26 |   ) {
   27 |     this.worlds = [this.create(0), this.create(0)];
   28 |     this.ai = new GolfAI(difficulty, report, seed);
   29 |   }
   30 |   private create(hole: number) {
   31 |     return new GolfPhysics(
   32 |       courses[this.plan[hole]],
   33 |       0,
   34 |       seedFor(this.seed, this.plan[hole]),
   35 |     );
   36 |   }
   37 |   begin() {
   38 |     if (this.phase === "ready") this.phase = "playing";
   39 |   }
   40 |   update(dt: number) {
   41 |     if (this.phase !== "playing") return;
   42 |     for (const p of [0, 1] as const) {
   43 |       if (this.attempts[p].length === this.plan.length || this.failed[p])
   44 |         continue;
   45 |       const w = this.worlds[p];
   46 |       this.elapsed[p] += dt;
   47 |       if (p === 1) this.ai.update(dt, w);
   48 |       w.advance(dt);
   49 |       if (w.status !== "playing" || this.elapsed[p] >= COURSE_TIMEOUT) {
   50 |         const completed = w.status === "won";
   51 |         this.attempts[p].push({
   52 |           time: Math.min(COURSE_TIMEOUT, this.elapsed[p]),
   53 |           strokes: w.strokes,
   54 |           completed,
   55 |           reason: completed
   56 |             ? undefined
   57 |             : this.elapsed[p] >= COURSE_TIMEOUT
   58 |               ? "timeout"
   59 |               : "strokes",
   60 |         });
   61 |         if (completed && this.holes[p] < this.plan.length - 1) {
   62 |           this.holes[p]++;
   63 |           this.elapsed[p] = 0;
   64 |           this.worlds[p] = this.create(this.holes[p]);
   65 |           if (p === 1) this.ai.reset();
   66 |         } else {
   67 |           this.failed[p] = !completed;
   68 |         }
   69 |       }
   70 |     }
   71 |     const done0 =
   72 |       this.attempts[0].length === this.plan.length || this.failed[0];
   73 |     const done1 =
   74 |       this.attempts[1].length === this.plan.length || this.failed[1];
   75 |     if (done0 && !done1) {
   76 |       this.ai.accelerated = true;
   77 |     }
   78 |     if (done0 && done1) {
   79 |       // Both immutable attempt records now exist; time tolerance belongs to
   80 |       // winner comparison, not an extra playable frame after completion.
   81 |       this.phase = "complete";
   82 |       this.ai.cancel();
   83 |     }
   84 |   }
   85 |   forfeit() {
   86 |     if (this.phase !== "playing") return;
   87 |     this.failed[0] = true;
   88 |     this.attempts[0].push({
   89 |       time: this.elapsed[0],
   90 |       strokes: this.worlds[0].strokes,
   91 |       completed: false,
   92 |       reason: "forfeit",
   93 |     });
   94 |     this.phase = "complete";
   95 |     this.ai.cancel();
   96 |   }
   97 |   get totals() {
   98 |     return this.attempts.map((a) => total(a, this.plan.length)) as [
   99 |       ReturnType<typeof total>,
  100 |       ReturnType<typeof total>,
  101 |     ];
  102 |   }
  103 |   get winner() {
  104 |     if (this.failed[0] && this.failed[1]) return "draw" as const;
  105 |     if (this.failed[0]) return 2 as const;
  106 |     if (this.failed[1]) return 1 as const;
  107 |     return winner(...this.totals);
  108 |   }
  109 |   pause() {
  110 |     this.ai.cancel();
  111 |     this.worlds.forEach((w) => w.resetAccumulator());
  112 |   }
  113 |   dispose() {
  114 |     this.ai.dispose();
  115 |   }
  116 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/modes/CasualMode.ts
SHA-256: 968bd652d58e3519ec4e5b82dd901689471b5baa62aaa35f6b74ec666f7aac4b
~~~text
    1 | import { courses } from "../courses";
    2 | import { GolfPhysics } from "../GolfPhysics";
    3 | import { GolfProgress } from "../GolfProgress";
    4 | import type { GolfDifficulty } from "../GolfRules";
    5 | export class CasualMode {
    6 |   readonly progress = new GolfProgress();
    7 |   world?: GolfPhysics;
    8 |   course = 0;
    9 |   difficulty: GolfDifficulty = 1;
   10 |   start(index: number) {
   11 |     this.course = index;
   12 |     this.world = new GolfPhysics(courses[index], this.difficulty);
   13 |     return this.world;
   14 |   }
   15 |   update(dt: number) {
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/modes/CompetitionRules.ts
SHA-256: bed91803681d8c791a2b68473ee49e8dfff7c34ed060a5abaecd0be808721291
~~~text
    1 | export interface Attempt {
    2 |   time: number;
    3 |   strokes: number;
    4 |   completed: boolean;
    5 |   reason?: "timeout" | "strokes" | "forfeit" | "opponent";
    6 | }
    7 | export interface Totals {
    8 |   time: number;
    9 |   strokes: number;
   10 |   completed: boolean;
   11 | }
   12 | export const FINISH_TOLERANCE = 0.1,
   13 |   COURSE_TIMEOUT = 180;
   14 | export function total(attempts: Attempt[], count: number): Totals {
   15 |   return {
   16 |     time: attempts.reduce((s, a) => s + a.time, 0),
   17 |     strokes: attempts.reduce((s, a) => s + a.strokes, 0),
   18 |     completed: attempts.length === count && attempts.every((a) => a.completed),
   19 |   };
   20 | }
   21 | export function winner(one: Totals, two: Totals): 1 | 2 | "draw" {
   22 |   if (one.completed !== two.completed) return one.completed ? 1 : 2;
   23 |   if (!one.completed) return "draw";
   24 |   if (one.strokes !== two.strokes) return one.strokes < two.strokes ? 1 : 2;
   25 |   if (Math.abs(one.time - two.time) > FINISH_TOLERANCE)
   26 |     return one.time < two.time ? 1 : 2;
   27 |   return "draw";
   28 | }
   29 | export function seedFor(seed: number, index: number) {
   30 |   let n = (seed ^ ((index + 1) * 0x9e3779b9)) >>> 0;
   31 |   n = Math.imul(n ^ (n >>> 16), 0x21f0aaad);
   32 |   return (n ^ (n >>> 15)) >>> 0;
   33 | }
   34 | export function seeded(seed: number) {
   35 |   let state = seed >>> 0;
   36 |   return () => {
   37 |     state = (Math.imul(state, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
   38 |     return state / 4294967296;
   39 |   };
   40 | }
   41 | export const timeText = (seconds: number) =>
   42 |   `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${(seconds % 60).toFixed(1).padStart(4, "0")}`;
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/modes/CompetitiveStats.ts
SHA-256: 0a5caf0fda1d9ec1de3b610d1904fadd3cbaa054e551ed0563df7dedadc311f3

~~~text
    1 | const KEY = "pocket-rivals.golf-versus.v1";
    2 | export function recordCompetition(
    3 |   mode: "local" | "ai",
    4 |   result: 1 | 2 | "draw",
    5 | ) {
    6 |   try {
    7 |     const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? "null");
    8 |     const data: Record<string, number> = {
    9 |       localMatches: 0,
   10 |       aiMatches: 0,
   11 |       one: 0,
   12 |       two: 0,
   13 |       draws: 0,
   14 |     };
   15 |     for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
   16 |       const n = raw?.[key];
   17 |       if (Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0) data[key] = n;
   18 |     }
   19 |     data[mode === "local" ? "localMatches" : "aiMatches"]++;
   20 |     data[result === "draw" ? "draws" : result === 1 ? "one" : "two"]++;
   21 |     localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
   22 |   } catch {
   23 |     /* Session gameplay never depends on persistence. */
   24 |   }
   25 | }
~~~

## src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/modes/LocalVersusMode.ts
SHA-256: bea8949930bd23166e73ff5f50f08151cd9c29d5a1473815381f110ebf09eed2
~~~text
    1 | import { courses } from "../courses";
    2 | import { GolfPhysics } from "../GolfPhysics";
    3 | import {
    4 |   COURSE_TIMEOUT,
    5 |   seedFor,
    6 |   total,
    7 |   winner,
    8 |   type Attempt,
    9 | } from "./CompetitionRules";
   10 | /** Hot-seat attempts own their clocks. Menus/handoffs never call update. */
   11 | export class LocalVersusMode {
   12 |   readonly attempts: [Attempt[], Attempt[]] = [[], []];
   13 |   player: 0 | 1 = 0;
   14 |   hole = 0;
   15 |   elapsed = 0;
   16 |   world: GolfPhysics;
   17 |   phase: "ready" | "playing" | "between" | "complete" = "ready";
   18 |   constructor(
   19 |     readonly plan: number[],
   20 |     readonly seed: number,
   21 |   ) {
   22 |     this.world = this.create();
   23 |   }
   24 |   private create() {
   25 |     return new GolfPhysics(
   26 |       courses[this.plan[this.hole]],
   27 |       0,
   28 |       seedFor(this.seed, this.plan[this.hole]),
   29 |     );
   30 |   }
   31 |   begin() {
   32 |     if (this.phase === "ready" || this.phase === "between") {
   33 |       this.world = this.create();
   34 |       this.elapsed = 0;
   35 |       this.phase = "playing";
   36 |     }
   37 |   }
   38 |   update(dt: number) {
   39 |     if (this.phase !== "playing") return;
   40 |     this.elapsed += Math.max(0, dt);
   41 |     this.world.advance(dt);
   42 |     if (this.world.status !== "playing" || this.elapsed >= COURSE_TIMEOUT)
   43 |       this.finish();
   44 |   }
   45 |   private finish(reason?: Attempt["reason"]) {
   46 |     if (this.phase !== "playing") return;
   47 |     const won = this.world.status === "won";
   48 |     this.attempts[this.player].push({
   49 |       time: Math.min(COURSE_TIMEOUT, this.elapsed),
   50 |       strokes: this.world.strokes,
   51 |       completed: won && !reason,
   52 |       reason:
   53 |         reason ??
   54 |         (won
   55 |           ? undefined
   56 |           : this.elapsed >= COURSE_TIMEOUT
   57 |             ? "timeout"
   58 |             : "strokes"),
   59 |     });
   60 |     if (won && !reason && this.hole < this.plan.length - 1) {
   61 |       this.hole++;
   62 |       this.phase = "between";
   63 |     } else if (this.player === 0) {
   64 |       this.player = 1;
   65 |       this.hole = 0;
   66 |       this.phase = "ready";
   67 |     } else this.phase = "complete";
   68 |   }
   69 |   forfeit() {
   70 |     this.finish("forfeit");
   71 |   }
   72 |   get totals() {
   73 |     return this.attempts.map((a) => total(a, this.plan.length)) as [
   74 |       ReturnType<typeof total>,
   75 |       ReturnType<typeof total>,
   76 |     ];
   77 |   }
   78 |   get winner() {
   79 |     return winner(...this.totals);
   80 |   }
   81 | }
~~~

## src/games/perfect-timer/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: cf7cd55684646818da534a38cdec023c18bf9085e0778f35ac00e13ae90a6096
~~~text
    1 | # Perfect Timer
    2 | 
    3 | Preserve Antigravity’s original layout/renderer. Rules own integer precision, submissions, idempotent resolution and five-round/sudden-death progression; reject nonfinite input. AI is seeded per match and stays inside this folder. Controllers own scene objects; host input subscriptions are automatically removed. Pause/terminal guards must prevent actions after completion. Active matches restart after process closure.
    4 | 
    5 | TimerClock is foreground monotonic time; both AI deadlines and human events use its elapsed milliseconds. Never use raw performance.now minus an unadjusted start time. Impossible targets exact visible durations; no fabricated minimum error.
    6 | 
    7 | Keep the target duration prominent, the round counter small, and the action buttons concise. This is simultaneous play: do not rotate the shared timer on individual stops.
    8 | 
    9 | Timing uses a quiet clockTick once per foreground half-second and clockStop for human/AI stops; countdown/start/reveal keep their existing feedback. Suppress catch-up sound bursts by comparing the current tick index once per update. All effects honor shared mute/volume and pause.
~~~

## src/games/perfect-timer/PerfectTimerAI.ts
SHA-256: 86b325a3c1ad80d77e337c2a915cf9690b56106aa16407b9ea9c3683daed0ce9
~~~text
    1 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    2 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    3 | /** A coherent fast/slow internal clock per match; Impossible uses the visible exact target. */
    4 | export class PerfectTimerAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   private scheduledStopMs: number | null = null;
    7 |   constructor(
    8 |     public readonly difficulty: Difficulty = "medium",
    9 |     seed?: number,
   10 |   ) {
   11 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   12 |   }
   13 |   scheduleRound(targetCentiseconds: number, startPerfMs: number) {
   14 |     const r = this.personality,
   15 |       spread =
   16 |         this.difficulty === "medium" ? 72 : this.difficulty === "hard" ? 21 : 0,
   17 |       bias = r.side * spread * (0.15 + r.role * 0.06);
   18 |     const error = Math.round(
   19 |       r.sample(bias, spread * (0.8 + r.tempo * 0.1), -spread * 1.4),
   20 |     );
   21 |     this.scheduledStopMs =
   22 |       startPerfMs + Math.max(50, targetCentiseconds + error) * 10;
   23 |   }
   24 |   shouldStop(elapsedMs: number) {
   25 |     return this.scheduledStopMs !== null && elapsedMs >= this.scheduledStopMs;
   26 |   }
   27 |   reset() {
   28 |     this.scheduledStopMs = null;
   29 |   }
   30 |   snapshot() {
   31 |     return this.personality.snapshot();
   32 |   }
   33 | }
~~~

~~~text
  183 |   private handlePlayerAction(player: 0 | 1) {

  195 |     } else if (this.state === "TIMING") {

  261 |       if (this.ai) {
  262 |         this.p2BtnText.setText("AI READY ✓");
  263 |       } else {
  264 |         this.p2BtnText.setText(this.ready[1] ? "Ready ✓" : "Ready");
  265 |       }
  266 |     } else if (this.state === "COUNTDOWN") {
  267 |       this.p1BtnText.setText("");
  268 |       this.p2BtnText.setText(this.ai ? "AI OPPONENT" : "");
  269 |     } else if (this.state === "TIMING") {
  270 |       const p1Stopped = this.match.stops[0] !== null;
  271 |       this.p1BtnText.setText(p1Stopped ? "✓" : "STOP");
  272 | 
  273 |       const p2Stopped = this.match.stops[1] !== null;
  274 |       if (this.ai) {
  275 |         this.p2BtnText.setText(p2Stopped ? "AI: STOPPED" : "AI: ESTIMATING...");
  276 |       } else {
  277 |         this.p2BtnText.setText(p2Stopped ? "✓" : "STOP");
  278 |       }
  279 |     } else if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  280 |       this.p1BtnText.setText("ROUND COMPLETE");
  281 |       this.p2BtnText.setText("ROUND COMPLETE");
  282 |     }
  283 |   }
~~~
