~~~text
  285 |   private triggerReveal() {
  286 |     if (this.state !== "TIMING" || this.reported) return;
  287 |     this.clock.pause();
  288 |     this.state = "REVEAL";
  289 |     this.revealAge = 0;
  290 |     this.roundResult = this.match.resolveRound();
  291 |     this.ctx.setScore(this.match.scores[0], this.match.scores[1]);
  292 | 
  293 |     const res = this.roundResult;
  294 |     const s0Str = formatSeconds(res.stops[0]);
  295 |     const s1Str = formatSeconds(res.stops[1]);
  296 |     const err0Str = formatSeconds(res.errors[0]);
  297 |     const err1Str = formatSeconds(res.errors[1]);
  298 |     const tarStr = formatSeconds(res.target);
  299 | 
  300 |     let winnerStr: string;
  301 |     if (res.winner === 1) {
  302 |       winnerStr = "ORANGE WINS ROUND!";
  303 |       this.ctx.audio.play("capture");
  304 |     } else if (res.winner === 2) {
  305 |       winnerStr = (this.ai ? "AI" : "BLUE") + " WINS ROUND!";
  306 |       this.ctx.audio.play("capture");
  307 |     } else {
  308 |       winnerStr = "TIED ROUND!";
  309 |       this.ctx.audio.play("draw");
  310 |     }
  311 | 
  312 |     // Hide overlapping background texts so reveal card is crisp and clean
  313 |     this.targetText.setAlpha(0);
  314 |     this.statusText.setAlpha(0);
  315 |     this.countdownText.setAlpha(0);
  316 | 
  317 |     this.revealText
  318 |       .setText(
  319 |         `TARGET: ${tarStr}\n\n` +
  320 |           `ORANGE: ${s0Str}   (ERR ${err0Str})\n` +
  321 |           `${this.ai ? "AI" : "BLUE"}: ${s1Str}   (ERR ${err1Str})\n\n` +
  322 |           `★ ${winnerStr} ★\n\n` +
  323 |           `TAP TO CONTINUE`,
  324 |       )
  325 |       .setAlpha(1);
  326 | 
  327 |     this.updateButtons();
  328 |   }
  329 | 
  330 |   private advanceNext() {
  331 |     if (this.match.isMatchOver) {
  332 |       if (!this.reported) {
  333 |         this.reported = true;
  334 |         this.ctx.finish({
  335 |           winner: this.match.matchWinner!,
  336 |           scores: this.match.scores,
  337 |         });
  338 |       }
  339 |       return;
  340 |     }
  341 | 
  342 |     this.match.nextRound();
  343 |     this.startRound();
  344 |   }
  345 | 
  346 |   update(dt: number) {
  347 |     if (this.paused || this.reported) return;
  348 |     this.animTime += dt;
  349 | 
  350 |     if (this.state === "COUNTDOWN") {
  351 |       this.countdownTimer -= dt;
  352 |       if (this.countdownTimer <= 0) {
  353 |         this.countdownStep--;
  354 |         if (this.countdownStep === 0) {
  355 |           this.countdownText.setText("GO!").setColor("#27ae60");
  356 |           this.startTimingPhase();
  357 |         } else {
  358 |           this.countdownTimer = 0.75;
  359 |           this.countdownText
  360 |             .setText(`${this.countdownStep}`)
  361 |             .setColor("#e67e22");
  362 |           this.ctx.audio.play("countdown");
  363 |         }
  364 |       }
  365 |     } else if (this.state === "TIMING") {
  366 |       const now = this.clock.elapsed();
  367 |       const tick = Math.floor(now / 500);
  368 |       if (tick !== this.lastTick && !this.match.bothStopped) {
  369 |         this.lastTick = tick;
  370 |         this.ctx.audio.play("clockTick");
  371 |       }
  372 | 
  373 |       // Check AI auto-stop
  374 |       if (this.ai && this.match.stops[1] === null && this.ai.shouldStop(now)) {
  375 |         const elapsedMs = now;
  376 |         this.match.recordStop(1, elapsedMs);
  377 |         this.ctx.audio.play("clockStop");
  378 |         this.updateButtons();
  379 |         if (this.match.bothStopped) {
  380 |           this.triggerReveal();
  381 |         }
  382 |       }
  383 | 
  384 |       // Max timeout safeguard (target + 5.00s)
  385 |       const maxMs = (this.match.target + 500) * 10;
  386 |       if (this.state === "TIMING" && now > maxMs) {
  387 |         if (this.match.stops[0] === null) this.match.recordStop(0, maxMs);
  388 |         if (this.match.stops[1] === null) this.match.recordStop(1, maxMs);
  389 |         this.updateButtons();
  390 |         this.triggerReveal();
  391 |       }
  392 |     } else if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  393 |       this.revealAge += dt;
  394 |       if (this.revealAge > 3.2) {
  395 |         this.advanceNext();
  396 |       }
  397 |     }
  398 | 
  399 |     this.render();
  400 |   }
  401 | 
  402 |   private render() {
  403 |     const g = this.g;
  404 |     g.clear();
  405 | 
  406 |     // 1. Play area card (warm ivory / off-white)
  407 |     rounded(g, 24, 112, 372, 538, 20, 0xfcf8f2, 4);
  408 | 
  409 |     // 2. Stopwatch Illustration in center (cx=210, cy=390, r=85)
  410 |     this.renderer.drawStopwatch(
  411 |       g,
  412 |       210,
  413 |       390,
  414 |       85,
  415 |       this.state === "TIMING",
  416 |       this.animTime,
  417 |     );
  418 | 
  419 |     // 3. Player 2 Button (Top)
  420 |     const p2Color =
  421 |       this.state === "TIMING" && this.match.stops[1] !== null
  422 |         ? 0x7f8c8d
  423 |         : theme.blue;
  424 |     rounded(
  425 |       g,
  426 |       this.p2Btn.x,
  427 |       this.p2Btn.y,
  428 |       this.p2Btn.w,
  429 |       this.p2Btn.h,
  430 |       16,
  431 |       p2Color,
  432 |       3,
  433 |     );
  434 | 
  435 |     // 4. Player 1 Button (Bottom)
  436 |     const p1Color =
  437 |       this.state === "TIMING" && this.match.stops[0] !== null
  438 |         ? 0x7f8c8d
  439 |         : theme.orange;
  440 |     rounded(
  441 |       g,
  442 |       this.p1Btn.x,
  443 |       this.p1Btn.y,
  444 |       this.p1Btn.w,
  445 |       this.p1Btn.h,
  446 |       16,
  447 |       p1Color,
  448 |       3,
  449 |     );
  450 | 
  451 |     // 5. Reveal Card Overlay in center
  452 |     if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  453 |       rounded(g, 40, 235, 340, 230, 18, 0xffffff, 3);
  454 |     }
  455 |   }
  456 | 
  457 |   pause() {
  458 |     if (this.state === "TIMING") this.clock.pause();
  459 |     this.paused = true;
  460 |   }
  461 | 
  462 |   resume() {
  463 |     if (this.paused && this.state === "TIMING") this.clock.resume();
  464 |     this.paused = false;
  465 |   }
  466 | 
  467 |   dispose() {
  468 |     this.reported = true;
  469 |     this.clock.pause();
  470 |     this.ai?.reset();
  471 |     this.g.destroy();
  472 |     for (const t of this.uiTexts) t.destroy();
  473 |   }
  474 | 
  475 |   snapshot() {
  476 |     return {
  477 |       ai: this.ai?.snapshot(),
  478 |       match: this.match,
  479 |       state: this.state,
  480 |       ready: [...this.ready],
  481 |       scores: [...this.match.scores],
  482 |       round: this.match.round,
  483 |     };
  484 |   }
  485 | }
~~~

## src/games/perfect-timer/PerfectTimerRules.ts
SHA-256: fb7b45176c2287c5abf601dbbc09f0f04f5af3dbeb0fddea6384870fda37e0fa
~~~text
    1 | export const TOTAL_ROUNDS = 5;
    2 | 
    3 | // Standard base targets with centisecond precision
    4 | export const TARGET_PRESETS = [500, 743, 1000, 1267, 1525]; // in centiseconds (5.00s, 7.43s, 10.00s, 12.67s, 15.25s)
    5 | 
    6 | export function formatSeconds(centiseconds: number): string {
    7 |   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.round(centiseconds));
    8 |   return (clamped / 100).toFixed(2) + "s";
    9 | }
   10 | 
   11 | export function formatSecondsRaw(centiseconds: number): string {
   12 |   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.round(centiseconds));
   13 |   return (clamped / 100).toFixed(2);
   14 | }
   15 | 
   16 | export interface TimerRoundResult {
   17 |   round: number;
   18 |   target: number; // centiseconds (e.g. 1000 = 10.00s)
   19 |   stops: [number, number]; // recorded centiseconds for each player
   20 |   errors: [number, number]; // |stop - target| in centiseconds
   21 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw";
   22 | }
   23 | 
   24 | export class PerfectTimerMatch {
   25 |   round = 1;
   26 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   27 |   history: TimerRoundResult[] = [];
   28 |   target = 1000; // current target in centiseconds
   29 |   stops: [number | null, number | null] = [null, null]; // centiseconds
   30 | 
   31 |   private resolved?: TimerRoundResult;
   32 |   private usedTargets = new Set<number>();
   33 | 
   34 |   constructor(private rng: () => number = Math.random) {
   35 |     this.startNewRound();
   36 |   }
   37 | 
   38 |   startNewRound() {
   39 |     this.resolved = undefined;
   40 |     this.stops = [null, null];
   41 | 
   42 |     const available = TARGET_PRESETS.filter(
   43 |       (value) => !this.usedTargets.has(value),
   44 |     );
   45 |     let candidate = available.length
   46 |       ? available[Math.floor(this.rng() * available.length)]
   47 |       : 500 + Math.floor(this.rng() * 1001);
   48 |     // Deterministic fallback avoids duplicate targets even with a constant test RNG.
   49 |     for (let i = 0; i < 1001 && this.usedTargets.has(candidate); i++)
   50 |       candidate = 500 + ((candidate - 499) % 1001);
   51 | 
   52 |     this.usedTargets.add(candidate);
   53 |     this.target = candidate;
   54 |   }
   55 | 
   56 |   recordStop(player: 0 | 1, elapsedMs: number): number {
   57 |     if (!Number.isFinite(elapsedMs) || elapsedMs < 0)
   58 |       throw new RangeError("Invalid elapsed time");
   59 |     if (this.stops[player] !== null) return this.stops[player]!;
   60 |     // High-resolution conversion to integer centiseconds using consistent rounding
   61 |     const centiseconds = Math.max(0, Math.round(elapsedMs / 10));
   62 |     this.stops[player] = centiseconds;
   63 |     return centiseconds;
   64 |   }
   65 | 
   66 |   get bothStopped(): boolean {
   67 |     return this.stops[0] !== null && this.stops[1] !== null;
   68 |   }
   69 | 
   70 |   resolveRound(): TimerRoundResult {
   71 |     if (this.resolved) return this.resolved;
   72 |     if (!this.bothStopped) {
   73 |       throw new Error("Cannot resolve round: both players must have stopped");
   74 |     }
   75 |     const s0 = this.stops[0]!;
   76 |     const s1 = this.stops[1]!;
   77 |     const err0 = Math.abs(s0 - this.target);
   78 |     const err1 = Math.abs(s1 - this.target);
   79 | 
   80 |     let winner: 1 | 2 | "draw";
   81 |     if (err0 < err1) {
   82 |       winner = 1;
   83 |       this.scores[0]++;
   84 |     } else if (err1 < err0) {
   85 |       winner = 2;
   86 |       this.scores[1]++;
   87 |     } else {
   88 |       winner = "draw";
   89 |     }
   90 | 
   91 |     const result: TimerRoundResult = {
   92 |       round: this.round,
   93 |       target: this.target,
   94 |       stops: [s0, s1],
   95 |       errors: [err0, err1],
   96 |       winner,
   97 |     };
   98 |     this.resolved = result;
   99 |     this.history.push(result);
  100 |     return result;
  101 |   }
  102 | 
  103 |   nextRound(): boolean {
  104 |     if (!this.resolved || this.isMatchOver) return false;
  105 |     this.round++;
  106 |     this.startNewRound();
  107 |     return true;
  108 |   }
  109 | 
  110 |   get isSuddenDeath(): boolean {
  111 |     return this.round > TOTAL_ROUNDS && this.scores[0] === this.scores[1];
  112 |   }
  113 | 
  114 |   get isMatchOver(): boolean {
  115 |     if (this.round < TOTAL_ROUNDS) return false;
  116 |     if (this.round === TOTAL_ROUNDS) {
  117 |       return (
  118 |         this.history.length === TOTAL_ROUNDS &&
  119 |         this.scores[0] !== this.scores[1]
  120 |       );
  121 |     }
  122 |     return this.scores[0] !== this.scores[1];
  123 |   }
  124 | 
  125 |   get matchWinner(): 1 | 2 | "draw" | null {
  126 |     if (!this.isMatchOver) return null;
  127 |     if (this.scores[0] > this.scores[1]) return 1;
  128 |     if (this.scores[1] > this.scores[0]) return 2;
  129 |     return "draw";
  130 |   }
  131 | }
~~~

## src/games/perfect-timer/TimerClock.ts
SHA-256: 598a3cf21c644a4cfed5892a8452b66ea1abd1f4e2960d7111de52bc445afe4e
~~~text
    1 | /** Foreground monotonic time, also used by pointer events between render frames. */
    2 | export class TimerClock {
    3 |   private started = 0;
    4 |   private carried = 0;
    5 |   private running = false;
    6 |   start(now = performance.now()) {
    7 |     this.started = now;
    8 |     this.carried = 0;
    9 |     this.running = true;
   10 |   }
   11 |   elapsed(now = performance.now()) {
   12 |     return this.carried + (this.running ? Math.max(0, now - this.started) : 0);
   13 |   }
   14 |   pause(now = performance.now()) {
   15 |     this.carried = this.elapsed(now);
   16 |     this.running = false;
   17 |   }
   18 |   resume(now = performance.now()) {
   19 |     if (!this.running) {
   20 |       this.started = now;
   21 |       this.running = true;
   22 |     }
   23 |   }
   24 | }
~~~

## src/games/perfect-timer/TimerRenderer.ts
SHA-256: 3e164bc20a72ed8bf3755c303292c8c258341c4abe5213ae0f89a89cb1433327
~~~text
    1 | import Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    3 | 
    4 | export class TimerRenderer {
    5 |   constructor(private scene: Phaser.Scene) {}
    6 | 
    7 |   drawStopwatch(
    8 |     g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
    9 |     cx: number,
   10 |     cy: number,
   11 |     r: number,
   12 |     isActiveTiming: boolean,
   13 |     pulseTime: number,
   14 |   ) {
   15 |     // 1. Crown and Loop at top
   16 |     g.fillStyle(0xd5dbdb);
   17 |     g.fillRoundedRect(cx - 14, cy - r - 22, 28, 16, 5);
   18 |     g.lineStyle(3, theme.ink);
   19 |     g.strokeRoundedRect(cx - 14, cy - r - 22, 28, 16, 5);
   20 | 
   21 |     // Loop
   22 |     g.lineStyle(3.5, theme.ink);
   23 |     g.strokeCircle(cx, cy - r - 26, 11);
   24 | 
   25 |     // 2. Stopwatch Outer Rim
   26 |     g.fillStyle(0xffffff);
   27 |     g.fillCircle(cx, cy, r);
   28 |     g.lineStyle(5, theme.ink);
   29 |     g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r);
   30 | 
   31 |     // 3. Inner Dial Bezel
   32 |     g.fillStyle(0xfafafa);
   33 |     g.fillCircle(cx, cy, r - 12);
   34 |     g.lineStyle(2, 0xd0d3d4);
   35 |     g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 12);
   36 | 
   37 |     // 4. Dial Ticks (12 main hour positions)
   38 |     for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
   39 |       const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 6;
   40 |       const isQuarter = i % 3 === 0;
   41 |       const innerR = r - (isQuarter ? 26 : 20);
   42 |       const outerR = r - 14;
   43 | 
   44 |       g.lineStyle(isQuarter ? 3 : 1.5, isQuarter ? theme.ink : 0x7f8c8d);
   45 |       g.lineBetween(
   46 |         cx + Math.sin(angle) * innerR,
   47 |         cy - Math.cos(angle) * innerR,
   48 |         cx + Math.sin(angle) * outerR,
   49 |         cy - Math.cos(angle) * outerR,
   50 |       );
   51 |     }
   52 | 
   53 |     // 5. Active state indicator (glowing pulse ring when timer is running invisibly)
   54 |     if (isActiveTiming) {
   55 |       const pulse = (Math.sin(pulseTime * 5) + 1) * 0.5; // 0..1
   56 |       const pulseR = 14 + pulse * 12;
   57 |       const alpha = 0.6 - pulse * 0.4;
   58 | 
   59 |       g.fillStyle(0xe74c3c, alpha);
   60 |       g.fillCircle(cx, cy, pulseR);
   61 | 
   62 |       g.fillStyle(0xe74c3c);
   63 |       g.fillCircle(cx, cy, 10);
   64 |       g.lineStyle(2, theme.ink);
   65 |       g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, 10);
   66 |     } else {
   67 |       // Static central hub pin
   68 |       g.fillStyle(0x34495e);
   69 |       g.fillCircle(cx, cy, 8);
   70 |       g.lineStyle(2, theme.ink);
   71 |       g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, 8);
   72 |     }
   73 |   }
   74 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | # Pong module
    2 | 
    3 | PongPhysics.ts owns swept paddle collisions; PongAI.ts owns prediction; PongState.ts validates saved rallies. Game registration ID is ping-pong: do not rename it. PongGame.ts connects MatchClock to physics and HUD. Never reset the match clock on a goal.
    4 | 
    5 | Read only this folder, the shared contract and required shared helpers. Do not import other games or put rules in core. Own and dispose workers/graphics; use host-owned input. Relevant checks: `tests/unit/engine.test.ts and phase3.test.ts` (browser paths are under tests).
    6 | 
    7 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
~~~

## src/games/pong/PongAI.ts
SHA-256: 83951c38836f5ae63c87319a141bfe83710846931f87fbc57eab5c8292b99833
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type {
    3 |   AIController,
    4 |   Difficulty,
    5 | } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    6 | import type { PongWorld } from "./PongPhysics";
    7 | import { FIELD } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    8 | import { MotionController } from "../../shared/physics/MotionController";
    9 | import { clamp } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
   10 | export function reflectedX(x: number, left: number, right: number) {
   11 |   const width = right - left,
   12 |     phase = (((x - left) % (2 * width)) + 2 * width) % (2 * width);
   13 |   return left + (phase <= width ? phase : 2 * width - phase);
   14 | }
   15 | export class PongAI implements AIController<PongWorld, number> {
   16 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
   17 |   private shotOffset = 0;
   18 |   snapshot() {
   19 |     return {
   20 |       ...this.personality.snapshot(),
   21 |       target: this.target,
   22 |       shotOffset: this.shotOffset,
   23 |     };
   24 |   }
   25 |   private reaction = 0;
   26 |   private target = 210;
   27 |   private control = 210;
   28 |   private motion = new MotionController(210, 0);
   29 |   private aimError = 0;
   30 |   private lastHits = -1;
   31 |   constructor(
   32 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   33 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   34 |   ) {
   35 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   36 |   }
   37 |   reset() {
   38 |     this.reaction = 0;
   39 |     this.target = this.control = 210;
   40 |     this.motion.reset(210, 0);
   41 |     this.lastHits = -1;
   42 |   }
   43 |   update(dt: number, w: PongWorld) {
   44 |     if (w.done) return w.paddles[1].x;
   45 |     const settings = {
   46 |       medium: {
   47 |         delay: 0.24,
   48 |         error: 56,
   49 |         speed: 420,
   50 |         shotScale: 0.35,
   51 |         visionThreshold: FIELD.middle,
   52 |       },
   53 |       hard: {
   54 |         delay: 0.075,
   55 |         error: 14,
   56 |         speed: 820,
   57 |         shotScale: 0.85,
   58 |         visionThreshold: FIELD.bottom,
   59 |       },
   60 |       impossible: {
   61 |         delay: 0.018,
   62 |         error: 0,
   63 |         speed: 1750,
   64 |         shotScale: 1.0,
   65 |         visionThreshold: FIELD.bottom,
   66 |       },
   67 |     }[this.difficulty];
   68 |     if (w.cooldown > 0) {
   69 |       this.target = 210;
   70 |       this.lastHits = -1;
   71 |     }
   72 |     this.reaction -= dt;
   73 |     if (this.reaction <= 0 && w.cooldown <= 0) {
   74 |       this.reaction = this.personality.sample(
   75 |         settings.delay * (0.9 + this.personality.tempo * 0.1),
   76 |         settings.delay * 0.15,
   77 |         0.012,
   78 |       );
   79 |       const b = w.ball,
   80 |         p = w.paddles[1];
   81 |       const t = b.vy < 0 ? Math.max(0, (p.y + 16 - b.y) / b.vy) : 0;
   82 |       if (b.vy < 0) {
   83 |         const bounceX = reflectedX(
   84 |           b.x + b.vx * t,
   85 |           FIELD.left + b.r,
   86 |           FIELD.right - b.r,
   87 |         );
   88 |         // While ball is across the net in opponent half, Medium tracks the direct trajectory
   89 |         // without anticipating multi-wall bank rebounds until the ball crosses midfield.
   90 |         const directX = clamp(
   91 |           b.x + b.vx * Math.min(t, 0.4),
   92 |           FIELD.left + b.r,
   93 |           FIELD.right - b.r,
   94 |         );
   95 |         this.target = b.y > settings.visionThreshold ? directX : bounceX;
   96 |       } else {
   97 |         this.target =
   98 |           210 +
   99 |           (b.x - 210) * [0.38, 0.12, 0.25, 0.3][this.personality.role] +
  100 |           this.personality.side * 8;
  101 |       }
  102 |       if (w.hits !== this.lastHits) {
  103 |         this.lastHits = w.hits;
  104 |         this.aimError = this.personality.sample(
  105 |           0,
  106 |           settings.error,
  107 |           -settings.error,
  108 |         );
  109 |         // Lock a shot plan for this incoming flight. Offset impacts send the ball
  110 |         // away from the observed opponent; never move the paddle outside its rules.
  111 |         const opponent = w.paddles[0],
  112 |           direction =
  113 |             Math.abs(opponent.x - 210) < 25
  114 |               ? this.personality.side
  115 |               : opponent.x > 210
  116 |                 ? -1
  117 |                 : 1;
  118 |         const rawOffset = [21, 5, 14, 25][this.personality.role];
  119 |         this.shotOffset = direction * rawOffset * settings.shotScale;
  120 |       }
  121 |       if (b.vy < 0) {
  122 |         this.target += this.aimError;
  123 |         // Sacrifice the offensive angle when interception already requires a long chase.
  124 |         const intendedTarget = clamp(
  125 |           this.target - this.shotOffset,
  126 |           FIELD.left + 44,
  127 |           FIELD.right - 44,
  128 |         );
  129 |         const reachable =
  130 |           Math.abs(intendedTarget - p.x) < settings.speed * t * 0.65 + 12;
  131 |         if (reachable) {
  132 |           this.target = intendedTarget;
  133 |         } else {
  134 |           this.shotOffset = 0;
  135 |         }
  136 |       }
  137 | 
  138 |       this.target = clamp(this.target, FIELD.left + 44, FIELD.right - 44);
  139 |     }
  140 |     this.control = clamp(
  141 |       this.motion.move(
  142 |         dt,
  143 |         w.paddles[1].x,
  144 |         0,
  145 |         this.target,
  146 |         0,
  147 |         settings.speed * (0.94 + this.personality.tempo * 0.03),
  148 |       ).x,
  149 |       68,
  150 |       352,
  151 |     );
  152 |     return this.control;
  153 |   }
  154 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { FIELD } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    2 | import { clamp } from "../../shared/physics/FixedStep";
    3 | import type { Player } from "../../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    4 | export class PongWorld {
    5 |   ball = { x: 210, y: 381, vx: 110, vy: 340, r: 9 };
    6 |   paddles = [
    7 |     { x: 210, y: 608, vx: 0 },
    8 |     { x: 210, y: 154, vx: 0 },
    9 |   ];
   10 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   11 |   cooldown = 1.35;
   12 |   done = false;
   13 |   hits = 0;
   14 |   constructor(
   15 |     private impact: (x: number, y: number) => void = () => {},
   16 |     private scored: (p: Player) => void = () => {},
   17 |   ) {}
   18 |   step(dt: number, targets: [number, number]) {
   19 |     this.paddles.forEach((p, i) => {
   20 |       const old = p.x;
   21 |       const delta = targets[i] - p.x;
   22 |       const motion =
   23 |         Math.abs(delta) < 0.25 ? 0 : clamp(delta, -1800 * dt, 1800 * dt);
   24 |       p.x += motion;
   25 |       p.x = clamp(p.x, FIELD.left + 44, FIELD.right - 44);
   26 |       p.vx = (p.x - old) / dt;
   27 |     });
   28 |     if (this.done) return;
   29 |     if (this.cooldown > 0) {
   30 |       this.cooldown -= dt;
   31 |       return;
   32 |     }
   33 |     const b = this.ball,
   34 |       oldY = b.y;
   35 |     b.x += b.vx * dt;
   36 |     b.y += b.vy * dt;
   37 |     if (b.x - b.r < FIELD.left) {
   38 |       b.x = FIELD.left + b.r;
   39 |       b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx);
   40 |       this.impact(b.x, b.y);
   41 |     }
   42 |     if (b.x + b.r > FIELD.right) {
   43 |       b.x = FIELD.right - b.r;
   44 |       b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx);
   45 |       this.impact(b.x, b.y);
   46 |     }
   47 |     this.paddles.forEach((p, i) => {
   48 |       const direction = i === 0 ? 1 : -1,
   49 |         contact = p.y - direction * (7 + b.r);
   50 |       if (
   51 |         b.vy * direction > 0 &&
   52 |         (oldY - contact) * direction <= 0 &&
   53 |         (b.y - contact) * direction >= 0 &&
   54 |         Math.abs(b.x - p.x) <= 44 + b.r
   55 |       ) {
   56 |         b.y = contact - direction * 0.1;
   57 |         const hit = clamp((b.x - p.x) / 44, -1, 1),
   58 |           speed = Math.min(820, Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy) * 1.055 + 8);
   59 |         b.vx = clamp(
   60 |           Math.sin(hit * 1.03) * speed + p.vx * 0.13,
   61 |           -speed * 0.88,
   62 |           speed * 0.88,
   63 |         );
   64 |         b.vy = -direction * Math.sqrt(speed * speed - b.vx * b.vx);
   65 |         this.hits++;
   66 |         this.impact(b.x, b.y);
   67 |       }
   68 |     });
   69 |     if (b.y < FIELD.top - b.r * 2) this.goal(1);
   70 |     else if (b.y > FIELD.bottom + b.r * 2) this.goal(2);
   71 |   }
   72 |   private goal(player: Player) {
   73 |     this.scores[player - 1]++;
   74 |     this.done = this.scores[player - 1] >= 5;
   75 |     this.scored(player);
   76 |     this.cooldown = 1.1;
   77 |     this.hits = 0;
   78 |     this.ball.x = 210;
   79 |     this.ball.y = 381;
   80 |     this.ball.vx = (this.scores[0] + this.scores[1]) % 2 ? 110 : -110;
   81 |     this.ball.vy = player === 1 ? -340 : 340;
   82 |   }
   83 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type { PongWorld } from "./PongPhysics";
    2 | import type { MatchClock } from "../../shared/rules/MatchClock";
    3 | export function savePong(w: PongWorld, clock: MatchClock) {
    4 |   return {
    5 |     version: 1,
    6 |     ball: { ...w.ball },
    7 |     paddles: w.paddles.map((p) => ({ ...p })),
    8 |     scores: [...w.scores],
    9 |     cooldown: w.cooldown,
   10 |     hits: w.hits,
   11 |     clock: { remaining: clock.remaining, overtime: clock.overtime },
   12 |   };
   13 | }
   14 | export function restorePong(w: PongWorld, clock: MatchClock, value: unknown) {
   15 |   const d = value as ReturnType<typeof savePong>;
   16 |   if (
   17 |     !d ||
   18 |     d.version !== 1 ||
   19 |     !d.ball ||
   20 |     !d.clock ||
   21 |     !Array.isArray(d.paddles) ||
   22 |     d.paddles.length !== 2 ||
   23 |     !Array.isArray(d.scores) ||
   24 |     d.scores.length !== 2
   25 |   )
   26 |     return false;
   27 |   if (
   28 |     !d.scores.every((n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n < 5) ||
   29 |     !Number.isFinite(d.cooldown) ||
   30 |     d.cooldown < -0.02 ||
   31 |     d.cooldown > 1.35 ||
   32 |     !Number.isSafeInteger(d.hits) ||
   33 |     d.hits < 0
   34 |   )
   35 |     return false;
   36 |   if (
   37 |     typeof d.clock.overtime !== "boolean" ||
   38 |     !Number.isFinite(d.clock.remaining) ||
   39 |     d.clock.remaining <= 0 ||
   40 |     d.clock.remaining > (d.clock.overtime ? 60 : 120)
   41 |   )
   42 |     return false;
   43 |   const b = d.ball;
   44 |   if (
   45 |     !Number.isFinite(b.x + b.y + b.vx + b.vy) ||
   46 |     b.x < 33 ||
   47 |     b.x > 387 ||
   48 |     b.y < 93 ||
   49 |     b.y > 669 ||
   50 |     Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy) > 1000
   51 |   )
   52 |     return false;
   53 |   if (
   54 |     !d.paddles.every(
   55 |       (p) =>
   56 |         p &&
   57 |         Number.isFinite(p.x + p.vx) &&
   58 |         p.x >= 68 &&
   59 |         p.x <= 352 &&
   60 |         Math.abs(p.vx) <= 1800.01,
   61 |     )
   62 |   )
   63 |     return false;
   64 |   Object.assign(w.ball, b, { r: 9 });
   65 |   w.paddles.forEach((p, i) =>
   66 |     Object.assign(p, { x: d.paddles[i].x, vx: d.paddles[i].vx }),
   67 |   );
   68 |   w.scores = [...d.scores] as [number, number];
   69 |   w.cooldown = d.cooldown;
   70 |   w.hits = d.hits;
   71 |   Object.assign(clock, d.clock);
   72 |   return true;
   73 | }
~~~

## src/games/spike-attacks/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 936cbaf8b56b8a5560027d1d47355cefbe5b49ec158f1f4047312a13e75da67a
~~~text
    1 | # Spike Attacks
    2 | 
    3 | One shared 320×320 arena with three selectable layouts (Courtyard, Split Steps, Crosswind) plus seeded Random. Maps.ts owns blocks, spawns and floor colors; config derives variants from it. Each layout has three fixed rectangular cover blocks and four retracting piston lanes on every edge. ArenaPhysics is the source of truth for player radius/speed, block bounds, tip/shaft collisions and each piston's maximum legal extension. Both players share the same physical hazards and have no player-to-player collision. Rendering uses the same bounds; do not restore projectile rain or separate player arenas.
    4 | 
    5 | Rules owns seeded nonrepeating attack directions and `warning → extend → hold → retract → recover` phases. First five survival points; same-step deaths replay. Round resets preserve a separate 120-second foreground deadline; tied scores draw. Warnings shorten from 1.85 to 1.05 seconds, extension speed grows from 620 to 940, and holding time grows modestly. Never remove warnings or generate a pattern with no legal safe position. Keep all integration/collision checks bounded to 120Hz, with no per-frame randomness.
    6 | 
    7 | Spikes are 72 units wide in 80-unit lanes; gaps cannot hide a radius-nine player. Do not restore the old permanently safe grid intersections. All collision/movement, AI and rendering must use the selected map, never the default BLOCKS constant. Tests reject permanent four-direction safe spots and verify exposed AI deaths.
    8 | 
    9 | AI computes bounded visibility routes around expanded blocks on each new wave, then moves through the same targets and speed limits as humans. Seeded personalities select comparable safe routes; difficulty controls reaction delay and route preferences. AI cannot teleport or award points. Medium aims for shelter centers with slower reactions; Hard/Impossible search tighter safe positions. Tests run 100 seeded mixed-difficulty matches across all maps.
   10 | 
   11 | SpikeView interpolates positions/shaft lengths and smooths facing without writing physics. SpikeArt owns the themed arena, original characters, warning lamps and joysticks. Only human players get a joystick or drag subscription (no blue joystick in AI mode); keyboard alternatives stay in setup. Solo accepts arrows or WASD; local uses Orange WASD and Blue arrows. SpikeControls polls gamepads once per existing update (left stick/D-pad, stable player slots, drift dead zone); pause requires neutral before held gamepad input can resume. Keyboard, gamepad and touch share legal movement, with keyboard priority. No global gamepad subscriptions. Pause/cancel/release clear movement. One retained Graphics plus mask/clip, all disposed on exit. No additional RAF, physics engine, timers or textures.
   12 | 
   13 | Tests: spike-attacks.test.ts, expansion-framerate.test.ts, spike-shared.spec.ts and expansion-phase2.spec.ts. See docs/SPIKE_ATTACKS_REFINEMENT.md for reference observations and measured checks.
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import {
    4 |   BLOCKS,
    5 |   clearPoint,
    6 |   safeFrom,
    7 |   type Point,
    8 |   type Block,
    9 | } from "./ArenaPhysics";
   10 | import type { SpikeMatch } from "./Rules";
   11 | function segmentClear(a: Point, b: Point, blocks: readonly Block[]) {
   12 |   // Slab intersection with radius-expanded solids; conservative around corners.
   13 |   return blocks.every((box) => {
   14 |     let lo = 0,
   15 |       hi = 1;
   16 |     for (const axis of ["x", "y"] as const) {
   17 |       const v = b[axis] - a[axis],
   18 |         min = box[axis] - 9,
   19 |         max = box[axis] + (axis === "x" ? box.w : box.h) + 9;
   20 |       if (Math.abs(v) < 1e-9) {
   21 |         if (a[axis] <= min || a[axis] >= max) return true;
   22 |       } else {
   23 |         const t1 = (min - a[axis]) / v,
   24 |           t2 = (max - a[axis]) / v;
   25 |         lo = Math.max(lo, Math.min(t1, t2));
   26 |         hi = Math.min(hi, Math.max(t1, t2));
   27 |       }
   28 |     }
   29 |     return lo > hi || hi <= 1e-7;
   30 |   });
   31 | }
   32 | export function coverRoute(
   33 |   start: Point,
   34 |   goal: Point,
   35 |   blocks: readonly Block[] = BLOCKS,
   36 | ): Point[] {
   37 |   if (!clearPoint(goal, 9.5, blocks)) return [];
   38 |   const nodes = [
   39 |     start,
   40 |     goal,
   41 |     ...blocks
   42 |       .flatMap((b) => [
   43 |         { x: b.x - 11, y: b.y - 11 },
   44 |         { x: b.x + b.w + 11, y: b.y - 11 },
   45 |         { x: b.x - 11, y: b.y + b.h + 11 },
   46 |         { x: b.x + b.w + 11, y: b.y + b.h + 11 },
   47 |       ])
   48 |       .filter((p) => clearPoint(p, 9.5, blocks)),
   49 |   ];
   50 |   const dist = nodes.map(() => Infinity),
   51 |     prev = nodes.map(() => -1),
   52 |     seen = new Set<number>();
   53 |   dist[0] = 0;
   54 |   for (let k = 0; k < nodes.length; k++) {
   55 |     let u = -1;
   56 |     for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++)
   57 |       if (!seen.has(i) && (u < 0 || dist[i] < dist[u])) u = i;
   58 |     if (u < 0 || !Number.isFinite(dist[u])) break;
   59 |     if (u === 1) break;
   60 |     seen.add(u);
   61 |     for (let v = 0; v < nodes.length; v++)
   62 |       if (!seen.has(v) && v !== u && segmentClear(nodes[u], nodes[v], blocks)) {
   63 |         const cost =
   64 |           dist[u] +
   65 |           Math.hypot(nodes[u].x - nodes[v].x, nodes[u].y - nodes[v].y);
   66 |         if (cost < dist[v]) {
   67 |           dist[v] = cost;
   68 |           prev[v] = u;
   69 |         }
   70 |       }
   71 |   }
   72 |   if (!Number.isFinite(dist[1])) return [];
   73 |   const route: Point[] = [];
   74 |   for (let i = 1; i > 0; i = prev[i]) route.unshift(nodes[i]);
   75 |   return route;
   76 | }
   77 | const candidates = Array.from({ length: 15 * 15 }, (_, i) => ({
   78 |   x: 20 + (i % 15) * 20,
   79 |   y: 20 + Math.floor(i / 15) * 20,
   80 | }));
   81 | export class SpikeAI {
   82 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
   83 |   private wave = -1;
   84 |   private delay = 0;
   85 |   private route: Point[] = [];
   86 |   private lastPlanMs = 0;
   87 |   constructor(
   88 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   89 |     seed?: number,
   90 |   ) {
   91 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   92 |   }
   93 |   update(dt: number, m: SpikeMatch, player: 0 | 1 = 1) {
   94 |     if (m.winner || m.between || !m.players[player].alive) return;
   95 |     const p = m.players[player],
   96 |       r = this.personality;
   97 |     if (this.wave !== m.wave) {
   98 |       const started = performance.now();
   99 |       this.wave = m.wave;
  100 |       // Medium aims for the middle of a shelter rather than solving every
  101 |       // safe pixel. The longer, conservative routes can be beaten by a player
  102 |       // who reads the warning sooner; collisions still decide every outcome.
  103 |       const basic = m.map.blocks.map((b) =>
  104 |         m.direction === 0
  105 |           ? { x: b.x + b.w + 21, y: b.y + b.h / 2 }
  106 |           : m.direction === 1
  107 |             ? { x: b.x - 21, y: b.y + b.h / 2 }
  108 |             : m.direction === 2
  109 |               ? { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h + 21 }
  110 |               : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y - 21 },
  111 |       );
  112 |       const choices = (this.difficulty === "medium" ? basic : candidates)
  113 |         .filter((c) => safeFrom(c, m.direction, 0.5, m.map.blocks))
  114 |         .map((goal) => ({ goal, d: Math.hypot(goal.x - p.x, goal.y - p.y) }))
  115 |         .sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d)
  116 |         .slice(0, 20);
  117 |       let best = Infinity;
  118 |       this.route = [];
  119 |       for (const { goal } of choices) {
  120 |         const route = coverRoute(p, goal, m.map.blocks);
  121 |         if (!route.length) continue;
  122 |         let cost = 0,
  123 |           last: Point = p;
  124 |         for (const q of route) {
  125 |           cost += Math.hypot(q.x - last.x, q.y - last.y);
  126 |           last = q;
  127 |         }
  128 |         // Personality only breaks close choices; never randomizes a movement target every frame.
  129 |         cost +=
  130 |           r.rank(Math.round(goal.x + goal.y * 320)) *
  131 |           (this.difficulty === "medium" ? 30 : 6) *
  132 |           (1 + r.role * 0.15);
  133 |         if (cost < best) {
  134 |           best = cost;
  135 |           this.route = route;
  136 |         }
  137 |       }
  138 |       this.delay = r.sample(
  139 |         { medium: 0.68, hard: 0.23, impossible: 0.12 }[this.difficulty],
  140 |         0.08,
  141 |         0.08,
  142 |       );
  143 |       this.lastPlanMs = performance.now() - started;
  144 |     }
  145 |     this.delay -= dt;
  146 |     if (this.delay > 0) return;
  147 |     while (
  148 |       this.route.length > 1 &&
  149 |       Math.hypot(p.x - this.route[0].x, p.y - this.route[0].y) < 1
  150 |     )
  151 |       this.route.shift();
  152 |     const t = this.route[0];
  153 |     if (t) m.target(player, t.x, t.y);
  154 |   }
  155 |   get computationMs() {
  156 |     return this.lastPlanMs;
  157 |   }
  158 | }
~~~

## src/games/spike-attacks/ArenaPhysics.ts
SHA-256: b77167891523fe447e835cb413f1e4a315665bc7cba1822e93808ed29c9ac3c6
~~~text
    1 | import { MAPS } from "./Maps";
    2 | export const SIZE = 320,
    3 |   RADIUS = 9,
    4 |   SPEED = 160,
    5 |   SHAFT = 72;
    6 | export type Point = { x: number; y: number };
    7 | export type Block = Point & { w: number; h: number };
    8 | export type Side = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3;
    9 | export const BLOCKS: readonly Block[] = MAPS[0].blocks;
   10 | export const laneCenter = (lane: number) => 40 + lane * 80;
   11 | export function clearPoint(
   12 |   p: Point,
   13 |   margin = RADIUS + 0.5,
   14 |   blocks: readonly Block[] = BLOCKS,
   15 | ) {
   16 |   return (
   17 |     p.x >= margin &&
   18 |     p.x <= SIZE - margin &&
   19 |     p.y >= margin &&
   20 |     p.y <= SIZE - margin &&
   21 |     blocks.every(
   22 |       (b) =>
   23 |         p.x < b.x - margin ||
   24 |         p.x > b.x + b.w + margin ||
   25 |         p.y < b.y - margin ||
   26 |         p.y > b.y + b.h + margin,
   27 |     )
   28 |   );
   29 | }
   30 | /** Each physical shaft stops at the first block in its lane. */
   31 | export function attackDepth(
   32 |   side: Side,
   33 |   lane: number,
   34 |   blocks: readonly Block[] = BLOCKS,
   35 | ) {
   36 |   const c = laneCenter(lane);
   37 |   let depth = SIZE;
   38 |   for (const b of blocks) {
   39 |     const low = side < 2 ? b.y : b.x,
   40 |       high = low + (side < 2 ? b.h : b.w);
   41 |     if (c + SHAFT / 2 <= low || c - SHAFT / 2 >= high) continue;
   42 |     const face =
   43 |       side === 0
   44 |         ? b.x
   45 |         : side === 1
   46 |           ? SIZE - b.x - b.w
   47 |           : side === 2
   48 |             ? b.y
   49 |             : SIZE - b.y - b.h;
   50 |     depth = Math.min(depth, face);
   51 |   }
   52 |   return depth;
   53 | }
   54 | export function localPoint(p: Point, side: Side): Point {
   55 |   return side === 0
   56 |     ? p
   57 |     : side === 1
   58 |       ? { x: SIZE - p.x, y: p.y }
   59 |       : side === 2
   60 |         ? { x: p.y, y: p.x }
   61 |         : { x: SIZE - p.y, y: p.x };
   62 | }
   63 | function segmentDistance(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point) {
   64 |   const dx = b.x - a.x,
   65 |     dy = b.y - a.y,
   66 |     den = dx * dx + dy * dy;
   67 |   const t = den
   68 |     ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p.x - a.x) * dx + (p.y - a.y) * dy) / den))
   69 |     : 0;
   70 |   return Math.hypot(p.x - a.x - t * dx, p.y - a.y - t * dy);
   71 | }
   72 | /** Circle against shaft plus triangular tip, in edge-local coordinates. */
   73 | export function pistonHits(
   74 |   p: Point,
   75 |   side: Side,
   76 |   lane: number,
   77 |   length: number,
   78 |   radius = RADIUS,
   79 | ) {
   80 |   if (length <= 0) return false;
   81 |   const q = localPoint(p, side),
   82 |     c = laneCenter(lane),
   83 |     base = length - 14;
   84 |   if (
   85 |     q.x + radius < 0 ||
   86 |     q.x - radius > length ||
   87 |     Math.abs(q.y - c) > SHAFT / 2 + radius
   88 |   )
   89 |     return false;
   90 |   const nearX = Math.max(0, Math.min(base, q.x)),
   91 |     nearY = Math.max(c - SHAFT / 2, Math.min(c + SHAFT / 2, q.y));
   92 |   if (base > 0 && Math.hypot(q.x - nearX, q.y - nearY) <= radius) return true;
   93 |   const a = { x: base, y: c - SHAFT / 2 },
   94 |     b = { x: length, y: c },
   95 |     d = { x: base, y: c + SHAFT / 2 };
   96 |   if (
   97 |     q.x >= base &&
   98 |     q.x <= length &&
   99 |     Math.abs(q.y - c) <= ((SHAFT / 2) * (length - q.x)) / 14
  100 |   )
  101 |     return true;
  102 |   return (
  103 |     Math.min(
  104 |       segmentDistance(q, a, b),
  105 |       segmentDistance(q, b, d),
  106 |       segmentDistance(q, d, a),
  107 |     ) <= radius
  108 |   );
  109 | }
  110 | export function safeFrom(
  111 |   p: Point,
  112 |   side: Side,
  113 |   margin = 0.5,
  114 |   blocks: readonly Block[] = BLOCKS,
  115 | ) {
  116 |   return (
  117 |     clearPoint(p, RADIUS + 0.5, blocks) &&
  118 |     [0, 1, 2, 3].every(
  119 |       (l) =>
  120 |         !pistonHits(p, side, l, attackDepth(side, l, blocks), RADIUS + margin),
  121 |     )
  122 |   );
  123 | }
  124 | /** Bounded substeps prevent tunnelling; separate axes slide against block faces. */
  125 | export function movePlayer(
  126 |   p: Point,
  127 |   dx: number,
  128 |   dy: number,
  129 |   dt: number,
  130 |   blocks: readonly Block[] = BLOCKS,
  131 | ) {
  132 |   const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  133 |   if (!len) return;
  134 |   const distance = Math.min(SPEED * dt, len),
  135 |     parts = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(distance / 3));
  136 |   const sx = ((dx / len) * distance) / parts,
  137 |     sy = ((dy / len) * distance) / parts;
  138 |   for (let i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
  139 |     const oldX = p.x,
  140 |       oldY = p.y;
  141 |     p.x = Math.max(RADIUS, Math.min(SIZE - RADIUS, p.x + sx));
  142 |     for (const b of blocks)
  143 |       if (
  144 |         p.y > b.y - RADIUS &&
  145 |         p.y < b.y + b.h + RADIUS &&
  146 |         p.x > b.x - RADIUS &&
  147 |         p.x < b.x + b.w + RADIUS
  148 |       )
  149 |         p.x =
  150 |           oldX <= b.x - RADIUS
  151 |             ? b.x - RADIUS
  152 |             : oldX >= b.x + b.w + RADIUS
  153 |               ? b.x + b.w + RADIUS
  154 |               : oldX;
  155 |     p.y = Math.max(RADIUS, Math.min(SIZE - RADIUS, p.y + sy));
  156 |     for (const b of blocks)
  157 |       if (
  158 |         p.x > b.x - RADIUS &&
  159 |         p.x < b.x + b.w + RADIUS &&
  160 |         p.y > b.y - RADIUS &&
  161 |         p.y < b.y + b.h + RADIUS
  162 |       )
  163 |         p.y =
  164 |           oldY <= b.y - RADIUS
  165 |             ? b.y - RADIUS
  166 |             : oldY >= b.y + b.h + RADIUS
  167 |               ? b.y + b.h + RADIUS
  168 |               : oldY;
  169 |   }
  170 | }
~~~

## src/games/spike-attacks/Rules.ts
SHA-256: f5583cc2f384c3a5d068e47d8ce5b9b9749d2a8c2be2c02ed6ff004158188825
~~~text
    1 | import { selectMap, type SpikeMap } from "./Maps";
    2 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    3 | import { attackDepth, movePlayer, pistonHits, type Side } from "./ArenaPhysics";
    4 | export type Phase = "warning" | "extend" | "hold" | "retract" | "recover";
    5 | export interface Survivor {
    6 |   x: number;
    7 |   y: number;
    8 |   tx: number;
    9 |   ty: number;
   10 |   alive: boolean;
   11 | }
   12 | export class SpikeMatch {
   13 |   readonly map: SpikeMap;
   14 |   players: [Survivor, Survivor];
   15 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   16 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw" | null = null;
   17 |   wave = 1;
   18 |   round = 1;
   19 |   direction: Side = 0;
   20 |   phase: Phase = "warning";
   21 |   phaseAge = 0;
   22 |   warning = 1.85;
   23 |   between = 0;
   24 |   elapsed = 0;
   25 |   total = 0;
   26 |   readonly lengths = [0, 0, 0, 0];
   27 |   private rng: MatchRandom;
   28 |   constructor(
   29 |     readonly seed: number,
   30 |     mapId?: string,
   31 |   ) {
   32 |     this.map = selectMap(mapId, seed);
   33 |     this.players = [this.player(0), this.player(1)];
   34 |     this.rng = new MatchRandom(seed);
   35 |     this.direction = Math.floor(this.rng.next() * 4) as Side;
   36 |   }
   37 |   private player(i: number): Survivor {
   38 |     return {
   39 |       ...this.map.spawns[i],
   40 |       tx: this.map.spawns[i].x,
   41 |       ty: this.map.spawns[i].y,
   42 |       alive: true,
   43 |     };
   44 |   }
   45 |   warningDuration() {
   46 |     return Math.max(1.05, 1.85 - (this.wave - 1) * 0.045);
   47 |   }
   48 |   extensionSpeed() {
   49 |     return Math.min(940, 620 + (this.wave - 1) * 18);
   50 |   }
   51 |   get remaining() {
   52 |     return Math.max(0, 120 - this.elapsed);
   53 |   }
   54 |   advanceClock(dt: number) {
   55 |     if (this.winner) return;
   56 |     this.elapsed = Math.min(120, this.elapsed + Math.max(0, dt));
   57 |     if (this.elapsed >= 120)
   58 |       this.winner =
   59 |         this.scores[0] === this.scores[1]
   60 |           ? "draw"
   61 |           : this.scores[0] > this.scores[1]
   62 |             ? 1
   63 |             : 2;
   64 |   }
   65 |   target(i: 0 | 1, x: number, y: number) {
   66 |     if (
   67 |       this.winner ||
   68 |       this.between ||
   69 |       !this.players[i].alive ||
   70 |       !Number.isFinite(x + y)
   71 |     )
   72 |       return;
   73 |     this.players[i].tx = Math.max(9, Math.min(311, x));
   74 |     this.players[i].ty = Math.max(9, Math.min(311, y));
   75 |   }
   76 |   stop(i: 0 | 1) {
   77 |     this.players[i].tx = this.players[i].x;
   78 |     this.players[i].ty = this.players[i].y;
   79 |   }
   80 |   private nextWave() {
   81 |     this.wave++;
   82 |     // A repeated side would reward camping. Changes are seeded and fully telegraphed.
   83 |     this.direction = ((this.direction + 1 + Math.floor(this.rng.next() * 3)) %
   84 |       4) as Side;
   85 |     this.phase = "warning";
   86 |     this.phaseAge = 0;
   87 |     this.warning = this.warningDuration();
   88 |     this.lengths.fill(0);
   89 |   }
   90 |   step(dt: number) {
   91 |     // Keep all collision/phase checks bounded, including direct simulation callers.
   92 |     for (
   93 |       let left = Math.max(0, Math.min(dt, 0.1));
   94 |       left > 1e-9;
   95 |       left -= 1 / 120
   96 |     )
   97 |       this.tick(Math.min(left, 1 / 120));
   98 |   }
   99 |   private tick(dt: number) {
  100 |     if (this.winner) return;
  101 |     this.total += dt;
  102 |     if (this.between) {
  103 |       this.between = Math.max(0, this.between - dt);
  104 |       if (this.between < 1e-8) {
  105 |         this.between = 0;
  106 |         this.round++;
  107 |         this.players = [this.player(0), this.player(1)];
  108 |         this.nextWave();
  109 |       }
  110 |       return;
  111 |     }
  112 |     const old = this.lengths.slice();
  113 |     this.phaseAge += dt;
  114 |     if (this.phase === "warning") {
  115 |       this.warning = Math.max(0, this.warningDuration() - this.phaseAge);
  116 |       if (this.warning < 1e-8) {
  117 |         this.phase = "extend";
  118 |         this.phaseAge = 0;
  119 |         this.warning = 0;
  120 |       }
  121 |     } else if (this.phase === "extend") {
  122 |       for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++)
  123 |         this.lengths[i] = Math.min(
  124 |           attackDepth(this.direction, i, this.map.blocks),
  125 |           this.phaseAge * this.extensionSpeed(),
  126 |         );
  127 |       if (this.phaseAge >= 320 / this.extensionSpeed()) {
  128 |         this.phase = "hold";
  129 |         this.phaseAge = 0;
  130 |       }
  131 |     } else if (this.phase === "hold") {
  132 |       if (this.phaseAge >= 0.32 + Math.min(0.18, this.wave * 0.008)) {
  133 |         this.phase = "retract";
  134 |         this.phaseAge = 0;
  135 |       }
  136 |     } else if (this.phase === "retract") {
  137 |       const t = Math.min(1, this.phaseAge / 0.64),
  138 |         ease = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
  139 |       for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++)
  140 |         this.lengths[i] =
  141 |           attackDepth(this.direction, i, this.map.blocks) * (1 - ease);
  142 |       if (t === 1) {
  143 |         this.lengths.fill(0);
  144 |         this.phase = "recover";
  145 |         this.phaseAge = 0;
  146 |       }
  147 |     } else if (this.phaseAge >= 0.18) this.nextWave();
  148 |     for (const p of this.players) {
  149 |       movePlayer(p, p.tx - p.x, p.ty - p.y, dt, this.map.blocks);
  150 |       for (let lane = 0; lane < 4; lane++)
  151 |         if (
  152 |           pistonHits(
  153 |             p,
  154 |             this.direction,
  155 |             lane,
  156 |             Math.max(old[lane], this.lengths[lane]),
  157 |           )
  158 |         )
  159 |           p.alive = false;
  160 |     }
  161 |     if (this.players.some((p) => !p.alive)) {
  162 |       if (this.players[0].alive !== this.players[1].alive)
  163 |         this.scores[this.players[0].alive ? 0 : 1]++;
  164 |       this.between = 1.15;
  165 |       if (this.scores.some((s) => s >= 5))
  166 |         this.winner = this.scores[0] >= 5 ? 1 : 2;
  167 |     }
  168 |   }
  169 | }
~~~

## src/games/spike-attacks/SpikeControls.ts
SHA-256: 392344e8345da3bbade7b6df495b693502c4173d4a470d435f125f544eebbfaa
~~~text
    1 | export type Direction = { x: number; y: number };
    2 | export const KEY_CODES = [
    3 |   "KeyW",
    4 |   "KeyA",
    5 |   "KeyS",
    6 |   "KeyD",
    7 |   "ArrowUp",
    8 |   "ArrowLeft",
    9 |   "ArrowDown",
   10 |   "ArrowRight",
   11 | ];
   12 | const ZERO = (): Direction => ({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   13 | export function keyboardDirection(
   14 |   keys: ReadonlySet<string>,
   15 |   player: 0 | 1,
   16 |   solo: boolean,
   17 | ): Direction {
   18 |   const wasd = player === 0,
   19 |     arrows = player === 1 || (player === 0 && solo);
   20 |   return {
   21 |     x:
   22 |       Number((wasd && keys.has("KeyD")) || (arrows && keys.has("ArrowRight"))) -
   23 |       Number((wasd && keys.has("KeyA")) || (arrows && keys.has("ArrowLeft"))),
   24 |     y:
   25 |       Number((wasd && keys.has("KeyS")) || (arrows && keys.has("ArrowDown"))) -
   26 |       Number((wasd && keys.has("KeyW")) || (arrows && keys.has("ArrowUp"))),
   27 |   };
   28 | }
   29 | type Pad = Pick<Gamepad, "index" | "connected" | "axes" | "buttons">;
   30 | function direction(pad: Pad): Direction {
   31 |   const pressed = (i: number) => pad.buttons[i]?.pressed === true;
   32 |   const dx = Number(pressed(15)) - Number(pressed(14)),
   33 |     dy = Number(pressed(13)) - Number(pressed(12));
   34 |   if (dx || dy) return { x: dx, y: dy };
   35 |   const x = Number.isFinite(pad.axes[0]) ? pad.axes[0] : 0,
   36 |     y = Number.isFinite(pad.axes[1]) ? pad.axes[1] : 0;
   37 |   const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
   38 |   if (length < 0.2) return ZERO();
   39 |   const scale = Math.min(1, (length - 0.2) / 0.8) / length;
   40 |   return { x: x * scale, y: y * scale };
   41 | }
   42 | /** Poll inside the existing game update. Stable player slots, no listeners or extra loop. */
   43 | export class SpikeGamepads {
   44 |   private slots = new Map<number, 0 | 1>();
   45 |   private neutralRequired = new Set<number>();
   46 |   read(pads: readonly (Pad | null)[], solo: boolean): [Direction, Direction] {
   47 |     const output: [Direction, Direction] = [ZERO(), ZERO()];
   48 |     const connected = pads
   49 |       .filter((p): p is Pad => !!p?.connected)
   50 |       .sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
   51 |     for (const index of this.slots.keys())
   52 |       if (!connected.some((p) => p.index === index)) {
   53 |         this.slots.delete(index);
   54 |         this.neutralRequired.delete(index);
   55 |       }
   56 |     for (const pad of connected) {
   57 |       let slot = this.slots.get(pad.index);
   58 |       if (slot === undefined) {
   59 |         const occupied = [...this.slots.values()];
   60 |         slot = !occupied.includes(0)
   61 |           ? 0
   62 |           : !solo && !occupied.includes(1)
   63 |             ? 1
   64 |             : undefined;
   65 |         if (slot === undefined) continue;
   66 |         this.slots.set(pad.index, slot);
   67 |       }
   68 |       if (solo && slot === 1) continue;
   69 |       const d = direction(pad);
   70 |       if (this.neutralRequired.has(pad.index)) {
   71 |         if (!d.x && !d.y) this.neutralRequired.delete(pad.index);
   72 |         continue;
   73 |       }
   74 |       output[slot] = d;
   75 |     }
   76 |     return output;
   77 |   }
   78 |   poll(solo: boolean): [Direction, Direction] {
   79 |     try {
   80 |       return this.read(
   81 |         typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.getGamepads
   82 |           ? [...navigator.getGamepads()]
   83 |           : [],
   84 |         solo,
   85 |       );
   86 |     } catch {
   87 |       return [ZERO(), ZERO()];
   88 |     }
   89 |   }
   90 |   pause() {
   91 |     for (const index of this.slots.keys()) this.neutralRequired.add(index);
   92 |   }
   93 |   dispose() {
   94 |     this.slots.clear();
   95 |     this.neutralRequired.clear();
   96 |   }
   97 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import type { GameContext, MiniGame } from "../../shared/contracts/GameModule";

    4 | import { freshSeed } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";

    9 | import { drawArena, JOYS, type Stick } from "./SpikeArt";
   10 | export class SpikeGame implements MiniGame {
   11 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   12 |   private m = new SpikeMatch(freshSeed());
   13 |   private ai?: SpikeAI;
   14 |   private g!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;

   23 |     { x: 0, y: 0, source: "none" },
   24 |     { x: 0, y: 0, source: "none" },
   25 |   ];
   26 |   private sticks: Stick[] = [
   27 |     { x: 0, y: 0, active: false },
   28 |     { x: 0, y: 0, active: false },
   29 |   ];
   30 |   private paused = false;
   31 |   private done = false;
   32 |   private scores = "";

   34 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {

   38 |     this.clip.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRoundedRect(22, 110, 376, 542, 22);
   39 |     this.mask = this.clip.createGeometryMask();
   40 |     this.g.setMask(this.mask);
   41 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai") {
   42 |       this.ai = new SpikeAI(ctx.options.difficulty);
   43 |     }
   44 |     this.m = new SpikeMatch(
   45 |       this.ai?.personality.seed ?? freshSeed(),
   46 |       ctx.options.variant,
   47 |     );
   48 |     for (const i of [0, 1] as const) {
   49 |       if (i === 1 && this.ai) continue;
   50 |       const center = JOYS[i];
   51 |       ctx.input.drag(
   52 |         (x, y) => {
   53 |           if (
   54 |             this.paused ||
   55 |             this.done ||
   56 |             Math.hypot(x - center.x, y - center.y) > 58
   57 |           )
   58 |             return false;
   59 |           this.sticks[i].active = true;
   60 |           this.stick(i, x, y);
   61 |           return true;
   62 |         },
   63 |         (x, y) => this.stick(i, x, y),

   65 |         () => this.release(i),
   66 |       );
   67 |     }
   68 |     this.keys = ctx.input.keys(KEY_CODES);
   69 |     ctx.setHint("");
   70 |     ctx.setScore(0, 0);
   71 |     ctx.setClock("2:00", false);
   72 |     this.view.reset(this.m);
   73 |     this.pose = this.view.sample(this.m, 1, 0);
   74 |     this.draw();
   75 |     ctx.audio.play("start");
   76 |   }

   78 |     const dx = x - JOYS[i].x,
   79 |       dy = y - JOYS[i].y,
   80 |       len = Math.hypot(dx, dy),

   82 |     this.sticks[i].x = len < 5 ? 0 : dx / scale;

   85 |   private release(i: 0 | 1) {

   87 |     this.m.stop(i);
   88 |   }
   89 |   update(dt: number) {

  119 |           );

  142 |       if (this.scores) this.ctx.audio.play("goal", 0.65);
  143 |       this.scores = this.m.scores.join();
  144 |       this.ctx.setScore(...this.m.scores);
  145 |     }
  146 |     const seconds = Math.ceil(this.m.remaining);
  147 |     this.ctx.setClock(
  148 |       `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  149 |       seconds <= 10,
  150 |     );
  151 |     this.pose = this.view.sample(
  152 |       this.m,
  153 |       this.fixed.fraction,
  154 |       Math.min(dt, 0.1),
  155 |     );
  156 |     this.ctx.reportAI(this.ai?.computationMs ?? 0);
  157 |     this.draw();
  158 |     if (this.m.winner) {
  159 |       this.finishAge += dt;
  160 |       if (this.finishAge > 0.7) {
  161 |         this.done = true;
  162 |         this.ctx.finish({ winner: this.m.winner, scores: this.m.scores });
  163 |       }
  164 |     }
  165 |   }
  166 |   private draw() {
  167 |     this.g.clear();
  168 |     drawArena(
  169 |       this.g,
  170 |       this.m,
  171 |       this.pose!,
  172 |       this.sticks.map((stick, i) =>
  173 |         stick.active
  174 |           ? stick
  175 |           : { ...stick, x: this.movement[i].x, y: this.movement[i].y },
  176 |       ),
  177 |       !!this.ai,
  178 |     );
  179 |   }
  180 |   pause() {
  181 |     this.paused = true;
  182 |     this.fixed.reset();
  183 |     this.pads.pause();
  184 |     this.movement.forEach((d) => {
  185 |       d.x = 0;
  186 |       d.y = 0;
  187 |       d.source = "none";
  188 |     });
  189 |     this.release(0);
  190 |     this.release(1);
  191 |   }
  192 |   resume() {
  193 |     this.paused = false;
  194 |   }
  195 |   dispose() {
  196 |     this.done = true;
  197 |     this.pads.dispose();
  198 |     this.g.destroy();
  199 |     this.mask.destroy();
  200 |     this.clip.destroy();
  201 |   }
  202 |   snapshot() {
  203 |     return {
  204 |       sharedArena: true,
  205 |       map: this.m.map.id,
  206 |       visibleControls: this.ai ? [0] : [0, 1],
  207 |       players: this.m.players,
  208 |       scores: this.m.scores,
  209 |       warning: this.m.warning,
  210 |       direction: this.m.direction,
  211 |       wave: this.m.wave,
  212 |       round: this.m.round,
  213 |       phase: this.m.phase,
  214 |       lengths: this.m.lengths,
  215 |       between: this.m.between,
  216 |       winner: this.m.winner,
  217 |       remaining: this.m.remaining,
  218 |       sticks: this.sticks,
  219 |       controls: this.movement,
  220 |       renderState: this.pose,
  221 |       ai: this.ai?.personality.snapshot(),
  222 |     };
  223 |   }
  224 | }
~~~

## src/games/spike-attacks/SpikeView.ts
SHA-256: 7533dba51d34328087f6c339518cbc02f8462488000c1cc8a8ef3f93ad1743ba
~~~text
    1 | import type { SpikeMatch } from "./Rules";
    2 | /** Presentation-only interpolation; neither camera nor animation can move a collider. */
    3 | export class SpikeView {
    4 |   private previous = [
    5 |     { x: 108, y: 208 },
    6 |     { x: 212, y: 208 },
    7 |   ];
    8 |   private lengths = [0, 0, 0, 0];
    9 |   private angles = [0, 0];
   10 |   capture(m: SpikeMatch) {
   11 |     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++)
   12 |       Object.assign(this.previous[i], { x: m.players[i].x, y: m.players[i].y });
   13 |     this.lengths.splice(0, 4, ...m.lengths);
   14 |   }
   15 |   reset(m: SpikeMatch) {
   16 |     this.capture(m);
   17 |     this.angles = [0, 0];
   18 |   }
   19 |   sample(m: SpikeMatch, alpha: number, dt: number) {
   20 |     const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, alpha));
   21 |     return {
   22 |       lengths: m.lengths.map(
   23 |         (n, i) => this.lengths[i] + (n - this.lengths[i]) * t,
   24 |       ),
   25 |       players: m.players.map((p, i) => {
   26 |         const dx = p.tx - p.x,
   27 |           dy = p.ty - p.y,
   28 |           moving = Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 1;
   29 |         if (moving) {
   30 |           const goal = Math.atan2(dy, dx) + Math.PI / 2;
   31 |           const delta = Math.atan2(
   32 |             Math.sin(goal - this.angles[i]),
   33 |             Math.cos(goal - this.angles[i]),
   34 |           );
   35 |           this.angles[i] += delta * (1 - Math.exp(-18 * dt));
   36 |         }
   37 |         return {
   38 |           ...p,
   39 |           x: this.previous[i].x + (p.x - this.previous[i].x) * t,
   40 |           y: this.previous[i].y + (p.y - this.previous[i].y) * t,
   41 |           angle: this.angles[i],
   42 |           moving,
   43 |         };
   44 |       }),
   45 |     };
   46 |   }
   47 | }
~~~

## src/games/tic-tac-toe/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: a8f516f9fc39d84fe6e49d3d4c4597c0ed79f43f26b4f5a50cd50b1e240f9f38
~~~text
    1 | # Tic-Tac-Toe module
    2 | 
    3 | The entry factory lazily imports classic/ClassicGame.ts or ultimate/UltimateGame.ts. Each variant owns its rules and AI. shared/lines.ts contains only module-local winning lines. UltimateRules is authoritative for routing/closed boards and restores legal move histories. UltimateGame maps board*9+cell into normal/focus coordinates; preserve that mapping. Expensive Ultimate search runs in a cancellable worker; Classic Impossible is exhaustively tested as unbeatable. Do not claim perfect Ultimate play.
    4 | 
    5 | Read only this folder, the shared contract and required shared helpers. Do not import other games or put rules in core. Own and dispose workers/graphics; use host-owned input. Relevant checks: `tests/unit/engine.test.ts, phase2.test.ts and browser/phase2.spec.ts` (browser paths are under tests).
    6 | 
    7 | AI identities use the lazy `shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts` utility; keep tactical parameters inside this module and preserve personality across rounds. See `docs/AI_REFINEMENT.md` for seeded replay and audit commands. Preserve legal actions and bounded worker/motion behavior when adding variety.
~~~

## src/games/tic-tac-toe/classic/ClassicAI.ts
SHA-256: 0f419daa3404157806075e523610686fa016cb8940eecef674bab81dbf167088
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, type SeedInput } from "../../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    3 | import type { Player } from "../../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    4 | import { WIN_LINES } from "../shared/lines";
    5 | import type { TicTacToeBoard } from "./ClassicRules";
    6 | const ORDER = [4, 0, 2, 6, 8, 1, 3, 5, 7];
    7 | /** Full minimax for Impossible; alpha-beta bounds keep this nine-cell search tiny. */
    8 | export function classicMove(
    9 |   board: TicTacToeBoard,
   10 |   difficulty: Difficulty,
   11 |   random = Math.random,
   12 |   preference: (move: number) => number = () => 1,
   13 | ): number {
   14 |   const cells = [...board.cells],
   15 |     player = board.turn;
   16 |   const legal = ORDER.filter((i) => !cells[i]);
   17 |   if (board.winner || !legal.length) return -1;
   18 |   if (difficulty === "medium" && random() < 0.32)
   19 |     return legal[Math.floor(random() * legal.length)];
   20 |   const limit =
   21 |     difficulty === "impossible"
   22 |       ? 9
   23 |       : difficulty === "hard"
   24 |         ? legal.length >= 8
   25 |           ? 9
   26 |           : 5
   27 |         : 2;
   28 |   function search(
   29 |     turn: Player,
   30 |     depth: number,
   31 |     alpha: number,
   32 |     beta: number,
   33 |   ): number {
   34 |     for (const line of WIN_LINES) {
   35 |       const p = cells[line[0]];
   36 |       if (p && line.every((i) => cells[i] === p))
   37 |         return p === player ? 100 + depth : -100 - depth;
   38 |     }
   39 |     if (cells.every(Boolean)) return 0;
   40 |     if (depth === 0) {
   41 |       let score = 0;
   42 |       for (const line of WIN_LINES) {
   43 |         const own = line.filter((i) => cells[i] === player).length,
   44 |           other = line.filter((i) => cells[i] && cells[i] !== player).length;
   45 |         if (!other) score += own * own;
   46 |         if (!own) score -= other * other;
   47 |       }
   48 |       return score;
   49 |     }
   50 |     let value = turn === player ? -Infinity : Infinity;
   51 |     for (const i of ORDER) {
   52 |       if (cells[i]) continue;
   53 |       cells[i] = turn;
   54 |       const score = search(turn === 1 ? 2 : 1, depth - 1, alpha, beta);
   55 |       cells[i] = null;
   56 |       if (turn === player) {
   57 |         value = Math.max(value, score);
   58 |         alpha = Math.max(alpha, value);
   59 |       } else {
   60 |         value = Math.min(value, score);
   61 |         beta = Math.min(beta, value);
   62 |       }
   63 |       if (beta <= alpha) break;
   64 |     }
   65 |     return value;
   66 |   }
   67 |   let best = -Infinity;
   68 |   let choices: number[] = [];
   69 |   for (const i of legal) {
   70 |     cells[i] = player;
   71 |     const score = search(player === 1 ? 2 : 1, limit - 1, -Infinity, Infinity);
   72 |     cells[i] = null;
   73 |     if (score > best) {
   74 |       best = score;
   75 |       choices = [i];
   76 |     } else if (score === best) choices.push(i);
   77 |   }
   78 |   const weights = choices.map(preference),
   79 |     total = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
   80 |   let value = random() * total;
   81 |   for (let i = 0; i < choices.length; i++) {
   82 |     value -= weights[i];
   83 |     if (value <= 0) return choices[i];
   84 |   }
   85 |   return choices.at(-1)!;
   86 | }
   87 | 
   88 | /** Natural opening variety only among equally evaluated moves; Impossible remains exact. */
   89 | export class ClassicAI {
   90 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
   91 |   readonly delay: number;
   92 |   constructor(
   93 |     readonly difficulty: Difficulty,
   94 |     seed?: SeedInput,
   95 |   ) {
   96 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   97 |     this.delay = this.personality.sample(
   98 |       { medium: 0.6, hard: 0.4, impossible: 0.25 }[difficulty],
   99 |       0.1,
  100 |       0.18,
  101 |     );
  102 |   }
  103 |   choose(board: TicTacToeBoard) {
  104 |     const role = this.personality.role;
  105 |     return classicMove(
  106 |       board,
  107 |       this.difficulty,
  108 |       new MatchRandom(
  109 |         this.personality.turnSeed(board.cells.filter(Boolean).length),
  110 |       ).next,
  111 |       (move) =>
  112 |         1 +
  113 |         (role === 0 && move === 4
  114 |           ? 3
  115 |           : role === 1 && [0, 2, 6, 8].includes(move)
  116 |             ? 3
  117 |             : role === 2 && [1, 3, 5, 7].includes(move)
  118 |               ? 3
  119 |               : role === 3 && move % 3 === (this.personality.side < 0 ? 0 : 2)
  120 |                 ? 3
  121 |                 : 0),
  122 |     );
  123 |   }
  124 |   snapshot() {
  125 |     return {
  126 |       ...this.personality.snapshot(),
  127 |       strategy: ["center", "corners", "edges", "flank"][this.personality.role],
  128 |     };
  129 |   }
  130 | }
~~~

## src/games/tic-tac-toe/classic/ClassicGame.ts
SHA-256: 1352e4af2040ffecfaf29a5823c5115d172f67485594737654be6da6b149f7d7
~~~text
    1 | import { turnBackground } from "../../../shared/components/TurnView";
    2 | import { restoredAISeed } from "../../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    3 | import { ClassicAI } from "./ClassicAI";
    4 | import Phaser from "phaser";
    5 | import type {
    6 |   GameContext,
    7 |   MiniGame,
    8 | } from "../../../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    9 | import { theme } from "../../../core/ThemeManager";
   10 | import { rounded, symbol, label } from "../../../shared/components/drawing";
   11 | import { TicTacToeBoard } from "./ClassicRules";
   12 | export class TicTacToe implements MiniGame {
   13 |   private ctx!: GameContext;
   14 |   private ai?: ClassicAI;
   15 |   private board = new TicTacToeBoard();
   16 |   private graphics!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   17 |   private bg!: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics;
   18 |   private turn!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   19 |   private ages = Array(9).fill(0);
   20 |   private endAge = 0;
   21 |   private reported = false;
   22 |   private paused = false;
   23 |   private elapsed = 0;
   24 |   private thinkFor = 0;
   25 |   initialize(ctx: GameContext) {
   26 |     this.ctx = ctx;
   27 |     this.board = TicTacToeBoard.restore(ctx.restoredState);
   28 |     if (ctx.options.mode === "ai")
   29 |       this.ai = new ClassicAI(
   30 |         ctx.options.difficulty,
   31 |         restoredAISeed(ctx.restoredState),
   32 |       );
   33 |     this.ages = this.board.cells.map((p) => (p ? 1 : 0));
   34 |     ctx.setScore(0, 0);
   35 |     ctx.setHint("");
   36 |     this.bg = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   37 |     this.turn = label(ctx.scene, 210, 172, "", 12);
   38 |     this.graphics = ctx.scene.add.graphics();
   39 |     ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
   40 |       if (
   41 |         this.paused ||
   42 |         (ctx.options.mode === "ai" && this.board.turn === 2) ||
   43 |         this.elapsed < 0.2 ||
   44 |         x < 48 ||
   45 |         x >= 372 ||
   46 |         y < 219 ||
   47 |         y >= 543
   48 |       )
   49 |         return;
   50 |       const cell = Math.floor((y - 219) / 108) * 3 + Math.floor((x - 48) / 108);
   51 |       this.place(cell);
   52 |     });
   53 |   }
   54 |   private place(cell: number) {
   55 |     if (!this.board.play(cell)) return;
   56 |     this.ages[cell] = 0.001;
   57 |     this.thinkFor = 0;
   58 |     this.ctx.audio.play("tap");
   59 |     this.ctx.saveState({ ...this.board.save(), ai: this.ai?.snapshot() });
   60 |     this.refreshTurn();
   61 |   }
   62 |   private refreshTurn() {
   63 |     this.bg.clear();
   64 |     rounded(this.bg, 24, 112, 372, 538, 20, turnBackground(this.board.turn), 4);
   65 |     rounded(this.bg, 48, 219, 324, 324, 18, theme.white, 3);
   66 |     this.bg
   67 |       .lineStyle(4, theme.ink)
   68 |       .lineBetween(156, 234, 156, 528)
   69 |       .lineBetween(264, 234, 264, 528)
   70 |       .lineBetween(63, 327, 357, 327)
   71 |       .lineBetween(63, 435, 357, 435);
   72 |     this.turn.setText(
   73 |       this.board.winner
   74 |         ? this.board.winner === "draw"
   75 |           ? "A PERFECT STANDOFF."
   76 |           : "THREE’S A CHARM!"
   77 |         : this.board.turn === 1
   78 |           ? ""
   79 |           : this.ctx.options.mode === "ai"
   80 |             ? "…"
   81 |             : "",
   82 |     );
   83 |   }
   84 |   update(dt: number) {
   85 |     if (this.paused) return;
   86 |     this.elapsed += dt;
   87 |     this.refreshTurn();
   88 |     if (
   89 |       !this.board.winner &&
   90 |       this.ctx.options.mode === "ai" &&
   91 |       this.board.turn === 2
   92 |     ) {
   93 |       this.thinkFor += dt;
   94 |       if (this.thinkFor > Math.max(0.75, this.ai!.delay))
   95 |         this.place(this.ai!.choose(this.board));
   96 |     }
   97 |     const g = this.graphics;
   98 |     g.clear();
   99 |     this.board.cells.forEach((p, i) => {
  100 |       if (!p) return;
  101 |       this.ages[i] += dt;
  102 |       const t = Math.min(1, this.ages[i] / 0.2),
  103 |         s = 1 + 2.7 * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + 1.7 * Math.pow(t - 1, 2);
  104 |       symbol(
  105 |         g,
  106 |         102 + (i % 3) * 108,
  107 |         273 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 108,
  108 |         p,
  109 |         25,
  110 |         Math.max(0.01, s),
  111 |       );
  112 |     });
  113 |     if (this.board.winner) {
  114 |       this.endAge += dt;
  115 |       if (this.board.line) {
  116 |         const a = this.board.line[0],
  117 |           b = this.board.line[2],
  118 |           t = Math.min(1, this.endAge / 0.35);
  119 |         const x = 102 + (a % 3) * 108,
  120 |           y = 273 + Math.floor(a / 3) * 108;
  121 |         g.lineStyle(8, theme.ink, 0.65).lineBetween(
  122 |           x,
  123 |           y,
  124 |           x + ((b % 3) - (a % 3)) * 108 * t,
  125 |           y + (Math.floor(b / 3) - Math.floor(a / 3)) * 108 * t,
  126 |         );
  127 |       }
  128 |       if (this.endAge > 0.7 && !this.reported) {
  129 |         this.reported = true;
  130 |         const winner = this.board.winner;
  131 |         this.ctx.setScore(winner === 1 ? 1 : 0, winner === 2 ? 1 : 0);
  132 |         this.ctx.finish({
  133 |           winner,
  134 |           scores: winner === 1 ? [1, 0] : winner === 2 ? [0, 1] : [0, 0],
  135 |         });
  136 |       }
  137 |     } else {
  138 |       symbol(g, 210, 593, this.board.turn, 15);
  139 |     }
  140 |   }
  141 |   pause() {
  142 |     this.paused = true;
  143 |   }
  144 |   resume() {
  145 |     this.paused = false;
  146 |   }
  147 |   dispose() {
  148 |     this.bg.destroy();
  149 |     this.graphics.destroy();
  150 |     this.turn.destroy();
  151 |   }
  152 |   snapshot() {
  153 |     return {
  154 |       ai: this.ai?.snapshot(),
  155 |       cells: [...this.board.cells],
  156 |       turn: this.board.turn,
  157 |       winner: this.board.winner,
  158 |     };
  159 |   }
  160 | }
~~~

## src/games/tic-tac-toe/classic/ClassicRules.ts
SHA-256: 9dc3f0969f20493adb64299188bec68ccae59b279086d8b3c372fe91676589c3
~~~text
    1 | import type { Player, Winner } from "../../../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    2 | import { WIN_LINES } from "../shared/lines";
    3 | export { WIN_LINES };
    4 | export class TicTacToeBoard {
    5 |   cells: (Player | null)[] = Array(9).fill(null);
    6 |   turn: Player = 1;
    7 |   winner: Winner | null = null;
    8 |   line: readonly number[] | null = null;
    9 |   history: number[] = [];
   10 |   save() {
   11 |     return { version: 1, moves: [...this.history] };
   12 |   }
   13 |   static restore(data: unknown) {
   14 |     const board = new TicTacToeBoard();
   15 |     const d = data as { version?: number; moves?: unknown };
   16 |     if (d?.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(d.moves) || d.moves.length > 9)
   17 |       return board;
   18 |     for (const move of d.moves)
   19 |       if (!board.play(move)) return new TicTacToeBoard();
   20 |     return board;
   21 |   }
   22 |   play(index: number) {
   23 |     if (
   24 |       !Number.isInteger(index) ||
   25 |       index < 0 ||
   26 |       index > 8 ||
   27 |       this.cells[index] ||
   28 |       this.winner
   29 |     )
   30 |       return false;
   31 |     this.cells[index] = this.turn;
   32 |     this.history.push(index);
   33 |     for (const line of WIN_LINES)
   34 |       if (line.every((i) => this.cells[i] === this.turn)) {
   35 |         this.winner = this.turn;
   36 |         this.line = line;
   37 |         return true;
   38 |       }
   39 |     if (this.cells.every(Boolean)) this.winner = "draw";
   40 |     else this.turn = this.turn === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   41 |     return true;
   42 |   }
   43 | }
~~~

## src/games/tic-tac-toe/ultimate/UltimateAI.ts
SHA-256: 99556e3d3f2ed304536bc8c1bcbff8a9e9b1b08abff6321743c089398b7a9bcf
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom, replayMode } from "../../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import { WorkerTask } from "../../../shared/utilities/WorkerTask";
    3 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    4 | import type { UltimateBoard } from "./UltimateRules";
    5 | export class UltimateAI {
    6 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    7 |   snapshot() {
    8 |     return this.personality.snapshot();
    9 |   }
   10 |   private task: WorkerTask<
   11 |     {
   12 |       id: number;
   13 |       state: unknown;
   14 |       difficulty: Difficulty;
   15 |       seed: number;
   16 |       replay: boolean;
   17 |     },
   18 |     { move: number }
   19 |   >;
   20 |   constructor(
   21 |     private difficulty: Difficulty,
   22 |     report: (ms: number) => void = () => {},
   23 |     seed?: number,
   24 |   ) {
   25 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   26 |     this.task = new WorkerTask(
   27 |       () =>
   28 |         new Worker(new URL("./ai.worker.ts", import.meta.url), {
   29 |           type: "module",
   30 |         }),
   31 |       report,
   32 |     );
   33 |   }
   34 |   async choose(board: UltimateBoard) {
   35 |     const answer = await this.task.run({
   36 |       id: 1,
   37 |       state: board.save(),
   38 |       difficulty: this.difficulty,
   39 |       seed: this.personality.seed,
   40 |       replay: replayMode(),
   41 |     });
   42 |     return answer?.move ?? board.legalMoves()[0] ?? -1;
   43 |   }
   44 |   cancel() {
   45 |     this.task.cancel();
   46 |   }
   47 |   dispose() {
   48 |     this.task.cancel();
   49 |   }
   50 | }
~~~

~~~text
    1 | import { turnBackground } from "../../../shared/components/TurnView";

   87 |       );

   90 |   private place(move: number) {

  167 |           114,

  177 |         this.g
  178 |           .lineStyle(7, theme.ink, 0.8)
  179 |           .lineBetween(
  180 |             x,
  181 |             y,
  182 |             x + ((b % 3) - (a % 3)) * 120 * t,
  183 |             y + (Math.floor(b / 3) - Math.floor(a / 3)) * 120 * t,
  184 |           );
  185 |       }
  186 |       if (this.endAge > 0.85 && !this.reported) {

  192 |         });
  193 |       }
  194 |     }
  195 |   }
  196 |   private drawBoard(
  197 |     b: number,
  198 |     x: number,
  199 |     y: number,
  200 |     size: number,
  201 |     active: boolean,
  202 |   ) {

  204 |       status = this.board.boards[b],
  205 |       cell = size / 3;

  207 |       g,
  208 |       x,
  209 |       y,
  210 |       size,
  211 |       size,
  212 |       8,

  215 |           ? 0xf5c49e
  216 |           : status === 2
  217 |             ? 0xb5d9e9
  218 |             : 0xdac9bf
  219 |         : active
  220 |           ? theme.white
  221 |           : 0xefd4c5,
  222 |       active && !status ? 3 : 2,
  223 |     );

  237 |       g.lineBetween(x + 7, y + k * cell, x + size - 7, y + k * cell);

  244 |             y + size * 0.44,

  246 |             y + size * 0.44,

  248 |           .lineBetween(

  251 |             x + size * 0.7,
~~~
