## src/games/tic-tac-toe/ultimate/UltimateRules.ts
SHA-256: 67e9fdf0c6abe678c1af290f5dab2faca266abbe8f905da5540f02d15b8eb2fc
~~~text
    1 | import type { Player, Winner } from "../../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    2 | import { WIN_LINES } from "../shared/lines";
    3 | export interface UltimateSave {
    4 |   version: 1;
    5 |   moves: number[];
    6 | }
    7 | /** Index = miniBoard * 9 + localCell. All legality and routing live here. */
    8 | export class UltimateBoard {
    9 |   cells: (Player | null)[] = Array(81).fill(null);
   10 |   boards: (Winner | null)[] = Array(9).fill(null);
   11 |   turn: Player = 1;
   12 |   forced: number | null = null;
   13 |   winner: Winner | null = null;
   14 |   line: readonly number[] | null = null;
   15 |   history: number[] = [];
   16 |   legal(move: number) {
   17 |     return (
   18 |       Number.isInteger(move) &&
   19 |       move >= 0 &&
   20 |       move < 81 &&
   21 |       !this.winner &&
   22 |       !this.cells[move] &&
   23 |       !this.boards[Math.floor(move / 9)] &&
   24 |       (this.forced === null || Math.floor(move / 9) === this.forced)
   25 |     );
   26 |   }
   27 |   legalMoves() {
   28 |     const out: number[] = [];
   29 |     if (this.winner) return out;
   30 |     for (let i = 0; i < 81; i++) if (this.legal(i)) out.push(i);
   31 |     return out;
   32 |   }
   33 |   play(move: number) {
   34 |     if (!this.legal(move)) return false;
   35 |     const b = Math.floor(move / 9),
   36 |       cell = move % 9,
   37 |       p = this.turn;
   38 |     this.cells[move] = p;
   39 |     this.history.push(move);
   40 |     if (
   41 |       WIN_LINES.some((line) => line.every((i) => this.cells[b * 9 + i] === p))
   42 |     )
   43 |       this.boards[b] = p;
   44 |     else if (this.cells.slice(b * 9, b * 9 + 9).every(Boolean))
   45 |       this.boards[b] = "draw";
   46 |     for (const line of WIN_LINES)
   47 |       if (line.every((i) => this.boards[i] === p)) {
   48 |         this.winner = p;
   49 |         this.line = line;
   50 |         break;
   51 |       }
   52 |     if (!this.winner && this.boards.every(Boolean)) this.winner = "draw";
   53 |     this.forced = this.boards[cell] ? null : cell;
   54 |     this.turn = p === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   55 |     return true;
   56 |   }
   57 |   clone() {
   58 |     const b = new UltimateBoard();
   59 |     b.cells = [...this.cells];
   60 |     b.boards = [...this.boards];
   61 |     b.turn = this.turn;
   62 |     b.forced = this.forced;
   63 |     b.winner = this.winner;
   64 |     b.line = this.line;
   65 |     b.history = [...this.history];
   66 |     return b;
   67 |   }
   68 |   save(): UltimateSave {
   69 |     return { version: 1, moves: [...this.history] };
   70 |   }
   71 |   static restore(data: unknown) {
   72 |     const b = new UltimateBoard(),
   73 |       d = data as Partial<UltimateSave>;
   74 |     if (d?.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(d.moves) || d.moves.length > 81)
   75 |       return b;
   76 |     for (const move of d.moves) if (!b.play(move)) return new UltimateBoard();
   77 |     return b;
   78 |   }
   79 |   key() {
   80 |     return (
   81 |       this.cells.map((v) => v ?? 0).join("") +
   82 |       ":" +
   83 |       this.forced +
   84 |       ":" +
   85 |       this.turn
   86 |     );
   87 |   }
   88 | }
~~~

## src/games/tic-tac-toe/ultimate/UltimateSearch.ts
SHA-256: a2f678c388ec070f1e40ef9d48808bf77cf3a0c11ede6c7832614e543e2f29c9
~~~text
    1 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    2 | import { UltimateBoard } from "./UltimateRules";
    3 | import { WIN_LINES } from "../shared/lines";
    4 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    5 | import type { Player } from "../../../shared/contracts/GameResult";
    6 | interface Entry {
    7 |   depth: number;
    8 |   value: number;
    9 |   flag: "exact" | "lower" | "upper";
   10 | }
   11 | export interface SearchResult {
   12 |   move: number;
   13 |   depth: number;
   14 |   nodes: number;
   15 | }
   16 | export function evaluate(
   17 |   board: UltimateBoard,
   18 |   player: Player,
   19 |   style?: MatchRandom,
   20 | ) {
   21 |   if (board.winner)
   22 |     return board.winner === "draw"
   23 |       ? 0
   24 |       : board.winner === player
   25 |         ? 1000000
   26 |         : -1000000;
   27 |   const enemy = player === 1 ? 2 : 1;
   28 |   let score = 0;
   29 |   for (const line of WIN_LINES) {
   30 |     const own = line.filter((i) => board.boards[i] === player).length,
   31 |       other = line.filter((i) => board.boards[i] === enemy).length,
   32 |       closed = line.some((i) => board.boards[i] === "draw");
   33 |     if (!closed) {
   34 |       if (!other) score += [0, 180, 1900][own] ?? 0;
   35 |       if (!own) score -= [0, 180, 1900][other] ?? 0;
   36 |     }
   37 |   }
   38 |   for (let b = 0; b < 9; b++) {
   39 |     if (board.boards[b]) {
   40 |       if (board.boards[b] === player) score += 530 + (style?.role ?? 1) * 15;
   41 |       else if (board.boards[b] === enemy)
   42 |         score -= 530 + (style?.role ?? 1) * 15;
   43 |       continue;
   44 |     }
   45 |     const weight = b === 4 ? 1.2 + (style?.tempo ?? 1) * 0.05 : 1;
   46 |     for (const line of WIN_LINES) {
   47 |       const own = line.filter((i) => board.cells[b * 9 + i] === player).length,
   48 |         other = line.filter((i) => board.cells[b * 9 + i] === enemy).length;
   49 |       if (!other) score += weight * ([0, 3, 24][own] ?? 0);
   50 |       if (!own) score -= weight * ([0, 3, 24][other] ?? 0);
   51 |     }
   52 |     if (board.cells[b * 9 + 4] === player) score += 6;
   53 |     else if (board.cells[b * 9 + 4] === enemy) score -= 6;
   54 |   }
   55 |   if (style)
   56 |     for (let b = 0; b < 9; b++) {
   57 |       const p = board.cells[b * 9 + (style.side < 0 ? 0 : 8)];
   58 |       if (p) score += (p === player ? 1 : -1) * (style.role === 3 ? 4 : 1);
   59 |     }
   60 |   return score;
   61 | }
   62 | /** Budgeted iterative deepening. This is strong practical play, not a solved-game claim. */
   63 | export function ultimateMove(
   64 |   board: UltimateBoard,
   65 |   difficulty: Difficulty,
   66 |   overrides: {
   67 |     budgetMs?: number;
   68 |     random?: () => number;
   69 |     seed?: number;
   70 |     replay?: boolean;
   71 |   } = {},
   72 | ): SearchResult {
   73 |   const settings = {
   74 |     medium: { ms: 25, depth: 2, nodes: 5000 },
   75 |     hard: { ms: 100, depth: 5, nodes: 45000 },
   76 |     impossible: { ms: 280, depth: 9, nodes: 160000 },
   77 |   }[difficulty];
   78 |   const style = new MatchRandom(overrides.seed ?? overrides.random),
   79 |     random = style.next,
   80 |     legal = board.legalMoves();
   81 |   if (!legal.length) return { move: -1, depth: 0, nodes: 0 };
   82 |   const player = board.turn,
   83 |     deadline = overrides.replay
   84 |       ? Infinity
   85 |       : performance.now() + (overrides.budgetMs ?? settings.ms),
   86 |     table = new Map<string, Entry>();
   87 |   let nodes = 0,
   88 |     completeDepth = 0,
   89 |     best = legal[0];
   90 |   const TIMEOUT = Symbol();
   91 |   function ordered(b: UltimateBoard) {
   92 |     return b
   93 |       .legalMoves()
   94 |       .map((move) => {
   95 |         const next = b.clone();
   96 |         next.play(move);
   97 |         return { move, next, value: evaluate(next, player, style) };
   98 |       })
   99 |       .sort(
  100 |         (a, z) =>
  101 |           (b.turn === player ? z.value - a.value : a.value - z.value) ||
  102 |           style.rank(a.move) - style.rank(z.move),
  103 |       );
  104 |   }
  105 |   const roots = ordered(board);
  106 |   best = roots[0].move;
  107 |   if (difficulty === "medium" && random() < 0.16) {
  108 |     const candidates = roots.slice(0, Math.min(5, roots.length));
  109 |     return {
  110 |       move: candidates[Math.floor(random() * candidates.length)].move,
  111 |       depth: 0,
  112 |       nodes: 0,
  113 |     };
  114 |   }
  115 |   function search(
  116 |     b: UltimateBoard,
  117 |     depth: number,
  118 |     alpha: number,
  119 |     beta: number,
  120 |   ): number {
  121 |     nodes++;
  122 |     if (
  123 |       nodes > settings.nodes ||
  124 |       ((nodes & 31) === 0 && performance.now() >= deadline)
  125 |     )
  126 |       throw TIMEOUT;
  127 |     if (b.winner || depth === 0) return evaluate(b, player, style);
  128 |     const key = b.key(),
  129 |       cached = table.get(key),
  130 |       originalAlpha = alpha,
  131 |       originalBeta = beta;
  132 |     if (cached && cached.depth >= depth) {
  133 |       if (cached.flag === "exact") return cached.value;
  134 |       if (cached.flag === "lower") alpha = Math.max(alpha, cached.value);
  135 |       else beta = Math.min(beta, cached.value);
  136 |       if (alpha >= beta) return cached.value;
  137 |     }
  138 |     let value = b.turn === player ? -Infinity : Infinity;
  139 |     for (const node of ordered(b)) {
  140 |       const candidate = search(node.next, depth - 1, alpha, beta);
  141 |       if (b.turn === player) {
  142 |         value = Math.max(value, candidate);
  143 |         alpha = Math.max(alpha, value);
  144 |       } else {
  145 |         value = Math.min(value, candidate);
  146 |         beta = Math.min(beta, value);
  147 |       }
  148 |       if (alpha >= beta) break;
  149 |     }
  150 |     if (table.size < 16000)
  151 |       table.set(key, {
  152 |         depth,
  153 |         value,
  154 |         flag:
  155 |           value <= originalAlpha
  156 |             ? "upper"
  157 |             : value >= originalBeta
  158 |               ? "lower"
  159 |               : "exact",
  160 |       });
  161 |     return value;
  162 |   }
  163 |   for (let depth = 1; depth <= settings.depth; depth++) {
  164 |     let roundBest = best,
  165 |       value = -Infinity;
  166 |     try {
  167 |       for (const node of roots) {
  168 |         if (performance.now() >= deadline) throw TIMEOUT;
  169 |         const score = search(node.next, depth - 1, -Infinity, Infinity);
  170 |         if (
  171 |           score > value ||
  172 |           (score === value && style.rank(node.move) < style.rank(roundBest))
  173 |         ) {
  174 |           value = score;
  175 |           roundBest = node.move;
  176 |         }
  177 |       }
  178 |       best = roundBest;
  179 |       completeDepth = depth;
  180 |       roots.sort((a, b) => (a.move === best ? -1 : b.move === best ? 1 : 0));
  181 |       if (value >= 1000000) break;
  182 |     } catch (e) {
  183 |       if (e !== TIMEOUT) throw e;
  184 |       break;
  185 |     }
  186 |   }
  187 |   return { move: best, depth: completeDepth, nodes };
  188 | }
~~~

"selected" : ""}">${chosen === i ? "×" : ""}</button>`).join("")}</div><span>→</span>${diagram()}</div>`

"Got it. Let’s play." : "Next"}</button>${step ? '<button class="text-button" data-action="back">Previous</button>' : '<button class="text-button" data-action="close">Back to setup</button>'}`,

## src/games/water-guess/AGENTS.md
SHA-256: 0195e9ee8dbb94b01485dd6439f7b3b27cf9d0a052e9ffdf20801aae0d63e4c4
~~~text
    1 | # Water Guess
    2 | 
    3 | Preserve Antigravity’s original layout/renderer. Rules own integer precision, submissions, idempotent resolution and five-round/sudden-death progression; reject nonfinite input. AI is seeded per match and stays inside this folder. Controllers own scene objects; host input subscriptions are automatically removed. Pause/terminal guards must prevent actions after completion. Active matches restart after process closure.
    4 | 
    5 | The 310-unit tube height is shared through Geometry.ts. Impossible estimates the visible level at one logical pixel resolution; lower difficulties add a persistent estimation bias and bounded perceptual variation. Handle NumpadDecimal separately from digit keys.
    6 | 
    7 | Use the playfield background for the active player, with a compact round counter and no repeated turn/status instructions. TurnView rotates the full local Blue field and keypad; map pointer coordinates through its inverse and reject input during transitions. AI guesses only after its foreground preparation delay.
~~~

## src/games/water-guess/WaterGuessAI.ts
SHA-256: c0ce972259d973421a0b3055bf370b9d16b652281fc6b37543c0f61b97e19e43
~~~text
    1 | import type { Difficulty } from "../../shared/contracts/AIController";
    2 | import { MatchRandom } from "../../shared/ai/MatchRandom";
    3 | import { TUBE_HEIGHT } from "./Geometry";
    4 | export class WaterGuessAI {
    5 |   readonly personality: MatchRandom;
    6 |   constructor(
    7 |     public readonly difficulty: Difficulty = "medium",
    8 |     seed?: number,
    9 |   ) {
   10 |     this.personality = new MatchRandom(seed);
   11 |   }
   12 |   estimate(actualHundredths: number) {
   13 |     // Measure the visible tube to one logical pixel; no oracle-perfect hidden decimal.
   14 |     const measured =
   15 |       (Math.round((actualHundredths / 10000) * TUBE_HEIGHT) / TUBE_HEIGHT) *
   16 |       10000;
   17 |     const r = this.personality,
   18 |       spread =
   19 |         this.difficulty === "medium"
   20 |           ? 550
   21 |           : this.difficulty === "hard"
   22 |             ? 170
   23 |             : 0;
   24 |     const bias = r.side * spread * (0.15 + r.role * 0.06),
   25 |       noise = r.sample(bias, spread * (0.8 + r.tempo * 0.1), -spread * 1.4);
   26 |     return Math.max(0, Math.min(10000, Math.round(measured + noise)));
   27 |   }
   28 |   snapshot() {
   29 |     return this.personality.snapshot();
   30 |   }
   31 | }
~~~

  182 | 
  183 |   private setupInputs() {
  184 |     // Tap handler for keypad and reveal tap-to-continue
  185 |     this.ctx.input.tap((x, y) => {
  186 |       if (!this.view.ready) return;
  187 |       ({ x, y } = this.view.point(x, y));
  188 |       if (this.paused || this.reported) return;
  189 | 
  190 |       if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  191 |         if (this.revealAge > 0.8) {
  192 |           this.advanceNext();
  193 |         }
  194 |         return;
  195 |       }
  196 | 
  197 |       if (this.state !== "GUESSING" || !this.view.ready) return;
  198 | 
  199 |       // Check button clicks
  200 |       for (const b of this.buttons) {
  201 |         if (x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h) {
  202 |           this.ctx.audio.play("tap");
  203 |           b.action();
  204 |           return;
  205 |         }
  206 |       }
  207 |     });
  208 | 
  209 |     // Keyboard support on desktop
  210 |     const digitCodes = [
  211 |       "Digit1",
  212 |       "Digit2",
  213 |       "Digit3",
  214 |       "Digit4",
  215 |       "Digit5",
  216 |       "Digit6",
  217 |       "Digit7",
  218 |       "Digit8",
  219 |       "Digit9",
  220 |       "Digit0",
  221 |       "Numpad1",
  222 |       "Numpad2",
  223 |       "Numpad3",
  224 |       "Numpad4",
  225 |       "Numpad5",
  226 |       "Numpad6",
  227 |       "Numpad7",
  228 |       "Numpad8",
  229 |       "Numpad9",
  230 |       "Numpad0",
  231 |     ];
  232 |     this.ctx.input.press(
  233 |       [...digitCodes, "Period", "NumpadDecimal", "Backspace", "Enter", "Space"],
  234 |       (code) => {
  235 |         if (this.paused || this.reported) return;
  236 |         if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  237 |           if (this.revealAge > 0.8) this.advanceNext();
  238 |           return;
  239 |         }
  240 |         if (this.state !== "GUESSING" || !this.view.ready) return;
  241 | 
  242 |         if (/^(Digit|Numpad)[0-9]$/.test(code)) {
  243 |           const char = code.replace("Digit", "").replace("Numpad", "");
  244 |           if (/^[0-9]$/.test(char)) {
  245 |             this.ctx.audio.play("tap");
  246 |             this.appendDigit(char);
  247 |           }
  248 |         } else if (code === "Period" || code === "NumpadDecimal") {
  249 |           this.ctx.audio.play("tap");
  250 |           this.appendDecimal();
  251 |         } else if (code === "Backspace") {
  252 |           this.ctx.audio.play("tap");
  253 |           this.backspace();
  254 |         } else if (code === "Enter" || code === "Space") {
  255 |           this.ctx.audio.play("wood");
  256 |           this.submitCurrentGuess();
  257 |         }
  258 |       },
  259 |     );
  260 |   }
  261 | 
  262 |   private appendDigit(digit: string) {
  263 |     if (this.inputBuffer.length >= 6) return;
  264 |     // Don't allow more than two decimals after dot
  265 |     const dotIdx = this.inputBuffer.indexOf(".");
  266 |     if (dotIdx !== -1 && this.inputBuffer.length - dotIdx > 2) return;
  267 | 
  268 |     this.inputBuffer += digit;
  269 |     this.updateBufferDisplay();
  270 |   }
  271 | 
  272 |   private appendDecimal() {
  273 |     if (this.inputBuffer.includes(".")) return;
  274 |     if (this.inputBuffer.length === 0) {
  275 |       this.inputBuffer = "0.";
  276 |     } else {
  277 |       this.inputBuffer += ".";
  278 |     }
  279 |     this.updateBufferDisplay();
  280 |   }
  281 | 
  282 |   private backspace() {
  283 |     if (this.inputBuffer.length > 0) {
  284 |       this.inputBuffer = this.inputBuffer.slice(0, -1);
  285 |       this.updateBufferDisplay();
  286 |     }
  287 |   }
  288 | 
  289 |   private updateBufferDisplay() {
  290 |     const pName = this.activeGuesser === 0 ? "ORANGE" : this.ai ? "AI" : "BLUE";
  291 |     const color = this.activeGuesser === 0 ? "#e67e22" : "#2980b9";
  292 |     this.promptText
  293 |       .setText(`${pName}: ENTER GUESS (0.01% PRECISION)`)
  294 |       .setColor(color);
  295 | 
  296 |     if (this.inputBuffer.length === 0) {
  297 |       this.inputBufferText.setText("— %");
  298 |     } else {
  299 |       this.inputBufferText.setText(`${this.inputBuffer}%`);
  300 |     }
  301 |   }
  302 | 
  303 |   private startRound() {
  304 |     this.state = "FILLING";
  305 |     this.fillAnimProgress = 0;
  306 |     this.inputBuffer = "";
  307 |     this.roundResult = undefined;
  308 |     this.revealAge = 0;
  309 |     this.revealText.setAlpha(0);
  310 | 
  311 |     const isSudden = this.match.isSuddenDeath;
  312 |     this.bannerTitle.setText(isSudden ? "TIEBREAK" : `${this.match.round} / 5`);
  313 |     this.ctx.setHint("");
  314 | 
  315 |     // In 2P, alternate who guesses first
  316 |     this.activeGuesser = this.match.round % 2 === 1 ? 0 : 1;
  317 | 
  318 |     // AI locks its guess automatically if in AI mode
  319 |     if (this.ai) {
  320 |       this.aiWait = this.random.sample(1.45, 0.35, 1.0);
  321 |       this.p2StatusText.setText("AI: LOCKED ✓").setColor("#27ae60");
  322 |       this.activeGuesser = 0; // Human is Player 1
  323 |     } else {
  324 |       this.p2StatusText.setText("BLUE: WAITING").setColor("#2980b9");
  325 |     }
  326 | 
  327 |     this.view.set(!this.ai && this.activeGuesser === 1);
  328 |     this.p1StatusText.setText("ORANGE: WAITING").setColor("#e67e22");
  329 |     this.promptText.setAlpha(1);
  330 |     this.inputBufferText.setAlpha(1);
  331 |     this.updateBufferDisplay();
  332 |     this.buttonTexts.forEach((t) => t.setAlpha(1));
  333 |     this.ctx.audio.play("soft");
  334 |   }
  335 | 
  336 |   private submitCurrentGuess() {
  337 |     if (this.inputBuffer.length === 0 || !this.view.ready) return;
  338 |     const val = parsePercentInput(this.inputBuffer);
  339 | 
  340 |     const ok = this.match.submit(this.activeGuesser, val);
  341 |     if (!ok) return;
  342 | 
  343 |     this.ctx.audio.play("wood");
  344 | 
  345 |     if (this.activeGuesser === 0) {
  346 |       this.p1StatusText.setText("ORANGE: LOCKED ✓").setColor("#27ae60");
  347 |     } else {
  348 |       this.p2StatusText.setText("BLUE: LOCKED ✓").setColor("#27ae60");
  349 |     }
  350 | 
  351 |     this.inputBuffer = "";
  352 | 
  353 |     // Check if both have submitted
  354 |     if (this.match.bothSubmitted) {
  355 |       this.triggerReveal();
  356 |     } else {
  357 |       // In 2P, switch to the other player
  358 |       if (!this.ai) {
  359 |         this.activeGuesser = this.activeGuesser === 0 ? 1 : 0;
  360 |         this.view.set(this.activeGuesser === 1);
  361 |       }
  362 |       this.updateBufferDisplay();
  363 |     }
  364 |   }
  365 | 
  366 |   private triggerReveal() {
  367 |     if (this.state !== "GUESSING" || this.reported) return;
  368 |     this.state = "REVEAL";
  369 |     this.revealAge = 0;
  370 |     this.view.set(false);
  371 |     this.buttonTexts.forEach((t) => t.setAlpha(0));
  372 |     this.roundResult = this.match.resolveRound();
  373 |     this.ctx.setScore(this.match.scores[0], this.match.scores[1]);
  374 | 
  375 |     const res = this.roundResult;
  376 |     const g0Str = formatPercent(res.guesses[0]);
  377 |     const g1Str = formatPercent(res.guesses[1]);
  378 | 
  379 |     const actStr = formatPercent(res.actual);
  380 | 
  381 |     if (res.winner === 1) {
  382 |       this.ctx.audio.play("capture");
  383 |     } else if (res.winner === 2) {
  384 |       this.ctx.audio.play("capture");
  385 |     } else {
  386 |       this.ctx.audio.play("draw");
  387 |     }
  388 | 
  389 |     this.revealText
  390 |       .setText(
  391 |         `${res.winner === "draw" ? "A TIE!" : "NICE GUESS!"}\n` +
  392 |           `Actual ${actStr}\n` +
  393 |           `${g0Str}  ·  ${g1Str}\n` +
  394 |           `Continue →`,
  395 |       )
  396 |       .setAlpha(1);
  397 | 
  398 |     this.promptText.setAlpha(0);
  399 |     this.inputBufferText.setAlpha(0);
  400 |   }
  401 | 
  402 |   private advanceNext() {
  403 |     if (this.match.isMatchOver) {
  404 |       if (!this.reported) {
  405 |         this.reported = true;
  406 |         this.ctx.finish({
  407 |           winner: this.match.matchWinner!,
  408 |           scores: this.match.scores,
  409 |         });
  410 |       }
  411 |       return;
  412 |     }
  413 | 
  414 |     this.match.nextRound();
  415 |     this.startRound();
  416 |   }
  417 | 
  418 |   update(dt: number) {
  419 |     if (this.paused || this.reported) return;
  420 |     this.animTime += dt;
  421 |     this.view.update(dt);
  422 |     if (
  423 |       this.state === "GUESSING" &&
  424 |       this.ai &&
  425 |       this.match.guesses[1] === null
  426 |     ) {
  427 |       this.aiWait = Math.max(0, this.aiWait - dt);
  428 |       if (this.aiWait === 0) {
  429 |         this.match.submit(1, this.ai.estimate(this.match.actual));
  430 |         if (this.match.bothSubmitted) this.triggerReveal();
  431 |       }
  432 |     }
  433 | 
  434 |     if (this.state === "FILLING") {
  435 |       this.fillAnimProgress = Math.min(1, this.fillAnimProgress + dt * 1.3);
  436 |       if (this.fillAnimProgress >= 1) {
  437 |         this.state = "GUESSING";
  438 |         this.updateBufferDisplay();
  439 |       }
  440 |     } else if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  441 |       this.revealAge += dt;
  442 |       // Auto-advance after 3.2s if player doesn't tap
  443 |       if (this.revealAge > 3.2) {
  444 |         this.advanceNext();
  445 |       }
  446 |     }
  447 | 
  448 |     this.render();
  449 |   }
  450 | 
  451 |   private render() {
  452 |     const g = this.g;
  453 |     g.clear();
  454 | 
  455 |     // 1. Play area card (warm cream/sky blue background)
  456 |     rounded(
  457 |       g,
  458 |       24,
  459 |       112,
  460 |       372,
  461 |       538,
  462 |       20,
  463 |       this.state === "REVEAL"
  464 |         ? this.roundResult?.winner === 1
  465 |           ? 0xf7e1cc
  466 |           : this.roundResult?.winner === 2
  467 |             ? 0xd9eaf4
  468 |             : theme.paper
  469 |         : turnBackground(
  470 |             this.ai &&
  471 |               this.match.guesses[0] !== null &&
  472 |               this.match.guesses[1] === null
  473 |               ? 2
  474 |               : this.activeGuesser === 0
  475 |                 ? 1
  476 |                 : 2,
  477 |           ),
  478 |       4,
  479 |     );
  480 | 
  481 |     // 2. Tube & Water
  482 |     const waterLevel =
  483 |       this.state === "FILLING"
  484 |         ? (1 - Math.pow(1 - this.fillAnimProgress, 2)) * this.match.actual
  485 |         : this.match.actual;
  486 | 
  487 |     this.renderer.drawTube(
  488 |       g,
  489 |       waterLevel,
  490 |       this.animTime,
  491 |       this.state === "REVEAL",
  492 |       this.match.actual,
  493 |       this.match.guesses[0],
  494 |       this.match.guesses[1],
  495 |     );
  496 | 
  497 |     // 3. Keypad buttons (during GUESSING state)
  498 |     if (this.state === "GUESSING" || this.state === "FILLING") {
  499 |       for (const b of this.buttons) {
  500 |         let btnColor = 0xffffff;
  501 |         if (b.label === "CONFIRM") {
  502 |           btnColor = this.activeGuesser === 0 ? theme.orange : theme.blue;
  503 |         } else if (b.label === "⌫ DEL") {
  504 |           btnColor = 0xf5b7b1;
  505 |         }
  506 |         rounded(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 10, btnColor, 2);
  507 |       }
  508 |     }
  509 | 
  510 |     // 4. Reveal bottom panel card
  511 |     if (this.state === "REVEAL") {
  512 |       const winner = this.roundResult?.winner;
  513 |       const color =
  514 |         winner === 1 ? theme.orange : winner === 2 ? theme.blue : 0xb8d998;
  515 |       const pop = Math.sin(Math.min(1, this.revealAge / 0.25) * Math.PI) * 5;
  516 |       rounded(
  517 |         g,
  518 |         34 - pop,
  519 |         484 - pop,
  520 |         352 + pop * 2,
  521 |         146 + pop * 2,
  522 |         16,
  523 |         color,
  524 |         3,
  525 |       );
  526 |     }
  527 |   }
  528 | 
  529 |   pause() {
  530 |     this.paused = true;
  531 |   }
  532 | 
  533 |   resume() {
  534 |     this.paused = false;
  535 |   }
  536 | 
  537 |   dispose() {
  538 |     this.reported = true;
  539 |     this.view.destroy();
  540 |   }
  541 | 
  542 |   snapshot() {
  543 |     return {
  544 |       ai: this.ai?.snapshot(),
  545 |       match: this.match,
  546 |       state: this.state,
  547 |       activeGuesser: this.activeGuesser,
  548 |       rotation: this.view.rotation,
  549 |       turning: !this.view.ready,
  550 |       aiWait: this.aiWait,
  551 |       inputBuffer: this.inputBuffer,
  552 |       scores: [...this.match.scores],
  553 |       round: this.match.round,
  554 |     };
  555 |   }
  556 | }

## src/games/water-guess/WaterGuessRules.ts
SHA-256: ac28b5ae00d168bb754fc633d362c185d5d927afa0c1ff6600dc9092d2e93a7d
~~~text
    1 | export const TOTAL_ROUNDS = 5;
    2 | export const MIN_PERCENT = 1000; // 10.00%
    3 | export const MAX_PERCENT = 9000; // 90.00%
    4 | 
    5 | export function formatPercent(hundredths: number): string {
    6 |   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(10000, Math.round(hundredths)));
    7 |   return (clamped / 100).toFixed(2) + "%";
    8 | }
    9 | 
   10 | export function formatValue(hundredths: number): string {
   11 |   const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(10000, Math.round(hundredths)));
   12 |   return (clamped / 100).toFixed(2);
   13 | }
   14 | 
   15 | export function parsePercentInput(input: string): number {
   16 |   const cleaned = input.trim().replace("%", "");
   17 |   const num = parseFloat(cleaned);
   18 |   if (isNaN(num)) return 0;
   19 |   return Math.max(0, Math.min(10000, Math.round(num * 100)));
   20 | }
   21 | 
   22 | export interface WaterRoundResult {
   23 |   round: number;
   24 |   actual: number; // 0..10000
   25 |   guesses: [number, number]; // 0..10000
   26 |   errors: [number, number]; // absolute error in hundredths
   27 |   winner: 1 | 2 | "draw";
   28 | }
   29 | 
   30 | export class WaterGuessMatch {
   31 |   round = 1;
   32 |   scores: [number, number] = [0, 0];
   33 |   history: WaterRoundResult[] = [];
   34 |   actual = 0; // 0..10000
   35 |   guesses: [number | null, number | null] = [null, null];
   36 |   private resolved?: WaterRoundResult;
   37 |   private usedActuals = new Set<number>();
   38 | 
   39 |   constructor(private rng: () => number = Math.random) {
   40 |     this.startNewRound();
   41 |   }
   42 | 
   43 |   startNewRound() {
   44 |     this.resolved = undefined;
   45 |     this.guesses = [null, null];
   46 |     let candidate = 5000;
   47 |     let attempts = 0;
   48 |     do {
   49 |       // Generate percentage with 0.01% granularity between 10.00% and 90.00%
   50 |       const r = this.rng();
   51 |       candidate = MIN_PERCENT + Math.floor(r * (MAX_PERCENT - MIN_PERCENT + 1));
   52 |       attempts++;
   53 |     } while (this.usedActuals.has(candidate) && attempts < 100);
   54 | 
   55 |     this.usedActuals.add(candidate);
   56 |     this.actual = candidate;
   57 |   }
   58 | 
   59 |   submit(player: 0 | 1, guessHundredths: number): boolean {
   60 |     if (!Number.isFinite(guessHundredths)) return false;
   61 |     if (this.guesses[player] !== null) return false;
   62 |     const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(10000, Math.round(guessHundredths)));
   63 |     this.guesses[player] = clamped;
   64 |     return true;
   65 |   }
   66 | 
   67 |   get bothSubmitted(): boolean {
   68 |     return this.guesses[0] !== null && this.guesses[1] !== null;
   69 |   }
   70 | 
   71 |   resolveRound(): WaterRoundResult {
   72 |     if (this.resolved) return this.resolved;
   73 |     if (!this.bothSubmitted) {
   74 |       throw new Error("Cannot resolve round: both players must submit guesses");
   75 |     }
   76 |     const g0 = this.guesses[0]!;
   77 |     const g1 = this.guesses[1]!;
   78 |     const err0 = Math.abs(g0 - this.actual);
   79 |     const err1 = Math.abs(g1 - this.actual);
   80 | 
   81 |     let winner: 1 | 2 | "draw";
   82 |     if (err0 < err1) {
   83 |       winner = 1;
   84 |       this.scores[0]++;
   85 |     } else if (err1 < err0) {
   86 |       winner = 2;
   87 |       this.scores[1]++;
   88 |     } else {
   89 |       winner = "draw";
   90 |       // Equal error: tied round, no points awarded
   91 |     }
   92 | 
   93 |     const result: WaterRoundResult = {
   94 |       round: this.round,
   95 |       actual: this.actual,
   96 |       guesses: [g0, g1],
   97 |       errors: [err0, err1],
   98 |       winner,
   99 |     };
  100 |     this.resolved = result;
  101 |     this.history.push(result);
  102 |     return result;
  103 |   }
  104 | 
  105 |   nextRound(): boolean {
  106 |     if (!this.resolved || this.isMatchOver) return false;
  107 |     this.round++;
  108 |     this.startNewRound();
  109 |     return true;
  110 |   }
  111 | 
  112 |   get isSuddenDeath(): boolean {
  113 |     return this.round > TOTAL_ROUNDS && this.scores[0] === this.scores[1];
  114 |   }
  115 | 
  116 |   get isMatchOver(): boolean {
  117 |     if (this.round < TOTAL_ROUNDS) return false;
  118 |     if (this.round === TOTAL_ROUNDS) {
  119 |       // If round 5 has completed and scores are tied, continue sudden death
  120 |       return (
  121 |         this.history.length === TOTAL_ROUNDS &&
  122 |         this.scores[0] !== this.scores[1]
  123 |       );
  124 |     }
  125 |     // In sudden death (round > 5), match ends as soon as scores are not equal
  126 |     return this.scores[0] !== this.scores[1];
  127 |   }
  128 | 
  129 |   get matchWinner(): 1 | 2 | "draw" | null {
  130 |     if (!this.isMatchOver) return null;
  131 |     if (this.scores[0] > this.scores[1]) return 1;
  132 |     if (this.scores[1] > this.scores[0]) return 2;
  133 |     return "draw";
  134 |   }
  135 | }
~~~

## src/games/water-guess/WaterRenderer.ts
SHA-256: 3d1a08ae62844c693c93af7fe67b025680a965b22f8b029df72b04c5c7a419cd
~~~text
    1 | import Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import { TUBE_HEIGHT } from "./Geometry";
    3 | import { theme } from "../../core/ThemeManager";
    4 | import { formatPercent } from "./WaterGuessRules";
    5 | 
    6 | export const TUBE = {
    7 |   cx: 210,
    8 |   yTop: 155, // 100.00% level
    9 |   yBottom: 465, // 0.00% level
   10 |   width: 82,
   11 |   innerHalfW: 36,
   12 |   height: TUBE_HEIGHT, // usable height: 465 - 155 = 310
   13 | };
   14 | 
   15 | export class WaterRenderer {
   16 |   constructor(private scene: Phaser.Scene) {}
   17 | 
   18 |   drawTube(
   19 |     g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics,
   20 |     currentWaterLevelHundredths: number, // 0..10000
   21 |     animTime: number,
   22 |     revealed: boolean,
   23 |     actualHundredths: number,
   24 |     guess0Hundredths: number | null,
   25 |     guess1Hundredths: number | null,
   26 |   ) {
   27 |     const { cx, yTop, yBottom, innerHalfW, height } = TUBE;
   28 | 
   29 |     // 1. Tube background (light glass tint)
   30 |     g.fillStyle(0xeaf4fc, 0.85);
   31 |     g.fillRoundedRect(
   32 |       cx - innerHalfW,
   33 |       yTop - 12,
   34 |       innerHalfW * 2,
   35 |       height + 24,
   36 |       18,
   37 |     );
   38 | 
   39 |     // 2. Graduation reference tick marks on the right side
   40 |     g.lineStyle(2, 0x95a5a6, 0.7);
   41 |     const ticks = [
   42 |       { pct: 0.25, label: "25%" },
   43 |       { pct: 0.5, label: "50%" },
   44 |       { pct: 0.75, label: "75%" },
   45 |     ];
   46 |     for (const t of ticks) {
   47 |       const y = yBottom - t.pct * height;
   48 |       g.lineBetween(cx + innerHalfW - 14, y, cx + innerHalfW - 2, y);
   49 |     }
   50 |     // Subtle 10% micro-ticks
   51 |     g.lineStyle(1, 0xbdc3c7, 0.4);
   52 |     for (let p = 0.1; p < 1.0; p += 0.1) {
   53 |       if (
   54 |         Math.abs(p - 0.25) < 0.01 ||
   55 |         Math.abs(p - 0.5) < 0.01 ||
   56 |         Math.abs(p - 0.75) < 0.01
   57 |       )
   58 |         continue;
   59 |       const y = yBottom - p * height;
   60 |       g.lineBetween(cx + innerHalfW - 8, y, cx + innerHalfW - 2, y);
   61 |     }
   62 | 
   63 |     // 3. Water body
   64 |     const frac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, currentWaterLevelHundredths / 10000));
   65 |     const waterHeight = frac * height;
   66 |     const waterBaseY = yBottom;
   67 |     const waterSurfaceY = waterBaseY - waterHeight;
   68 | 
   69 |     if (waterHeight > 0) {
   70 |       // Main water fill
   71 |       g.fillStyle(0x2980b9, 0.95);
   72 |       g.beginPath();
   73 |       g.moveTo(cx - innerHalfW + 2, waterBaseY);
   74 |       g.lineTo(cx - innerHalfW + 2, waterSurfaceY);
   75 | 
   76 |       // Subtle water ripple along surface
   77 |       const steps = 14;
   78 |       const stepW = (innerHalfW * 2 - 4) / steps;
   79 |       for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
   80 |         const x = cx - innerHalfW + 2 + i * stepW;
   81 |         const wave =
   82 |           Math.sin(animTime * 4.5 + i * 0.7) * 2.2 * Math.min(1, frac * 4);
   83 |         g.lineTo(x, waterSurfaceY + wave);
   84 |       }
   85 | 
   86 |       g.lineTo(cx + innerHalfW - 2, waterBaseY);
   87 |       g.closePath();
   88 |       g.fillPath();
   89 | 
   90 |       // Slightly lighter upper layer
   91 |       g.fillStyle(0x3498db, 0.75);
   92 |       g.fillRect(
   93 |         cx - innerHalfW + 2,
   94 |         waterSurfaceY + 4,
   95 |         innerHalfW * 2 - 4,
   96 |         Math.max(0, waterHeight - 4),
   97 |       );
   98 | 
   99 |       // Surface foam highlight
  100 |       g.lineStyle(2.5, 0xd4e6f1, 0.85);
  101 |       g.beginPath();
  102 |       for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
  103 |         const x = cx - innerHalfW + 2 + i * stepW;
  104 |         const wave =
  105 |           Math.sin(animTime * 4.5 + i * 0.7) * 2.2 * Math.min(1, frac * 4);
  106 |         if (i === 0) g.moveTo(x, waterSurfaceY + wave);
  107 |         else g.lineTo(x, waterSurfaceY + wave);
  108 |       }
  109 |       g.strokePath();
  110 |     }
  111 | 
  112 |     // 4. Glass reflection streak (left side)
  113 |     g.fillStyle(0xffffff, 0.35);
  114 |     g.fillRoundedRect(cx - innerHalfW + 6, yTop, 7, height - 10, 3);
  115 | 
  116 |     // 5. Outer tube glass contour and dark border
  117 |     g.lineStyle(4, theme.ink);
  118 |     g.strokeRoundedRect(
  119 |       cx - innerHalfW,
  120 |       yTop - 12,
  121 |       innerHalfW * 2,
  122 |       height + 24,
  123 |       18,
  124 |     );
  125 | 
  126 |     // Top rim lip
  127 |     g.lineStyle(5, theme.ink);
  128 |     g.lineBetween(
  129 |       cx - innerHalfW - 6,
  130 |       yTop - 12,
  131 |       cx + innerHalfW + 6,
  132 |       yTop - 12,
  133 |     );
  134 | 
  135 |     // 6. Reveal marker lines (if revealed)
  136 |     if (revealed) {
  137 |       // Actual green marker
  138 |       const actualY = yBottom - (actualHundredths / 10000) * height;
  139 |       g.lineStyle(3, 0x27ae60, 1);
  140 |       g.lineBetween(
  141 |         cx - innerHalfW - 14,
  142 |         actualY,
  143 |         cx + innerHalfW + 14,
  144 |         actualY,
  145 |       );
  146 | 
  147 |       // P1 Orange guess marker
  148 |       if (guess0Hundredths !== null) {
  149 |         const g0Y = yBottom - (guess0Hundredths / 10000) * height;
  150 |         g.lineStyle(2.5, theme.orange, 0.9);
  151 |         g.lineBetween(cx - innerHalfW - 22, g0Y, cx - innerHalfW - 2, g0Y);
  152 |       }
  153 | 
  154 |       // P2 Blue guess marker
  155 |       if (guess1Hundredths !== null) {
  156 |         const g1Y = yBottom - (guess1Hundredths / 10000) * height;
  157 |         g.lineStyle(2.5, theme.blue, 0.9);
  158 |         g.lineBetween(cx + innerHalfW + 2, g1Y, cx + innerHalfW + 22, g1Y);
  159 |       }
  160 |     }
  161 |   }
  162 | }
~~~

    1 | import Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | import type { GameManager } from "../core/GameManager";
    3 | import type {
    4 |   MiniGame,
    5 |   GameResult,
    6 |   MatchOptions,
    7 | } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    8 | import { getGame } from "../core/GameRegistry";
    9 | import { loadGame } from "../core/GameLoader";
   10 | import { InputManager } from "../core/InputManager";
   11 | import { theme } from "../core/ThemeManager";
   12 | import { rounded, label } from "../shared/components/drawing";
   13 | export class GameHost extends Phaser.Scene {
   14 |   module?: MiniGame;
   15 |   controls?: InputManager;
   16 |   paused = false;
   17 |   ready = false;
   18 |   private ended = false;
   19 |   private alive = false;
   20 |   private generation = 0;
   21 |   private id = "";
   22 |   private options!: MatchOptions;
   23 |   private restoredState?: unknown;
   24 |   private run = 0;
   25 |   private texts: Phaser.GameObjects.Text[] = [];
   26 |   private lastTime = 0;
   27 |   private clockText!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   28 |   private hint!: Phaser.GameObjects.Text;
   29 |   constructor(private app: GameManager) {
   30 |     super({ key: "GameHost" });
   31 |   }
   32 |   init(data: {
   33 |     id: string;
   34 |     options: MatchOptions;
   35 |     restoredState?: unknown;
   36 |     run: number;
   37 |   }) {
   38 |     this.id = data.id;
   39 |     this.options = data.options;
   40 |     this.restoredState = data.restoredState;
   41 |     this.run = data.run;
   42 |     this.paused = false;
   43 |     this.ready = false;
   44 |     this.ended = false;
   45 |     this.alive = true;
   46 |     this.texts = [];
   47 |     this.generation++;
   48 |   }
   49 |   create() {
   50 |     const generation = this.generation;
   51 |     const started = performance.now();
   52 |     const meta = getGame(this.id);
   53 |     this.cameras.main
   54 |       .setBackgroundColor(theme.paper)
   55 |       .setOrigin(0, 0)
   56 |       .setZoom(this.app.renderScale)
   57 |       .setScroll(0, 0);
   58 |     if (meta.presentation !== "custom") {
   59 |       const g = this.add.graphics();
   60 |       rounded(g, 18, 14, 44, 42, 13, theme.white, 2);
   61 |       rounded(g, 358, 14, 44, 42, 13, theme.white, 2);
   62 |       g.lineStyle(3, theme.ink)
   63 |         .lineBetween(44, 27, 35, 35)
   64 |         .lineBetween(35, 35, 44, 43)
   65 |         .lineBetween(35, 35, 49, 35);
   66 |       g.fillStyle(theme.ink)
   67 |         .fillRoundedRect(373, 27, 4, 16, 2)
   68 |         .fillRoundedRect(382, 27, 4, 16, 2);
   69 |       label(this, 210, 28, meta.name, 24);
   70 |       label(
   71 |         this,
   72 |         210,
   73 |         51,
   74 |         this.options.variant
   75 |           ? this.options.variant.toUpperCase()
   76 |           : "POCKET RIVALS",
   77 |         10,
   78 |         "#7d8583",
   79 |       );
   80 |       this.add
   81 |         .zone(40, 35, 50, 48)
   82 |         .setInteractive({ useHandCursor: true })
   83 |         .on("pointerup", () => this.app.pause("leave"));
   84 |       this.add
   85 |         .zone(380, 35, 50, 48)
   86 |         .setInteractive({ useHandCursor: true })
   87 |         .on("pointerup", () => this.app.pause());
   88 |       if (meta.category !== "arcade") {
   89 |         rounded(g, 141, 70, 138, 32, 12, theme.blue, 2);
   90 |         rounded(g, 141, 674, 138, 32, 12, theme.orange, 2);
   91 |         this.texts = [
   92 |           label(this, 210, 690, "ORANGE   0", 18),
   93 |           label(
   94 |             this,
   95 |             210,
   96 |             86,
   97 |             this.options.mode === "ai" ? "BLUE AI   0" : "BLUE   0",
   98 |             18,
   99 |           ).setRotation(this.options.mode === "ai" ? 0 : Math.PI),
  100 |         ];
  101 |       } else {
  102 |         rounded(g, 80, 70, 260, 32, 12, theme.blue, 2);
  103 |         this.texts = [
  104 |           label(this, 210, 86, "SCORE  0", 18),
  105 |           label(this, 210, 690, "", 15),
  106 |         ];
  107 |       }
  108 |       this.clockText = label(this, 73, 86, "", 18);
  109 |       this.hint = label(this, 210, 733, "", 11, "#697474");
  110 |       if (meta.category !== "arcade")
  111 |         label(this, 210, 714, "PLAYER 1", 9, "#8a8d84");
  112 |     }
  113 |     this.controls = new InputManager(this);
  114 |     this.events.once(Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, () => this.cleanup());
  115 |     void loadGame(this.id, this.options)
  116 |       .then((module) => {
  117 |         if (!this.alive || generation !== this.generation) {
  118 |           return;
  119 |         }
  120 |         this.module = module;
  121 |         module.initialize({
  122 |           reportAI: (ms) => this.app.diagnostics.computation(ms),
  123 |           bestScore: this.app.arcade.best(this.id),
  124 |           setArcadeHUD: (score, detail) => {
  125 |             this.texts[0]?.setText(
  126 |               `SCORE  ${score}    BEST  ${Math.max(score, this.app.arcade.best(this.id))}`,
  127 |             );
  128 |             this.texts[1]?.setText(detail);
  129 |           },
  130 |           finishArcade: (score, detail) => {
  131 |             if (this.ended) return;
  132 |             this.ended = true;
  133 |             this.pauseGame();
  134 |             this.app.finishArcade(score, detail, this.run);
  135 |           },
  136 |           scene: this,
  137 |           navigation: {
  138 |             pause: () => this.app.pause(),
  139 |             exit: () => this.app.pause("leave"),
  140 |           },
  141 |           options: this.options,
  142 |           restoredState: this.restoredState,
  143 |           saveState: (state) => this.app.checkpoint(this.run, state),
  144 |           input: this.controls!,
  145 |           audio: this.app.audio,
  146 |           setClock: (text, urgent) =>
  147 |             this.clockText
  148 |               ?.setText(text)
  149 |               .setColor(urgent ? "#b2462c" : "#697474"),
  150 |           setScore: (a, b) => this.setScore(a, b),
  151 |           setHint: (text) => this.hint?.setText(text),
  152 |           finish: (result) => this.finish(result),
  153 |         });
  154 |         this.ready = true;
  155 |         this.app.diagnostics.loaded(this.id);
  156 |         this.app.diagnostics.initialized(this.id, performance.now() - started);
  157 |         if (this.paused) {
  158 |           this.controls!.pause();
  159 |           module.pause();
  160 |         }
  161 |         this.lastTime = performance.now();
  162 |         this.game.events.once(Phaser.Core.Events.POST_RENDER, () => {
  163 |           if (this.alive && generation === this.generation)
  164 |             this.app.onReady(this.run);
  165 |         });
  166 |       })
  167 |       .catch((error) => {
  168 |         if (this.alive && generation === this.generation)
  169 |           this.app.showError(error);
  170 |       });
  171 |   }
  172 |   private setScore(a: number, b: number) {
  173 |     [a, b].forEach((value, i) => {
  174 |       const text = this.texts[i];
  175 |       const next = `${i === 0 ? "ORANGE" : this.options.mode === "ai" ? "BLUE AI" : "BLUE"}   ${value}`;
  176 |       if (text.text !== next) {
  177 |         text.setText(next);
  178 |         this.tweens.add({
  179 |           targets: text,
  180 |           scaleX: 1.16,
  181 |           scaleY: 1.16,
  182 |           duration: 100,
  183 |           yoyo: true,
  184 |         });
  185 |       }
  186 |     });
  187 |   }
  188 |   private finish(result: GameResult) {
  189 |     if (this.ended) return;
  190 |     this.ended = true;
  191 |     this.pauseGame();
  192 |     this.app.finish(result, this.run);
  193 |   }
  194 |   update() {
  195 |     const now = performance.now(),
  196 |       dt = this.lastTime ? (now - this.lastTime) / 1000 : 0;
  197 |     this.lastTime = now;
  198 |     if (this.ready && !this.paused) this.module?.update(dt);
  199 |     this.app.diagnostics.frame(
  200 |       dt,
  201 |       this.game.scene.getScenes(true).length,
  202 |       this.textures.getTextureKeys().length,
  203 |     );
  204 |   }
  205 |   pauseGame() {
  206 |     this.paused = true;
  207 |     this.controls?.pause();
  208 |     this.module?.pause();
  209 |   }
  210 |   resumeGame() {
  211 |     if (this.ended) return;
  212 |     this.paused = false;
  213 |     this.lastTime = performance.now();
  214 |     this.controls?.resume();
  215 |     this.module?.resume();
  216 |   }
  217 |   private cleanup() {
  218 |     this.alive = false;
  219 |     this.ready = false;
  220 |     this.module?.dispose();
  221 |     this.module = undefined;
  222 |     this.controls?.dispose();
  223 |     this.controls = undefined;
  224 |     this.texts = [];
  225 |   }
  226 |   snapshot() {
  227 |     return {
  228 |       id: this.id,
  229 |       options: this.options,
  230 |       ready: this.ready,
  231 |       paused: this.paused,
  232 |       ended: this.ended,
  233 |       inputListeners: this.controls?.listenerCount ?? 0,

  235 |       game: this.module?.snapshot?.(),
  236 |       children: this.children.length,
  237 |     };
  238 |   }
  239 | }

    1 | import type {
    2 |   GameMetadata,

    4 | } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";

    8 | export const difficultyButtons = (selected: string) =>
    9 |   `<div class="choice-label">AI DIFFICULTY</div><div class="segmented difficulty" role="radiogroup" aria-label="AI difficulty">${["medium", "hard", "impossible"].map((d) => `<button role="radio" aria-checked="${selected === d}" class="${selected === d ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="difficulty-${d}">${d[0].toUpperCase() + d.slice(1)}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
   10 | export class GameSetup {
   11 |   constructor(
   12 |     private modal: Modal,
   13 |     private launch: (options: MatchOptions) => void,
   14 |   ) {}
   15 |   open(meta: GameMetadata, options: MatchOptions = defaultOptions()) {
   16 |     const current = {
   17 |       ...options,
   18 |       variant: options.variant ?? meta.variants?.[0]?.id,
   19 |     };
   20 |     const render = () => {
   21 |       const variant = meta.variants?.find((v) => v.id === current.variant),
   22 |         ai =
   23 |           meta.supportedModes.includes("single-player") &&
   24 |           variant?.ai !== false;
   25 |       if (!ai) current.mode = "local";
   26 |       const actions: Record<string, () => void> = {
   27 |         close: () => this.modal.close(),
   28 |         local: () => {
   29 |           current.mode = "local";
   30 |           render();
   31 |         },
   32 |         ai: () => {
   33 |           if (ai) {
   34 |             current.mode = "ai";
   35 |             render();
   36 |           }
   37 |         },
   38 |         start: () => this.launch({ ...current }),
   39 |         help: () =>
   40 |           void loadTutorial(meta.id, current.variant!, {
   41 |             show: (html, actions) => this.modal.show(html, actions, "", render),
   42 |             done: render,
   43 |           }),
   44 |       };
   45 |       for (const d of ["medium", "hard", "impossible"] as const)
   46 |         actions[`difficulty-${d}`] = () => {
   47 |           current.difficulty = d;
   48 |           render();
   49 |         };
   50 |       for (const v of meta.variants ?? [])
   51 |         actions[`variant-${v.id}`] = () => {
   52 |           current.variant = v.id;
   53 |           render();
   54 |         };
   55 |       this.modal.show(
   56 |         `<div class="eyebrow">PICK YOUR RIVAL</div><h2 id="dialog-title">${meta.name}</h2>${meta.variants ? `<div class="variant-choices">${meta.variants.map((v) => `<button data-action="variant-${v.id}" class="variant-choice ${current.variant === v.id ? "selected" : ""}" aria-pressed="${current.variant === v.id}">${v.preview ? `<span class="variant-preview-icon">${v.preview}</span>` : ""}<b>${v.name}</b><small>${v.description}</small></button>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}<div class="segmented players" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Player mode"><button data-action="ai" role="radio" aria-checked="${current.mode === "ai"}" ${ai ? "" : "disabled"} class="${current.mode === "ai" ? "selected" : ""}">1 Player<small>vs AI${ai ? "" : " unavailable"}</small></button><button data-action="local" role="radio" aria-checked="${current.mode === "local"}" class="${current.mode === "local" ? "selected" : ""}">2 Players<small>on this phone</small></button></div>${current.mode === "ai" ? difficultyButtons(current.difficulty) : ""}<p class="setup-note">${current.mode === "ai" ? "You are orange. Blue is your opponent." : "Orange below. Blue across the phone."}${current.mode === "ai" && current.difficulty === "impossible" ? " Strongest available play; no unfair movement." : ""}</p><details class="setup-note"><summary>How to play</summary><p>${meta.instructions}</p></details><button class="primary-button" data-action="start">Let’s play →</button>${variant?.hasTutorial ? '<button class="text-button" data-action="help">How to play Ultimate</button>' : ""}<button class="text-button" data-action="close">Back</button>`,
   57 |         actions,
   58 |         "setup-modal",
   59 |       );
   60 |     };
   61 |     render();
   62 |   }
   63 | }

## src/shared/ai/MatchRandom.ts
SHA-256: d07ade6b650939f4187a7989382613b508ac4fb0a402616c45a19adc785f3094
~~~text
    1 | /** Isolated, lazy AI support. Contains no game rules and no Math Quiz imports. */
    2 | export type SeedInput = number | (() => number);
    3 | export function mixSeed(seed: number, salt: number) {
    4 |   let n = (seed ^ Math.imul(salt + 1, 0x9e3779b9)) >>> 0;
    5 |   n = Math.imul(n ^ (n >>> 16), 0x21f0aaad);
    6 |   n = Math.imul(n ^ (n >>> 15), 0x735a2d97);
    7 |   return (n ^ (n >>> 15)) >>> 0;
    8 | }
    9 | export function freshSeed(): number {
   10 |   if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof location !== "undefined") {
   11 |     const value = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("aiSeed");
   12 |     if (value !== null && /^\d+$/.test(value)) return Number(value) >>> 0;
   13 |   }
   14 |   if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.getRandomValues)
   15 |     return crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0];
   16 |   return (Math.random() * 4294967296) >>> 0;
   17 | }
   18 | export function replayMode() {
   19 |   return (
   20 |     import.meta.env.DEV &&
   21 |     typeof location !== "undefined" &&
   22 |     new URLSearchParams(location.search).has("aiReplay")
   23 |   );
   24 | }
   25 | export interface AIIdentity {
   26 |   seed: number;
   27 |   profile: number;
   28 |   role: number;
   29 |   tempo: number;
   30 |   side: -1 | 1;
   31 | }
   32 | export class MatchRandom {
   33 |   readonly seed: number;
   34 |   readonly profile: number;
   35 |   readonly role: number;
   36 |   readonly tempo: number;
   37 |   readonly side: -1 | 1;
   38 |   private state: number;
   39 |   constructor(input: SeedInput = freshSeed()) {
   40 |     this.seed =
   41 |       typeof input === "number" ? input >>> 0 : (input() * 4294967296) >>> 0;
   42 |     this.state = mixSeed(this.seed, 1);
   43 |     this.profile = mixSeed(this.seed, 0) % 24;
   44 |     this.role = Math.floor(this.profile / 6);
   45 |     this.tempo = Math.floor((this.profile % 6) / 2);
   46 |     this.side = this.profile % 2 ? 1 : -1;
   47 |   }
   48 |   next = () => {
   49 |     this.state = (this.state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
   50 |     let t = this.state;
   51 |     t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
   52 |     t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
   53 |     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
   54 |   };
   55 |   /** Bounded bell-shaped jitter, sampled at decisions, never in a render loop. */
   56 |   sample(mean: number, spread: number, min: number) {
   57 |     return Math.max(
   58 |       min,
   59 |       mean + (spread * (this.next() + this.next() + this.next() - 1.5)) / 1.5,
   60 |     );
   61 |   }
   62 |   rank(action: number, salt = 0) {
   63 |     return mixSeed(this.seed, action + salt * 97) / 4294967296;
   64 |   }
   65 |   turnSeed(turn: number) {
   66 |     return mixSeed(this.seed, turn + 101);
   67 |   }
   68 |   snapshot(): AIIdentity {
   69 |     return {
   70 |       seed: this.seed,
   71 |       profile: this.profile,
   72 |       role: this.role,
   73 |       tempo: this.tempo,
   74 |       side: this.side,
   75 |     };
   76 |   }
   77 | }
   78 | export function restoredAISeed(state: unknown): number | undefined {
   79 |   const value = (state as { ai?: { seed?: unknown } } | undefined)?.ai?.seed;
   80 |   return typeof value === "number" &&
   81 |     Number.isInteger(value) &&
   82 |     value >= 0 &&
   83 |     value <= 4294967295
   84 |     ? value
   85 |     : undefined;
   86 | }
~~~

    1 | export class Modal {
    2 |   private root = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#overlays")!;
    3 |   private previous: HTMLElement | null = null;
    4 |   private backAction?: () => void;
    5 |   get isOpen() {
    6 |     return this.root.childElementCount > 0;
    7 |   }
    8 |   show(
    9 |     content: string,
   10 |     actions: Record<string, () => void>,
   11 |     className = "",
   12 |     back?: () => void,
   13 |   ) {
   14 |     if (!this.isOpen) this.previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
   15 |     this.backAction = back;
   16 |     for (const id of ["#menu", "#game-stage"]) {
   17 |       const node = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(id)!;
   18 |       node.inert = true;
   19 |       node.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
   20 |     }
   21 |     const focused = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.dataset.action;
   22 |     let panel = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".modal");
   23 |     if (!panel) {
   24 |       this.root.innerHTML =
   25 |         '<div class="modal-backdrop"><section class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dialog-title"></section></div>';
   26 |       panel = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".modal")!;
   27 |     }
   28 |     panel.className = `modal ${className}`;
   29 |     panel.innerHTML = content;
   30 |     this.root
   31 |       .querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-action]")
   32 |       .forEach((b) => (b.onclick = () => actions[b.dataset.action!]?.()));
   33 |     (focused
   34 |       ? this.root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
   35 |           `[data-action="${CSS.escape(focused)}"]`,
   36 |         )
   37 |       : null
   38 |     )?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
   39 |     if (!this.root.contains(document.activeElement))
   40 |       this.root
   41 |         .querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("button:not([disabled])")
   42 |         ?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
   43 |     return this.root;
   44 |   }
   45 |   back() {
   46 |     if (this.backAction) this.backAction();
   47 |     else this.close();
   48 |   }
   49 |   close() {
   50 |     this.root.replaceChildren();
   51 |     this.backAction = undefined;
   52 |     for (const id of ["#menu", "#game-stage"]) {
   53 |       const node = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(id)!;
   54 |       node.inert = false;
   55 |       node.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
   56 |     }
   57 |     if (this.previous?.isConnected)
   58 |       this.previous.focus({ preventScroll: true });
   59 |     this.previous = null;
   60 |   }
   61 |   trapFocus(e: KeyboardEvent) {
   62 |     if (e.key !== "Tab" || !this.isOpen) return;
   63 |     const list = Array.from(
   64 |       this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
   65 |         "button:not([disabled]),a[href],input,select",
   66 |       ),
   67 |     );
   68 |     const first = list[0],
   69 |       last = list.at(-1);
   70 |     if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
   71 |       e.preventDefault();
   72 |       last?.focus();
   73 |     } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
   74 |       e.preventDefault();
   75 |       first?.focus();
   76 |     }
   77 |   }
   78 | }

## src/shared/components/TurnView.ts
SHA-256: 887c41595802046111fc51c291b3d20bc4fe2314046ff1c634e06f01c62f5dc8
~~~text
    1 | import type Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | /** Rotate only module-owned play content; host navigation stays fixed. */
    3 | export class TurnView {
    4 |   private root: Phaser.GameObjects.Container;
    5 |   private target = false;
    6 |   private flipped = false;
    7 |   private age = 0;
    8 |   constructor(
    9 |     scene: Phaser.Scene,
   10 |     children: (Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics | Phaser.GameObjects.Text)[],
   11 |   ) {
   12 |     this.root = scene.add.container(210, 381);
   13 |     for (const child of children) {
   14 |       child.setPosition(child.x - 210, child.y - 381);
   15 |       this.root.add(child);
   16 |     }
   17 |   }
   18 |   set(flipped: boolean) {
   19 |     if (flipped !== this.target) {
   20 |       this.target = flipped;
   21 |       this.age = 0.28;
   22 |     }
   23 |   }
   24 |   update(dt: number) {
   25 |     if (this.age <= 0) return;
   26 |     this.age = Math.max(0, this.age - dt);
   27 |     if (this.age <= 0.14 && this.flipped !== this.target) {
   28 |       this.flipped = this.target;
   29 |       this.root.setRotation(this.flipped ? Math.PI : 0);
   30 |     }
   31 |     this.root.setAlpha(1 - 0.22 * Math.sin((Math.PI * this.age) / 0.28));
   32 |   }
   33 |   get ready() {
   34 |     return this.age === 0;
   35 |   }
   36 |   point(x: number, y: number) {
   37 |     return this.flipped ? { x: 420 - x, y: 762 - y } : { x, y };
   38 |   }
   39 |   get rotation() {
   40 |     return this.flipped ? Math.PI : 0;
   41 |   }
   42 |   destroy() {
   43 |     this.root.destroy(true);
   44 |   }
   45 | }
   46 | export const turnBackground = (player: 1 | 2) =>
   47 |   player === 1 ? 0xf7e1cc : 0xd9eaf4;
~~~

    1 | import Phaser from "phaser";
    2 | interface Pulse {
    3 |   x: number;
    4 |   y: number;
    5 |   color: number;
    6 |   life: number;
    7 | }
    8 | export class Impacts {
    9 |   private pool: Pulse[] = Array.from({ length: 14 }, () => ({
   10 |     x: 0,
   11 |     y: 0,
   12 |     color: 0,
   13 |     life: 0,
   14 |   }));
   15 |   private cursor = 0;
   16 |   burst(x: number, y: number, color: number) {
   17 |     const p = this.pool[this.cursor++ % this.pool.length];
   18 |     p.x = x;
   19 |     p.y = y;
   20 |     p.color = color;
   21 |     p.life = 0.22;
   22 |   }
   23 |   draw(g: Phaser.GameObjects.Graphics, dt: number) {
   24 |     for (const p of this.pool) {
   25 |       if (p.life <= 0) continue;
   26 |       p.life -= dt;
   27 |       const t = Math.max(0, p.life / 0.22);
   28 |       g.lineStyle(3 * t, p.color, t).strokeCircle(p.x, p.y, 8 + (1 - t) * 22);
   29 |     }
   30 |   }
   31 | }

## src/shared/physics/FixedStep.ts
SHA-256: b489bc600cf248e85f80f303508446aaf83727ffbb312ecdbab30c5036caaabf
~~~text
    1 | export class FixedStep {
    2 |   private accumulator = 0;
    3 |   readonly step = 1 / 120;
    4 |   advance(deltaSeconds: number, tick: (dt: number) => void) {
    5 |     this.accumulator += Math.max(0, Math.min(deltaSeconds, 0.1));
    6 |     let n = 0;
    7 |     while (this.accumulator + 1e-10 >= this.step && n++ < 12) {
    8 |       tick(this.step);
    9 |       this.accumulator -= this.step;
   10 |     }
   11 |   }
   12 |   reset() {
   13 |     this.accumulator = 0;
   14 |   }
   15 |   get remainder() {
   16 |     return this.accumulator;
   17 |   }
   18 |   get fraction() {
   19 |     return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, this.accumulator / this.step));
   20 |   }
   21 | }
   22 | export const clamp = (v: number, min: number, max: number) =>
   23 |   Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
~~~

## src/shared/physics/MotionController.ts
SHA-256: dfc05c338c389f9564296fd4a75fe68d0017a3dbb1b1c8842193d8b547be9e5c
~~~text
    1 | /** Acceleration-limited, critically damped movement. Targets may change; motion stays continuous. */
    2 | export class MotionController {
    3 |   vx = 0;
    4 |   vy = 0;
    5 |   private tx: number;
    6 |   private ty: number;
    7 |   constructor(x: number, y: number) {
    8 |     this.tx = x;
    9 |     this.ty = y;
   10 |   }
   11 |   reset(x: number, y: number) {
   12 |     this.vx = this.vy = 0;
   13 |     this.tx = x;
   14 |     this.ty = y;
   15 |   }
   16 |   move(
   17 |     dt: number,
   18 |     x: number,
   19 |     y: number,
   20 |     targetX: number,
   21 |     targetY: number,
   22 |     speed: number,
   23 |     acceleration = speed * 7,
   24 |   ) {
   25 |     const blend = 1 - Math.exp(-18 * dt);
   26 |     this.tx += (targetX - this.tx) * blend;
   27 |     this.ty += (targetY - this.ty) * blend;
   28 |     const dx = this.tx - x,
   29 |       dy = this.ty - y,
   30 |       d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   31 |     const desired = Math.min(speed, d * 10, Math.sqrt(2 * acceleration * d));
   32 |     const wantX = d > 0.3 ? (dx / d) * desired : 0,
   33 |       wantY = d > 0.3 ? (dy / d) * desired : 0;
   34 |     const ax = wantX - this.vx,
   35 |       ay = wantY - this.vy,
   36 |       a = Math.hypot(ax, ay),
   37 |       s = a ? Math.min(1, (acceleration * dt) / a) : 0;
   38 |     this.vx += ax * s;
   39 |     this.vy += ay * s;
   40 |     // A subpixel deadband avoids limit cycles, without snapping a visible distance.
   41 |     if (d < 0.3 && Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy) < 3) this.vx = this.vy = 0;
   42 |     return { x: x + this.vx * dt, y: y + this.vy * dt };
   43 |   }
   44 | }
~~~

## src/shared/rules/FirstResponse.ts
SHA-256: 33a961e55821c2307d0e90675cca179875203cda684d4f75f6ed56b1fcaf6db3
~~~text
    1 | /** First response per player; input events in the same simulation frame tie fairly. */
    2 | export class FirstResponse<T> {
    3 |   private entries: { player: 0 | 1; value: T; time: number }[] = [];
    4 |   add(player: 0 | 1, value: T, time: number) {
    5 |     if (this.entries.some((e) => e.player === player)) return;
    6 |     this.entries.push({ player, value, time });
    7 |   }
    8 |   resolve(now: number) {
    9 |     const first = this.entries[0];
   10 |     if (!first || now - first.time < 0.009) return null;
   11 |     const other = this.entries[1],
   12 |       tie = !!other && Math.abs(other.time - first.time) <= 0.008;
   13 |     this.entries = [];
   14 |     return { first, tie };
   15 |   }
   16 |   clear() {
   17 |     this.entries = [];
   18 |   }
   19 | }
~~~

## src/shared/rules/MatchClock.ts
SHA-256: a791304380e72c6f84848ae584a3dccdd82345fac0609adcc1d568c95b192e6d
~~~text
    1 | import type { Winner } from "../contracts/GameResult";
    2 | /** Feed foreground monotonic elapsed seconds, independently of the physics catch-up cap. */
    3 | export class MatchClock {
    4 |   remaining = 120;
    5 |   overtime = false;
    6 |   winner: Winner | null = null;
    7 |   score(scores: readonly number[]) {
    8 |     if (this.winner !== null) return this.winner;
    9 |     if (scores[0] >= 5 || scores[1] >= 5)
   10 |       this.winner = scores[0] > scores[1] ? 1 : 2;
   11 |     else if (this.overtime && scores[0] !== scores[1])
   12 |       this.winner = scores[0] > scores[1] ? 1 : 2;
   13 |     return this.winner;
   14 |   }
   15 |   advance(dt: number, scores: readonly number[]) {
   16 |     if (this.score(scores) !== null) return this.winner;
   17 |     this.remaining -= Math.max(0, dt);
   18 |     if (this.remaining <= 0) {
   19 |       if (scores[0] !== scores[1]) this.winner = scores[0] > scores[1] ? 1 : 2;
   20 |       else if (!this.overtime && scores[0] > 0) {
   21 |         this.overtime = true;
   22 |         this.remaining += 60;
   23 |         if (this.remaining <= 0) this.winner = "draw";
   24 |       } else this.winner = "draw";
   25 |     }
   26 |     if (this.winner !== null) this.remaining = Math.max(0, this.remaining);
   27 |     return this.winner;
   28 |   }
   29 |   get text() {
   30 |     const t = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(this.remaining));
   31 |     return `${this.overtime ? "OT " : ""}${Math.floor(t / 60)}:${String(t % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
   32 |   }
   33 | }
~~~

## src/shared/utilities/WorkerTask.ts
SHA-256: 7bb5b1de6a145686fede546507513db4768d3f3dbea91444ab69b45f163a5ca8
~~~text
    1 | /** One outstanding computation. Cancellation terminates CPU work, including on scene exit. */
    2 | export class WorkerTask<Input, Output> {
    3 |   private worker?: Worker;
    4 |   private resolve?: (value: Output | null) => void;
    5 |   private timeout?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    6 |   constructor(
    7 |     private create: () => Worker,
    8 |     private report: (ms: number) => void = () => {},
    9 |   ) {}
   10 |   run(input: Input): Promise<Output | null> {
   11 |     this.cancel();
   12 |     const start = performance.now();
   13 |     return new Promise((resolve) => {
   14 |       this.resolve = resolve;
   15 |       const finish = (value: Output | null) => {
   16 |         const reported = (value as { milliseconds?: number } | null)
   17 |           ?.milliseconds;
   18 |         this.report(
   19 |           typeof reported === "number" ? reported : performance.now() - start,
   20 |         );
   21 |         this.cancel(value);
   22 |       };
   23 |       try {
   24 |         this.worker = this.create();
   25 |         this.worker.onmessage = (e) => finish(e.data as Output);
   26 |         this.worker.onerror = () => finish(null);
   27 |         this.worker.postMessage(input);
   28 |         this.timeout = setTimeout(() => finish(null), 2000);
   29 |       } catch {
   30 |         finish(null);
   31 |       }
   32 |     });
   33 |   }
   34 |   cancel(value: Output | null = null) {
   35 |     clearTimeout(this.timeout);
   36 |     this.worker?.terminate();
   37 |     this.worker = undefined;
   38 |     const resolve = this.resolve;
   39 |     this.resolve = undefined;
   40 |     resolve?.(value);
   41 |   }
   42 | }
~~~

    1 | import type { GameManager } from "../core/GameManager";
    2 | import { tournamentGames, getGame } from "../core/GameRegistry";
    3 | import { shuffledSchedule } from "../core/TournamentManager";
    4 | import { difficultyButtons } from "../scenes/GameSetup";
    5 | import type { Difficulty } from "../shared/contracts/AIController";
    6 | import type { MatchSpec } from "../shared/contracts/GameModule";
    7 | import { icons } from "../shared/components/icons";
    8 | export class TournamentScene {
    9 |   constructor(private app: GameManager) {}
   10 |   setup() {
   11 |     let mode: "local" | "ai" = "local",
   12 |       difficulty: Difficulty = "medium",
   13 |       rounds = 3,
   14 |       manual = false;
   15 |     const selected = new Set<string>();
   16 |     const entries = () =>
   17 |       tournamentGames.flatMap((g) =>
   18 |         (g.variants ?? [{ id: undefined, name: g.name }])
   19 |           .filter(
   20 |             (v) =>
   21 |               mode === "local" ||
   22 |               (g.supportedModes.includes("single-player") &&
   23 |                 (!("ai" in v) || v.ai !== false)),
   24 |           )
   25 |           .map((v) => ({
   26 |             key: g.id + ":" + (v.id ?? ""),
   27 |             name: g.name + (v.id ? " · " + v.name.split(" —")[0] : ""),
   28 |             spec: {
   29 |               gameId: g.id,
   30 |               options: { mode, difficulty, variant: v.id },
   31 |             } as MatchSpec,
   32 |           })),
   33 |       );
   34 |     const render = () => {
   35 |       const pool = entries();
   36 |       const actions: Record<string, () => void> = {
   37 |         close: () => this.app.modal.close(),
   38 |         ai: () => {
   39 |           mode = "ai";
   40 |           render();
   41 |         },
   42 |         local: () => {
   43 |           mode = "local";
   44 |           render();
   45 |         },
   46 |         random: () => {
   47 |           manual = false;
   48 |           render();
   49 |         },
   50 |         manual: () => {
   51 |           manual = true;
   52 |           render();
   53 |         },
   54 |         start: () => {
   55 |           const chosen = pool.filter((e) => !manual || selected.has(e.key));
   56 |           if (!chosen.length) return;
   57 |           this.app.tournament.create(
   58 |             shuffledSchedule(
   59 |               chosen.map((e) => e.spec),
   60 |               rounds,
   61 |             ),
   62 |           );
   63 |           this.app.showTournament();
   64 |         },
   65 |       };
   66 |       for (const d of ["medium", "hard", "impossible"] as const)
   67 |         actions[`difficulty-${d}`] = () => {
   68 |           difficulty = d;
   69 |           render();
   70 |         };
   71 |       for (const e of pool)
   72 |         actions[`choose-${e.key}`] = () => {
   73 |           if (selected.has(e.key)) selected.delete(e.key);
   74 |           else selected.add(e.key);
   75 |           render();
   76 |         };
   77 |       const root = this.app.modal.show(
   78 |         `<div class="eyebrow">A PROPER LITTLE SHOWDOWN</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Make it a tournament.</h2><div class="segmented players"><button data-action="local" class="${mode === "local" ? "selected" : ""}">2 Players<small>local rivals</small></button><button data-action="ai" class="${mode === "ai" ? "selected" : ""}">1 Player<small>vs Blue AI</small></button></div>${mode === "ai" ? difficultyButtons(difficulty) : ""}<label class="round-control">Number of rounds <select aria-label="Number of rounds">${Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => `<option value="${i + 1}" ${rounds === i + 1 ? "selected" : ""}>${i + 1}</option>`).join("")}</select></label><div class="segmented"><button data-action="random" class="${!manual ? "selected" : ""}">All games</button><button data-action="manual" class="${manual ? "selected" : ""}">Choose games</button></div>${manual ? `<div class="game-picks">${pool.map((e) => `<button role="checkbox" aria-checked="${selected.has(e.key)}" data-action="choose-${e.key}" class="${selected.has(e.key) ? "selected" : ""}">${selected.has(e.key) ? "✓" : "○"} ${e.name}</button>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}<p class="setup-note">Shuffled rounds. One point per win.<br>Draws give ½ point to each rival.${this.app.tournament.state ? "<br>Starting a new tournament replaces the saved one." : ""}</p><button class="primary-button" data-action="start" ${manual && !pool.some((e) => selected.has(e.key)) ? "disabled" : ""}>Start tournament →</button><button class="text-button" data-action="close">Back</button>`,
   79 |         actions,
   80 |         "tournament-setup",
   81 |       );
   82 |       root.querySelector("select")!.onchange = (e) => {
   83 |         rounds = Number((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value);
   84 |       };
   85 |     };
   86 |     render();
   87 |   }
   88 |   show() {
   89 |     const s = this.app.tournament.state;
   90 |     if (!s) {
   91 |       this.setup();
   92 |       return;
   93 |     }
   94 |     const complete = s.phase === "complete",
   95 |       blue = s.plan[0].options.mode === "ai" ? "BLUE AI" : "BLUE";
   96 |     const champion =
   97 |       s.points[0] === s.points[1]
   98 |         ? "Two worthy champions."
   99 |         : s.points[0] > s.points[1]
  100 |           ? "Orange is the champion!"
  101 |           : `${blue === "BLUE AI" ? "Blue AI" : "Blue"} is the champion!`;
  102 |     const next = this.app.tournament.current();
  103 |     let nextName = "";
  104 |     try {
  105 |       if (next) nextName = getGame(next.gameId).name;
  106 |     } catch {
  107 |       nextName = "Unavailable game";
  108 |     }
  109 |     const last = s.results.at(-1);
  110 |     const actions = {
  111 |       play: () => this.app.startTournamentRound(),
  112 |       menu: () => this.app.goMenu(),
  113 |       rematch: () => {
  114 |         this.app.tournament.rematch();
  115 |         this.app.showTournament();
  116 |       },
  117 |       new: () => this.setup(),
  118 |     };
  119 |     this.app.modal.show(
  120 |       `<span class="tournament-cup">${icons.cup}</span><div class="eyebrow">${complete ? "THE FINAL SCORE" : `ROUND ${s.results.length + 1} OF ${s.plan.length}`}</div><h2 id="dialog-title">${complete ? champion : last ? (last.winner === "draw" ? "Half a point each." : `${last.winner === 1 ? "Orange" : blue === "BLUE AI" ? "Blue AI" : "Blue"} wins the round.`) : "Let the rivalry begin."}</h2><div class="tournament-score"><div><small>ORANGE</small><b>${s.points[0]}</b></div><span>—</span><div><small>${blue}</small><b>${s.points[1]}</b></div></div><div class="round-dots">${s.plan.map((_, i) => `<i class="${i < s.results.length ? "done" : i === s.results.length ? "current" : ""}"></i>`).join("")}</div>${complete ? "" : `<p>Up next: <b>${nextName}</b>${next?.options.variant ? ` · ${next.options.variant}` : ""}<br>${s.phase === "playing" ? "Your unfinished round is ready to resume." : "One game. One point. Make it count."}</p>`}${s.results.length ? `<div class="round-history">${s.results.map((r, i) => `<span>Round ${i + 1}<b>${r.winner === "draw" ? "Draw · ½ each" : r.winner === 1 ? "Orange +1" : blue + " +1"}</b></span>`).join("")}</div>` : ""}<button class="primary-button" data-action="${complete ? "rematch" : "play"}">${complete ? "Tournament rematch" : s.phase === "playing" ? "Resume round" : "Play next round"} →</button><button class="secondary-button" data-action="new">New tournament</button><button class="text-button" data-action="menu">${complete ? "Back to all games" : "Save & return to menu"}</button>`,
  121 |       actions,
  122 |       "tournament-results",
  123 |       () => this.app.goMenu(),
  124 |     );
  125 |   }
  126 | }

    1 | import { test, expect, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
    2 | const state = (p: Page) => p.evaluate(() => (window as any).__POCKET__);
    3 | async function tap(p: Page, x: number, y: number) {
    4 |   const b = (await p.locator("canvas").boundingBox())!;
    5 |   await p.touchscreen.tap(
    6 |     b.x + (x / 420) * b.width,
    7 |     b.y + (y / 760) * b.height,
    8 |   );
    9 | }
   10 | test("seeded personalities, all AI lifecycles, and worker cleanup survive repeated navigation", async ({
   11 |   page,
   12 | }) => {
   13 |   test.setTimeout(120000);
   14 |   const errors: string[] = [];
   15 |   page.on("pageerror", (e) => errors.push(e.message));
   16 |   await page.addInitScript(() => {
   17 |     const Original = window.Worker;
   18 |     const active = new Set<Worker>();
   19 |     (window as any).__aiWorkers = active;
   20 |     window.Worker = class extends Original {
   21 |       constructor(url: string | URL, options?: WorkerOptions) {
   22 |         super(url, options);
   23 |         active.add(this);
   24 |       }
   25 |       terminate() {
   26 |         active.delete(this);
   27 |         super.terminate();
   28 |       }
   29 |     };
   30 |   });
   31 |   await page.goto("/?aiSeed=314159&aiReplay&diagnostics");
   32 |   for (const [name, variant, x, y] of [
   33 |     ["Pong", "", 0, 0],
   34 |     ["Air Hockey", "", 0, 0],
   35 |     ["Tic-Tac-Toe", "Classic", 102, 273],
   36 |     ["Tic-Tac-Toe", "Ultimate", 52, 233],
   37 |     ["Connect Four", "", 210, 280],
   38 |     ["Dots and Boxes", "", 97, 240],
   39 |     ["Hammer Hit", "", 0, 0],
   40 |     ["Light Fingers", "", 0, 0],
   41 |     ["Fruit Duel", "", 0, 0],
   42 |     ["Lumberjack", "", 0, 0],
   43 |     ["Connect Four", "", 160, 280],
   44 |     ["Dots and Boxes", "", 172, 240],
   45 |   ] as const) {
   46 |     await page
   47 |       .getByRole("button", { name: `Play ${name}`, exact: true })
   48 |       .click();
   49 |     if (variant)
   50 |       await page
   51 |         .getByRole("button", { name: new RegExp(variant + " —") })
   52 |         .click();
   53 |     await page.getByRole("radio", { name: /1 Player/ }).click();
   54 |     await page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Hard", exact: true }).click();

   56 |     await expect.poll(async () => (await state(page)).scene.ready).toBe(true);
   57 |     await page.waitForTimeout(320);
   58 |     expect((await state(page)).scene.game.ai.seed).toBe(314159);
   59 |     if (x) await tap(page, x, y);
   60 |     await page.waitForTimeout(750);
   61 |     await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
   62 |     await expect(
   63 |       page.getByRole("heading", { name: "A little timeout?" }),
   64 |     ).toBeVisible();
   65 |     const paused = (await state(page)).scene.game;
   66 |     await page.waitForTimeout(350);
   67 |     expect((await state(page)).scene.game).toEqual(paused);
   68 |     expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__aiWorkers.size)).toBe(0);
   69 |     await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Keep playing/ }).click();
   70 |     await page.waitForTimeout(150);
   71 |     await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
   72 |     await page
   73 |       .getByRole("button", { name: "Back to all games", exact: true })
   74 |       .click();
   75 |     expect((await state(page)).scene.inputListeners).toBe(0);
   76 |     expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__aiWorkers.size)).toBe(0);
   77 |   }

   34 |   await page.keyboard.up("KeyD");
   35 |   await page.keyboard.up("KeyS");
   36 | 
   37 |   // Player 1 (Blue) uses Arrows: move right and down towards net
