   42 |   await page.keyboard.up("ArrowRight");
   43 |   await page.keyboard.up("ArrowDown");
   44 | 
   45 |   // Player 1 moves left and up towards back rail

   47 |   await page.keyboard.down("ArrowUp");
   48 |   await expect.poll(async () => (await mallets(page))[1].x).toBeLessThan(190);
   49 |   await expect.poll(async () => (await mallets(page))[1].y).toBeLessThan(170);
   50 |   await page.keyboard.up("ArrowLeft");
   51 |   await page.keyboard.up("ArrowUp");
   52 | 
   53 |   // Pause test: pause clears input and stops mallets

   55 |   await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: /Keep playing/ })).toBeVisible();
   56 |   const stopped = await mallets(page);
   57 |   await page.waitForTimeout(100);
   58 |   expect(await mallets(page)).toEqual(stopped);
   59 | });

    1 | import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
    2 | 
    3 | test('Math Quiz visual capture across viewports and formulas', async ({ page }) => {
    4 |   await page.goto('/?diagnostics');
    5 |   await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Play Math Quiz', exact: true }).click();
    6 |   await page.getByRole('button', { name: /University Challenge/ }).click();
    7 |   await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Let’s play/ }).click();
    8 |   await expect(page.locator('.quiz-overlay')).toBeVisible();
    9 | 
   10 |   await expect.poll(async () => (await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__POCKET__)).scene.ready).toBe(true);
   11 | 
   12 |   const formulasToTest = [
   13 |     { id: 'binom', latex: String.raw`\binom{7}{2}`, topic: 'Probability', options: ['14', '21', '42'] },
   14 |     { id: 'hard-limit', latex: String.raw`\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x-x\cos x}{x^3}`, topic: 'Limits', options: [String.raw`\frac13`, String.raw`\frac16`, String.raw`\frac12`] },
   15 |     { id: 'integral-sym', latex: String.raw`\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}x^3\cos^2x\,dx`, topic: 'Integrals', options: ['0', String.raw`\frac{\pi^4}{2}`, String.raw`-\frac{\pi^4}{2}`] },
   16 |     { id: 'matrix', latex: String.raw`\det\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\4&1\end{pmatrix}`, topic: 'Matrices', options: ['-1', '1', '7'] },
   17 |     { id: 'summation', latex: String.raw`\sum_{n=1}^\infty\left(\frac1{4}\right)^n`, topic: 'Algebra', options: [String.raw`\frac13`, String.raw`\frac14`, String.raw`\frac43`] },
   18 |     { id: 'log-chain', latex: String.raw`\left.\frac{d}{dx}\ln(\sin x)\right|_{x=\frac\pi4}`, topic: 'Derivatives', options: ['1', String.raw`\sqrt2`, String.raw`\frac12`] },
   19 |   ];
   20 | 
   21 |   // Test across each formula
   22 |   for (const item of formulasToTest) {
   23 |     await page.evaluate(async (data) => {
   24 |       const { renderMath } = await import('/src/games/math-quiz/MathUI.ts' as string);
   25 |       document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-topic').forEach((t) => {
   26 |         t.textContent = data.topic;
   27 |       });
   28 |       document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-formula').forEach((n) => renderMath(data.latex, n as HTMLElement));
   29 |       document.querySelectorAll('button[data-player]').forEach((b) => {
   30 |         const idx = Number((b as HTMLElement).dataset.answer);
   31 |         renderMath(data.options[idx], b as HTMLElement);
   32 |       });
   33 |       const middleSpan = document.querySelector('.quiz-middle span');
   34 |       if (middleSpan) middleSpan.textContent = `${data.topic} · FIRST TO 10`;
   35 |       const explain = document.querySelector('.quiz-explanation') as HTMLElement;
   36 |       if (explain) explain.replaceChildren();
   37 |     }, item);
   38 | 
   39 |     await page.waitForTimeout(50);
   40 |     await page.screenshot({ path: `test-results/math-quiz-formula-${item.id}.png` });
   41 |   }
   42 | 
   43 |   // Test binomial choose-pair across all 4 target viewports
   44 |   const viewports = [
   45 |     { width: 320, height: 568, name: '320x568' },
   46 |     { width: 375, height: 667, name: '375x667' },
   47 |     { width: 390, height: 844, name: '390x844' },
   48 |     { width: 1280, height: 720, name: 'desktop' },
   49 |   ];
   50 | 
   51 |   for (const vp of viewports) {
   52 |     await page.setViewportSize({ width: vp.width, height: vp.height });
   53 |     await page.waitForTimeout(200);
   54 |     // trigger resize
   55 |     await page.evaluate(() => {

   58 |     await page.waitForTimeout(100);
   59 |     await page.screenshot({ path: `test-results/math-quiz-${vp.name}-binom.png` });

   61 | });

   30 |     .poll(async () => (await paddles(page)).map((p) => p.x))
   31 |     .toEqual([352, 68]);
   32 |   await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
   33 |   await page.keyboard.up("KeyD");
   34 |   await page.keyboard.up("ArrowLeft");

   38 |   await page.keyboard.down("KeyA");

   40 |   await page.keyboard.up("KeyA");

  184 | test("a complete Temple run uses real touch shots, banks its score and persists its record", async ({
  185 |   page,
  186 | }) => {
  187 |   test.setTimeout(60000);
  188 |   await open(page);
  189 |   await page.clock.install();
  190 |   await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
  191 |   await page.getByRole("button", { name: "1 Player Casual" }).click();
  192 |   await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Easy", exact: true }).click();
  193 |   await page.clock.runFor(32);
  194 |   await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Lost Temple/ }).click();
  195 |   expect((await state(page)).scene.game.course).toBe("temple");
  196 |   const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
  197 |   async function shot(vx: number, vy: number) {
  198 |     const start = await center(page),
  199 |       scale = (await state(page)).scene.game.view.scale,
  200 |       end = {
  201 |         x: start.x + (vy / 3.125) * scale,
  202 |         y: start.y - (vx / 3.125) * scale,
  203 |       };
  204 |     await cdp.send("Input.dispatchTouchEvent", {
  205 |       type: "touchStart",
  206 |       touchPoints: [{ ...start, id: 1 }],
  207 |     });
  208 |     await cdp.send("Input.dispatchTouchEvent", {
  209 |       type: "touchMove",
  210 |       touchPoints: [{ ...end, id: 1 }],
  211 |     });
  212 |     await cdp.send("Input.dispatchTouchEvent", {
  213 |       type: "touchEnd",
  214 |       touchPoints: [],
  215 |     });
  216 |     for (let frame = 0; frame < 750; frame++) {
  217 |       await page.clock.runFor(16);
  218 |       const s = (await state(page)).scene.game;
  219 |       if (s.shootable || s.phase === "result") return;
  220 |     }
  221 |     throw Error("Shot did not settle");
  222 |   }
  223 |   for (const [wait, vx, vy] of golfSolutions[3]) {
  224 |     await page.clock.runFor(Math.round(wait * 1000));
  225 |     await shot(vx, vy);
  226 |     if ((await state(page)).scene.game.phase === "result") break;
  227 |   }
  228 |   // Real browser frames can advance a few extra simulation steps after a ball settles.
  229 |   // Aim the final three legal putts from the measured resting position.
  230 |   for (const [x, y] of [
  231 |     [1745, 690],
  232 |     [1745, 570],
  233 |     [1560, 575],
  234 |   ]) {
  235 |     const s = (await state(page)).scene.game;
  236 |     if (s.phase === "result") break;
  237 |     const distance = Math.hypot(x - s.ball.x, y - s.ball.y),
  238 |       speed = Math.sqrt(220 * distance);
  239 |     await shot(
  240 |       ((x - s.ball.x) / distance) * speed,
  241 |       ((y - s.ball.y) / distance) * speed,
  242 |     );
  243 |   }
  244 |   const result = (await state(page)).scene.game;
  245 |   expect(result.status).toBe("won");
  246 |   expect(result.recoveries).toBe(0);
  247 |   expect(result.progress[3]).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  248 |   await page.clock.resume();
  249 |   await page.waitForTimeout(100);
  250 |   await page.screenshot({ path: "docs/golf-browser-completion.png" });
  251 |   await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Finish run", exact: true }).click();
  252 |   await expect(
  253 |     page.getByRole("button", { name: "Play again →" }),
  254 |   ).toBeVisible();
  255 |   expect((await state(page)).saved.rounds).toBe(0);
  256 |   await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Back to all games" }).click();
  257 |   await page.reload();
  258 |   await page
  259 |     .getByRole("button", { name: "Play Ultimate Golf", exact: true })
  260 |     .click();
  261 |   await expect
  262 |     .poll(async () => (await state(page)).scene.game?.progress?.[3])
  263 |     .toBe(result.progress[3]);
  264 |   await cdp.detach();
  265 | });

   18 |       if (!w.shootable) {

   20 |           w.tick(1 / 240);

   22 |         }
   23 |       }

    1 | import { it, expect } from "vitest";
    2 | import { courses } from "../../src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/courses";
    3 | import { GolfPhysics } from "../../src/games/mini-golf/ultimate/GolfPhysics";
    4 | const lane = (1920 - 196) / 6,
    5 |   c = (i: number) => 28 + i * (lane + 28) + lane / 2;
    6 | const routes = [
    7 |   [
    8 |     [c(0), 220],
    9 |     [c(1) + 110, 220],
   10 |     [c(1) + 110, 670],
   11 |     [c(1) - 100, 670],
   12 |     [c(1) - 100, 950],

   20 |     [c(5) - 120, 942],
   21 |     [c(5), 942],
   22 |   ],
   23 |   [
   24 |     [220, 990],
   25 |     [220, 220],
   26 |     [520, 220],
   27 |     [520, 970],
   28 |     [910, 970],
   29 |     [910, 220],
   30 |     [910, 150],
   31 |     [1340, 150],
   32 |     [1340, 930],

   36 |   ],

   41 |     [290, 340],
   42 |     [290, 590],
   43 |     [700, 600, 1205, 600],
   44 |     [1400, 575],
   45 |   ],
   46 |   [
   47 |     [520, 980],
   48 |     [790, 960],
   49 |     [1080, 960],
   50 |     [1080, 570],
   51 |     [1000, 570],
   52 |     [1260, 570],
   53 |     [1260, 220],
   54 |     [1810, 200],
   55 |     [1810, 950],
   56 |     [1770, 660],
   57 |     [1770, 570],
   58 |     [1560, 575],
   59 |   ],
   60 | ];
   61 | function clone(w: GolfPhysics) {
   62 |   const n = new GolfPhysics(w.course, w.difficulty, () => 0.9);
   63 |   Object.assign(n.ball, w.ball);
   64 |   n.lastShot = { ...w.lastShot };
   65 |   n.strokes = w.strokes;
   66 |   const d = n.dynamics,
   67 |     s = w.dynamics;
   68 |   d.time = s.time;
   69 |   d.gate = s.gate;
   70 |   d.plates = [...s.plates];
   71 |   d.doors = [...s.doors];
   72 |   d.planks = [...s.planks];
   73 |   d.portalCooldown = s.portalCooldown;
   74 |   d.ufo = { ...s.ufo };
   75 |   return n;
   76 | }
   77 | for (let course = 0; course < 4; course++)
   78 |   it(`full course route ${course + 1}`, () => {
   79 |     let w = new GolfPhysics(courses[course], 0, () => 0.9);
   80 |     const shots: number[][] = [];
   81 |     for (const [tx, ty, gx = tx, gy = ty] of routes[course]) {
   82 |       for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
   83 |         if (w.status === "won") break;
   84 |         const distance = Math.hypot(w.ball.x - tx, w.ball.y - ty);
   85 |         if (distance < 22) break;
   86 |         const angle = Math.atan2(ty - w.ball.y, tx - w.ball.x);
   87 |         let best: GolfPhysics | undefined,
   88 |           bestCost = Infinity,
   89 |           bestShot: number[] = [];
   90 |         for (const wait of course === 1
   91 |           ? [0, 0.6, 1.2, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
   92 |           : [0, 0.6, 1.2, 2])
   93 |           for (const da of [0, -0.03, 0.03, -0.08, 0.08, -0.18, 0.18])
   94 |             for (let power = 60; power <= 650; power += 15) {
   95 |               const trial = clone(w);
   96 |               for (let i = 0; i < wait * 240; i++) trial.tick(1 / 240);
   97 |               if (!trial.shootable) continue;
   98 |               const vx = Math.cos(angle + da) * power,
   99 |                 vy = Math.sin(angle + da) * power;
  100 |               trial.shoot(vx, vy);
  101 |               for (let i = 0; i < 240 * 12; i++) {
  102 |                 trial.tick(1 / 240);
  103 |                 if (trial.stopped || trial.status !== "playing") break;
  104 |               }
  105 |               const cost =
  106 |                 trial.status === "won"
  107 |                   ? -1e6
  108 |                   : Math.hypot(trial.ball.x - gx, trial.ball.y - gy) +
  109 |                     (trial.recoveries ? 1e5 : 0) +
  110 |                     (!trial.stopped ? 1e4 : 0);
  111 |               if (cost < bestCost) {
  112 |                 bestCost = cost;
  113 |                 best = trial;
  114 |                 bestShot = [wait, vx, vy];
  115 |               }
  116 |               if (cost < 2) break;
  117 |             }
  118 |         if (!best || bestCost >= distance - 1) break;
  119 |         w = best;
  120 |         shots.push(bestShot);
  121 |         console.log(
  122 |           course,
  123 |           "target",
  124 |           tx,
  125 |           ty,
  126 |           "at",
  127 |           w.ball.x,
  128 |           w.ball.y,
  129 |           "stroke",
  130 |           w.strokes,
  131 |           w.status,
  132 |         );
  133 |       }
  134 |     }
  135 |     console.log("ROUTE", course, JSON.stringify(shots));
  136 |     expect(w.status).toBe("won");
  137 |   }, 120000);

    9 | describe("Dots and Boxes", () => {
   10 |   it("maps every edge to a touch target and rejects blank space", () => {
   11 |     for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
   12 |       const p = edgeEnds(i);
   13 |       expect(pickEdge((p.x + p.x2) / 2, (p.y + p.y2) / 2)).toBe(i);
   14 |     }
   15 |     expect(pickEdge(0, 0)).toBe(-1);
   16 |   });
   17 |   it("rejects illegal and duplicate edges, claims two adjacent boxes and retains the turn", () => {
   18 |     const b = new DotsBoard();
   19 |     for (const e of [0, 1, 4, 5, 20, 22]) expect(b.play(e)).toBe(0);
   20 |     const p = b.turn;
   21 |     expect(b.play(21)).toBe(2);
   22 |     expect(b.scores[p - 1]).toBe(2);
   23 |     expect(b.turn).toBe(p);
   24 |     expect(b.play(21)).toBe(-1);
   25 |     expect(b.play(40)).toBe(-1);
   26 |     expect(b.play(NaN)).toBe(-1);
   27 |   });
   28 |   it("finishes exactly once with all 16 boxes owned and restores legal histories", () => {
   29 |     const b = new DotsBoard();
   30 |     for (let e = 0; e < 40; e++) b.play(e);
   31 |     expect(b.scores[0] + b.scores[1]).toBe(16);
   32 |     expect(b.owners.every(Boolean)).toBe(true);
   33 |     expect(b.winner).not.toBeNull();
   34 |     expect(b.play(0)).toBe(-1);
   35 |     expect(DotsBoard.restore(b.save())).toEqual(b);
   36 |     expect(DotsBoard.restore({ history: [0, 0] }).history).toEqual([]);
   37 |   });
   38 |   it("all difficulties capture an available box without modifying the input", () => {
   39 |     for (const d of ["medium", "hard", "impossible"] as const) {
   40 |       const b = new DotsBoard();
   41 |       [0, 4, 20].forEach((e) => b.play(e));
   42 |       const save = b.save(),
   43 |         p = chooseEdge(b, d);
   44 |       expect(b.save()).toEqual(save);
   45 |       expect(p.edge).toBe(21);
   46 |       expect(p.milliseconds).toBeLessThan(500);
   47 |     }
   48 |   });
   49 |   it("Impossible finds an exact terminal endgame and returns a legal move", () => {
   50 |     const b = new DotsBoard();
   51 |     for (let e = 0; e < 33; e++) b.play(e);
   52 |     const result = chooseEdge(b, "impossible");
   53 |     expect(b.legal()).toContain(result.edge);
   54 |     expect(result.depth).toBe(7);
   55 |   });
   56 |   it("scores agree with owned box geometry through 100 reproducible full games", () => {
   57 |     let seed = 123;
   58 |     for (let game = 0; game < 100; game++) {
   59 |       const b = new DotsBoard();
   60 |       while (!b.winner) {
   61 |         seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
   62 |         const legal = b.legal();
   63 |         b.play(legal[seed % legal.length]);
   64 |         b.owners.forEach((p, i) => {
   65 |           if (p) expect(boxes[i].every((e) => b.edges[e])).toBe(true);
   66 |         });
   67 |       }
   68 |       expect(b.scores).toEqual([
   69 |         b.owners.filter((p) => p === 1).length,
   70 |         b.owners.filter((p) => p === 2).length,
   71 |       ]);
   72 |     }
   73 |   });
   74 |   it("supports 4x4, 5x5, and 6x6 board sizes with exact geometry and AI compatibility", () => {
   75 |     for (const size of [4, 5, 6] as const) {
   76 |       const b = new DotsBoard(size);
   77 |       const expectedBoxes = size * size;
   78 |       const expectedEdges = 2 * (size + 1) * size;
   79 |       expect(b.totalBoxes).toBe(expectedBoxes);
   80 |       expect(b.totalEdges).toBe(expectedEdges);
   81 |       expect(b.edges.length).toBe(expectedEdges);
   82 |       expect(b.owners.length).toBe(expectedBoxes);
   83 | 
   84 |       // Verify touch target mapping for every edge on this board size
   85 |       for (let i = 0; i < expectedEdges; i++) {
   86 |         const p = edgeEnds(i, size);
   87 |         expect(pickEdge((p.x + p.x2) / 2, (p.y + p.y2) / 2, size)).toBe(i);
   88 |       }
   89 | 
   90 |       // Play edges until the game finishes
   91 |       for (let e = 0; e < expectedEdges; e++) b.play(e);
   92 |       expect(b.scores[0] + b.scores[1]).toBe(expectedBoxes);
   93 |       expect(b.owners.every(Boolean)).toBe(true);
   94 |       expect(b.winner).not.toBeNull();
   95 | 
   96 |       // Serialization and restore preserve size
   97 |       const restored = DotsBoard.restore(b.save());
   98 |       expect(restored.size).toBe(size);
   99 |       expect(restored.totalBoxes).toBe(expectedBoxes);
  100 |       expect(restored.totalEdges).toBe(expectedEdges);
  101 |       expect(restored).toEqual(b);
  102 | 
  103 |       // AI plays legal moves on new board sizes
  104 |       const fresh = new DotsBoard(size);
  105 |       fresh.play(0);
  106 |       const move = chooseEdge(fresh, "medium");
  107 |       expect(fresh.legal()).toContain(move.edge);
  108 |     }
  109 |   });
  110 | });

## tests/unit/lumberjack.test.ts
SHA-256: d34954edbcc51f8cfffffab7461ac267be3d151278d4cce4282bdd7340f1ba4f
~~~text
    1 | import {it,expect} from 'vitest';import {LumberMatch,branches} from '../../src/games/lumberjack/Rules';import {LumberAI} from '../../src/games/lumberjack/AI';
    2 | it('Lumberjack seeded streams always leave at least one legal chopping side',()=>{for(let seed=0;seed<100;seed++){const a=branches(seed);expect(a).toEqual(branches(seed));for(let i=0;i<a.length-1;i++)expect((a[i]!==-1&&a[i+1]!==-1)||(a[i]!==1&&a[i+1]!==1)).toBe(true);}});
    3 | it('Lumberjack counts one valid chop, rejects repeats and detects branches',()=>{const m=new LumberMatch(4);expect(m.chop(0,-1)).toBe(true);expect(m.chop(0,-1)).toBeNull();m.update(.1);m.pattern[1]=-1;expect(m.chop(0,-1)).toBe(false);expect(m.players[0].alive).toBe(false);expect(m.players[0].score).toBe(1);});
    4 | it('Lumberjack runs exactly three base rounds and adds sudden death on a tie',()=>{const m=new LumberMatch();for(let i=0;i<3;i++){m.update(2);if(i<2)m.update(2);}expect(m.round).toBe(3);expect(m.phase).toBe('between');m.update(2);expect(m.round).toBe(4);m.chop(0,-1);m.update(2);expect(m.winner).toBe(1);expect(m.totals).toEqual([1,0]);});
    5 | it('Lumberjack AI uses legal chop timing, finishes a three-round match and respects pause-by-update',()=>{for(const d of ['medium','hard','impossible'] as const){const m=new LumberMatch(9),ai=new LumberAI(d,()=>.5);for(let i=0;i<10000&&!m.winner;i++){m.update(1/60);const side=ai.update(1/60,m);if(side)m.chop(1,side);}expect(m.winner).toBe(2);expect(m.round).toBe(3);expect(m.totals[1]).toBeGreaterThan(0);}});
~~~

  128 |       } else if (q.questionLatex.includes('frac')) {
  129 |         const [dividend, divisor] = q.questionLatex.match(/\d+/g)!.map(Number);
  130 |         expect(Number(correctOpt)).toBe(dividend / divisor);
  131 |       }
  132 |     } else if (q.topic === 'Percentages') {
  133 |       const [pct, base] = q.questionLatex.match(/\d+/g)!.map(Number);
  134 |       expect(Number(correctOpt)).toBe((pct * base) / 100);
  135 |     } else if (q.topic === 'Precedence') {
  136 |       const [a, b, c] = q.questionLatex.match(/\d+/g)!.map(Number);
  137 |       expect(Number(correctOpt)).toBe(a + b * c);
  138 |     } else if (q.topic === 'Fractions') {
  139 |       // Fraction addition: a/den + b/den = (a+b)/den

  141 |       expect(den1).toBe(den2);
  142 |       expect(correctOpt).toContain(String(a + b) === String(den1) ? '1' : '');
  143 |     }

  145 |     // Verify KaTeX renders for sample of questions to keep test ultra-fast
  146 |     if (i < 200) {
  147 |       for (const part of [q.questionLatex, ...q.optionsLatex, q.explanationLatex]) {
  148 |         expect(() => katex.renderToString(part, { throwOnError: true, strict: 'ignore' })).not.toThrow();
  149 |       }

  151 |   }

## tests/unit/spike-controls.test.ts

   42 |   // Disconnecting Orange must not steal Blue\'s controller assignment.

## tests/unit/turn-view.test.ts
SHA-256: caaf2eab99a87874059fd75474aec032cfd20edf184383357dcf92d5291202a6
~~~text
    1 | import { it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
    2 | import { TurnView, turnBackground } from "../../src/shared/components/TurnView";
    3 | it("turn view rotates module content, inverts input, blocks transition, and destroys owned objects", () => {
    4 |   const root = {
    5 |     add: vi.fn(),
    6 |     setRotation: vi.fn(),
    7 |     setAlpha: vi.fn(),
    8 |     destroy: vi.fn(),
    9 |   };
   10 |   const scene = { add: { container: vi.fn(() => root) } };
   11 |   const child = { x: 60, y: 541, setPosition: vi.fn() };
   12 |   const view = new TurnView(scene as any, [child as any]);
   13 |   expect(child.setPosition).toHaveBeenCalledWith(-150, 160);
   14 |   expect(view.point(60, 541)).toEqual({ x: 60, y: 541 });
   15 |   view.set(true);
   16 |   expect(view.ready).toBe(false);
   17 |   view.update(0.15);
   18 |   expect(view.rotation).toBe(Math.PI);
   19 |   view.update(0.15);
   20 |   expect(view.ready).toBe(true);
   21 |   expect(view.point(360, 221)).toEqual({ x: 60, y: 541 });
   22 |   view.set(false);
   23 |   view.update(0.3);
   24 |   expect(view.point(60, 541)).toEqual({ x: 60, y: 541 });
   25 |   expect(turnBackground(1)).not.toBe(turnBackground(2));
   26 |   view.destroy();
   27 |   expect(root.destroy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(true);
   28 | });

  227 |           if (w.shootable && i % 240 === 0)
  228 |             w.shoot(Math.sin(i) * 650, Math.cos(i) * 650);
  229 |           w.tick(1 / 240);
  230 |           expect(
  231 |             Number.isFinite(w.ball.x + w.ball.y + w.ball.vx + w.ball.vy),
  232 |           ).toBe(true);
  233 |           expect(Math.hypot(w.ball.vx, w.ball.vy)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(650.001);
  234 |         }
  235 |       }
  236 |   }, 30000);
  237 | });
~~~
